/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - DOUBLE-ENTRY JOURNAL & FINANCIAL PERIOD ENGINE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-003, POL-004, POL-008, Section 6.3, REQ-015, REQ-072
 * Wired strictly to hydrated JournalEntries, JournalEntryLines, and FinancialPeriods headers.
 */

/**
 * Checks whether a posting date falls inside an OPEN (non-closed) FinancialPeriod (POL-008 / Section 6.11).
 * If FinancialPeriods has no rows configured yet during bootstrap, permits posting with a warning note.
 */
function ksAssertOpenFinancialPeriod_(postingDateStr) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const fpSheet = ss.getSheetByName('FinancialPeriods');
  if (!fpSheet || fpSheet.getLastRow() < 2) return { period_id: 'UNCONFIGURED_BOOTSTRAP', is_closed: false };

  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(fpSheet, ['period_id', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'is_closed']);
  const rows = fpSheet.getRange(2, 1, fpSheet.getLastRow() - 1, fpSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  const target = new Date(postingDateStr);

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const start = new Date(rows[i][headerMap['start_date'] - 1]);
    const end = new Date(rows[i][headerMap['end_date'] - 1]);
    if (target >= start && target <= end) {
      const closedVal = String(rows[i][headerMap['is_closed'] - 1]).trim().toUpperCase();
      const isClosed = (closedVal === 'TRUE' || closedVal === 'YES' || closedVal === '1');
      if (isClosed) {
        throw new Error(
          'Period Lock Violation: Date ' + postingDateStr + ' falls in closed period "' +
          rows[i][headerMap['period_id'] - 1] + '" (POL-008 / Section 6.11).'
        );
      }
      return { period_id: String(rows[i][headerMap['period_id'] - 1]), is_closed: false };
    }
  }
  return { period_id: 'NO_MATCHING_PERIOD', is_closed: false };
}

/**
 * Posts a balanced double-entry Journal Voucher (POL-008: Total Debit === Total Credit).
 * Note: Uses exact hydrated header spelling "journal_entrie_id" in JournalEntries.
 */
function ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS], 'ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.record_date) throw new Error('record_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is required.');
  if (!Array.isArray(payload.lines) || payload.lines.length < 2) {
    throw new Error('A double-entry journal voucher requires at least 2 lines.');
  }

  // 1. Enforce Open Financial Period
  const periodInfo = ksAssertOpenFinancialPeriod_(payload.record_date);

  // 2. Enforce exact Debit === Credit balance in integer paise (Section 3.4 & POL-008)
  let totalDebitPaise = 0;
  let totalCreditPaise = 0;

  payload.lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
    const side = String(line.dr_cr || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const amt = Number(line.amount);
    if (!['DEBIT', 'CREDIT'].includes(side)) {
      throw new Error('Line ' + (idx + 1) + ': dr_cr must be DEBIT or CREDIT.');
    }
    if (!(amt > 0)) {
      throw new Error('Line ' + (idx + 1) + ': amount must be > 0.');
    }
    const paise = Math.round(amt * 100);
    if (side === 'DEBIT') totalDebitPaise += paise;
    if (side === 'CREDIT') totalCreditPaise += paise;
  });

  if (totalDebitPaise !== totalCreditPaise) {
    const errMsg = 'Unbalanced Journal Voucher: Debit INR ' + (totalDebitPaise / 100).toFixed(2) +
      ' != Credit INR ' + (totalCreditPaise / 100).toFixed(2) + ' (POL-008).';
    ksLogException_('CRITICAL', 'ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher', 'JournalEntries', payload.nonce, errMsg, payload);
    throw new Error(errMsg);
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const jvAlloc = ksAllocateId('JournalEntries', payload.nonce + '_JV');
  const jvId = jvAlloc.allocated_id;
  const totalRupees = totalDebitPaise / 100;

  const jvHeader = {
    record_id: jvId,
    journal_entrie_id: jvId,
    reference_type: payload.reference_type || 'MANUAL_JV',
    reference_id: payload.reference_id || '',
    record_date: payload.record_date,
    description: String(payload.description || '').trim(),
    quantity: payload.lines.length,
    unit: 'LINES',
    amount: totalRupees,
    owner_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Period=' + periodInfo.period_id + (payload.notes ? ' | ' + payload.notes : '')
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'JournalEntries', jvHeader, 'journal_entrie_id', ['journal_entrie_id', 'record_date', 'amount']);

  payload.lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
    const side = String(line.dr_cr).trim().toUpperCase();
    const amt = Math.round(Number(line.amount) * 100) / 100;
    const lineAlloc = ksAllocateId('JournalEntryLines', payload.nonce + '_JVL_' + (idx + 1));

    const lineRecord = {
      record_id: lineAlloc.allocated_id,
      journal_entry_line_id: lineAlloc.allocated_id,
      parent_record_id: jvId,
      line_number: idx + 1,
      item_type: side, // DEBIT or CREDIT
      item_id: String(line.account_code || '').trim(),
      description: String(line.description || payload.description || '').trim(),
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'INR',
      unit_rate: amt,
      tax_rate: Number(line.tax_rate) || 0,
      line_amount: side === 'DEBIT' ? amt : -amt, // Signed net amount for instant Trial Balance SUM = 0 check
      status: 'POSTED',
      created_at: nowIso,
      created_by: ctx.user_id,
      notes: line.cost_centre || ''
    };

    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'JournalEntryLines', lineRecord, 'journal_entry_line_id', ['journal_entry_line_id', 'parent_record_id', 'item_id']);
  });

  ksLogAudit_('JOURNAL_VOUCHER_POSTED', 'JournalEntries', jvId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'amount',
    new_value: 'INR ' + totalRupees.toFixed(2),
    reason: jvHeader.description,
    related_record_id: jvHeader.reference_id
  });

  return { success: true, journal_voucher_id: jvId, balanced_amount: totalRupees, line_count: payload.lines.length };
}

/**
 * End-to-End Phase G Disposable-Copy Verification Test for Sales + Receipt + Double-Entry Posting.
 */
function ksRunPhaseGSalesAndAccountingTest() {
  const today = ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);

  // 1. Create Sales Order
  const so = ksCreateSalesOrder({
    nonce: 'TEST_SO_001',
    customer_id: 'CUST-20261118-00001',
    customer_name_snapshot: 'Shree Balaji Kirana Store',
    channel_id: 'RETAIL_FIELD',
    items: [
      { product_id: 'PRD-MMP', sku: 'KS-MMP-200', product_name_snapshot: 'Moong Master Papad 200g', pack_weight_g: 200, quantity: 20, unit_price: 55 }
    ]
  });

  // 2. Issue Distinct Sales Invoice
  const inv = ksCreateSalesInvoice({
    nonce: 'TEST_INV_001',
    sales_order_id: so.sales_order_id,
    customer_id: 'CUST-20261118-00001',
    invoice_date: today,
    taxable_value: so.grand_total,
    items: [
      { item_id: 'KS-MMP-200', description: 'Moong Master Papad 200g', quantity: 20, unit: 'PKT', unit_rate: 55, line_amount: so.grand_total }
    ]
  });

  // 3. Record Customer Receipt & Invoice Allocation
  const rcpt = ksRecordCustomerReceiptAndAllocation({
    nonce: 'TEST_RCPT_001',
    customer_id: 'CUST-20261118-00001',
    sales_order_id: so.sales_order_id,
    sales_invoice_id: inv.sales_invoice_id,
    payment_date: today,
    payment_method_id: 'UPI',
    amount_received: inv.invoice_total,
    transaction_reference: 'UTR-TEST-998877'
  });

  // 4. Post Balanced Double-Entry Journal Voucher
  const jv = ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher({
    nonce: 'TEST_JV_001',
    reference_type: 'SALES_INVOICE',
    reference_id: inv.sales_invoice_id,
    record_date: today,
    description: 'Sales & UPI receipt posting for ' + inv.sales_invoice_id,
    lines: [
      { dr_cr: 'DEBIT', account_code: '1120-BANK-UPI', amount: inv.invoice_total, description: 'UPI receipt ' + rcpt.customer_payment_id },
      { dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: '4100-PRODUCT-SALES', amount: inv.invoice_total, description: 'Sales revenue ' + inv.sales_invoice_id }
    ]
  });

  Logger.log('Phase G Sales & Accounting Test Passed: ' + JSON.stringify({ so: so, inv: inv, rcpt: rcpt, jv: jv }));
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - AUDIT LOGGER, EXCEPTION REGISTER & GOVERNANCE BOOTSTRAP
 * Aligned to verified AuditLog (12 cols) and ExceptionRegister (14 cols)
 * Enforces REQ-103, REQ-108, REQ-109, Section 11.5
 */

/**
 * Safely initializes ONLY missing governance tabs (AuditLog, ExceptionRegister)
 * in a disposable copy without touching existing data tabs (POL-018).
 */
function ksInitGovernanceTabs() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const governanceTabs = ['AuditLog', 'ExceptionRegister'];
  const created = [];

  governanceTabs.forEach(tabName => {
    let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sheet) {
      sheet = ss.insertSheet(tabName);
      const headers = KS_CONFIG.REQUIRED_HEADERS[tabName];
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
      created.push(tabName);
    }
  });

  return { initialized: created, timestamp: ksNowIso_() };
}

/**
 * Resolves the active Google user's email to a user_id in the Users tab if present,
 * otherwise records their email safely without exposing PII/secrets (POL-012).
 */
function ksResolveActorId_() {
  const email = ksGetActorEmail_();
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const userSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.USERS);
    if (!userSheet || userSheet.getLastRow() < 2) return email;

    const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(userSheet, ['user_id']);
    const emailCol = headerMap['email'] || headerMap['work_email'] || headerMap['login_email'];
    if (!emailCol) return email;

    const data = userSheet.getRange(2, 1, userSheet.getLastRow() - 1, userSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      if (String(data[i][emailCol - 1] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) {
        return String(data[i][headerMap['user_id'] - 1]);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Fallback to email if Users lookup is not yet populated
  }
  return email;
}

/**
 * Appends an immutable field/record audit entry aligned to the 12-column AuditLog schema.
 */
function ksLogAudit_(action, entityType, entityId, opts) {
  const o = opts || {};
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT_LOG)) return;

    const alloc = ksAllocateId(KS_CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT_LOG, 'AUD_' + Utilities.getUuid());
    const auditRecord = {
      audit_id: alloc.allocated_id,
      event_datetime: ksNowIso_(),
      actor_user_id: o.actor_user_id || ksResolveActorId_(),
      action: action,
      entity_type: entityType,
      entity_id: entityId || '',
      field_changed: o.field_changed || '*',
      old_value: o.old_value !== undefined ? String(o.old_value) : '',
      new_value: o.new_value !== undefined ? String(o.new_value) : '',
      reason: o.reason || '',
      approved_by_user_id: o.approved_by_user_id || '',
      related_record_id: o.related_record_id || ''
    };

    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(
      ss,
      KS_CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT_LOG,
      auditRecord,
      'audit_id',
      ['audit_id', 'event_datetime', 'actor_user_id', 'action', 'entity_type']
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('CRITICAL AUDIT FAILURE: ' + e.message);
  }
}

/**
 * Records a failed write, validation breach, or reconciliation mismatch (REQ-109).
 */
function ksLogException_(severity, sourceFunction, tabName, referenceId, errorMessage, payloadObj) {
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTION_REGISTER)) return;

    const alloc = ksAllocateId(KS_CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTION_REGISTER, 'EXC_' + Utilities.getUuid());
    const excRecord = {
      exception_id: alloc.allocated_id,
      created_at: ksNowIso_(),
      severity: severity || 'HIGH',
      source_function: sourceFunction,
      tab_name: tabName || '',
      reference_id: referenceId || '',
      error_message: String(errorMessage),
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(payloadObj || {}),
      assigned_owner: 'OWNER_ADMIN',
      due_date: '',
      status: 'OPEN',
      resolution_notes: '',
      resolved_by: '',
      resolved_at: ''
    };

    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(
      ss,
      KS_CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTION_REGISTER,
      excRecord,
      'exception_id',
      ['exception_id', 'created_at', 'severity', 'source_function', 'error_message', 'status']
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('CRITICAL EXCEPTION LOGGING FAILURE: ' + e.message);
  }
}

/**
 * Phase G Disposable-Copy Verification Test:
 * Tests schema headers, ID allocation, idempotency retry safety, and AuditLog write.
 */
function ksRunPhaseGCoreTest() {
  ksInitGovernanceTabs();
  const testNonce = 'TEST_NONCE_001';
  const firstCall = ksAllocateId('Customers', testNonce);
  const retryCall = ksAllocateId('Customers', testNonce);

  if (firstCall.allocated_id !== retryCall.allocated_id || retryCall.status !== 'EXISTING_IDEMPOTENT') {
    throw new Error('Idempotency test failed!');
  }

  ksLogAudit_('ID_ALLOC_TEST', 'IdAllocations', firstCall.allocated_id, {
    field_changed: 'allocated_id',
    new_value: firstCall.allocated_id,
    reason: 'Phase G Core Verification Test (nonce=' + testNonce + ')',
    related_record_id: firstCall.allocation_id
  });

  Logger.log('Phase G Core Test Passed: ' + JSON.stringify(retryCall));
}

/**
 * Read-only inventory of all existing tabs and column/row counts (Phase B).
 */
function ksListAllExistingTabs() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const summary = ss.getSheets().map(s => s.getName() + ' (cols=' + s.getLastColumn() + ', rows=' + s.getLastRow() + ')');
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL, MENU & SIDEBAR CONTROLLER
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-011, POL-012, POL-015, Section 10.1, Section 11.4, Section 12
 */

const KS_ROLES = Object.freeze({
  OWNER_ADMIN: 'OWNER_ADMIN',
  PA: 'PA',
  ACCOUNTS: 'ACCOUNTS',
  PROCUREMENT: 'PROCUREMENT',
  STORE: 'STORE',
  PRODUCTION: 'PRODUCTION',
  QUALITY: 'QUALITY',
  PACKAGING: 'PACKAGING',
  SALES: 'SALES',
  FIELD_SALESMAN: 'FIELD_SALESMAN',
  HR: 'HR',
  AUDITOR: 'AUDITOR'
});

/**
 * Resolves the current logged-in user's record and active role from the Users tab.
 * Fails closed (returns UNAUTHORIZED) if user is missing or inactive (POL-012).
 */
function ksGetCurrentUserContext_() {
  const email = ksGetActorEmail_();
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const ownerEmail = ss.getOwner() ? ss.getOwner().getEmail() : '';

  const userSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.USERS);
  if (userSheet && userSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(userSheet, ['user_id']);
    const emailCol = headerMap['email'] || headerMap['work_email'] || headerMap['login_email'];
    const roleCol = headerMap['role'] || headerMap['user_role'] || headerMap['role_code'];
    const activeCol = headerMap['active'] || headerMap['is_active'] || headerMap['status'];
    const nameCol = headerMap['full_name'] || headerMap['name'] || headerMap['user_name'];

    if (emailCol && roleCol) {
      const data = userSheet.getRange(2, 1, userSheet.getLastRow() - 1, userSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        const rowEmail = String(data[i][emailCol - 1] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (rowEmail === email.toLowerCase()) {
          const activeVal = activeCol ? String(data[i][activeCol - 1]).trim().toUpperCase() : 'TRUE';
          const isActive = (activeVal === 'TRUE' || activeVal === 'YES' || activeVal === 'ACTIVE' || activeVal === '1');
          return {
            authenticated: isActive,
            user_id: String(data[i][headerMap['user_id'] - 1]),
            name: nameCol ? String(data[i][nameCol - 1]) : email,
            email: email,
            role: isActive ? String(data[i][roleCol - 1]).trim().toUpperCase() : 'INACTIVE'
          };
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Spreadsheet owner fallback during initial clean-database bootstrap (POL-017)
  if (ownerEmail && email.toLowerCase() === ownerEmail.toLowerCase()) {
    return {
      authenticated: true,
      user_id: 'OWNER_BOOTSTRAP',
      name: 'Owner Admin',
      email: email,
      role: KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN
    };
  }

  return {
    authenticated: false,
    user_id: 'UNREGISTERED',
    name: email,
    email: email,
    role: 'UNAUTHORIZED'
  };
}

/**
 * Enforces role permission before executing any protected workflow (Section 10.1 & 11.2).
 */
function ksRequireRole_(allowedRoles, actionName) {
  const ctx = ksGetCurrentUserContext_();
  if (!ctx.authenticated || !allowedRoles.includes(ctx.role)) {
    const msg = 'Access Denied for "' + actionName + '": User ' + ctx.email +
      ' (Role: ' + ctx.role + ') lacks required role [' + allowedRoles.join(', ') + '].';
    ksLogException_('HIGH', actionName, 'Users', ctx.email, msg, { role: ctx.role });
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  return ctx;
}

/**
 * Builds the role-aware Kawad Swad ERP menu when the spreadsheet opens (Section 11.4).
 */
function onOpen() {
  let ui;
  try {
    ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  } catch (e) {
    Logger.log('onOpen skipped UI build (not in active spreadsheet UI context).');
    return;
  }

  const ctx = ksGetCurrentUserContext_();
  const menu = ui.createMenu('Kawad Swad ERP');

  if (!ctx.authenticated) {
    menu.addItem('Access Status (Unauthorized)', 'ksUiShowWhoAmI').addToUi();
    return;
  }

  menu.addItem('Open Operations Sidebar', 'ksUiOpenOperationsSidebar');
  menu.addItem('My Session & Role (' + ctx.role + ')', 'ksUiShowWhoAmI');
  menu.addSeparator();

  const r = ctx.role;
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.STORE, KS_ROLES.PROCUREMENT].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('1. Purchase / Material Receipt', 'ksUiOpenPurchaseForm');
  }
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('2. Production Batch Entry', 'ksUiOpenProductionForm');
  }
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.QUALITY].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('3. Quality Release / Hold', 'ksUiOpenQualityForm');
  }
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PACKAGING].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('4. Packaging Batch (SKUs)', 'ksUiOpenPackagingForm');
  }
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.SALES, KS_ROLES.FIELD_SALESMAN].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('5. Sales Order & Invoice', 'ksUiOpenSalesForm');
  }
  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS, KS_ROLES.FIELD_SALESMAN].includes(r)) {
    menu.addItem('6. Customer Receipt / Expense', 'ksUiOpenFinanceForm');
  }

  // Management Reports submenu (Section 12)
  menu.addSeparator();
  menu.addSubMenu(
    ui.createMenu('Management Reports')
      .addItem('Refresh All Core Reports', 'ksUiRefreshAllReports')
      .addItem('Generate Trial Balance (RPT_TrialBalance)', 'ksUiGenTrialBalance')
      .addItem('Generate Lot Stock Status (RPT_StockStatus)', 'ksUiGenStockStatus')
      .addItem('Generate Sales & Receivables (RPT_SalesAndReceivables)', 'ksUiGenSalesReceivables')
  );

  if ([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.AUDITOR].includes(r)) {
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addSubMenu(
      ui.createMenu('System & Governance')
        .addItem('Run Full Schema Health Check', 'ksUiRunSchemaHealthCheck')
        .addItem('Inspect Users Table Headers', 'ksInspectUsersHeaders')
    );
  }

  menu.addToUi();
}

function ksOpenSidebarWithTab_(defaultTab) {
  const ctx = ksGetCurrentUserContext_();
  if (!ctx.authenticated) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Access Denied', 'Your account (' + ctx.email + ') is not authorized.', SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
    return;
  }
  const tpl = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('ErpSidebar');
  tpl.userContext = JSON.stringify(ctx);
  tpl.defaultTab = defaultTab || 'purchase';
  const html = tpl.evaluate()
    .setTitle('Kawad Swad ERP')
    .setWidth(380);
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().showSidebar(html);
}

function ksUiSubmitExpenseVoucher(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS], 'ksUiSubmitExpenseVoucher');
  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  const amount = Number(payload.amount);
  if (!(amount > 0)) throw new Error('Expense amount must be greater than 0.');
  if (!payload.expense_account || !payload.payment_account || !payload.payee) {
    throw new Error('Payee, expense category/account, and payment mode/account are required.');
  }

  return ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher({
    nonce: payload.nonce,
    reference_type: 'EXPENSE_VOUCHER',
    reference_id: payload.voucher_ref || ('EXP-' + payload.expense_date),
    record_date: payload.expense_date,
    description: 'Expense: ' + payload.payee + ' - ' + (payload.purpose || ''),
    notes: 'Recorded via ERP Sidebar by ' + ctx.user_id,
    lines: [
      { dr_cr: 'DEBIT', account_code: payload.expense_account, amount: amount, description: payload.purpose || payload.payee },
      { dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: payload.payment_account, amount: amount, description: 'Paid via ' + payload.payment_account }
    ]
  });
}

function ksUiSubmitSalesEntry(payload) {
  const so = ksCreateSalesOrder(payload);
  let inv = null;
  if (payload.issue_invoice_now) {
    const today = ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);
    inv = ksCreateSalesInvoice({
      nonce: payload.nonce + '_AUTO_INV',
      sales_order_id: so.sales_order_id,
      customer_id: payload.customer_id,
      invoice_date: today,
      taxable_value: so.grand_total,
      notes: payload.notes || '',
      items: payload.items.map(it => ({
        item_type: 'PACKAGED_SKU',
        item_id: it.sku || it.product_id,
        description: it.product_name_snapshot || it.sku,
        quantity: it.quantity,
        unit: 'PKT',
        unit_rate: it.unit_price,
        tax_rate: it.tax_rate || 0,
        line_amount: Number(it.quantity) * Number(it.unit_price)
      }))
    });
  }
  return { success: true, sales_order: so, sales_invoice: inv };
}

function ksSchema_() {
  const d = JSON.parse(KS_SCHEMA_JSON);
  if (d.tables.length !== 218 || d.fields.length !== 3074) {
    throw new Error('Embedded schema integrity check failed. Expected 218 tables and 3,074 fields; found ' + d.tables.length + ' tables and ' + d.fields.length + ' fields.');
  }
  return d;
}

function onOpen() { ksBuildMasterMenu_(); }

function ksRunPreflight() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const live = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (!live) throw new Error('No active spreadsheet. Open the bound Kawad Swad ERP spreadsheet and run this function there.');
    const schema = ksSchema_();
    const report = ksCompareSchema_(live, schema);
    ksWriteRows_(live, KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_AUDIT_TAB, report.auditHeaders, report.auditRows);
    ksWriteRows_(live, KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_MAPPING_TAB, report.mappingHeaders, report.mappingRows);
    ksWriteRows_(live, KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_DECISION_TAB, report.decisionHeaders, report.decisionRows);
    ksLog_('PREFLIGHT_COMPLETED', 'Read-only schema comparison completed using embedded v2.0 schema.', {
      liveSpreadsheet: live.getName(), liveTabs: live.getSheets().length,
      canonicalTables: report.tableCount, canonicalFields: report.fieldCount,
      exactFieldMatches: report.exactMatches, missingTabs: report.missingTabs,
      missingFields: report.missingFields, ambiguousFields: report.ambiguousFields
    });
    ksNotify_('Preflight completed. Live spreadsheet: ' + live.getName() +
      '; canonical tables: ' + report.tableCount +
      '; canonical fields: ' + report.fieldCount +
      '; exact matches: ' + report.exactMatches +
      '; missing tabs: ' + report.missingTabs +
      '; missing fields: ' + report.missingFields +
      '; duplicate headers: ' + report.ambiguousFields +
      '. Review KS_SCHEMA_AUDIT, KS_FIELD_MAPPING and KS_OPEN_DECISIONS.');
    return report;
  } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
}

function ksCreateBackup() {
  const live = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!live) throw new Error('No active spreadsheet.');
  const file = DriveApp.getFileById(live.getId());
  const tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Kolkata';
  const stamp = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), tz, 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
  const name = file.getName() + '_BACKUP_BEFORE_ERP_IMPLEMENTATION_' + stamp;
  const backup = file.makeCopy(name);
  ksLog_('BACKUP_CREATED', 'Full Drive copy created; verify it before any structural implementation.',
    {backupName:name, backupUrl:backup.getUrl(), backupFileId:backup.getId()});
  ksNotify_('Backup created. Verify this copy before proceeding: ' + backup.getUrl());
  return backup.getUrl();
}

function ksApplySafeFoundation() {
  const live = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const defs = [
    [KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_AUDIT_TAB, ['Check','Result','Details','Checked At']],
    [KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_MAPPING_TAB, ['Canonical Table','Canonical Field','Recommended Type','Required Rule','Uniqueness','Relationship Note','Plain-language Meaning','Confidence','Review Finding','Live Tab Exists','Exact Header Match','Mapping Status','Observed Live Headers','Recommended Action']],
    [KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_LOG_TAB, ['Timestamp','Version','Event','Message','Details JSON']],
    [KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_DECISION_TAB, ['Decision ID','Decision Topic','Recommended Design','Approval / Evidence Required','Current Status']]
  ];
  defs.forEach(function(x) {
    let sh = live.getSheetByName(x[0]);
    if (!sh) sh = live.insertSheet(x[0]);
    if (sh.getLastRow() === 0) {
      sh.getRange(1,1,1,x[1].length).setValues([x[1]]);
      sh.setFrozenRows(1); sh.getRange(1,1,1,x[1].length).setFontWeight('bold');
    }
  });
  ksRunPreflight();
  ksLog_('SAFE_FOUNDATION_APPLIED','Created/verified KS_* report tabs only. Business tabs and records were not changed.',{});
  ksNotify_('Safe foundation completed. Only KS_* report tabs were created or verified. No business tables or records were changed.');
}

function ksBuildFieldMapping() {
  const live = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const report = ksCompareSchema_(live, ksSchema_());
  ksWriteRows_(live, KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_MAPPING_TAB, report.mappingHeaders, report.mappingRows);
  ksLog_('FIELD_MAPPING_REBUILT','Exact-header mapping report rebuilt from embedded schema.',{canonicalFields:report.fieldCount,exactFieldMatches:report.exactMatches,missingTabs:report.missingTabs,missingFields:report.missingFields,ambiguousFields:report.ambiguousFields});
  ksNotify_('Field mapping rebuilt. Review KS_FIELD_MAPPING.');
}

function ksCompareSchema_(live, schema) {
  const liveSheets = live.getSheets();
  const liveByName = {};
  liveSheets.forEach(sh => liveByName[sh.getName()] = sh);
  const canonical = {};
  schema.tables.forEach(r => canonical[r[1]] = r);
  const headersByTable = {};
  Object.keys(canonical).forEach(name => {
    const sh = liveByName[name];
    if (sh) {
      const width = Math.max(sh.getLastColumn(),1);
      headersByTable[name] = sh.getRange(KS_IMPL.HEADER_ROW,1,1,width).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v || '').trim());
    }
  });
  const mapHeaders = ['Canonical Table','Canonical Field','Recommended Type','Required Rule','Uniqueness','Relationship Note','Plain-language Meaning','Confidence','Review Finding','Live Tab Exists','Exact Header Match','Mapping Status','Observed Live Headers','Recommended Action'];
  const mapRows=[]; let exact=0,missingTabs=0,missingFields=0,ambiguous=0;
  schema.fields.forEach(r => {
    const table=r[0], field=r[1], exists=!!liveByName[table], headers=headersByTable[table] || [];
    const matches=headers.filter(h => h === field);
    let status,action,match='';
    if (!exists) {status='MISSING_TAB';action='REVIEW_BEFORE_CREATE';missingTabs++;}
    else if (matches.length===1) {status='EXACT_MATCH';action='KEEP_AS_IS';match=matches[0];exact++;}
    else if (matches.length>1) {status='AMBIGUOUS_DUPLICATE_HEADER';action='MANUAL_REVIEW';ambiguous++;}
    else {status='NO_EXACT_HEADER_MATCH';action='REVIEW_ALIAS_OR_ADD_AFTER_APPROVAL';missingFields++;}
    mapRows.push([table,field,r[2],r[3],r[4],r[5],r[6],r[7],r[8],exists?'YES':'NO',match,status,headers.join(' | '),action]);
  });
  const now=new Date();
  const auditRows=[
    ['Script version',KS_IMPL.VERSION,'Embedded v2.0 schema; no external blueprint spreadsheet required',now],
    ['Live spreadsheet',live.getName(),live.getId(),now],
    ['Live tab count',liveSheets.length,'Existing tabs are preserved',now],
    ['Canonical table count',Object.keys(canonical).length,'Embedded schema integrity checked',now],
    ['Canonical field count',mapRows.length,'Embedded schema integrity checked',now],
    ['Exact field matches',exact,'Exact header text only; no fuzzy alias guessing',now],
    ['Missing canonical tabs',missingTabs,'Not created automatically',now],
    ['Fields without exact match',missingFields,'Require mapping decision',now],
    ['Duplicate exact headers',ambiguous,'Require manual review',now],
    ['Business data writes','NONE','No transactions, stock, finance or payroll changed',now],
    ['Destructive operations','NONE','No delete, rename, clear or overwrite of business tabs',now]
  ];
  return {auditHeaders:['Check','Result','Details','Checked At'],auditRows: auditRows,
    mappingHeaders:mapHeaders,mappingRows:mapRows,
    decisionHeaders:['Decision ID','Decision Topic','Recommended Design','Approval / Evidence Required','Current Status'],
    decisionRows:schema.decisions,tableCount:Object.keys(canonical).length,fieldCount:mapRows.length,
    exactMatches:exact,missingTabs:missingTabs,missingFields:missingFields,ambiguousFields:ambiguous};
}

function ksWriteRows_(ss, tabName, headers, rows) {
  let sh=ss.getSheetByName(tabName); if(!sh) sh=ss.insertSheet(tabName);
  // This function is restricted to KS_* report tabs. It never targets business tabs.
  if (tabName.indexOf('KS_') !== 0) throw new Error('Refusing to write outside KS_* reporting tabs: '+tabName);
  sh.clearContents();
  const all=[headers].concat(rows), width=headers.length;
  if(sh.getMaxColumns()<width) sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(),width-sh.getMaxColumns());
  if(sh.getMaxRows()<all.length) sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(),all.length-sh.getMaxRows());
  for(let start=0;start<all.length;start+=KS_IMPL.MAX_OUTPUT_ROWS_PER_WRITE){
    const chunk=all.slice(start,start+KS_IMPL.MAX_OUTPUT_ROWS_PER_WRITE);
    sh.getRange(start+1,1,chunk.length,width).setValues(chunk);
  }
  sh.setFrozenRows(1); sh.getRange(1,1,1,width).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.autoResizeColumns(1,Math.min(width,14));
}

function ksLog_(event,message,details) {
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet(); let sh=ss.getSheetByName(KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_LOG_TAB);
  if(!sh){sh=ss.insertSheet(KS_IMPL.OUTPUT_LOG_TAB);sh.appendRow(['Timestamp','Version','Event','Message','Details JSON']);sh.setFrozenRows(1);}
  sh.appendRow([new Date(),KS_IMPL.VERSION,event,message,JSON.stringify(details||{})]);
}


/** Context-safe user notification. Apps Script UI is unavailable in some run contexts. */
function ksNotify_(message) {
  Logger.log(message);
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message);
  } catch (err) {
    // Expected for time-driven triggers, API executions, and contexts without spreadsheet UI.
    console.log(message);
  }
}



/* ===== MASTER DATABASE AUDIT ===== */

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD MASTER DATABASE AUDITOR v1.0
 * READ-ONLY AUDIT OF THE ACTIVE GOOGLE SHEETS WORKBOOK
 *
 * WHAT IT DOES
 * - Reads every tab in the active workbook.
 * - Inventories every header and row count.
 * - Flags blank/duplicate headers and populated data under blank headers.
 * - Checks likely ID columns for blanks and duplicates (counts only).
 * - Identifies possible cross-tab reference columns by header-name matching.
 * - Produces a Google Doc audit report in the user's Google Drive.
 *
 * WHAT IT NEVER DOES TO THE BUSINESS WORKBOOK
 * - Does not create, rename, delete, move, clear or edit any sheet.
 * - Does not change cells, formulas, formatting, filters or protections.
 * - Does not generate IDs or alter transactions.
 * - Does not print cell contents, names, phone numbers, addresses or amounts.
 *
 * IMPORTANT
 * - Run from the Apps Script project attached to the confirmed live workbook.
 * - Do not run from an unrelated spreadsheet.
 * - The report is a structural/diagnostic audit, not proof that a transaction
 *   happened in the real world. Reconcile flagged items with source documents.
 * - Header-based guesses are labelled "POSSIBLE", never treated as fact.
 *
 * RUN:
 * 1. Save this complete file.
 * 2. Select kawadRunMasterDatabaseAudit from the function dropdown.
 * 3. Click Run and approve Google Sheets + Google Docs permissions.
 * 4. Open the Google Doc URL shown in the execution log.
 */

const KAWAD_AUDIT = Object.freeze({
  VERSION: '1.0',
  EXPECTED_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  HEADER_ROW: 1,
  MAX_COLUMNS_TO_SCAN: 500,
  MAX_ROWS_PER_READ: 5000,
  MAX_REFERENCE_HEADERS_IN_REPORT: 100,
  // No cell values are included in the report.
  INCLUDE_FORMULA_COUNTS: true
});

/** MAIN FUNCTION. This is the only function you need to run. */
function kawadRunMasterDatabaseAudit() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) throw new Error('No active spreadsheet. Open the confirmed Kawad Swad workbook first.');

  const actualName = ss.getName();
  if (actualName !== KAWAD_AUDIT.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error(
      'WRONG WORKBOOK STOP. Expected "' + KAWAD_AUDIT.EXPECTED_NAME +
      '" but active workbook is "' + actualName + '". No workbook changes made.'
    );
  }

  const started = new Date();
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  const results = [];
  const headerIndex = {};
  const globalSummary = {
    tabCount: sheets.length,
    tabsWithData: 0,
    totalDataRows: 0,
    totalColumns: 0,
    blankHeaderColumnsWithData: 0,
    duplicateHeaderOccurrences: 0,
    likelyIdColumns: 0,
    likelyIdBlanks: 0,
    likelyIdDuplicates: 0,
    formulaCells: 0
  };

  sheets.forEach(function(sh, index) {
    const one = kawadInspectSheet_(sh, index + 1);
    results.push(one);
    globalSummary.totalDataRows += one.dataRows;
    globalSummary.totalColumns += one.lastColumn;
    globalSummary.blankHeaderColumnsWithData += one.blankHeaderColumnsWithData.length;
    globalSummary.duplicateHeaderOccurrences += one.duplicateHeaders.length;
    globalSummary.likelyIdColumns += one.idChecks.length;
    one.idChecks.forEach(function(x) {
      globalSummary.likelyIdBlanks += x.blankCount;
      globalSummary.likelyIdDuplicates += x.duplicateCount;
    });
    globalSummary.formulaCells += one.formulaCount;
    if (one.dataRows > 0) globalSummary.tabsWithData++;
    one.headers.forEach(function(h) {
      if (!h) return;
      const key = kawadMasterNorm_(h);
      if (!headerIndex[key]) headerIndex[key] = [];
      headerIndex[key].push(one.name);
    });
  });

  const relationships = kawadFindPossibleRelationships_(results, headerIndex);
  const businessChecks = kawadBuildBusinessChecks_(results);
  const report = {
    title: 'KAWAD SWAD | MASTER DATABASE FINALIZATION REPORT v1.0',
    generatedAt: started,
    spreadsheetName: actualName,
    spreadsheetUrl: ss.getUrl(),
    auditVersion: KAWAD_AUDIT.VERSION,
    mode: 'STRICT READ-ONLY',
    summary: globalSummary,
    tabs: results,
    possibleRelationships: relationships,
    businessChecks: businessChecks
  };

  const docUrl = kawadCreateReportDoc_(report);
  Logger.log('AUDIT FINISHED. Business workbook was not modified.');
  Logger.log('Workbook: ' + actualName);
  Logger.log('Tabs inspected: ' + globalSummary.tabCount);
  Logger.log('Google Doc report: ' + docUrl);
  return docUrl;
}

/** Inspect structure and non-sensitive quality indicators for one sheet. */
function kawadInspectSheet_(sh, order) {
  const name = sh.getName();
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = Math.min(sh.getLastColumn(), KAWAD_AUDIT.MAX_COLUMNS_TO_SCAN);
  const headers = lastCol
    ? sh.getRange(KAWAD_AUDIT.HEADER_ROW, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
        .map(function(v) { return String(v).trim(); })
    : [];

  const headerPositions = {};
  headers.forEach(function(h, i) {
    if (!h) return;
    const k = kawadMasterNorm_(h);
    if (!headerPositions[k]) headerPositions[k] = [];
    headerPositions[k].push(i + 1);
  });

  const duplicateHeaders = Object.keys(headerPositions)
    .filter(function(k) { return headerPositions[k].length > 1; })
    .map(function(k) {
      return { header: headers[headerPositions[k][0] - 1],
        columns: headerPositions[k] };
    });

  const blankHeaderColumnsWithData = [];
  const dataRows = Math.max(0, lastRow - KAWAD_AUDIT.HEADER_ROW);
  if (dataRows && lastCol) {
    headers.forEach(function(h, i) {
      if (h) return;
      const count = kawadCountNonBlankInColumn_(sh, i + 1, KAWAD_AUDIT.HEADER_ROW + 1, lastRow);
      if (count > 0) blankHeaderColumnsWithData.push({
        column: kawadColLetter_(i + 1), populatedCellCount: count
      });
    });
  }

  const idChecks = [];
  headers.forEach(function(h, i) {
    if (!h || !kawadLooksLikeId_(h)) return;
    const stats = kawadCheckUniqueColumn_(sh, i + 1, KAWAD_AUDIT.HEADER_ROW + 1, lastRow);
    idChecks.push({
      header: h,
      column: kawadColLetter_(i + 1),
      blankCount: stats.blankCount,
      duplicateCount: stats.duplicateCount,
      checkedValues: stats.checkedValues,
      status: stats.duplicateCount || stats.blankCount ? 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' : 'NO_DUPLICATES_OR_BLANKS_FOUND'
    });
  });

  let formulaCount = 0;
  if (KAWAD_AUDIT.INCLUDE_FORMULA_COUNTS && dataRows && lastCol) {
    formulaCount = kawadCountFormulas_(sh, dataRows, lastCol);
  }

  const flags = [];
  if (!headers.length) flags.push('NO HEADER ROW FOUND');
  if (headers.some(function(h) { return !h; })) flags.push('BLANK HEADER(S)');
  if (duplicateHeaders.length) flags.push('DUPLICATE HEADER(S)');
  if (blankHeaderColumnsWithData.length) flags.push('DATA UNDER BLANK HEADER');
  if (idChecks.some(function(x) { return x.status === 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'; }))
    flags.push('POSSIBLE ID QUALITY ISSUE');

  return {
    order: order,
    name: name,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastCol,
    dataRows: dataRows,
    headerCount: headers.filter(Boolean).length,
    headers: headers,
    duplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaders,
    blankHeaderColumnsWithData: blankHeaderColumnsWithData,
    idChecks: idChecks,
    formulaCount: formulaCount,
    flags: flags,
    initialClassification: flags.length ? 'UPDATE / INVESTIGATE' :
      (dataRows ? 'STRUCTURE LOOKS CLEAN; BUSINESS VALIDATION STILL REQUIRED' : 'EMPTY TAB; PURPOSE MUST BE CONFIRMED')
  };
}

function kawadCountNonBlankInColumn_(sh, col, startRow, endRow) {
  let count = 0;
  for (let r = startRow; r <= endRow; r += KAWAD_AUDIT.MAX_ROWS_PER_READ) {
    const n = Math.min(KAWAD_AUDIT.MAX_ROWS_PER_READ, endRow - r + 1);
    const vals = sh.getRange(r, col, n, 1).getValues();
    vals.forEach(function(row) {
      if (row[0] !== '' && row[0] !== null) count++;
    });
  }
  return count;
}

/** Counts blanks and duplicate nonblank values, but never returns the values. */
function kawadCheckUniqueColumn_(sh, col, startRow, endRow) {
  const seen = Object.create(null);
  let blankCount = 0, duplicateCount = 0, checkedValues = 0;
  if (endRow < startRow) return {blankCount:0, duplicateCount:0, checkedValues:0};
  for (let r = startRow; r <= endRow; r += KAWAD_AUDIT.MAX_ROWS_PER_READ) {
    const n = Math.min(KAWAD_AUDIT.MAX_ROWS_PER_READ, endRow - r + 1);
    const vals = sh.getRange(r, col, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
    vals.forEach(function(row) {
      const v = String(row[0]).trim();
      if (!v) { blankCount++; return; }
      checkedValues++;
      const key = v.toLowerCase();
      if (seen[key]) duplicateCount++;
      else seen[key] = true;
    });
  }
  return {blankCount:blankCount, duplicateCount:duplicateCount, checkedValues:checkedValues};
}

function kawadCountFormulas_(sh, dataRows, lastCol) {
  let count = 0;
  for (let start = 2; start <= dataRows + 1; start += 500) {
    const n = Math.min(500, dataRows + 2 - start);
    const formulas = sh.getRange(start, 1, n, lastCol).getFormulas();
    formulas.forEach(function(row) {
      row.forEach(function(f) { if (f) count++; });
    });
  }
  return count;
}

function kawadFindPossibleRelationships_(tabs, headerIndex) {
  const refs = [];
  tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
    tab.headers.forEach(function(h) {
      if (!h || !kawadLooksLikeReference_(h)) return;
      const targetKey = kawadMasterNorm_(h).replace(/_id$/, '');
      const possibleTargets = headerIndex[targetKey + '_id'] || [];
      const otherTargets = possibleTargets.filter(function(n) { return n !== tab.name; });
      if (otherTargets.length) refs.push({
        sourceTab: tab.name,
        referenceHeader: h,
        possibleTargetTabs: otherTargets,
        confidence: 'POSSIBLE ONLY: confirm business meaning and actual IDs'
      });
    });
  });
  return refs;
}

function kawadBuildBusinessChecks_(tabs) {
  const groups = [
    {label:'Sales / invoices', terms:['sales','saleitems','salesorders','salesorderitems','salesinvoices']},
    {label:'Customer payments', terms:['payments','customerpayments','customerreceipts','paymentallocations']},
    {label:'Supplier procurement / payments', terms:['purchaseorders','goodsreceipts','supplierbills','supplierpayments','supplieradvances']},
    {label:'Raw material inventory', terms:['rawmaterials','rawmaterialledger']},
    {label:'Production', terms:['recipes','productionbatches','productionstockledger','productiondispatches']},
    {label:'Packaging / finished goods', terms:['packagingbatches','packagingoutputs','finishedgoods']},
    {label:'Cash / bank / expenses', terms:['cashledger','banktransactions','expenses','bankreconciliation']},
    {label:'Daily closing', terms:['dailyclosing','dailyclosings']},
    {label:'Workforce', terms:['workers','workerattendance','employees','employeeattendance','salarypayments','salaryincentives']},
    {label:'Audit / approvals', terms:['auditlog','approvalrequests','approvals','incompletetransactions']}
  ];
  const byName = {};
  tabs.forEach(function(t) { byName[kawadMasterNorm_(t.name)] = t; });
  return groups.map(function(g) {
    const present = g.terms.filter(function(n) { return !!byName[n]; });
    const missing = g.terms.filter(function(n) { return !byName[n]; });
    return {
      businessArea: g.label,
      matchingTabsFound: present,
      candidateTabsNotFoundByExactName: missing,
      assessment: present.length ? 'STRUCTURE FOUND; records and end-to-end reconciliation still need review' :
        'NOT FOUND BY THESE NAMES; may exist under another name'
    };
  });
}

function kawadCreateReportDoc_(report) {
  const doc = DocumentApp.create(report.title);
  const body = doc.getBody();
  body.appendParagraph(report.title).setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.TITLE);
  body.appendParagraph('Generated: ' + report.generatedAt);
  body.appendParagraph('Workbook: ' + report.spreadsheetName);
  body.appendParagraph('Source workbook: ' + report.spreadsheetUrl);
  body.appendParagraph('Audit mode: STRICT READ-ONLY. No business spreadsheet cells or tabs were changed.');
  body.appendParagraph('Important: structural indicators and name-based relationship matches are diagnostic clues, not proof of business correctness.');
  body.appendParagraph('1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  kawadAddTable_(body, [
    ['Measure','Result'],
    ['Tabs inspected', String(report.summary.tabCount)],
    ['Tabs with data', String(report.summary.tabsWithData)],
    ['Total data rows (all tabs)', String(report.summary.totalDataRows)],
    ['Total columns (all tabs)', String(report.summary.totalColumns)],
    ['Blank-header columns containing data', String(report.summary.blankHeaderColumnsWithData)],
    ['Duplicate header groups', String(report.summary.duplicateHeaderOccurrences)],
    ['Likely ID columns checked', String(report.summary.likelyIdColumns)],
    ['Blank cells in likely ID columns', String(report.summary.likelyIdBlanks)],
    ['Duplicate values in likely ID columns', String(report.summary.likelyIdDuplicates)],
    ['Formula cells counted', String(report.summary.formulaCells)]
  ]);

  body.appendParagraph('2. BUSINESS AREA PRESENCE CHECK').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  report.businessChecks.forEach(function(x) {
    body.appendParagraph(x.businessArea + ': ' + x.assessment).setBold(true);
    body.appendParagraph('Tabs found: ' + (x.matchingTabsFound.join(', ') || 'None by exact name'));
    body.appendParagraph('Not found by exact name: ' + (x.candidateTabsNotFoundByExactName.join(', ') || 'None'));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('3. POSSIBLE CROSS-TAB RELATIONSHIPS').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  body.appendParagraph('These are header-name matches only. They are not confirmed foreign keys.');
  if (!report.possibleRelationships.length) body.appendParagraph('No likely relationships detected by the naming rule.');
  report.possibleRelationships.forEach(function(x) {
    body.appendParagraph(x.sourceTab + '.' + x.referenceHeader + ' -> possible: ' +
      x.possibleTargetTabs.join(', '));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('4. COMPLETE TAB-BY-TAB INVENTORY').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  report.tabs.forEach(function(t) {
    body.appendParagraph(t.order + '. ' + t.name).setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
    body.appendParagraph('Rows: ' + t.dataRows + ' | Columns: ' + t.lastColumn +
      ' | Header count: ' + t.headerCount + ' | Formula cells: ' + t.formulaCount);
    body.appendParagraph('Classification: ' + t.initialClassification);
    body.appendParagraph('Headers: ' + (t.headers.map(function(h, i) {
      return (h || '[BLANK]') + ' [' + kawadColLetter_(i + 1) + ']';
    }).join(' | ') || 'No headers'));
    if (t.flags.length) body.appendParagraph('Flags: ' + t.flags.join('; '));
    t.duplicateHeaders.forEach(function(d) {
      body.appendParagraph('DUPLICATE HEADER: ' + d.header + ' at columns ' + d.columns.join(', '));
    });
    t.blankHeaderColumnsWithData.forEach(function(b) {
      body.appendParagraph('DATA UNDER BLANK HEADER: column ' + b.column +
        ', populated cells ' + b.populatedCellCount);
    });
    t.idChecks.forEach(function(id) {
      body.appendParagraph('ID CHECK ' + id.header + ': checked ' + id.checkedValues +
        ', blank ' + id.blankCount + ', duplicates ' + id.duplicateCount +
        ' (' + id.status + ')');
    });
  });

  body.appendParagraph('5. LIMITATIONS AND NEXT VALIDATION').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  [
    'This script does not decide which tab is the official authority when two tabs appear similar.',
    'This script does not read or reproduce transaction details in the report.',
    'A clean ID column does not prove that an order, payment, stock movement or journal entry is genuine.',
    'Amounts, quantities, stock balances, payment allocations, tax treatment and daily closing must be checked against approved business rules and source documents.',
    'No tabs, headers, rows, formulas, formatting, IDs or business records were changed.',
    'Next step: owner/accountant review of flagged tabs and a controlled field-by-field reconciliation against the approved business blueprint.'
  ].forEach(function(s) { body.appendListItem(s); });

  doc.saveAndClose();
  return doc.getUrl();
}

function kawadAddTable_(body, rows) {
  body.appendTable(rows);
}

function kawadLooksLikeId_(header) {
  const h = kawadMasterNorm_(header);
  return /(^id$|_id$|^id_|^.*_key$|^.*_number$)/.test(h) &&
    !/(mobile|telephone|phone|gstin|pincode|postal|account_number|ifsc)/.test(h);
}

function kawadLooksLikeReference_(header) {
  const h = kawadMasterNorm_(header);
  return /(_id$|_ref$|^reference$)/.test(h) &&
    !/(created_by|updated_by|approved_by|user_id|worker_id|employee_id|customer_id|supplier_id)/.test(h);
}

function kawadMasterNorm_(value) {
  return String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
}

function kawadColLetter_(column) {
  let n = column, out = '';
  while (n > 0) {
    const r = (n - 1) % 26;
    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + r) + out;
    n = Math.floor((n - 1) / 26);
  }
  return out;
}



/* ===== TRANSACTION INTEGRITY AUDIT ===== */

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD | READ-ONLY TRANSACTION INTEGRITY AUDIT
 * Version: 2.0 | 16-Nov-2026
 *
 * READ-ONLY GUARANTEE:
 * - Opens the approved live workbook by ID and verifies its exact name.
 * - Never writes to, clears, renames, deletes, formats, or adds anything
 *   inside the business spreadsheet.
 * - Creates a separate Google Doc report in Drive.
 * - Does not print customer, employee, password-hash, bank, or transaction
 *   values. Findings use tab names, row numbers, counts, and rule descriptions.
 *
 * RUN: kawadRunTransactionIntegrityAudit()
 */

const KAWAD_TX_AUDIT = Object.freeze({
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  EXPECTED_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  VERSION: '2.0',
  TOLERANCE: 0.01
});

function kawadRunTransactionIntegrityAudit() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getName() !== KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Spreadsheet name does not match the approved Kawad Swad workbook. No audit was run.');
  }

  const started = new Date();
  const findings = [];
  const summaries = [];
  const sheetMap = {};

  ss.getSheets().forEach(sh => {
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
      sheetMap[sh.getName()] = {sheet: sh, headers: [], rows: [], index: {}, dataCount: 0};
      summaries.push([sh.getName(), 0, lastCol, 'EMPTY']);
      return;
    }
    const values = sh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getValues();
    const headers = values[0].map(v => String(v == null ? '' : v).trim());
    const index = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      if (h) {
        const k = kawadTxNorm_(h);
        if (!index[k]) index[k] = [];
        index[k].push(i);
      }
    });
    const rows = values.slice(1).map((r, i) => ({rowNo: i + 2, values: r}));
    const dataCount = rows.filter(x => x.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)).length;
    sheetMap[sh.getName()] = {sheet: sh, headers, rows, index, dataCount};
    summaries.push([sh.getName(), dataCount, lastCol, dataCount ? 'HAS DATA' : 'EMPTY']);
  });

  // 1. Primary-key completeness and uniqueness. Only explicit known key fields.
  const primaryKeys = {
    Products: ['product_id'],
    Customers: ['customer_id'],
    RawMaterials: ['raw_material_id'],
    Workers: ['worker_id'],
    Users: ['user_id'],
    Sales: ['sale_id'],
    SaleItems: ['sale_item_id'],
    Payments: ['payment_id'],
    RawMaterialLedger: ['ledger_id'],
    ProductionBatches: ['production_id', 'batch_id'],
    PackagingBatches: ['packaging_id'],
    ProductionStockLedger: ['movement_id'],
    ProductionDispatches: ['dispatch_id'],
    Expenses: ['expense_id'],
    DailyClosing: ['closing_id'],
    AuditLog: ['audit_id'],
    JournalHeaders: ['journal_id'],
    JournalLines: ['line_id'],
    IdAllocations: ['allocation_id']
  };

  Object.keys(primaryKeys).forEach(tab => {
    const t = sheetMap[tab];
    if (!t) return;
    primaryKeys[tab].forEach(key => {
      const col = kawadCol_(t, [key]);
      if (col < 0) return;
      const seen = new Map();
      let blanks = 0, duplicates = 0;
      t.rows.forEach(r => {
        if (!r.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)) return;
        const raw = r.values[col];
        const val = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).trim();
        if (!val) { blanks++; kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', tab, r.rowNo, 'PRIMARY KEY BLANK', key + ' is empty.'); return; }
        const norm = val.toLowerCase();
        if (seen.has(norm)) {
          duplicates++;
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, r.rowNo, 'DUPLICATE PRIMARY KEY', key + ' repeats a value already present at row ' + seen.get(norm) + '.');
        } else seen.set(norm, r.rowNo);
      });
      kawadAddSummary_(findings, 'INFO', tab, '-', 'PRIMARY KEY CHECK', key + ': ' + seen.size + ' distinct values; ' + blanks + ' blank; ' + duplicates + ' duplicate occurrences.');
    });
  });

  // 2. Explicit child-to-parent references. Only checks when both tabs and fields exist.
  const relations = [
    ['Sales','customer_id','Customers','customer_id'],
    ['SaleItems','sale_id','Sales','sale_id'],
    ['SaleItems','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['Payments','sale_id','Sales','sale_id'],
    ['RawMaterialLedger','raw_material_id','RawMaterials','raw_material_id'],
    ['RawMaterialLedger','production_id','ProductionBatches',['production_id','batch_id']],
    ['ProductionStockLedger','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['ProductionStockLedger','production_batch_id','ProductionBatches',['production_id','batch_id']],
    ['ProductionDispatches','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['Expenses','submitted_by_user_id','Users','user_id'],
    ['Expenses','approved_by_user_id','Users','user_id'],
    ['DailyClosing','salesman_user_id','Users','user_id'],
    ['JournalLines','journal_id','JournalHeaders','journal_id'],
    ['JournalLines','account_code','ChartOfAccounts','account_code']
  ];

  relations.forEach(rel => {
    const [childName, childField, parentName, parentField] = rel;
    const child = sheetMap[childName], parent = sheetMap[parentName];
    if (!child || !parent) return;
    const cc = kawadCol_(child, [childField]);
    const pc = kawadCol_(parent, Array.isArray(parentField) ? parentField : [parentField]);
    if (cc < 0 || pc < 0) {
      kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', childName, '-', 'RELATIONSHIP NOT TESTED',
        'Expected field/tab unavailable: ' + childField + ' -> ' + parentName + '.' + (Array.isArray(parentField) ? parentField.join('/') : parentField) + '.');
      return;
    }
    const parentSet = new Set();
    parent.rows.forEach(r => {
      const v = String(r.values[pc] == null ? '' : r.values[pc]).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (v) parentSet.add(v);
    });
    let checked = 0, orphan = 0, blank = 0;
    child.rows.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)) return;
      const v = String(r.values[cc] == null ? '' : r.values[cc]).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!v) { blank++; return; }
      checked++;
      if (!parentSet.has(v)) {
        orphan++;
        kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', childName, r.rowNo, 'UNMATCHED REFERENCE',
          childField + ' does not match a value in ' + parentName + '.' + (Array.isArray(parentField) ? parentField.join('/') : parentField) + '.');
      }
    });
    kawadAddSummary_(findings, 'INFO', childName, '-', 'REFERENCE CHECK',
      childField + ' -> ' + parentName + ': ' + checked + ' checked; ' + orphan + ' unmatched; ' + blank + ' blank (blank references not automatically treated as errors).');
  });

  // 3. Sales header total arithmetic, only where all required fields exist.
  const sales = sheetMap.Sales;
  if (sales && sales.dataCount) {
    const cols = {
      subtotal: kawadCol_(sales, ['subtotal']),
      discount: kawadCol_(sales, ['discount_amount']),
      tax: kawadCol_(sales, ['tax_amount']),
      total: kawadCol_(sales, ['bill_total'])
    };
    if (Object.values(cols).every(x => x >= 0)) {
      sales.rows.forEach(r => {
        if (!r.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)) return;
        const nums = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(cols).map(([k,c]) => [k, kawadNum_(r.values[c])]));
        if (Object.values(nums).some(v => v === null)) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'Sales', r.rowNo, 'SALES TOTAL NOT TESTABLE', 'One or more amount fields are blank or non-numeric.');
          return;
        }
        const expected = nums.subtotal - nums.discount + nums.tax;
        if (Math.abs(expected - nums.total) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', 'Sales', r.rowNo, 'BILL TOTAL MISMATCH',
            'subtotal - discount_amount + tax_amount differs from bill_total. Difference: ' + (nums.total - expected).toFixed(2) + '.');
        }
      });
    } else kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'Sales', '-', 'SALES TOTAL NOT TESTED', 'Required amount headers are not all present.');
  }

  // 4. Sale-item line arithmetic, when the workbook has the required columns.
  const items = sheetMap.SaleItems;
  if (items && items.dataCount) {
    const c = {
      qty: kawadCol_(items, ['quantity']),
      rate: kawadCol_(items, ['actual_unit_price']),
      discount: kawadCol_(items, ['discount_amount']),
      total: kawadCol_(items, ['line_total'])
    };
    if (Object.values(c).every(x => x >= 0)) {
      items.rows.forEach(r => {
        if (!r.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)) return;
        const q = kawadNum_(r.values[c.qty]), p = kawadNum_(r.values[c.rate]);
        const d = kawadNum_(r.values[c.discount]), total = kawadNum_(r.values[c.total]);
        if ([q,p,d,total].some(v => v === null)) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'SaleItems', r.rowNo, 'LINE TOTAL NOT TESTABLE', 'Quantity, unit price, discount or line total is blank/non-numeric.');
        } else if (Math.abs((q * p - d) - total) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', 'SaleItems', r.rowNo, 'LINE TOTAL MISMATCH', 'quantity × actual_unit_price - discount_amount differs from line_total.');
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // 5. Journal balance checks. No journal values are disclosed.
  const jh = sheetMap.JournalHeaders, jl = sheetMap.JournalLines;
  if (jh && jl && jh.dataCount && jl.dataCount) {
    const hId = kawadCol_(jh, ['journal_id']);
    const hD = kawadCol_(jh, ['total_debit']), hC = kawadCol_(jh, ['total_credit']);
    const lId = kawadCol_(jl, ['journal_id']);
    const lD = kawadCol_(jl, ['debit_amount']), lC = kawadCol_(jl, ['credit_amount']);
    if ([hId,hD,hC,lId,lD,lC].every(x => x >= 0)) {
      const sums = {};
      jl.rows.forEach(r => {
        const id = String(r.values[lId] == null ? '' : r.values[lId]).trim();
        if (!id) return;
        if (!sums[id]) sums[id] = {debit:0, credit:0, invalid:false};
        const d = kawadNum_(r.values[lD]), c = kawadNum_(r.values[lC]);
        if (d === null || c === null) sums[id].invalid = true;
        else { sums[id].debit += d; sums[id].credit += c; }
      });
      jh.rows.forEach(r => {
        const id = String(r.values[hId] == null ? '' : r.values[hId]).trim();
        if (!id) return;
        const hd = kawadNum_(r.values[hD]), hc = kawadNum_(r.values[hC]);
        const lines = sums[id];
        if (!lines) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', 'JournalHeaders', r.rowNo, 'JOURNAL HAS NO LINES', 'No JournalLines record was found for this journal_id.');
          return;
        }
        if (hd === null || hc === null || lines.invalid) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'JournalHeaders', r.rowNo, 'JOURNAL NOT TESTABLE', 'Header or line debit/credit amount is blank or non-numeric.');
          return;
        }
        if (Math.abs(hd - hc) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE ||
            Math.abs(hd - lines.debit) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE ||
            Math.abs(hc - lines.credit) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE ||
            Math.abs(lines.debit - lines.credit) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', 'JournalHeaders', r.rowNo, 'JOURNAL DEBIT/CREDIT MISMATCH',
            'Header totals, line totals and debit-credit equality do not all agree.');
        }
      });
    } else kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'JournalHeaders', '-', 'JOURNAL NOT TESTED', 'Required journal amount/reference headers are not all present.');
  }

  // 6. Packaging weight arithmetic, only if exact known columns exist.
  const pack = sheetMap.PackagingBatches;
  if (pack && pack.dataCount) {
    const c = {
      p200: kawadCol_(pack, ['packets_200g']),
      p500: kawadCol_(pack, ['packets_500g']),
      p1000: kawadCol_(pack, ['packets_1000g']),
      expected: kawadCol_(pack, ['expected_kg'])
    };
    if (Object.values(c).every(x => x >= 0)) {
      pack.rows.forEach(r => {
        if (!r.values.some(v => v !== '' && v !== null)) return;
        const a = kawadNum_(r.values[c.p200]), b = kawadNum_(r.values[c.p500]);
        const d = kawadNum_(r.values[c.p1000]), e = kawadNum_(r.values[c.expected]);
        if ([a,b,d,e].some(v => v === null)) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'PackagingBatches', r.rowNo, 'PACKAGING WEIGHT NOT TESTABLE', 'Packet counts or expected_kg are blank/non-numeric.');
          return;
        }
        const calculated = a * 0.2 + b * 0.5 + d;
        if (Math.abs(calculated - e) > KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.TOLERANCE) {
          kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', 'PackagingBatches', r.rowNo, 'PACKAGING WEIGHT MISMATCH',
            'Packet counts converted to kilograms differ from expected_kg. This check does not assess approved packing loss.');
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // 7. Detect duplicated transaction references in known idempotency fields.
  ['Sales','PurchaseOrders','GoodsReceipts','SupplierBills','SupplierPayments','Expenses'].forEach(tab => {
    const t = sheetMap[tab];
    if (!t) return;
    const c = kawadCol_(t, ['idempotency_key']);
    if (c < 0) return;
    const seen = new Map();
    t.rows.forEach(r => {
      const v = String(r.values[c] == null ? '' : r.values[c]).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!v) return;
      if (seen.has(v)) kawadAdd_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, r.rowNo, 'DUPLICATE IDEMPOTENCY KEY',
        'idempotency_key repeats a value already present at row ' + seen.get(v) + '.');
      else seen.set(v, r.rowNo);
    });
  });

  // Explicitly flag areas that cannot be verified from this workbook snapshot alone.
  const limitations = [
    'No external bank statement, cash count, supplier invoice, customer receipt or marketplace settlement was supplied; cash/bank authenticity cannot be proved.',
    'No approved movement-sign convention or opening-stock cut-off was assumed; raw-material and finished-stock balances are not certified by this script.',
    'Production input/output/yield and process-loss checks require the approved recipe and batch field semantics; no assumptions are made.',
    'DailyClosing cash arithmetic is reported for manual review because the approved sign convention and treatment of UPI/bank/other collections must be confirmed.',
    'A relationship check is performed only for the explicit mappings in this script and only when both tabs and columns exist.',
    'Rows in audit/blueprint/register tabs are not treated as business transactions.'
  ];
  limitations.forEach(s => kawadAdd_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'AUDIT LIMITATION', '-', 'MANUAL EVIDENCE REQUIRED', s));

  const counts = {PASS:0, REVIEW:0, FAIL:0, INFO:0};
  findings.forEach(f => counts[f[0]] = (counts[f[0]] || 0) + 1);
  const doc = DocumentApp.create('Kawad Swad - Transaction Integrity Audit v2.0 - ' +
    Utilities.formatDate(started, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HHmm'));
  const body = doc.getBody();
  body.appendParagraph('KAWAD SWAD | READ-ONLY TRANSACTION INTEGRITY AUDIT').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.TITLE);
  body.appendParagraph('Version: ' + KAWAD_TX_AUDIT.VERSION);
  body.appendParagraph('Generated: ' + started.toString());
  body.appendParagraph('Workbook: ' + ss.getName());
  body.appendParagraph('Mode: STRICT READ-ONLY. No business spreadsheet cells, tabs, formulas, formatting, IDs or records were changed.');
  body.appendParagraph('Important: PASS means only that the specific programmed rule passed. REVIEW means manual evidence/owner decision is required. FAIL means a programmed mismatch was detected, not that the script repaired it.');
  body.appendParagraph('SUMMARY').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  body.appendTable([
    ['Measure','Count'],
    ['Tabs inspected', String(summaries.length)],
    ['Tabs with business/data rows', String(summaries.filter(x => x[1] > 0).length)],
    ['FAIL findings', String(counts.FAIL)],
    ['REVIEW findings', String(counts.REVIEW)],
    ['INFO checks', String(counts.INFO)]
  ]);
  body.appendParagraph('FINDINGS').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  const tableRows = [['Status','Tab','Row','Check','Finding']];
  findings.forEach(f => tableRows.push(f.map(String)));
  body.appendTable(tableRows);
  body.appendParagraph('TAB INVENTORY').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  const inv = [['Tab','Data rows','Columns','Status']];
  summaries.forEach(x => inv.push(x.map(String)));
  body.appendTable(inv);
  body.appendParagraph('LIMITATIONS').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  limitations.forEach(x => body.appendListItem(x));
  body.appendParagraph('NEXT STEP').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  body.appendParagraph('Review every FAIL and REVIEW finding against source documents and approved Kawad Swad rules. Do not edit or delete a business record solely because this diagnostic report flags it.');
  doc.saveAndClose();

  Logger.log('TRANSACTION INTEGRITY AUDIT FINISHED. BUSINESS WORKBOOK WAS NOT MODIFIED.');
  Logger.log('Workbook: ' + ss.getName());
  Logger.log('Tabs inspected: ' + summaries.length);
  Logger.log('FAIL: ' + counts.FAIL + ' | REVIEW: ' + counts.REVIEW + ' | INFO: ' + counts.INFO);
  Logger.log('Google Doc report: ' + doc.getUrl());
}

function kawadCol_(table, names) {
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    const cols = table.index[kawadTxNorm_(names[i])];
    if (cols && cols.length) return cols[0];
  }
  return -1;
}
function kawadTxNorm_(s) { return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
function kawadNum_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof v === 'number') return isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  const n = Number(String(v).replace(/[,₹\s]/g, ''));
  return isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}
function kawadAdd_(arr, status, tab, row, check, detail) {
  arr.push([status, tab, row, check, detail]);
}
function kawadAddSummary_(arr, status, tab, row, check, detail) {
  arr.push([status, tab, row, check, detail]);
}



/* ===== COMPLETE DATABASE VERIFICATION ===== */

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD | COMPLETE DATABASE VERIFICATION v3.0
 *
 * READ-ONLY ONLY. This script does not edit the business workbook.
 * It creates a separate Google Doc report.
 *
 * Covers:
 * 1. All-tab structural integrity (headers, duplicate headers, blank headers with data).
 * 2. 66 backend REQUIRED_TABS contracts using DBV5_BACKEND_CONTRACTS_66 as
 *    the documented contract register, while clearly identifying missing register data.
 * 3. Primary-key completeness and uniqueness for explicitly listed core tables.
 * 4. Explicit foreign-key checks for known core relationships.
 * 5. Advisory checks for proposed relationship mappings, without treating
 *    unapproved blueprint relationships as confirmed business rules.
 * 6. Journal header/line balance and account references.
 * 7. Recipe JSON validity and recipe-to-product mapping review.
 * 8. Packaging quantity arithmetic and unexplained-variance review.
 * 9. Formula error scan and formula inventory.
 * 10. Explicit manual gates for bank, cash, stock opening balances, production yield,
 *     daily closing, persistence reliability, and deployment readiness.
 *
 * Run: kawadRunCompleteDatabaseVerificationV3()
 */

const KS_DBV3 = {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  SPREADSHEET_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  CONTRACT_TAB: 'DBV5_BACKEND_CONTRACTS_66',
  RELATIONSHIP_TAB: 'DBV5_RELATIONSHIP_REVIEW',
  MAX_CELL_FINDINGS: 500,
  PRIMARY_KEYS: {
    Products: ['product_id'],
    Customers: ['customer_id'],
    RawMaterials: ['raw_material_id'],
    Workers: ['worker_id'],
    Users: ['user_id'],
    AuthUsers: ['auth_id'],
    Sales: ['sale_id'],
    SaleItems: ['sale_item_id'],
    Payments: ['payment_id'],
    RawMaterialLedger: ['ledger_id'],
    ProductionBatches: ['production_id', 'batch_id'],
    PackagingBatches: ['packaging_id'],
    ProductionStockLedger: ['movement_id'],
    ProductionDispatches: ['dispatch_id'],
    Expenses: ['expense_id'],
    DailyClosing: ['closing_id'],
    AuditLog: ['audit_id'],
    IdAllocations: ['allocation_id'],
    RevokedTokens: ['token_id'],
    ApprovalRequests: ['request_id'],
    JournalHeaders: ['journal_id'],
    JournalLines: ['line_id'],
    ChartOfAccounts: ['account_code']
  },
  CORE_RELATIONSHIPS: [
    ['Sales','customer_id','Customers','customer_id'],
    ['SaleItems','sale_id','Sales','sale_id'],
    ['SaleItems','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['Payments','sale_id','Sales','sale_id'],
    ['RawMaterialLedger','raw_material_id','RawMaterials','raw_material_id'],
    ['RawMaterialLedger','production_id','ProductionBatches','production_id'],
    ['ProductionBatches','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['ProductionBatches','recipe_id','Recipes','recipe_id'],
    ['PackagingBatches','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['ProductionStockLedger','product_id','Products','product_id'],
    ['ProductionStockLedger','production_batch_id','ProductionBatches','production_id'],
    ['Expenses','submitted_by_user_id','Users','user_id'],
    ['Expenses','approved_by_user_id','Users','user_id'],
    ['JournalLines','journal_id','JournalHeaders','journal_id'],
    ['JournalLines','account_code','ChartOfAccounts','account_code']
  ],
  MANUAL_GATES: [
    'External bank statement reconciliation and proof of bank balances',
    'Physical cash count and cash-ledger reconciliation',
    'Supplier invoices, supplier balances and supplier-payment reconciliation',
    'Customer receipts and marketplace settlement reconciliation',
    'Opening stock cut-off and approved stock movement sign convention',
    'Raw-material and finished-goods physical stock reconciliation',
    'Production recipe approval, batch input/output, yield and process-loss verification',
    'Packaging residual bulk, packing loss and variance authorization',
    'DailyClosing treatment of cash, UPI, bank and other collections',
    'Function-level backend read/write contract and API integration tests',
    'Google Sheets write reliability, retry/idempotency and read-after-write tests',
    'Live environment deployment, access control and production smoke tests'
  ]
};

function kawadRunCompleteDatabaseVerificationV3() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_DBV3.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_DBV3.SPREADSHEET_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Verification stopped.');
  }

  const findings = [];
  const metrics = {
    tabsInspected: 0,
    tabsWithData: 0,
    totalDataRows: 0,
    totalColumns: 0,
    blankHeaderColumnsWithData: 0,
    duplicateHeaderGroups: 0,
    formulaCells: 0,
    formulaErrorCells: 0,
    backendContractTables: 0,
    backendRequiredFields: 0,
    missingBackendRequiredFields: 0,
    primaryKeyFieldsChecked: 0,
    primaryKeyBlankValues: 0,
    primaryKeyDuplicateOccurrences: 0,
    coreRelationshipsChecked: 0,
    unmatchedCoreReferences: 0,
    recipeJsonInvalid: 0,
    journalUnbalanced: 0,
    packagingArithmeticMismatches: 0,
    packagingVarianceReview: 0
  };

  const cache = {};
  ss.getSheets().forEach(sh => {
    metrics.tabsInspected++;
    const t = kawadV3_read_(sh);
    cache[sh.getName()] = t;
    metrics.totalColumns += t.headers.length;
    metrics.totalDataRows += t.dataRows;
    if (t.dataRows > 0) metrics.tabsWithData++;

    // Structural checks across every tab.
    const headerPositions = {};
    t.headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      const key = kawadV3_norm_(h).toLowerCase();
      if (!key) {
        if (t.columnHasData[i]) {
          metrics.blankHeaderColumnsWithData++;
          kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', sh.getName(), 1, 'BLANK HEADER WITH DATA',
            'Column ' + (i + 1) + ' contains data but has no header. Preserve until its meaning is confirmed.');
        }
      } else {
        if (!headerPositions[key]) headerPositions[key] = [];
        headerPositions[key].push(i + 1);
      }
    });
    Object.keys(headerPositions).forEach(h => {
      if (headerPositions[h].length > 1) {
        metrics.duplicateHeaderGroups++;
        kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', sh.getName(), 1, 'DUPLICATE HEADER',
          'Header "' + h + '" appears in columns ' + headerPositions[h].join(', ') + '.');
      }
    });

    // Formula inventory and formula error detection. Values are not modified.
    for (let r = 0; r < t.formulas.length; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < (t.formulas[r] || []).length; c++) {
        const f = t.formulas[r][c];
        const v = t.values[r] ? t.values[r][c] : '';
        if (f) metrics.formulaCells++;
        const display = String(t.display[r] ? t.display[r][c] : v);
        if (/^#(REF!|VALUE!|DIV\/0!|N\/A|NAME\?|NUM!|NULL!)/i.test(display)) {
          metrics.formulaErrorCells++;
          kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', sh.getName(), r + 1, 'FORMULA ERROR',
            'A cell displays a spreadsheet formula error. Cell ' + kawadV3_colLetter_(c + 1) + (r + 1) + '.');
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Backend REQUIRED_TABS field contract check.
  kawadV3_checkContracts_(cache, metrics, findings);

  // Primary keys: completeness and uniqueness only for explicit known key fields.
  Object.keys(KS_DBV3.PRIMARY_KEYS).forEach(tab => {
    const t = cache[tab];
    if (!t) return;
    KS_DBV3.PRIMARY_KEYS[tab].forEach(key => {
      const col = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, key);
      if (col < 0) return;
      metrics.primaryKeyFieldsChecked++;
      const seen = {};
      t.rows.forEach((row, i) => {
        if (!kawadV3_rowHasData_(row)) return;
        const value = kawadV3_norm_(row[col]);
        if (!value) {
          metrics.primaryKeyBlankValues++;
          kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, i + 2, 'BLANK PRIMARY KEY',
            key + ' is blank on a populated record.');
        } else if (seen[value]) {
          metrics.primaryKeyDuplicateOccurrences++;
          kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, i + 2, 'DUPLICATE PRIMARY KEY',
            key + ' duplicates an earlier populated record.');
        } else seen[value] = true;
      });
    });
  });

  // Explicit core foreign-key relationships.
  KS_DBV3.CORE_RELATIONSHIPS.forEach(rel => {
    const [child, childField, parent, parentField] = rel;
    const ct = cache[child], pt = cache[parent];
    if (!ct || !pt) return;
    const cc = kawadV3_col_(ct.headers, childField);
    const pc = kawadV3_col_(pt.headers, parentField);
    if (cc < 0 || pc < 0) {
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', child, '-', 'RELATIONSHIP FIELD MISSING',
        childField + ' -> ' + parent + '.' + parentField + ' could not be checked because a header is missing.');
      return;
    }
    const parentSet = new Set(pt.rows.map(r => kawadV3_norm_(r[pc])).filter(Boolean));
    let checked = 0, unmatched = 0, blanks = 0;
    ct.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (!kawadV3_rowHasData_(r)) return;
      const v = kawadV3_norm_(r[cc]);
      if (!v) { blanks++; return; }
      checked++;
      if (!parentSet.has(v)) {
        unmatched++;
        kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', child, i + 2, 'UNMATCHED REFERENCE',
          childField + ' does not match ' + parent + '.' + parentField + '.');
      }
    });
    metrics.coreRelationshipsChecked++;
    metrics.unmatchedCoreReferences += unmatched;
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'INFO', child, '-', 'REFERENCE SUMMARY',
      childField + ' -> ' + parent + ': ' + checked + ' checked, ' + unmatched + ' unmatched, ' + blanks + ' blank.');
  });

  // Advisory review of blueprint relationship proposals. Not treated as authoritative.
  kawadV3_checkProposedRelationships_(cache, findings);

  // Journal controls: line sums vs header totals and debit/credit equality.
  kawadV3_checkJournals_(cache, metrics, findings);

  // Recipe JSON validity and product ID relationship.
  kawadV3_checkRecipes_(cache, metrics, findings);

  // Packaging packet arithmetic. Residual bulk is not automatically treated as loss.
  kawadV3_checkPackaging_(cache, metrics, findings);

  // Empty operational tables are readiness observations, not automatic failures.
  [
    'Sales','SaleItems','Payments','CashLedger','DailyClosing',
    'ProductionDispatches','PurchaseOrders','GoodsReceipts','SupplierBills',
    'SupplierPayments','BankTransactions','BankReconciliation'
  ].forEach(tab => {
    if (cache[tab] && cache[tab].dataRows === 0) {
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'INFO', tab, '-', 'EMPTY OPERATIONAL TABLE',
        'No data rows found. Confirm whether this workflow is not yet in use or is expected to be active before go-live.');
    }
  });

  // Explicit manual gates.
  KS_DBV3.MANUAL_GATES.forEach((g, i) =>
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'FINALIZATION GATE', '-', 'MANUAL EVIDENCE REQUIRED',
      'G' + (i + 1) + ': ' + g + '.')
  );

  const reportUrl = kawadV3_createReport_(metrics, findings);
  Logger.log('COMPLETE DATABASE VERIFICATION REPORT: ' + reportUrl);
  return reportUrl;
}

function kawadV3_checkContracts_(cache, metrics, findings) {
  const t = cache[KS_DBV3.CONTRACT_TAB];
  if (!t) {
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', KS_DBV3.CONTRACT_TAB, '-', 'CONTRACT REGISTER MISSING',
      'Cannot compare the 66 documented backend contracts. No contract assumptions were made.');
    return;
  }
  const tableCol = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, 'Table');
  const fieldCol = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, 'Required field');
  if (tableCol < 0 || fieldCol < 0) {
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', KS_DBV3.CONTRACT_TAB, 1, 'CONTRACT REGISTER HEADERS',
      'Expected Table and Required field columns were not found.');
    return;
  }
  const byTable = {};
  t.rows.forEach(r => {
    const tab = kawadV3_norm_(r[tableCol]);
    const field = kawadV3_norm_(r[fieldCol]);
    if (!tab || !field) return;
    if (!byTable[tab]) byTable[tab] = new Set();
    byTable[tab].add(field);
  });
  metrics.backendContractTables = Object.keys(byTable).length;
  Object.keys(byTable).forEach(tab => {
    const live = cache[tab];
    if (!live) {
      metrics.missingBackendRequiredFields += byTable[tab].size;
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, '-', 'BACKEND CONTRACT TAB MISSING',
        'Documented backend contract exists for this tab, but the live tab is missing.');
      return;
    }
    byTable[tab].forEach(field => {
      metrics.backendRequiredFields++;
      if (kawadV3_col_(live.headers, field) < 0) {
        metrics.missingBackendRequiredFields++;
        kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', tab, 1, 'BACKEND REQUIRED FIELD MISSING',
          'Required backend field "' + field + '" is absent from the live header row.');
      }
    });
  });
  kawadV3_add_(findings, 'INFO', KS_DBV3.CONTRACT_TAB, '-', 'BACKEND CONTRACT SUMMARY',
    metrics.backendContractTables + ' contract tables and ' + metrics.backendRequiredFields +
    ' required fields checked; ' + metrics.missingBackendRequiredFields + ' missing.');
}

function kawadV3_checkProposedRelationships_(cache, findings) {
  const t = cache[KS_DBV3.RELATIONSHIP_TAB];
  if (!t) return;
  const statusCol = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, 'Review status');
  const childCol = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, 'Child table');
  const fieldCol = kawadV3_col_(t.headers, 'Child field');
  let proposed = 0;
  t.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const status = statusCol >= 0 ? kawadV3_norm_(r[statusCol]) : '';
    if (!status) return;
