    if (!/APPROVED|CONFIRMED/i.test(status)) {
      proposed++;
      const child = childCol >= 0 ? kawadV3_norm_(r[childCol]) : 'Relationship register';
      const field = fieldCol >= 0 ? kawadV3_norm_(r[fieldCol]) : '';
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', child, i + 2, 'PROPOSED RELATIONSHIP NOT APPROVED',
        (field ? field + ': ' : '') + 'The relationship register marks this mapping as proposed/unverified. Confirm business meaning before enforcing it.');
    }
  });
  kawadV3_add_(findings, 'INFO', KS_DBV3.RELATIONSHIP_TAB, '-', 'RELATIONSHIP GOVERNANCE',
    proposed + ' proposed/unapproved relationship mappings remain advisory and were not used to reject records.');
}

function kawadV3_checkJournals_(cache, metrics, findings) {
  const h = cache.JournalHeaders, l = cache.JournalLines, a = cache.ChartOfAccounts;
  if (!h || !l) return;
  const hId = kawadV3_col_(h.headers, 'journal_id');
  const hDebit = kawadV3_col_(h.headers, 'total_debit');
  const hCredit = kawadV3_col_(h.headers, 'total_credit');
  const lId = kawadV3_col_(l.headers, 'journal_id');
  const lDebit = kawadV3_col_(l.headers, 'debit_amount');
  const lCredit = kawadV3_col_(l.headers, 'credit_amount');
  if ([hId,hDebit,hCredit,lId,lDebit,lCredit].some(x => x < 0)) {
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'JournalHeaders/JournalLines', '-', 'JOURNAL FIELDS MISSING',
      'Journal arithmetic could not be fully checked because required headers are missing.');
    return;
  }
  const totals = {};
  l.rows.forEach(r => {
    const id = kawadV3_norm_(r[lId]);
    if (!id) return;
    if (!totals[id]) totals[id] = {debit:0, credit:0};
    totals[id].debit += Number(r[lDebit] || 0);
    totals[id].credit += Number(r[lCredit] || 0);
  });
  h.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const id = kawadV3_norm_(r[hId]);
    if (!id) return;
    const line = totals[id] || {debit:0, credit:0};
    const hd = Number(r[hDebit] || 0), hc = Number(r[hCredit] || 0);
    const balanced = Math.abs(hd - hc) < 0.000001;
    const matches = Math.abs(hd - line.debit) < 0.000001 && Math.abs(hc - line.credit) < 0.000001;
    if (!balanced || !matches) {
      metrics.journalUnbalanced++;
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', 'JournalHeaders', i + 2, 'JOURNAL TOTAL MISMATCH',
        'Header debit/credit totals do not balance or do not match the sum of journal lines.');
    }
  });
  kawadV3_add_(findings, 'INFO', 'JournalHeaders', '-', 'JOURNAL CONTROL SUMMARY',
    'Journal header totals compared with journal-line totals. Count of mismatched journals: ' + metrics.journalUnbalanced + '.');
}

function kawadV3_checkRecipes_(cache, metrics, findings) {
  const r = cache.Recipes, p = cache.Products, rm = cache.RawMaterials;
  if (!r) return;
  const itemsCol = kawadV3_col_(r.headers, 'items_json');
  const productCol = kawadV3_col_(r.headers, 'product_id');
  const products = p ? new Set(p.rows.map(x => kawadV3_norm_(x[kawadV3_col_(p.headers,'product_id')])).filter(Boolean)) : new Set();
  const productNameCol = p ? kawadV3_col_(p.headers, 'product_name') : -1;
  const productNames = p && productNameCol >= 0 ? new Set(p.rows.map(x => kawadV3_norm_(x[productNameCol]).toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)) : new Set();
  const materialNames = rm ? new Set(rm.rows.map(x => kawadV3_norm_(x[kawadV3_col_(rm.headers,'material_name')]).toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)) : new Set();
  r.rows.forEach((row, i) => {
    if (!kawadV3_rowHasData_(row)) return;
    if (itemsCol >= 0 && kawadV3_norm_(row[itemsCol])) {
      try {
        const items = JSON.parse(String(row[itemsCol]));
        if (!Array.isArray(items)) throw new Error('not array');
        items.forEach(item => {
          if (item && item.material_name && materialNames.size &&
              !materialNames.has(String(item.material_name).trim().toLowerCase())) {
            kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'Recipes', i + 2, 'RECIPE MATERIAL NOT IN MASTER',
              'An ingredient name in items_json does not match RawMaterials.material_name. Confirm alias/ingredient master mapping.');
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        metrics.recipeJsonInvalid++;
        kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', 'Recipes', i + 2, 'INVALID RECIPE JSON',
          'items_json is not valid JSON array data.');
      }
    }
    if (productCol >= 0) {
      const pid = kawadV3_norm_(row[productCol]);
      if (pid && products.size && !products.has(pid)) {
        const nameCol = kawadV3_col_(r.headers, 'product_name_snapshot');
        const name = nameCol >= 0 ? kawadV3_norm_(row[nameCol]).toLowerCase() : '';
        const nameMatch = name && productNames.has(name);
        kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'Recipes', i + 2, 'RECIPE PRODUCT ID NOT IN PRODUCTS',
          'Recipe product_id is not a current Products.product_id. Product-name match=' + (nameMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO') +
          '. This may be a legacy ID mapping; do not rewrite until the canonical mapping is approved.');
      }
    }
  });
}

function kawadV3_checkPackaging_(cache, metrics, findings) {
  const t = cache.PackagingBatches;
  if (!t) return;
  const cols = {
    bulk:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'bulk_kg_used'),
    p200:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'packets_200g'),
    p500:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'packets_500g'),
    p1000:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'packets_1000g'),
    total:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'total_packets'),
    expected:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'expected_kg'),
    diff:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'difference_kg'),
    status:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'difference_status'),
    explanation:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'discrepancy_explanation'),
    approved:kawadV3_col_(t.headers,'discrepancy_approved')
  };
  if (Object.values(cols).some(x => x < 0)) {
    kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'PackagingBatches', '-', 'PACKAGING FIELDS MISSING',
      'Packet and variance arithmetic could not be fully checked.');
    return;
  }
  t.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (!kawadV3_rowHasData_(r)) return;
    const n200=Number(r[cols.p200]||0), n500=Number(r[cols.p500]||0), n1000=Number(r[cols.p1000]||0);
    const expected=(n200*0.2)+(n500*0.5)+(n1000*1.0);
    const total=n200+n500+n1000;
    const storedExpected=Number(r[cols.expected]||0);
    const storedTotal=Number(r[cols.total]||0);
    const diff=Number(r[cols.bulk]||0)-expected;
    const storedDiff=Number(r[cols.diff]||0);
    if (Math.abs(total-storedTotal)>0.000001 ||
        Math.abs(expected-storedExpected)>0.000001 ||
        Math.abs(diff-storedDiff)>0.000001) {
      metrics.packagingArithmeticMismatches++;
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'FAIL', 'PackagingBatches', i + 2, 'PACKAGING ARITHMETIC MISMATCH',
        'Stored packet total, expected kg or difference does not match packet counts and bulk_kg_used.');
    }
    if (Math.abs(diff)>0.000001) {
      metrics.packagingVarianceReview++;
      const explanation=kawadV3_norm_(r[cols.explanation]);
      const approved=kawadV3_norm_(r[cols.approved]).toLowerCase();
      kawadV3_add_(findings, 'REVIEW', 'PackagingBatches', i + 2, 'PACKAGING BULK VARIANCE',
        'Bulk remaining/difference is ' + diff.toFixed(3) + ' kg. Confirm residual bulk, process loss, stock return or approved variance. Explanation=' +
        (explanation ? 'present' : 'missing') + '; approved=' + (approved || 'blank') + '.');
    }
  });
}

function kawadV3_read_(sheet) {
  const range = sheet.getDataRange();
  const values = range.getValues();
  const display = range.getDisplayValues();
  const formulas = range.getFormulas();
  const headers = values.length ? values[0].map(v => kawadV3_norm_(v)) : [];
  const rows = values.length > 1 ? values.slice(1) : [];
  const columnHasData = headers.map((h,c) => values.some((row,i) => i > 0 && kawadV3_norm_(row[c]) !== ''));
  const dataRows = rows.filter(kawadV3_rowHasData_).length;
  return {headers, rows, values, display, formulas, columnHasData, dataRows};
}

function kawadV3_col_(headers, name) {
  const target = String(name).trim().toLowerCase();
  return headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === target);
}

function kawadV3_norm_(v) {
  return v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim();
}

function kawadV3_rowHasData_(row) {
  return row.some(v => kawadV3_norm_(v) !== '');
}

function kawadV3_add_(arr, status, tab, row, check, finding) {
  if (arr.length < KS_DBV3.MAX_CELL_FINDINGS) arr.push([status,tab,row,check,finding]);
}

function kawadV3_colLetter_(n) {
  let s='';
  while(n>0){const r=(n-1)%26;s=String.fromCharCode(65+r)+s;n=Math.floor((n-1)/26);}
  return s;
}

function kawadV3_createReport_(m, findings) {
  const doc = DocumentApp.create('Kawad Swad Complete Database Verification v3.0 - ' +
    Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'));
  const b = doc.getBody();
  b.appendParagraph('KAWAD SWAD | COMPLETE DATABASE VERIFICATION v3.0').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  b.appendParagraph('Generated: ' + new Date());
  b.appendParagraph('Workbook: ' + KS_DBV3.SPREADSHEET_NAME);
  b.appendParagraph('Mode: STRICT READ-ONLY. No business spreadsheet data or structure was changed.');
  b.appendParagraph('Important: This verifies workbook structure and selected data rules. It does not prove external money/stock evidence, backend runtime behavior, or production deployment readiness.');
  b.appendParagraph('Summary').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  Object.keys(m).forEach(k => b.appendParagraph(k + ': ' + m[k]));
  const counts={FAIL:0,REVIEW:0,INFO:0};
  findings.forEach(r => {if(counts[r[0]]!==undefined) counts[r[0]]++;});
  b.appendParagraph('Finding counts: FAIL=' + counts.FAIL + '; REVIEW=' + counts.REVIEW + '; INFO=' + counts.INFO);
  b.appendParagraph('Detailed findings').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  if (findings.length) {
    const t=b.appendTable();
    findings.forEach(r=>{const tr=t.appendTableRow();r.forEach(v=>tr.appendTableCell(String(v)));});
  } else b.appendParagraph('No findings generated.');
  b.appendParagraph('Go-live gates').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  [
    'Workbook structural checks and backend required-field checks must pass.',
    'All primary-key and confirmed-reference failures must be resolved.',
    'Proposed relationship mappings must be approved or explicitly excluded.',
    'Packaging bulk variances must be explained/approved or correctly represented as residual bulk.',
    'Bank, cash, supplier, customer and marketplace balances must be reconciled to external evidence.',
    'Opening inventory, movement signs, physical stock, production yield and process losses must be approved and reconciled.',
    'Backend route-level tests, Google Sheets persistence/retry tests, access controls and staging smoke tests must pass.',
    'Only then may the database be signed off as production-ready.'
  ].forEach(x=>b.appendListItem(x));
  b.appendParagraph('No repair, deletion, schema migration, or deployment was performed by this verification.');
  doc.saveAndClose();
  return doc.getUrl();
}



/* ===== PRODUCT AND RECIPE INVESTIGATION ===== */

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD | CONSOLIDATED PRODUCT + RECIPE INVESTIGATION v1.0
 *
 * STRICT READ-ONLY:
 * - Does not edit, rename, delete, or add anything to the business workbook.
 * - Creates one separate Google Doc report.
 *
 * Investigates:
 * 1. All Products master headers and populated records.
 * 2. Duplicate product IDs and duplicate product names.
 * 3. Product attributes that may distinguish pack sizes / variants / SKUs.
 * 4. All Recipes records and parsed ingredient JSON.
 * 5. Recipe-to-product candidate matches, without approving any mapping.
 * 6. ProductionBatches references to recipe IDs and product IDs.
 *
 * Run: kawadRunConsolidatedProductRecipeInvestigationV1()
 */

const KS_PRI = {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  SPREADSHEET_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets'
};

function kawadRunConsolidatedProductRecipeInvestigationV1() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_PRI.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_PRI.SPREADSHEET_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Stopped without making changes.');
  }

  const productsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Products');
  const recipesSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Recipes');
  const batchesSheet = ss.getSheetByName('ProductionBatches');
  if (!productsSheet || !recipesSheet) {
    throw new Error('Products or Recipes tab is missing. No changes made.');
  }

  const products = kspriRead_(productsSheet);
  const recipes = kspriRead_(recipesSheet);
  const batches = batchesSheet ? kspriRead_(batchesSheet) : {headers:[], rows:[]};

  const pId = kspriCol_(products.headers, ['product_id']);
  const pName = kspriCol_(products.headers, ['product_name','name']);
  const rId = kspriCol_(recipes.headers, ['recipe_id']);
  const rProduct = kspriCol_(recipes.headers, ['product_id']);
  const rSnapshot = kspriCol_(recipes.headers, ['product_name_snapshot']);
  const rItems = kspriCol_(recipes.headers, ['items_json','ingredients_json','recipe_json']);
  const bId = kspriCol_(batches.headers, ['production_id','batch_id']);
  const bRecipe = kspriCol_(batches.headers, ['recipe_id']);
  const bProduct = kspriCol_(batches.headers, ['product_id']);

  if (pId < 0 || pName < 0 || rId < 0 || rProduct < 0) {
    throw new Error('Required ID/name headers are missing. No changes made.');
  }

  const productRows = products.rows.map((row, i) => ({
    rowNumber: i + 2,
    values: row,
    id: kspriText_(row[pId]),
    name: kspriText_(row[pName])
  })).filter(x => x.values.some(v => kspriText_(v)));

  const recipeRows = recipes.rows.map((row, i) => ({
    rowNumber: i + 2,
    values: row,
    id: kspriText_(row[rId]),
    productId: kspriText_(row[rProduct]),
    snapshot: rSnapshot >= 0 ? kspriText_(row[rSnapshot]) : '',
    items: rItems >= 0 ? kspriText_(row[rItems]) : ''
  })).filter(x => x.values.some(v => kspriText_(v)));

  const idGroups = kspriGroup_(productRows, x => x.id);
  const nameGroups = kspriGroup_(productRows, x => kspriNorm_(x.name));
  const duplicateIds = Object.keys(idGroups).filter(k => k && idGroups[k].length > 1);
  const duplicateNames = Object.keys(nameGroups).filter(k => k && nameGroups[k].length > 1);

  const productById = {};
  productRows.forEach(p => { if (p.id) productById[p.id] = p; });

  const recipeAnalyses = recipeRows.map(r => {
    const exactIdProduct = productById[r.productId] || null;
    const nameKey = kspriNorm_(r.snapshot);
    const nameCandidates = nameKey && nameGroups[nameKey] ? nameGroups[nameKey] : [];
    let parsed = 'NOT PRESENT';
    let ingredientSummary = [];
    if (r.items) {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(r.items);
        parsed = Array.isArray(data) ? 'VALID JSON ARRAY' : 'VALID JSON, NOT ARRAY';
        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
          ingredientSummary = data.map(item => {
            if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
              return Object.keys(item).sort().map(k => k + '=' + String(item[k])).join('; ');
            }
            return String(item);
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        parsed = 'INVALID JSON';
      }
    }
    return {recipe:r, exactIdProduct, nameCandidates, parsed, ingredientSummary};
  });

  const batchAnalyses = batches.rows.map((row, i) => ({
    rowNumber: i + 2,
    id: bId >= 0 ? kspriText_(row[bId]) : '',
    recipeId: bRecipe >= 0 ? kspriText_(row[bRecipe]) : '',
    productId: bProduct >= 0 ? kspriText_(row[bProduct]) : '',
    values: row
  })).filter(x => x.values.some(v => kspriText_(v)));

  const doc = DocumentApp.create(
    'Kawad Swad Consolidated Product Recipe Investigation - ' +
    Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')
  );
  const body = doc.getBody();

  body.appendParagraph('KAWAD SWAD | CONSOLIDATED PRODUCT + RECIPE INVESTIGATION')
      .setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  body.appendParagraph('Generated: ' + new Date());
  body.appendParagraph('Workbook: ' + KS_PRI.SPREADSHEET_NAME);
  body.appendParagraph('Mode: STRICT READ-ONLY. No business spreadsheet data or structure was changed.');
  body.appendParagraph('This report is evidence for review. It does not approve or perform any ID correction.');

  body.appendParagraph('1. Summary').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  [
    'Products records inspected: ' + productRows.length,
    'Recipes records inspected: ' + recipeRows.length,
    'ProductionBatches records inspected: ' + batchAnalyses.length,
    'Duplicate product ID groups: ' + duplicateIds.length,
    'Duplicate normalized product-name groups: ' + duplicateNames.length,
    'Recipe IDs with exact current product ID: ' + recipeAnalyses.filter(x => x.exactIdProduct).length,
    'Recipe IDs without exact current product ID: ' + recipeAnalyses.filter(x => !x.exactIdProduct).length,
    'Recipe rows with invalid ingredient JSON: ' + recipeAnalyses.filter(x => x.parsed === 'INVALID JSON').length
  ].forEach(x => body.appendParagraph(x));

  body.appendParagraph('2. Products master structure').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  body.appendParagraph('All existing Products headers are listed below in their current order. No header changes are suggested by this report.');
  body.appendParagraph(products.headers.map((h,i) => (i+1) + '. ' + (h || '[BLANK HEADER]')).join('\n'));

  body.appendParagraph('3. Duplicate product ID groups').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  if (!duplicateIds.length) body.appendParagraph('No duplicate nonblank product IDs detected.');
  duplicateIds.forEach(k => {
    body.appendParagraph('Product ID: ' + k).setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING3);
    idGroups[k].forEach(p => body.appendParagraph('Products row ' + p.rowNumber + ': ' + kspriRowSummary_(products.headers,p.values)));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('4. Duplicate product-name groups and distinguishing attributes').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  if (!duplicateNames.length) body.appendParagraph('No duplicate normalized product names detected.');
  duplicateNames.forEach(k => {
    body.appendParagraph('Normalized name: ' + k).setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING3);
    nameGroups[k].forEach(p => body.appendParagraph('Products row ' + p.rowNumber + ': ' + kspriRowSummary_(products.headers,p.values)));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('5. Complete Products master records').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  productRows.forEach(p => {
    body.appendParagraph('Products row ' + p.rowNumber + ' | ' + (p.id || '(blank ID)') + ' | ' + (p.name || '(blank name)'))
        .setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING3);
    body.appendParagraph(kspriRowSummary_(products.headers,p.values));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('6. Recipe-by-recipe mapping and ingredient evidence').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  recipeAnalyses.forEach(x => {
    const r = x.recipe;
    body.appendParagraph('Recipes row ' + r.rowNumber + ' | ' + (r.id || '(blank recipe ID)'))
        .setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING3);
    body.appendParagraph('Current recipe product_id: ' + (r.productId || '(blank)'));
    body.appendParagraph('Product name snapshot: ' + (r.snapshot || '(blank)'));
    body.appendParagraph('Exact product ID exists in Products: ' + (x.exactIdProduct ? 'YES, Products row ' + x.exactIdProduct.rowNumber : 'NO'));
    body.appendParagraph('Exact normalized name candidates: ' + x.nameCandidates.length);
    x.nameCandidates.forEach(p => body.appendParagraph('Candidate Products row ' + p.rowNumber + ': ' + p.id + ' | ' + p.name + ' | ' + kspriRowSummary_(products.headers,p.values)));
    body.appendParagraph('Ingredient JSON status: ' + x.parsed);
    if (x.ingredientSummary.length) {
      body.appendParagraph('Parsed ingredients:');
      x.ingredientSummary.forEach(s => body.appendListItem(s));
    }
    body.appendParagraph('Complete existing recipe row: ' + kspriRowSummary_(recipes.headers,r.values));
    body.appendParagraph('Proposed disposition: OWNER REVIEW REQUIRED. No automatic mapping selected.');
  });

  body.appendParagraph('7. Production batch references').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  if (!batchesSheet) {
    body.appendParagraph('ProductionBatches tab not found.');
  } else {
    body.appendParagraph('ProductionBatches headers: ' + batches.headers.map((h,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+(h||'[BLANK HEADER]')).join(' | '));
    batchAnalyses.forEach(b => {
      body.appendParagraph('ProductionBatches row ' + b.rowNumber +
        ' | production/batch ID=' + (b.id || '(blank)') +
        ' | recipe_id=' + (b.recipeId || '(blank)') +
        ' | product_id=' + (b.productId || '(blank)'));
      body.appendParagraph('Full existing batch row: ' + kspriRowSummary_(batches.headers,b.values));
    });
  }

  body.appendParagraph('8. Mapping decision register').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  body.appendParagraph('Use this section to record a decision for every recipe. The report intentionally leaves decisions blank.');
  const decisionTable = body.appendTable();
  ['recipe_id','current product_id','product_name_snapshot','evidence/candidate count','owner decision','approved canonical product_id','reason/evidence'].forEach(h => decisionTable.appendTableRow().appendTableCell(h));
  recipeAnalyses.forEach(x => {
    const tr = decisionTable.appendTableRow();
    [
      x.recipe.id, x.recipe.productId, x.recipe.snapshot,
      x.exactIdProduct ? 'Exact ID exists' : String(x.nameCandidates.length) + ' name candidates',
      '', '', ''
    ].forEach(v => tr.appendTableCell(String(v || '')));
  });

  body.appendParagraph('9. Safety and interpretation rules').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  [
    'Do not infer pack size, SKU, or variant from repeated product names unless the corresponding fields and business rules confirm it.',
    'Do not change recipe product_id solely because a product name matches.',
    'Do not delete duplicate-looking Products records. They may represent pack-size records or historical records.',
    'Confirm recipe usage against approved formulations and actual production history.',
    'After owner decisions, prepare a separate repair plan with backup and before/after validation. Do not execute repairs as part of this audit.'
  ].forEach(x => body.appendListItem(x));

  body.appendParagraph('No repair, deletion, schema migration, or deployment was performed.');
  doc.saveAndClose();
  Logger.log('CONSOLIDATED PRODUCT + RECIPE INVESTIGATION REPORT: ' + doc.getUrl());
  return doc.getUrl();
}

function kspriRead_(sheet) {
  const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  return {
    headers: values.length ? values[0].map(kspriText_) : [],
    rows: values.length > 1 ? values.slice(1) : []
  };
}
function kspriCol_(headers, aliases) {
  for (const name of aliases) {
    const i = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase());
    if (i >= 0) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}
function kspriText_(v) {
  return v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim();
}
function kspriNorm_(v) {
  return String(v || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKC')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
}
function kspriGroup_(items, keyFn) {
  const out = {};
  items.forEach(x => {
    const k = keyFn(x);
    if (!out[k]) out[k] = [];
    out[k].push(x);
  });
  return out;
}
function kspriRowSummary_(headers, row) {
  const parts = [];
  headers.forEach((h,i) => {
    const v = kspriText_(row[i]);
    if (v !== '') parts.push((h || '[BLANK HEADER ' + (i+1) + ']') + ': ' + v);
  });
  return parts.join(' | ') || '(no populated fields)';
}



/* ===== REPAIR PREVIEW (APPLY DISABLED) ===== */

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD MASTER DATABASE REPAIR CONTROLLER v1.0
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * - Stage 1 (PREVIEW) is read-only against the business workbook.
 * - Stage 2 (APPLY) is disabled by default and requires explicit configuration.
 * - The script never guesses account codes, batch IDs, stock references,
 *   opening balances, cash movements, recipe yields, or external reconciliations.
 * - Before any approved write, it creates a separate Drive copy of the workbook.
 * - It only writes explicitly configured cells / rows in the named tabs.
 *
 * Install in the Apps Script project attached to the Kawad Swad workbook.
 * Run kawadRepairPreview() first. Do not enable APPLY until all mappings
 * have been verified against source documents and approved.
 */

const KS_REPAIR = {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  SPREADSHEET_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  APPLY_CHANGES: false, // Change to true only after reviewing the preview and filling every approved mapping.
  REQUIRE_BACKUP: true,
  REPORT_TITLE_PREFIX: 'Kawad Swad Database Repair',
  TABS: {
    JOURNAL_LINES: 'JournalLines',
    CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS: 'ChartOfAccounts',
    PRODUCTION_BATCHES: 'ProductionBatches',
    PRODUCTION_STOCK_LEDGER: 'ProductionStockLedger'
  },

  /**
   * ACCOUNT MASTER ROWS
   * Add one object for each genuinely missing account after verifying it.
   * Keys MUST exactly match the ChartOfAccounts header names.
   * Example only (do not copy placeholder values):
   * { account_code: 'VERIFIED_CODE', account_name: 'Verified account name',
   *   account_type: 'Verified type', is_active: true }
   *
   * Empty by default. No accounts will be invented.
   */
  APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS: [],

  /**
   * Optional account-code corrections.
   * Use actual sheet row numbers (as shown in the audit), and include the
   * exact current value as a guard against editing a changed record.
   * Example only:
   * { row: 2, expectedOldCode: 'CURRENT_CODE', approvedNewCode: 'VERIFIED_CODE' }
   */
  APPROVED_ACCOUNT_CODE_CORRECTIONS: [],

  /**
   * Production batch ID repairs.
   * Fill only after confirming the intended batch_id from original records.
   * Example only:
   * { row: 2, expectedOldValue: '', approvedValue: 'VERIFIED_BATCH_ID' }
   */
  APPROVED_BATCH_ID_REPAIRS: [],

  /**
   * Production stock ledger batch-reference repairs.
   * Fill only where the movement is production-related and the correct
   * production_id is confirmed from source records.
   * Example only:
   * { row: 2, expectedOldValue: '', approvedProductionId: 'VERIFIED_PRODUCTION_ID' }
   */
  APPROVED_STOCK_BATCH_LINKS: [],

  /**
   * These areas require source documents and approved accounting/business rules.
   * This script deliberately reports them as NOT AUTOMATICALLY REPAIRABLE.
   */
  MANUAL_RECONCILIATION_AREAS: [
    'Bank statement and cash-count reconciliation',
    'Customer receipts and marketplace settlements',
    'Supplier invoices and supplier payment reconciliation',
    'Opening stock and stock movement sign convention',
    'Production recipe, yield, process loss and actual output',
    'Daily closing cash / UPI / bank treatment',
    'Complete relationship mapping and transaction classification'
  ]
};

function kawadRepairPreview() {
  const ss = kawadGetVerifiedSpreadsheet_();
  const findings = [];
  const summary = {
    journalLinesChecked: 0,
    unmatchedAccountCodes: 0,
    blankBatchIds: 0,
    blankProductionStockLinks: 0,
    proposedAccountRows: KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS.length,
    configuredAccountCorrections: KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_ACCOUNT_CODE_CORRECTIONS.length,
    configuredBatchRepairs: KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_BATCH_ID_REPAIRS.length,
    configuredStockLinks: KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_STOCK_BATCH_LINKS.length
  };

  const coa = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS);
  const jl = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.JOURNAL_LINES);
  const pb = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_BATCHES);
  const psl = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_STOCK_LEDGER);

  if (!coa || !jl || !pb || !psl) {
    throw new Error('Required tab missing. No changes made. Check exact tab names.');
  }

  const coaData = kawadReadTable_(coa);
  const jlData = kawadReadTable_(jl);
  const pbData = kawadReadTable_(pb);
  const pslData = kawadReadTable_(psl);

  const coaCodeCol = kawadFindColumn_(coaData.headers, ['account_code']);
  const jlCodeCol = kawadFindColumn_(jlData.headers, ['account_code']);
  if (coaCodeCol < 0 || jlCodeCol < 0) {
    findings.push(['BLOCKER', 'Accounting', '-', 'Required account_code header not found.']);
  } else {
    const masterCodes = new Set(coaData.rows.map(r => kawadRepairNorm_(r[coaCodeCol])).filter(Boolean));
    const correctionByRow = new Map(KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_ACCOUNT_CODE_CORRECTIONS.map(x => [Number(x.row), x]));
    jlData.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const sheetRow = i + 2;
      const code = kawadRepairNorm_(r[jlCodeCol]);
      if (!code) return;
      summary.journalLinesChecked++;
      if (!masterCodes.has(code)) {
        summary.unmatchedAccountCodes++;
        const configured = correctionByRow.get(sheetRow);
        findings.push([
          configured ? 'CONFIGURED, VERIFY' : 'FAIL',
          'JournalLines',
          sheetRow,
          configured
            ? 'Unmatched account code has a proposed replacement. Verify against source documents.'
            : 'Account code does not exist in ChartOfAccounts.'
        ]);
      }
    });
  }

  const pbIdCol = kawadFindColumn_(pbData.headers, ['batch_id']);
  if (pbIdCol < 0) {
    findings.push(['BLOCKER', 'ProductionBatches', '-', 'batch_id header not found.']);
  } else {
    pbData.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (!kawadRepairNorm_(r[pbIdCol])) {
        summary.blankBatchIds++;
        findings.push(['REVIEW', 'ProductionBatches', i + 2, 'batch_id is blank. Requires verified source value or approved optional-field rule.']);
      }
    });
  }

  const pslRefCol = kawadFindColumn_(pslData.headers, ['production_batch_id']);
  if (pslRefCol < 0) {
    findings.push(['BLOCKER', 'ProductionStockLedger', '-', 'production_batch_id header not found.']);
  } else {
    pslData.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (!kawadRepairNorm_(r[pslRefCol])) {
        summary.blankProductionStockLinks++;
        findings.push(['REVIEW', 'ProductionStockLedger', i + 2, 'production_batch_id is blank. Determine movement type before linking.']);
      }
    });
  }

  const reportUrl = kawadCreateReport_('PREVIEW', summary, findings, [
    'No business workbook cells, tabs, formulas or formatting were changed.',
    'This preview does not verify external bank statements, cash counts, supplier invoices, receipts or marketplace settlements.',
    'Do not approve a repair merely because a field is blank; verify the business rule and original source record.',
    'Configured mappings are proposals only until APPLY_CHANGES is explicitly enabled.'
  ]);

  Logger.log('Repair preview report: ' + reportUrl);
  return reportUrl;
}

function kawadApplyApprovedRepairs() { throw new Error('Disabled in the consolidated baseline. Review the repair preview and request a separately reviewed migration script. No data changed.'); }

function kawadGetVerifiedSpreadsheet_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_REPAIR.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_REPAIR.SPREADSHEET_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Expected "' + KS_REPAIR.SPREADSHEET_NAME +
      '" but found "' + ss.getName() + '". No changes made.');
  }
  return ss;
}

function kawadReadTable_(sheet) {
  const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (!values.length) return {headers: [], rows: []};
  const headers = values[0].map(v => String(v).trim());
  return {headers: headers, rows: values.slice(1)};
}

function kawadFindColumn_(headers, acceptedNames) {
  const normalized = headers.map(h => kawadRepairNorm_(h));
  for (const name of acceptedNames) {
    const idx = normalized.indexOf(kawadRepairNorm_(name));
    if (idx >= 0) return idx;
  }
  return -1;
}

function kawadRepairNorm_(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
  return String(value).trim();
}

function kawadValidateAllApprovedMappings_(ss) {
  const requiredTabs = [
    KS_REPAIR.TABS.JOURNAL_LINES,
    KS_REPAIR.TABS.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS,
    KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_BATCHES,
    KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_STOCK_LEDGER
  ];
  requiredTabs.forEach(name => {
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(name)) throw new Error('Missing required tab: ' + name);
  });

  const coa = kawadReadTable_(ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS));
  const jl = kawadReadTable_(ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.JOURNAL_LINES));
  const pb = kawadReadTable_(ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_BATCHES));
  const psl = kawadReadTable_(ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_STOCK_LEDGER));

  const coaCodeCol = kawadFindColumn_(coa.headers, ['account_code']);
  const jlCodeCol = kawadFindColumn_(jl.headers, ['account_code']);
  const pbIdCol = kawadFindColumn_(pb.headers, ['batch_id']);
  const pslRefCol = kawadFindColumn_(psl.headers, ['production_batch_id']);
  if ([coaCodeCol, jlCodeCol, pbIdCol, pslRefCol].some(i => i < 0)) {
    throw new Error('One or more required headers are missing. No changes made.');
  }

  // Validate new account rows against exact existing header set.
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS.forEach((obj, i) => {
    const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
    const expected = coa.headers.filter(Boolean).slice().sort();
    if (JSON.stringify(keys) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) {
      throw new Error('APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS item ' + (i + 1) +
        ' must provide every nonblank ChartOfAccounts header exactly once. No changes made.');
    }
    if (!kawadRepairNorm_(obj.account_code)) throw new Error('New account row has blank account_code.');
  });

  const jlValues = jl.rows;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_ACCOUNT_CODE_CORRECTIONS.forEach(x => {
    const row = Number(x.row);
    if (!Number.isInteger(row) || row < 2 || row > jlValues.length + 1) throw new Error('Invalid JournalLines row: ' + x.row);
    const current = kawadRepairNorm_(jlValues[row - 2][jlCodeCol]);
    if (current !== kawadRepairNorm_(x.expectedOldCode)) throw new Error('JournalLines row ' + row + ' changed since mapping was prepared.');
    if (!kawadRepairNorm_(x.approvedNewCode)) throw new Error('Blank approvedNewCode at JournalLines row ' + row);
  });

  const pbValues = pb.rows;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_BATCH_ID_REPAIRS.forEach(x => {
    const row = Number(x.row);
    if (!Number.isInteger(row) || row < 2 || row > pbValues.length + 1) throw new Error('Invalid ProductionBatches row: ' + x.row);
    if (kawadRepairNorm_(pbValues[row - 2][pbIdCol]) !== kawadRepairNorm_(x.expectedOldValue)) {
      throw new Error('ProductionBatches row ' + row + ' changed since mapping was prepared.');
    }
    if (!kawadRepairNorm_(x.approvedValue)) throw new Error('Blank approved batch ID at row ' + row);
  });

  const stockValues = psl.rows;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_STOCK_BATCH_LINKS.forEach(x => {
    const row = Number(x.row);
    if (!Number.isInteger(row) || row < 2 || row > stockValues.length + 1) throw new Error('Invalid ProductionStockLedger row: ' + x.row);
    if (kawadRepairNorm_(stockValues[row - 2][pslRefCol]) !== kawadRepairNorm_(x.expectedOldValue)) {
      throw new Error('ProductionStockLedger row ' + row + ' changed since mapping was prepared.');
    }
    if (!kawadRepairNorm_(x.approvedProductionId)) throw new Error('Blank approvedProductionId at row ' + row);
  });

  // Prevent duplicate account codes in the resulting ChartOfAccounts.
  const codes = coa.rows.map(r => kawadRepairNorm_(r[coaCodeCol])).filter(Boolean);
  const proposedCodes = KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS.map(x => kawadRepairNorm_(x.account_code));
  const allCodes = codes.concat(proposedCodes);
  if (new Set(allCodes).size !== allCodes.length) throw new Error('Duplicate account_code in current/proposed ChartOfAccounts.');
}

function kawadApplyAccountMasterRows_(ss, log) {
  const entries = KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_NEW_ACCOUNTS;
  if (!entries.length) return;
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS);
  const table = kawadReadTable_(sheet);
  entries.forEach(obj => {
    const row = table.headers.map(h => obj[h]);
    sheet.appendRow(row);
    log.push(['APPLIED', sheet.getName(), sheet.getLastRow(), 'Added explicitly approved ChartOfAccounts row.']);
  });
}

function kawadApplyAccountCorrections_(ss, log) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.JOURNAL_LINES);
  const table = kawadReadTable_(sheet);
  const col = kawadFindColumn_(table.headers, ['account_code']) + 1;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_ACCOUNT_CODE_CORRECTIONS.forEach(x => {
    sheet.getRange(Number(x.row), col).setValue(x.approvedNewCode);
    log.push(['APPLIED', sheet.getName(), x.row, 'Updated account_code from verified expected value.']);
  });
}

function kawadApplyBatchIdRepairs_(ss, log) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_BATCHES);
  const table = kawadReadTable_(sheet);
  const col = kawadFindColumn_(table.headers, ['batch_id']) + 1;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_BATCH_ID_REPAIRS.forEach(x => {
    sheet.getRange(Number(x.row), col).setValue(x.approvedValue);
    log.push(['APPLIED', sheet.getName(), x.row, 'Filled batch_id using explicitly approved source value.']);
  });
}

function kawadApplyStockLinks_(ss, log) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_REPAIR.TABS.PRODUCTION_STOCK_LEDGER);
  const table = kawadReadTable_(sheet);
  const col = kawadFindColumn_(table.headers, ['production_batch_id']) + 1;
  KS_REPAIR.APPROVED_STOCK_BATCH_LINKS.forEach(x => {
    sheet.getRange(Number(x.row), col).setValue(x.approvedProductionId);
    log.push(['APPLIED', sheet.getName(), x.row, 'Filled production_batch_id using explicitly approved reference.']);
  });
}

function kawadCreateReport_(mode, summary, rows, notes) {
  const doc = DocumentApp.create(KS_REPAIR.REPORT_TITLE_PREFIX + ' - ' + mode + ' - ' +
    Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'));
  const body = doc.getBody();
  body.appendParagraph('KAWAD SWAD | MASTER DATABASE REPAIR ' + mode).setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING1);
  body.appendParagraph('Generated: ' + new Date());
  body.appendParagraph('Workbook: ' + KS_REPAIR.SPREADSHEET_NAME);
  body.appendParagraph('Mode: ' + mode);
  body.appendParagraph('Summary').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  Object.keys(summary || {}).forEach(k => body.appendParagraph(k + ': ' + summary[k]));
  body.appendParagraph('Findings / changes').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  if (rows && rows.length) {
    const table = body.appendTable();
    rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const tr = table.appendTableRow();
      r.forEach(v => tr.appendTableCell(String(v)));
    });
  } else {
    body.appendParagraph('No configured findings or changes.');
  }
  body.appendParagraph('Notes and limitations').setHeading(DocumentApp.ParagraphHeading.HEADING2);
  (notes || []).forEach(n => body.appendListItem(n));
  body.appendParagraph('Safety: This report is separate from the business workbook.');
  doc.saveAndClose();
  return doc.getUrl();
}

const KS_MASTER = Object.freeze({

  ID_RULES: {
    Products:['product_id','PRD'], Customers:['customer_id','CUS'], RawMaterials:['raw_material_id','RAW'],
    Workers:['worker_id','WRK'], Users:['user_id','USR'], AuthUsers:['auth_id','AUTH'],
    Sales:['sale_id','SAL'], SaleItems:['sale_item_id','SIT'], Payments:['payment_id','PAY'],
    RawMaterialLedger:['ledger_id','RML'], ProductionBatches:['production_id','PDB'],
    PackagingBatches:['packaging_id','PKG'], ProductionStockLedger:['movement_id','MOV'],
    ProductionDispatches:['dispatch_id','DSP'], Expenses:['expense_id','EXP'], DailyClosing:['closing_id','CLS'],
    AuditLog:['audit_id','AUD'], IdAllocations:['allocation_id','IDA'], ApprovalRequests:['request_id','APR'],
    JournalHeaders:['journal_id','JRN'], JournalLines:['line_id','JLN']
  },
  PROP_PREFIX:'KAWAD_ID_SEQ_V1_'
});

function ksBuildMasterMenu_() {
  const ui=SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  ui.createMenu('Kawad Swad ERP')
    .addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('Run All Checks')
      .addItem('Run Complete Read-Only Check Suite','ksRunAllReadOnlyChecks')
      .addItem('Master Database Audit','kawadRunMasterDatabaseAudit')
      .addItem('Transaction Integrity Audit','kawadRunTransactionIntegrityAudit')
      .addItem('Complete Database Verification','kawadRunCompleteDatabaseVerificationV3')
      .addItem('Product & Recipe Investigation','kawadRunConsolidatedProductRecipeInvestigationV1')
      .addItem('Repair Preview Only','kawadRepairPreview'))
    .addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('Schema & Setup')
      .addItem('Implementation Preflight','ksRunPreflight')
      .addItem('Rebuild Field Mapping','ksBuildFieldMapping')
      .addItem('Create / Verify Report Tabs','ksApplySafeFoundation'))
    .addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('ID Management')
      .addItem('Audit IDs (No Business Changes)','ksAuditIds')
      .addItem('Generate ID for Selected Row','ksGenerateIdForSelectedRow'))
    .addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('Backup')
      .addItem('Create Full Spreadsheet Backup','ksCreateBackup'))
    .addToUi();
}

function ksRunAllReadOnlyChecks() {
  const jobs=[
    ['Master Database Audit',kawadRunMasterDatabaseAudit],
    ['Transaction Integrity Audit',kawadRunTransactionIntegrityAudit],
    ['Complete Database Verification',kawadRunCompleteDatabaseVerificationV3],
    ['Product & Recipe Investigation',kawadRunConsolidatedProductRecipeInvestigationV1],
    ['Repair Preview',kawadRepairPreview],
    ['Schema Preflight',ksRunPreflight]
  ];
  const results=[];
  jobs.forEach(([label,fn])=>{try{const result=fn();results.push([label,'COMPLETED',typeof result==='string'?result:'See execution log / report']);}catch(e){results.push([label,'FAILED',String(e&&e.message||e)]);}});
  const msg=results.map(r=>r.join(' | ')).join('\n\n');
  Logger.log(msg);
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Kawad Swad ERP | Check Suite',msg,SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
  return results;
}

function ksGenerateIdForSelectedRow() {
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if(!ss || ss.getName()!==KS_MASTER.EXPECTED_NAME) throw new Error('Open the approved Kawad Swad workbook first.');
  const sh=ss.getActiveSheet(), row=sh.getActiveRange().getRow(), rule=KS_MASTER.ID_RULES[sh.getName()];
  if(row<=1) throw new Error('Select one data row, not the header row.');
  if(!rule) throw new Error('No approved ID rule for tab: '+sh.getName());
  const lastCol=sh.getLastColumn(); if(!lastCol) throw new Error('The selected sheet has no headers.');
  const headers=sh.getRange(1,1,1,lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v=>String(v).trim());
  const idCol=headers.indexOf(rule[0])+1; if(!idCol) throw new Error('Required ID header not found: '+rule[0]);
  const rowValues=sh.getRange(row,1,1,lastCol).getValues()[0];
  if(!rowValues.some(v=>v!=='' && v!==null)) throw new Error('Selected row is empty.');
  const lock=LockService.getDocumentLock(); lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const cell=sh.getRange(row,idCol);
    if(String(cell.getDisplayValue()).trim()) throw new Error('This row already has an ID. Existing IDs are never overwritten.');
    const id=ksNextUniqueId_(sh,idCol,rule[1]);
    cell.setNumberFormat('@'); cell.setValue(id);
    if(typeof ksLog_==='function') ksLog_('ID_GENERATED','New ID generated for '+sh.getName()+' row '+row,{field:rule[0],row:row,id:id});
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Generated ID: '+id+'\nSheet: '+sh.getName()+'\nRow: '+row);
    return id;
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}

function ksNextUniqueId_(sh,idCol,prefix) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(), key=KS_MASTER.PROP_PREFIX+sh.getName();
  let seq=Number(props.getProperty(key)||0), last=sh.getLastRow();
  const seen=new Set(last>1?sh.getRange(2,idCol,last-1,1).getDisplayValues().flat().map(v=>String(v).trim().toUpperCase()):[]);
  let id; do {seq++;id=prefix+'-'+String(seq).padStart(6,'0');} while(seen.has(id.toUpperCase()));
  props.setProperty(key,String(seq)); return id;
}

function ksAuditIds() {
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if(!ss || ss.getName()!==KS_MASTER.EXPECTED_NAME) throw new Error('Open the approved Kawad Swad workbook first.');
  const rows=[['Sheet','ID Field','Populated Rows','Blank IDs','Duplicate IDs','Result']];
  Object.keys(KS_MASTER.ID_RULES).forEach(name=>{
    const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name); if(!sh)return;
    const [field]=KS_MASTER.ID_RULES[name], lastCol=sh.getLastColumn(), headers=lastCol?sh.getRange(1,1,1,lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v=>String(v).trim()):[];
    const idx=headers.indexOf(field); if(idx<0){rows.push([name,field,0,'-','-','HEADER MISSING']);return;}
    const last=sh.getLastRow(), data=last>1?sh.getRange(2,1,last-1,lastCol).getValues():[], vals=data.map(r=>r[idx]);
    let populated=0,blank=0,duplicates=0; const seen=new Set();
    data.forEach((r,i)=>{if(!r.some(v=>v!==''&&v!==null))return;populated++;const v=String(vals[i]??'').trim();if(!v){blank++;return;}const k=v.toUpperCase();if(seen.has(k))duplicates++;else seen.add(k);});
    rows.push([name,field,populated,blank,duplicates,blank||duplicates?'REVIEW':'OK']);
  });
  let report=ss.getSheetByName('KS_ID_AUDIT'); if(!report) report=ss.insertSheet('KS_ID_AUDIT');
  report.clearContents(); report.getRange(1,1,rows.length,rows[0].length).setValues(rows); report.setFrozenRows(1); report.getRange(1,1,1,rows[0].length).setFontWeight('bold');
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('ID audit completed. Review KS_ID_AUDIT. No business IDs were changed.');
  return rows;
}
function kawadRunMasterDatabaseAuditWithNotice() {
  try {
    console.log('MASTER DATABASE AUDIT STARTED');

    const reportUrl = kawadRunMasterDatabaseAudit();

    if (reportUrl) {
      console.log('MASTER DATABASE AUDIT COMPLETED');
      console.log('OPEN YOUR AUDIT REPORT: ' + reportUrl);
      Logger.log('AUDIT REPORT: ' + reportUrl);
    } else {
      console.log('Audit returned no report URL. Check the execution logs.');
    }

    return reportUrl;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('MASTER DATABASE AUDIT FAILED: ' + error.stack);
    Logger.log('AUDIT ERROR: ' + error.message);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * 1. Dry-Run Preview (Read-Only)
 */
function ksPreviewDatabaseReconciliation() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksPreviewDatabaseReconciliation');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const dictMap = ksLoadFullFieldDictionaryMap_(ss);

  let tablesToHydrate = 0;
  let totalColumnsToAppend = 0;
  const previewDetails = [];

  Object.keys(dictMap).forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) return;
    const existingHeaders = sh.getLastColumn() > 0
      ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim())
      : [];
    const existingSet = new Set(existingHeaders.filter(Boolean));
    const missingCols = dictMap[tabName].filter(col => !existingSet.has(col));

    if (missingCols.length > 0) {
      tablesToHydrate++;
      totalColumnsToAppend += missingCols.length;
      previewDetails.push({
        tab: tabName,
        existing_cols: existingHeaders.length,
        missing_cols_count: missingCols.length,
        sample_missing: missingCols.slice(0, 6)
      });
    }
  });

  const legacyPresent = KS_NONCANONICAL_LEGACY_TABS.filter(t => !!ss.getSheetByName(t));

  Logger.log('=== DATABASE RECONCILIATION DRY-RUN PREVIEW ===');
  Logger.log('Canonical tables in dictionary: ' + Object.keys(dictMap).length);
  Logger.log('Tables needing dictionary header hydration: ' + tablesToHydrate + ' (total columns to append: ' + totalColumnsToAppend + ')');
  Logger.log('Noncanonical legacy tabs present to tag LEGACY_READONLY_: ' + legacyPresent.length);
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(previewDetails.slice(0, 25), null, 2));

  return {
    checked_by: ctx.user_id,
    canonical_tables_found: Object.keys(dictMap).length,
    tables_to_hydrate: tablesToHydrate,
    total_columns_to_append: totalColumnsToAppend,
    legacy_tabs_to_tag: legacyPresent.length
  };
}

/**
 * 2. Execute Controlled Database Reconciliation (Hydrate Dictionary + Double-Entry + Quarantine Legacy Tabs)
 */
function ksExecuteDatabaseReconciliation(confirmationPhrase) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksExecuteDatabaseReconciliation');
  if (confirmationPhrase !== 'RECONCILE_DISPOSABLE_OR_STAGING_DB') {
    throw new Error('Safety Lock (POL-018): Pass exact phrase "RECONCILE_DISPOSABLE_OR_STAGING_DB" to run schema reconciliation.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const dictMap = ksLoadFullFieldDictionaryMap_(ss);

  let hydratedTablesCount = 0;
  let appendedColsCount = 0;

  // Step A: Hydrate all 218 canonical tables from DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074
  Object.keys(dictMap).forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) return;

    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const existingHeaders = lastCol > 0
      ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim())
      : [];
    const existingSet = new Set(existingHeaders.filter(Boolean));
    const missingCols = dictMap[tabName].filter(col => !existingSet.has(col));

    if (missingCols.length > 0) {
      const startCol = existingHeaders.length + 1;
      sh.getRange(1, startCol, 1, missingCols.length).setValues([missingCols]);
      sh.getRange(1, startCol, 1, missingCols.length).setFontWeight('bold');
      hydratedTablesCount++;
      appendedColsCount += missingCols.length;
    }
  });

  // Step B: Enforce POL-008 Double-Entry Split Columns on Canonical Journal Tables
  const jvHeadAdded = ksEnsureColumnsExist_(ss, 'JournalEntries', ['total_debit', 'total_credit', 'financial_period_id', 'posting_status']);
  const jvLineAdded = ksEnsureColumnsExist_(ss, 'JournalEntryLines', ['debit_amount', 'credit_amount', 'account_code', 'cost_centre_id']);

  // Step C: Quarantine 30 Noncanonical Legacy Operational Tabs as LEGACY_READONLY_*
  const taggedLegacyTabs = [];
  KS_NONCANONICAL_LEGACY_TABS.forEach(legacyName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(legacyName);
    if (!sh) return;
    const archivedName = 'LEGACY_READONLY_' + legacyName;
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(archivedName)) {
      sh.setName(archivedName);
      sh.hideSheet();
      taggedLegacyTabs.push(legacyName + ' -> ' + archivedName);
    }
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  ksLogAudit_('DATABASE_SCHEMA_RECONCILED', 'WORKBOOK', ss.getId(), {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'canonical_headers_and_legacy_tabs',
    old_value: 'Placeholder headers + overlapping legacy tabs',
    new_value: 'Hydrated ' + hydratedTablesCount + ' tables (+' + appendedColsCount + ' cols), Journal debit/credit split enforced, Tagged ' + taggedLegacyTabs.length + ' legacy tabs',
    reason: 'Executed schema reconciliation per POL-008 & POL-018',
    approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
  });

  const summary = {
    success: true,
    hydrated_tables: hydratedTablesCount,
    appended_columns: appendedColsCount,
    journal_entries_cols_added: jvHeadAdded,
    journal_lines_cols_added: jvLineAdded,
    tagged_legacy_tabs_count: taggedLegacyTabs.length,
    tagged_legacy_tabs: taggedLegacyTabs
  };

  Logger.log('=== DATABASE RECONCILIATION COMPLETE ===');
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
  return summary;
}

function ksRunDatabaseReconciliationNow() {
  return ksExecuteDatabaseReconciliation('RECONCILE_DISPOSABLE_OR_STAGING_DB');
}

/**
 * 3. Safe Old-Header Cleaner & V2.0 Baseline Finalizer (POL-017 & POL-018):
 * - Purges leftover Phase G test rows (Row 2+) across transactional tables.
 * - Deletes obsolete non-dictionary columns from Row 1 ONLY if those columns have 0 data rows
 *   and are not protected system/audit/accounting columns.
 * - Updates START_HERE title banner to reflect V2.0 Clean Data-Entry Readiness.
 */
function ksFinalizeCleanHeadersAndBaseline(confirmationPhrase) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksFinalizeCleanHeadersAndBaseline');
  if (confirmationPhrase !== 'FINALIZE_CLEAN_V2_SCHEMA_AND_RESET') {
    throw new Error('Safety Lock (POL-018): Pass exact phrase "FINALIZE_CLEAN_V2_SCHEMA_AND_RESET".');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const dictMap = ksLoadFullFieldDictionaryMap_(ss);

  // Step 1: Purge leftover test rows (Row 2+) so transactional tables start at clean 0-row baseline (POL-017)
  if (typeof ksPurgeTestRowsForCleanCutover === 'function') {
    ksPurgeTestRowsForCleanCutover('RESET_FOR_CLEAN_PRODUCTION_BASELINE');
  } else {
    KS_CORE_TRANSACTION_TABS_TO_VERIFY_EMPTY.forEach(tabName => {
      const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
      if (sh && sh.getLastRow() > 1) {
        sh.deleteRows(2, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
      }
    });
  }

  // Protected columns never stripped even if not explicitly listed in DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074
  const protectedCols = new Set([
    'record_id', 'created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by', 'status', 'notes',
    'total_debit', 'total_credit', 'financial_period_id', 'posting_status',
    'debit_amount', 'credit_amount', 'account_code', 'cost_centre_id',
    'nonce', 'idempotency_key', 'correlation_id'
  ]);

  let cleanedTables = 0;
  let removedOldColsTotal = 0;
  const headerCleanupReport = [];

  // Step 2: Strip obsolete non-dictionary Row-1 headers that have 0 data rows
  Object.keys(dictMap).forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh || sh.getLastColumn() === 0) return;

    const allowedSet = new Set(dictMap[tabName]);
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const currentHeaders = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim());

    const removedInTab = [];
    for (let c = currentHeaders.length; c >= 1; c--) {
      const hName = currentHeaders[c - 1];
      if (!hName) continue;
      if (!allowedSet.has(hName) && !protectedCols.has(hName)) {
        let hasData = false;
        if (lastRow > 1) {
          const colVals = sh.getRange(2, c, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
          hasData = colVals.some(r => String(r[0] || '').trim() !== '');
        }
        if (!hasData) {
          sh.deleteColumn(c);
          removedInTab.push(hName);
          removedOldColsTotal++;
        }
      }
    }

    if (removedInTab.length > 0) {
      cleanedTables++;
      headerCleanupReport.push({ tab: tabName, removed_old_headers: removedInTab });
    }
  });

  // Step 3: Update START_HERE banner if still showing DEVELOPMENT TEMPLATE
  const startHere = ss.getSheetByName('START_HERE');
  if (startHere) {
    const banner = String(startHere.getRange('A1').getValue() || '');
    if (banner.indexOf('DEVELOPMENT TEMPLATE') !== -1) {
      startHere.getRange('A1').setValue('KAWAD SWAD ERP SYSTEM (V2.0) — CLEAN SCHEMA & DATA ENTRY BASELINE');
    }
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  ksLogAudit_('OLD_HEADERS_CLEARED_FOR_V2_DATA_ENTRY', 'WORKBOOK', ss.getId(), {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'obsolete_row1_headers_and_test_rows',
    old_value: removedOldColsTotal + ' obsolete headers across ' + cleanedTables + ' tables',
    new_value: 'CLEAN_V2_DICTIONARY_SCHEMA_READY',
    reason: 'Cleared obsolete headers and purged test rows for clean V2.0 data entry (POL-017, POL-018)',
    approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
  });

  const result = {
    success: true,
    tables_cleaned: cleanedTables,
    obsolete_headers_removed: removedOldColsTotal,
    details: headerCleanupReport
  };

  Logger.log('=== CLEAN V2.0 SCHEMA & BASELINE READY FOR DATA ENTRY ===');
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

function ksRunCleanHeadersAndBaselineNow() {
  return ksFinalizeCleanHeadersAndBaseline('FINALIZE_CLEAN_V2_SCHEMA_AND_RESET');
}

/**
 * 4. Read-Only Readiness Inspection (Confirms 0 Transaction Rows & Clean V2.0 Schema)

function ksInspectCleanReadiness() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksInspectCleanReadiness');

/**
 * Loads all 218 canonical table -> ordered field_name arrays from DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074.
 * Dynamically inspects Row 1 headers so it never misreads the table name column.
 */
function ksLoadFullFieldDictionaryMap_(ss) {
  const dictSheet = ss.getSheetByName('DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074');
  if (!dictSheet || dictSheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    throw new Error('DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074 tab is missing or empty.');
  }

  const values = dictSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const rawHeaders = values[0].map(h => String(h).trim());
  const lowerHeaders = rawHeaders.map(h => h.toLowerCase());

  const tableCandidates = ['canonical_table_name', 'canonical_table', 'table_name', 'sheet_name', 'tab_name', 'table'];
  const fieldCandidates = ['field_name', 'canonical_field_name', 'column_name', 'header_name', 'field'];

  let tableCol = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < tableCandidates.length; i++) {
    const idx = lowerHeaders.indexOf(tableCandidates[i]);
    if (idx !== -1) { tableCol = idx; break; }
  }

  let fieldCol = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < fieldCandidates.length; i++) {
    const idx = lowerHeaders.indexOf(fieldCandidates[i]);
    if (idx !== -1) { fieldCol = idx; break; }
  }

  if (tableCol === -1 || fieldCol === -1) {
    throw new Error(
      'Could not locate table/field columns in DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074. Found headers: ' +
      JSON.stringify(rawHeaders)
    );
  }

  const map = {};
  for (let r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    const tName = String(values[r][tableCol] || '').trim();
    const fName = String(values[r][fieldCol] || '').trim();
    if (!tName || !fName) continue;
    if (!map[tName]) map[tName] = [];
    if (!map[tName].includes(fName)) {
      map[tName].push(fName);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Appends required columns to a canonical tab if they do not already exist.
 */
function ksEnsureColumnsExist_(ss, tabName, requiredCols) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
  if (!sh) return [];
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const existing = lastCol > 0
    ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim())
    : [];
  const existingSet = new Set(existing.filter(Boolean));
  const toAdd = requiredCols.filter(c => !existingSet.has(c));

  if (toAdd.length > 0) {
    const startCol = existing.length + 1;
    sh.getRange(1, startCol, 1, toAdd.length).setValues([toAdd]);
    sh.getRange(1, startCol, 1, toAdd.length).setFontWeight('bold');
  }
  return toAdd;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - DICTIONARY-DRIVEN SCHEMA HYDRATOR
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces Section 3.3, Section 11.2, Section 15.2, POL-018
 * Reads DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074 using verified exact headers:
 * ["Table","Position","Field","Data type","Required rule","Uniqueness",
 *  "Relationship note","Plain-language meaning","Schema source","Confidence","Execution eligibility"]
 */

const KS_DICTIONARY_TAB = 'DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074';

/**
 * Loads and indexes DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074 by exact Table, Position, and Field headers.
 */
function ksLoadDictionaryIndex_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const dictSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_DICTIONARY_TAB);
  if (!dictSheet) {
    throw new Error('Dictionary tab "' + KS_DICTIONARY_TAB + '" not found in workbook.');
  }

  const requiredDictCols = ['Table', 'Position', 'Field'];
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(dictSheet, requiredDictCols);
  const lastRow = dictSheet.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = dictSheet.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2) return { tableCount: 0, byTable: {} };

  const idxTable = headerMap['Table'] - 1;
  const idxPos   = headerMap['Position'] - 1;
  const idxField = headerMap['Field'] - 1;
  const idxElig  = headerMap['Execution eligibility'] ? headerMap['Execution eligibility'] - 1 : -1;

  const rows = dictSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues();
  const byTable = {};

  rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
    const tName = String(r[idxTable] || '').trim();
    const fName = String(r[idxField] || '').trim();
    if (!tName || !fName) return;

    const orderVal = Number(r[idxPos]) || (idx + 1);
    const eligVal  = idxElig >= 0 ? String(r[idxElig] || '').trim() : '';

    if (!byTable[tName]) byTable[tName] = [];
    byTable[tName].push({
      field: fName,
      order: orderVal,
      eligibility: eligVal
    });
  });

  // Sort each table's fields by Position and deduplicate
  Object.keys(byTable).forEach(tName => {
    byTable[tName].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    const seen = new Set();
    byTable[tName] = byTable[tName]
      .filter(item => {
        if (seen.has(item.field)) return false;
        seen.add(item.field);
        return true;
      });
  });

  return {
    tableCount: Object.keys(byTable).length,
    byTable: byTable
  };
}

/**
 * Read-only preview: compares current physical headers of a table group against
 * DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074 so we can see exact columns to add before touching any sheet.
 */
function ksPreviewDictionaryDiff(groupName) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const tables = KS_CORE_TABLES[groupName];
  if (!tables) throw new Error('Unknown group: ' + groupName);

  const dict = ksLoadDictionaryIndex_();
  Logger.log('=== DICTIONARY DIFF PREVIEW: ' + groupName + ' (Dictionary tables=' + dict.tableCount + ') ===');

  tables.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      Logger.log('[MISSING TAB] ' + tabName);
      return;
    }
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const currentHeaders = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim()) : [];
    const expectedItems = dict.byTable[tabName] || [];
    const missing = expectedItems
      .map(item => item.field)
      .filter(h => !currentHeaders.includes(h));

    Logger.log(
      tabName + ' | physical=' + currentHeaders.length +
      ' | dict=' + expectedItems.length +
      ' | to_add=' + missing.length +
      ' -> ' + JSON.stringify(missing)
    );
  });
}

function ksPreviewInventoryDictDiff()  { ksPreviewDictionaryDiff('INVENTORY'); }
function ksPreviewProductionDictDiff() { ksPreviewDictionaryDiff('PRODUCTION'); }
function ksPreviewSalesDictDiff()      { ksPreviewDictionaryDiff('SALES'); }
function ksPreviewAccountingDictDiff() { ksPreviewDictionaryDiff('ACCOUNTING'); }
function ksPreviewMasterDictDiff()     { ksPreviewDictionaryDiff('MASTER'); }

/**
 * Hydrates missing dictionary columns onto existing tables in a DISPOSABLE TEST COPY
 * by appending missing headers to the right of existing headers (never deletes/overwrites).
 * Requires OWNER_ADMIN role and logs every schema expansion to AuditLog (POL-018).
 */
function ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary(groupName) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary:' + groupName);
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const tables = KS_CORE_TABLES[groupName];
  if (!tables) throw new Error('Unknown group: ' + groupName);

  const dict = ksLoadDictionaryIndex_();
  let hydratedCount = 0;

  tables.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) return;

    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const currentHeaders = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim()) : [];
    const expectedItems = dict.byTable[tabName] || [];
    const missing = expectedItems
      .map(item => item.field)
      .filter(h => !currentHeaders.includes(h));

    if (missing.length > 0) {
      sh.getRange(1, lastCol + 1, 1, missing.length).setValues([missing]);
      sh.setFrozenRows(1);
      hydratedCount++;

      ksLogAudit_('SCHEMA_HYDRATE', tabName, tabName, {
        actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
        field_changed: 'headers',
        old_value: currentHeaders.length + ' cols',
        new_value: (currentHeaders.length + missing.length) + ' cols',
        reason: 'Hydrated ' + missing.length + ' dictionary fields from ' + KS_DICTIONARY_TAB
      });
    }
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  Logger.log('Hydrated ' + hydratedCount + ' tables in group "' + groupName + '".');
  return hydratedCount;
}

function ksHydrateInventoryTables()  { return ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary('INVENTORY'); }
function ksHydrateProductionTables() { return ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary('PRODUCTION'); }
function ksHydrateSalesTables()      { return ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary('SALES'); }
function ksHydrateAccountingTables() { return ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary('ACCOUNTING'); }
function ksHydrateMasterTables()     { return ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary('MASTER'); }

/**
 * Hydrates ALL 5 core operational/accounting groups in one controlled run
 * in the disposable test copy.
 */
function ksHydrateAllCoreGroups() {
  const groups = ['MASTER', 'INVENTORY', 'PRODUCTION', 'SALES', 'ACCOUNTING'];
  const summary = {};
  groups.forEach(g => {
    summary[g] = ksHydrateTableGroupFromDictionary(g);
  });
  Logger.log('Full Core Schema Hydration Complete: ' + JSON.stringify(summary));
}

  <script>
    const USER_CTX = <?!= userContext ?>;
    const DEFAULT_TAB = "<?= defaultTab ?>";

    const ROLE_TABS = {
      OWNER_ADMIN: ['purchase', 'production', 'quality', 'packaging', 'sales', 'finance'],
      PA:          ['purchase', 'production', 'sales', 'finance'],
      STORE:       ['purchase'],
      PROCUREMENT: ['purchase'],
      PRODUCTION:  ['production'],
      QUALITY:     ['quality'],
      PACKAGING:   ['packaging'],
      SALES:       ['sales'],
      FIELD_SALESMAN: ['sales', 'finance'],
      ACCOUNTS:    ['finance'],
      AUDITOR:     []
    };

    function makeNonce(prefix) {
      return prefix + '_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();
    }

    function showStatus(ok, msg) {
      const box = document.getElementById('statusBox');
      box.className = 'status-box ' + (ok ? 'status-ok' : 'status-err');
      box.textContent = msg;
    }

    function switchTab(tabName) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      const sec = document.getElementById('sec-' + tabName);
      const btn = document.getElementById('btn-' + tabName);
      if (sec) sec.classList.add('active');
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('statusBox').className = 'status-box';
    }

    function runServer(btn, fnName, payload, onSuccess) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      const origText = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Saving & Verifying...';
      showStatus(true, 'Processing request...');

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(res => {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = origText;
          onSuccess(res);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(err => {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = origText;
          showStatus(false, 'Error: ' + (err.message || err));
        })[fnName](payload);
    }

    function submitPurchase(btn) {
      runServer(btn, 'ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt', {
        nonce: makeNonce('UI_PUR'),
        item_type: document.getElementById('pur_item_type').value,
        item_id: document.getElementById('pur_item_id').value,
        supplier_lot_number: document.getElementById('pur_sup_lot').value,
        warehouse_id: document.getElementById('pur_wh').value,
        quantity_received: Number(document.getElementById('pur_qty').value),
        unit: document.getElementById('pur_unit').value,
        unit_cost: Number(document.getElementById('pur_cost').value),
        quality_status: document.getElementById('pur_qc').value,
        notes: document.getElementById('pur_notes').value
      }, res => {
        showStatus(true, 'Saved! Lot ID: ' + res.inventory_lot_id + ' | Movement: ' + res.movement_id + ' (' + res.quality_status + ')');
      });
    }

    function submitProduction(btn) {
      const nonce = makeNonce('UI_PRD');
      const prodId = document.getElementById('prd_prod_id').value;
      const rcpVer = document.getElementById('prd_rcp_ver').value;
      const outQty = Number(document.getElementById('prd_out_qty').value);

      runServer(btn, 'ksCreateProductionOrder', {
        nonce: nonce + '_PO',
        product_id: prodId,
        recipe_id: rcpVer.split('-V')[0] || rcpVer,
        recipe_version_id: rcpVer,
        planned_quantity_kg: outQty
      }, poRes => {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(() => {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(outRes => {
                showStatus(true, 'Production Posted! Batch: ' + poRes.production_order_id + ' | Bulk Lot: ' + outRes.output_lot_id + ' (PENDING_QC)');
              })
              .withFailureHandler(e => showStatus(false, 'Output Error: ' + e.message))
              .ksRecordProductionOutputAndLoss({
                nonce: nonce + '_OUT',
                production_batch_id: poRes.production_order_id,
                product_id: prodId,
                output_quantity_kg: outQty,
                loss_quantity_kg: Number(document.getElementById('prd_loss_qty').value),
                loss_reason: document.getElementById('prd_loss_reason').value
              });
          })
          .withFailureHandler(e => showStatus(false, 'Consumption Error: ' + e.message))
          .ksRecordProductionConsumption({
            nonce: nonce + '_CON',
            production_batch_id: poRes.production_order_id,
            raw_material_id: document.getElementById('prd_rm_id').value,
            inventory_lot_id: document.getElementById('prd_rm_lot').value,
            actual_quantity: Number(document.getElementById('prd_rm_qty').value),
            unit: 'KG'
          });
      });
    }

    function submitQuality(btn) {
      runServer(btn, 'ksRecordQualityRelease', {
        nonce: makeNonce('UI_QC'),
        product_lot_id: document.getElementById('qc_lot_id').value,
        parameter_name: document.getElementById('qc_param').value,
        measured_value: document.getElementById('qc_val').value,
        release_status: document.getElementById('qc_decision').value
      }, res => {
        showStatus(true, 'QC Recorded (' + res.finished_qc_id + '): Lot ' + res.product_lot_id + ' is now ' + res.release_status);
      });
    }

    function submitPackaging(btn) {
      runServer(btn, 'ksRecordPackagingOutput', {

        packaging_batch_id: document.getElementById('pkg_batch_id').value,
        bulk_lot_id: document.getElementById('pkg_bulk_lot').value,

        pack_weight_g: Number(document.getElementById('pkg_weight').value),

      }, res => {

      });

    function submitSales(btn) {

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - CENTRAL ID ALLOCATOR
 * Wired to verified IdAllocations tab: [allocation_id, tab_name, allocated_id, nonce, created_at]
 * Enforces POL-002, REQ-101, Section 11.2 (LockService + idempotency nonce)
 */

function ksAllocateId(targetTabName, nonce) {
  if (!targetTabName || !KS_CONFIG.ID_PREFIXES[targetTabName]) {
    throw new Error('Invalid or unapproved target table for ID allocation: ' + targetTabName);
  }
  if (!nonce || String(nonce).trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required for ID allocation.');
  }

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(KS_CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS);

  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const allocSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.ID_ALLOCATIONS);
    const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(allocSheet, KS_CONFIG.REQUIRED_HEADERS.IdAllocations);

    const lastRow = allocSheet.getLastRow();
    const cleanNonce = String(nonce).trim();
    const prefix = KS_CONFIG.ID_PREFIXES[targetTabName];
    const dateStamp = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), KS_CONFIG.TIMEZONE, 'yyyyMMdd');

    let maxAllocSeq = 0;
    let maxTargetSeq = 0;

    if (lastRow >= 2) {
      const data = allocSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, allocSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
      const idxAllocId = headerMap['allocation_id'] - 1;
      const idxTab = headerMap['tab_name'] - 1;
      const idxAllocatedId = headerMap['allocated_id'] - 1;
      const idxNonce = headerMap['nonce'] - 1;

      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        const rowNonce = String(data[i][idxNonce] || '').trim();
        const rowTab = String(data[i][idxTab] || '').trim();

        // Idempotency check: return existing ID if this exact (tab_name + nonce) already succeeded
        if (rowNonce === cleanNonce && rowTab === targetTabName) {
          return {
            status: 'EXISTING_IDEMPOTENT',
            allocation_id: String(data[i][idxAllocId]),
            allocated_id: String(data[i][idxAllocatedId]),
            tab_name: targetTabName,
            nonce: cleanNonce
          };
        }

        // Track highest sequence numbers so IDs are never recycled (POL-002)
        const allocMatch = String(data[i][idxAllocId] || '').match(/(\d+)$/);
        if (allocMatch) maxAllocSeq = Math.max(maxAllocSeq, parseInt(allocMatch[1], 10));

        if (rowTab === targetTabName) {
          const targetMatch = String(data[i][idxAllocatedId] || '').match(/(\d+)$/);
          if (targetMatch) maxTargetSeq = Math.max(maxTargetSeq, parseInt(targetMatch[1], 10));
        }
      }
    }

    const nextAllocId = 'ALLOC-' + String(maxAllocSeq + 1).padStart(7, '0');
    const nextTargetId = prefix + '-' + dateStamp + '-' + String(maxTargetSeq + 1).padStart(5, '0');
    const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

    const allocRecord = {
      allocation_id: nextAllocId,
      tab_name: targetTabName,
      allocated_id: nextTargetId,
      nonce: cleanNonce,
      created_at: nowIso
    };

    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(
      ss,
      KS_CONFIG.TABS.ID_ALLOCATIONS,
      allocRecord,
      'allocation_id',
      KS_CONFIG.REQUIRED_HEADERS.IdAllocations
    );

    return {
      status: 'NEW_ALLOCATED',
      allocation_id: nextAllocId,
      allocated_id: nextTargetId,
      tab_name: targetTabName,
      nonce: cleanNonce
    };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
