/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - INVENTORY LOT & MOVEMENT ENGINE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-003, POL-004, POL-005, REQ-004, REQ-034..039
 * Wired to hydrated InventoryLots & InventoryMovements tables.
 */

const KS_MOVEMENT_TYPES = Object.freeze([
  'OPENING_BALANCE',
  'PURCHASE_RECEIPT',
  'PRODUCTION_ISSUE',
  'PRODUCTION_OUTPUT',
  'PACKAGING_ISSUE',
  'PACKAGING_OUTPUT',
  'SALES_DISPATCH',
  'SALES_RETURN',
  'TRANSFER_OUT',
  'TRANSFER_IN',
  'DAMAGE_WRITE_OFF',
  'EXPIRY_WRITE_OFF',
  'APPROVED_ADJUSTMENT'
]);

/**
 * Creates a new traceable inventory lot (raw material, bulk output, or finished SKU)
 * and posts its initial movement record atomically with read-back verification.
 */
function ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.STORE, KS_ROLES.PROCUREMENT, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION, KS_ROLES.PACKAGING],
    'ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt'
  );

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.item_type || !payload.item_id) throw new Error('item_type and item_id are required.');
  const qty = Number(payload.quantity_received);
  if (!(qty > 0)) throw new Error('quantity_received must be greater than 0.');
  if (!payload.unit) throw new Error('unit is required.');

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const unitCost = Number(payload.unit_cost) || 0;
  const totalCost = Math.round(qty * unitCost * 100) / 100;

  // 1. Allocate idempotent Lot ID and Movement ID
  const lotAlloc = ksAllocateId('InventoryLots', payload.nonce + '_LOT');
  const movAlloc = ksAllocateId('InventoryMovements', payload.nonce + '_MOV');
  const lotId = lotAlloc.allocated_id;
  const movId = movAlloc.allocated_id;

  const lotRecord = {
    record_id: lotId,
    inventory_lot_id: lotId,
    item_type: String(payload.item_type).trim().toUpperCase(), // RAW_MATERIAL | BULK_FG | PACKAGED_SKU | PACKAGING_MAT
    item_id: String(payload.item_id).trim(),
    lot_number: payload.lot_number || lotId,
    supplier_lot_number: payload.supplier_lot_number || '',
    manufacture_date: payload.manufacture_date || '',
    received_date: payload.received_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    expiry_date: payload.expiry_date || '',
    warehouse_id: payload.warehouse_id || 'WH-MAIN',
    storage_location_id: payload.storage_location_id || '',
    quantity_received: qty,
    quantity_available: qty,
    unit: String(payload.unit).trim(),
    unit_cost: unitCost,
    quality_status: payload.quality_status || 'PENDING_QC', // Held from sale until RELEASED (POL-005 / DB-05)
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  const movRecord = {
    record_id: movId,
    movement_id: movId,
    movement_datetime: nowIso,
    item_type: lotRecord.item_type,
    item_id: lotRecord.item_id,
    inventory_lot_id: lotId,
    movement_type: payload.movement_type || 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT',
    quantity_in: qty,
    quantity_out: 0,
    unit: lotRecord.unit,
    from_location_id: payload.from_location_id || 'EXTERNAL_SUPPLIER',
    to_location_id: lotRecord.warehouse_id,
    reference_type: payload.reference_type || 'GRN',
    reference_id: payload.reference_id || '',
    unit_cost: unitCost,
    total_cost: totalCost,
    performed_by: ctx.user_id,
    approved_by: payload.approved_by || '',
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  try {
    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'InventoryLots', lotRecord, 'inventory_lot_id', ['inventory_lot_id', 'item_id', 'unit']);
    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'InventoryMovements', movRecord, 'movement_id', ['movement_id', 'inventory_lot_id', 'movement_type']);

    ksLogAudit_('STOCK_RECEIPT_POSTED', 'InventoryLots', lotId, {
      actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
      field_changed: 'quantity_in',
      new_value: qty + ' ' + lotRecord.unit,
      reason: movRecord.movement_type + ' (' + lotRecord.quality_status + ')',
      related_record_id: movId
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      inventory_lot_id: lotId,
      movement_id: movId,
      quality_status: lotRecord.quality_status
    };
  } catch (e) {
    ksLogException_('CRITICAL', 'ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt', 'InventoryLots', lotId, e.message, payload);
    throw e;
  }
}

/**
 * Calculates live movement-led stock balance for an item_id (and optional lot_id)
 * directly from posted rows in InventoryMovements (POL-005 & Section 3.7).
 */
function ksGetMovementLedStockBalance(itemId, optionalLotId) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const movSheet = ss.getSheetByName('InventoryMovements');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(movSheet, ['item_id', 'inventory_lot_id', 'quantity_in', 'quantity_out', 'status']);
  const lastRow = movSheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return { item_id: itemId, lot_id: optionalLotId || 'ALL', total_in: 0, total_out: 0, balance: 0 };

  const data = movSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, movSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  let totalIn = 0;
  let totalOut = 0;

  data.forEach(r => {
    if (String(r[headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim() !== 'POSTED') return;
    if (String(r[headerMap['item_id'] - 1]).trim() !== String(itemId).trim()) return;
    if (optionalLotId && String(r[headerMap['inventory_lot_id'] - 1]).trim() !== String(optionalLotId).trim()) return;

    totalIn += Number(r[headerMap['quantity_in'] - 1]) || 0;
    totalOut += Number(r[headerMap['quantity_out'] - 1]) || 0;
  });

  return {
    item_id: itemId,
    lot_id: optionalLotId || 'ALL',
    total_in: Math.round(totalIn * 1000) / 1000,
    total_out: Math.round(totalOut * 1000) / 1000,
    balance: Math.round((totalIn - totalOut) * 1000) / 1000
  };
}

/**
 * Phase G Disposable-Copy Verification Test for Inventory Engine.
 */
function ksRunPhaseGInventoryTest() {
  const res = ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt({
    nonce: 'TEST_INV_RECEIPT_001',
    item_type: 'RAW_MATERIAL',
    item_id: 'RM-TEST-MOONG-DAL',
    lot_number: 'LOT-2026-001',
    quantity_received: 500,
    unit: 'KG',
    unit_cost: 92.5,
    quality_status: 'RELEASED',
    notes: 'Phase G Inventory Engine test receipt'
  });

  const bal = ksGetMovementLedStockBalance('RM-TEST-MOONG-DAL', res.inventory_lot_id);
  Logger.log('Inventory Test Result: ' + JSON.stringify(res) + ' | Derived Balance: ' + JSON.stringify(bal));
}

BEGIN FILE 12/43: Kawad_Swad_Phase3_Field_Reconciliation_v1_0.js
ORIGINAL_BYTE_SIZE: 9194
FILE_SHA256: a6e0c82b0a00f232c4cbfff7ee976fb8139c99f6ab28a124f485c5e9d6f8d28a

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 FIELD-BY-FIELD LIVE SCHEMA RECONCILIATION v1.0
 *
 * READ-ONLY AGAINST THE WORKBOOK.
 * Creates two CSV report files in Google Drive; it does not edit workbook tabs.
 *
 * Run:
 *   ksP3FieldReconciliationPreview()
 *   ksP3CreateFieldReconciliationReports()
 *
 * The report uses exact header matching only. It does NOT auto-accept aliases,
 * fuzzy matches, rename headers, add columns, or change any business data.
 */

var KS_P3_RECON = {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  EXPECTED_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  TABLE_REGISTRY: 'KS_P1_TABLE_REGISTRY',
  FIELD_DICTIONARY: 'KS_P1_FIELD_DICTIONARY',
  RUNTIME_REGISTRY: 'DBV5_RUNTIME_EXTRA_29'
};

function ksP3ReconReadTableNames_(ss) {
  var names = [];
  [KS_P3_RECON.TABLE_REGISTRY, KS_P3_RECON.RUNTIME_REGISTRY].forEach(function(tab) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(tab);
    if (!sh) throw new Error('Missing required registry: ' + tab);
    if (sh.getLastRow() < 2) return;
    sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues().forEach(function(r) {
      var name = String(r[0] || '').trim();
      if (name && names.indexOf(name) === -1) names.push(name);
    });
  });
  return names;
}

function ksP3ReconHeaderIndex_(headers) {
  var map = {};
  headers.forEach(function(h, i) {
    var key = String(h || '').trim();
    if (key) map[key] = i;
  });
  return map;
}

function ksP3ReconCsv_(rows) {
  return rows.map(function(row) {
    return row.map(function(value) {
      var s = value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value);
      return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
    }).join(',');
  }).join('\r\n');
}

function ksP3ReconLoad_(ss) {
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_RECON.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. No report generated.');
  }

  var dict = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_RECON.FIELD_DICTIONARY);
  var registry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_RECON.TABLE_REGISTRY);
  if (!dict || !registry) throw new Error('Field dictionary or table registry missing.');

  var dictData = dict.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  var regData = registry.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  if (dictData.length < 2 || regData.length < 2) {
    throw new Error('Dictionary or registry has no data rows.');
  }

  var dh = ksP3ReconHeaderIndex_(dictData[0]);
  var rh = ksP3ReconHeaderIndex_(regData[0]);

  var requiredDictHeaders = [
    'Table', 'Position', 'Field', 'Data type', 'Required rule',
    'Uniqueness', 'Relationship note', 'Plain-language meaning',
    'Schema source', 'Confidence', 'Execution eligibility'
  ];
  requiredDictHeaders.forEach(function(h) {
    if (dh[h] === undefined) throw new Error('Missing dictionary column: ' + h);
  });

  var requiredRegHeaders = ['Table', 'Finalization status', 'Safe action'];
  requiredRegHeaders.forEach(function(h) {
    if (rh[h] === undefined) throw new Error('Missing registry column: ' + h);
  });

  var regByTable = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < regData.length; r++) {
    var t = String(regData[r][rh['Table']] || '').trim();
    if (t) {
      regByTable[t] = {
        finalizationStatus: regData[r][rh['Finalization status']],
        safeAction: regData[r][rh['Safe action']]
      };
    }
  }

  var names = ksP3ReconReadTableNames_(ss);
  var liveByTable = {};
  var missingTabs = [];

  names.forEach(function(name) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      missingTabs.push(name);
      liveByTable[name] = [];
      return;
    }
    var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    var headers = lastCol > 0
      ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
      : [];
    liveByTable[name] = headers.map(function(h) { return String(h || '').trim(); })
      .filter(function(h) { return h !== ''; });
  });

  var fields = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < dictData.length; i++) {
    var row = dictData[i];
    var table = String(row[dh['Table']] || '').trim();
    var field = String(row[dh['Field']] || '').trim();
    if (!table || !field) continue;

    var liveHeaders = liveByTable[table] || [];
    var exact = liveHeaders.indexOf(field) !== -1;
    var caseInsensitive = liveHeaders.some(function(h) {
      return h.toLowerCase() === field.toLowerCase();
    });
    var regInfo = regByTable[table] || {};

    fields.push({
      table: table,
      position: row[dh['Position']],
      field: field,
      dataType: row[dh['Data type']],
      requiredRule: row[dh['Required rule']],
      uniqueness: row[dh['Uniqueness']],
      relationshipNote: row[dh['Relationship note']],
      plainMeaning: row[dh['Plain-language meaning']],
      schemaSource: row[dh['Schema source']],
      confidence: row[dh['Confidence']],
      executionEligibility: row[dh['Execution eligibility']],
      exactLiveHeader: exact ? 'YES' : 'NO',
      caseInsensitiveOnly: (!exact && caseInsensitive) ? 'YES' : 'NO',
      liveHeaderCount: liveHeaders.length,
      tableFinalizationStatus: regInfo.finalizationStatus || '',
      tableSafeAction: regInfo.safeAction || '',
      tableExists: ss.getSheetByName(table) ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    });
  }

  var liveOnly = [];
  Object.keys(liveByTable).forEach(function(table) {
    var liveHeaders = liveByTable[table];
    var dictionaryFields = fields.filter(function(f) { return f.table === table; })
      .map(function(f) { return f.field; });

    liveHeaders.forEach(function(header) {
      if (dictionaryFields.indexOf(header) === -1) {
        liveOnly.push({
          table: table,
          liveHeader: header,
          inDictionaryExact: 'NO',
          note: 'Live header has no exact field-name match in KS_P1_FIELD_DICTIONARY. Review manually; do not rename automatically.'
        });
      }
    });
  });

  return {
    names: names,
    missingTabs: missingTabs,
    fields: fields,
    liveOnly: liveOnly
  };
}

function ksP3FieldReconciliationPreview() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_RECON.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  var data = ksP3ReconLoad_(ss);

  var exact = data.fields.filter(function(f) { return f.exactLiveHeader === 'YES'; }).length;
  var missing = data.fields.length - exact;
  var caseOnly = data.fields.filter(function(f) { return f.caseInsensitiveOnly === 'YES'; }).length;
  var noTable = data.fields.filter(function(f) { return f.tableExists === 'NO'; }).length;

  var report = {
    previewOnly: true,
    readOnlyWorkbook: true,
    workbook: ss.getName(),
    uniqueRegisteredTabs: data.names.length,
    missingRegisteredTabs: data.missingTabs,
    dictionaryFieldRows: data.fields.length,
    exactHeaderMatches: exact,
    nonExactDictionaryFields: missing,
    caseInsensitiveOnlyMatches: caseOnly,
    dictionaryRowsWhoseTableTabIsMissing: noTable,
    liveHeadersWithoutExactDictionaryMatch: data.liveOnly.length,
    note: 'Exact-name reconciliation only. No schema or business data changed.'
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return report;
}

function ksP3CreateFieldReconciliationReports() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_RECON.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  var data = ksP3ReconLoad_(ss);

  var fieldHeaders = [
    'Table', 'Position', 'Field', 'Data type', 'Required rule', 'Uniqueness',
    'Relationship note', 'Plain-language meaning', 'Schema source', 'Confidence',
    'Execution eligibility', 'Exact live header', 'Case-insensitive only',
    'Live header count', 'Table finalization status', 'Table safe action', 'Table exists'
  ];

  var fieldRows = [fieldHeaders];
  data.fields.forEach(function(f) {
    fieldRows.push([
      f.table, f.position, f.field, f.dataType, f.requiredRule, f.uniqueness,
      f.relationshipNote, f.plainMeaning, f.schemaSource, f.confidence,
      f.executionEligibility, f.exactLiveHeader, f.caseInsensitiveOnly,
      f.liveHeaderCount, f.tableFinalizationStatus, f.tableSafeAction, f.tableExists
    ]);
  });

  var liveHeaders = ['Table', 'Live header', 'Exact dictionary match', 'Review note'];
  var liveRows = [liveHeaders];
  data.liveOnly.forEach(function(x) {
    liveRows.push([x.table, x.liveHeader, x.inDictionaryExact, x.note]);
  });

  var stamp = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
  var fieldFile = DriveApp.createFile(
    'Kawad_Swad_Phase3_Field_Reconciliation_' + stamp + '.csv',
    ksP3ReconCsv_(fieldRows),
    MimeType.CSV
  );
  var liveFile = DriveApp.createFile(
    'Kawad_Swad_Phase3_Live_Headers_Without_Dictionary_Match_' + stamp + '.csv',
    ksP3ReconCsv_(liveRows),
    MimeType.CSV
  );

  var exactCount = data.fields.filter(function(f) { return f.exactLiveHeader === 'YES'; }).length;
  var report = {
    success: true,
    workbookModified: false,
    dictionaryFieldRows: data.fields.length,
    exactHeaderMatches: exactCount,
    nonExactDictionaryFields: data.fields.length - exactCount,
    liveHeadersWithoutExactDictionaryMatch: data.liveOnly.length,
    missingRegisteredTabs: data.missingTabs,
    fieldReconciliationCsv: fieldFile.getUrl(),
    liveOnlyHeadersCsv: liveFile.getUrl(),
    instruction: 'Review both reports. No columns were added, renamed, or approved as aliases.'
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return report;
}

// KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 ONE-GO EMPTY DATABASE RESET
const KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG = Object.freeze({
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  EXPECTED_NAME: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  CONFIRMATION_PHRASE: 'RESET KAWAD SWAD DATABASE TO EMPTY',
  BACKUP_FOLDER_ID: '', // Optional: put a Drive folder ID here. Blank = same folder as source.
  CONTROL_SHEETS_TO_PRESERVE: [
    'KS_P3_LIVE_INVENTORY',
    'KS_P3_MIGRATION_PLAN',
    'KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG',
    'KS_P3_TABLE_MAPPING',
    'KS_P3_FIELD_MAPPING'
  ],
  RESET_LOG_SHEET: 'KS_P3_EMPTY_RESET_LOG'
});

/**
 * MAIN ONE-GO RUNNER.
 * Execute this function once from Apps Script.
 */
function ksP3ExecuteEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(30000)) throw new Error('Another migration is running. No changes made.');

  let backupFile = null;
  const startedAt = new Date();
  const resetCounts = [];

  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.EXPECTED_NAME) {
      throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Expected "' +
        KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.EXPECTED_NAME + '", found "' + ss.getName() + '". No changes made.');
    }

    const typed = Browser.inputBox(
      'FINAL DESTRUCTIVE CONFIRMATION',
      'This will permanently clear all business data rows from the live workbook after making a backup.\\n\\n' +
      'Type exactly:\\n' + KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.CONFIRMATION_PHRASE,
      Browser.Buttons.OK_CANCEL
    );
    if (typed !== KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.CONFIRMATION_PHRASE) {
      throw new Error('Confirmation phrase did not match. No changes made.');
    }

    // Create a full workbook backup before touching any sheet.
    const sourceFile = DriveApp.getFileById(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    const backupName = ss.getName() + '_PRE_EMPTY_RESET_BACKUP_' +
      Utilities.formatDate(startedAt, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
    backupFile = KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID
      ? sourceFile.makeCopy(backupName, DriveApp.getFolderById(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID))
      : sourceFile.makeCopy(backupName);

    if (!backupFile || !backupFile.getId()) {
      throw new Error('Backup creation failed. Reset aborted before data deletion.');
    }

    const protectedNames = new Set(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.CONTROL_SHEETS_TO_PRESERVE);
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();

    // Preflight all sheets before first write.
    const preflight = sheets.map(sh => ({
      name: sh.getName(),
      rows: sh.getLastRow(),
      cols: sh.getLastColumn(),
      protected: protectedNames.has(sh.getName())
    }));

    // Preserve all table headers (row 1) and formulas. Clear all other values.
    for (const sh of sheets) {
      const name = sh.getName();
      if (protectedNames.has(name) || name === KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.RESET_LOG_SHEET) continue;

      const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
      if (lastRow <= 1 || lastCol < 1) {
        resetCounts.push({sheet: name, clearedCells: 0, status: 'NO DATA ROWS'});
        continue;
      }

      const body = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol);
      const values = body.getValues();
      const formulas = body.getFormulas();
      let clearedCells = 0;

      const output = values.map((row, r) => row.map((value, c) => {
        if (formulas[r][c]) return formulas[r][c];
        if (value !== '' && value !== null) clearedCells++;
        return '';
      }));

      if (clearedCells > 0) body.setValues(output);
      resetCounts.push({sheet: name, clearedCells: clearedCells, status: 'CLEARED'});
    }

    // Verify all non-control sheets contain no constants below the header.
    const verificationFailures = [];
    for (const sh of ss.getSheets()) {
      if (protectedNames.has(sh.getName()) || sh.getName() === KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.RESET_LOG_SHEET) continue;
      const lr = sh.getLastRow();
      const lc = sh.getLastColumn();
      if (lr <= 1 || lc < 1) continue;
      const vals = sh.getRange(2, 1, lr - 1, lc).getValues();
      const forms = sh.getRange(2, 1, lr - 1, lc).getFormulas();
      for (let r = 0; r < vals.length; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < vals[r].length; c++) {
          if (!forms[r][c] && vals[r][c] !== '' && vals[r][c] !== null) {
            verificationFailures.push(sh.getName() + '!R' + (r + 2) + 'C' + (c + 1));
            if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) break;
          }
        }
        if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) break;
      }
      if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) break;
    }

    const log = ksP3GetOrCreateResetLog_(ss);
    log.appendRow([
      new Date(), 'EMPTY_DATABASE_RESET',
      verificationFailures.length === 0 ? 'SUCCESS' : 'PARTIAL_FAILURE',
      backupFile.getUrl(), backupFile.getId(),
      sheets.length, resetCounts.reduce((n, x) => n + x.clearedCells, 0),
      verificationFailures.join(' | '),
      'Headers/formulas/formatting/validation preserved; business data rows cleared.'
    ]);

    if (verificationFailures.length) {
      throw new Error('Reset ran but verification found remaining constants: ' +
        verificationFailures.slice(0, 10).join(', ') +
        '. Backup: ' + backupFile.getUrl());
    }

    const result = {
      success: true,
      workbook: ss.getName(),
      sheetCount: sheets.length,
      clearedCells: resetCounts.reduce((n, x) => n + x.clearedCells, 0),
      clearedSheets: resetCounts.filter(x => x.status === 'CLEARED').length,
      preservedControlSheets: Array.from(protectedNames),
      backupUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
      backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
      completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      note: 'All non-control sheets were cleared below row 1. Headers and formulas remain.'
    };
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('PHASE 3 EMPTY RESET FAILED: ' + (err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
    throw err;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksP3GetOrCreateResetLog_(ss) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.RESET_LOG_SHEET);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(KS_P3_RESET_CONFIG.RESET_LOG_SHEET);
    sh.appendRow([
      'timestamp', 'operation', 'status', 'backup_url', 'backup_file_id',
      'sheet_count', 'cleared_cell_count', 'verification_failures', 'notes'
    ]);
  }
  return sh;
}

function ksP3V12GetBusinessTableNames_(ss) {
  var names = new Set();
  var registry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.TABLE_REGISTRY);
  if (!registry) throw new Error('Missing ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.TABLE_REGISTRY + '. Reset aborted.');

  // Table registry: first column is "Table"; rows below are table names.
  var last = registry.getLastRow();
  if (last > 1) {
    registry.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).getDisplayValues().forEach(function(r) {
      var n = String(r[0] || '').trim();
      if (n) names.add(n);
    });
  }

  // Runtime-only tables: first column is "Tab"; rows below are table names.
  var runtime = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.RUNTIME_REGISTRY);
  if (!runtime) throw new Error('Missing ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.RUNTIME_REGISTRY + '. Reset aborted.');
  last = runtime.getLastRow();
  if (last > 1) {
    runtime.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).getDisplayValues().forEach(function(r) {
      var n = String(r[0] || '').trim();
      if (n) names.add(n);
    });
  }

  KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.PRESERVE_ALWAYS.forEach(function(n) { names.delete(n); });
  names.delete(KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.RESET_LOG);
  return names;
}

    }

    // Backup is mandatory and occurs before the first deletion.
    var sourceFile = DriveApp.getFileById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V12.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    var backupName = ss.getName() + '_PRE_EMPTY_DB_RESET_' +
      Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
    backup = sourceFile.makeCopy(backupName);
    if (!backup || !backup.getId()) throw new Error('Backup failed. No data was cleared.');

    var results = [];
    var totalCleared = 0;
    var missingTabs = [];

    targets.forEach(function(name) {
      var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
      if (!sh) {
        missingTabs.push(name);
        return;
      }
      var lr = sh.getLastRow();
      var lc = sh.getLastColumn();
      var cleared = 0;
      if (lr > 1 && lc > 0) {
        var body = sh.getRange(2, 1, lr - 1, lc);
        var vals = body.getValues();
        var formulas = body.getFormulas();
        var output = vals.map(function(row, r) {
          return row.map(function(v, c) {
            if (formulas[r][c]) return formulas[r][c];
            if (v !== '' && v !== null) cleared++;
            return '';
          });
        });
        if (cleared > 0) body.setValues(output);
      }
      totalCleared += cleared;
      results.push({sheet: name, clearedCells: cleared});
    });

    var failures = [];
    results.forEach(function(item) {

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD - DICTIONARY SEMANTIC QUALITY AUDIT
 * Version: 1.0
 * READ-ONLY. This script inspects only schema/governance registers.
 * It does not read business transaction rows, employee personal data, or AuthUsers.
 * It does not create, rename, clear, format, or write any worksheet or Drive file.
 *
 * Run: KS_RUN_DICTIONARY_SEMANTIC_AUDIT
 */

var KS_DSA_CONFIG = {
  spreadsheetId: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  expectedSpreadsheetName: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  dictionarySheet: 'KS_P1_FIELD_DICTIONARY',
  tableRegisterSheet: 'KS_P1_TABLE_REGISTRY',
  relationshipSheet: 'KS_P1_RELATIONSHIPS',
  maxFindingsPerPart: 35,
  maxCharsPerPart: 5200
};

function KS_RUN_DICTIONARY_SEMANTIC_AUDIT() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_DSA_CONFIG.spreadsheetId);
  if (ss.getId() !== KS_DSA_CONFIG.spreadsheetId ||
      ss.getName() !== KS_DSA_CONFIG.expectedSpreadsheetName) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Target spreadsheet identity does not match the approved audit target.');
  }

  var dictSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_DSA_CONFIG.dictionarySheet);
  var registrySheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_DSA_CONFIG.tableRegisterSheet);
  if (!dictSheet || !registrySheet) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Required schema register sheet is missing. No writes were performed.');
  }

  var dictValues = dictSheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  var registryValues = registrySheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  var relSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_DSA_CONFIG.relationshipSheet);
  var relValues = relSheet ? relSheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues() : [];

  if (dictValues.length < 2 || registryValues.length < 2) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Schema registers have no usable data rows.');
  }

  var dh = KS_DSA_headerMap_(dictValues[0]);
  var requiredDictHeaders = ['table', 'field', 'data type'];
  requiredDictHeaders.forEach(function (h) {
    if (dh[h] === undefined) throw new Error('STOP: Field Dictionary is missing column: ' + h);
  });
  var rh = KS_DSA_headerMap_(registryValues[0]);
  if (rh['table'] === undefined) throw new Error('STOP: Table Registry is missing its Table column.');

  var tables = {};
  var duplicateFields = [];
  var malformedNames = [];
  var typeFlags = [];
  var noKeyTables = [];
  var dictionaryRows = 0;

  for (var i = 1; i < dictValues.length; i++) {
    var row = dictValues[i];
    var table = KS_DSA_text_(row[dh.table]);
    var field = KS_DSA_text_(row[dh.field]);
    var type = KS_DSA_text_(row[dh['data type']]).toUpperCase();
    if (!table || !field) continue;
    dictionaryRows++;
    if (!tables[table]) tables[table] = { fields: [], fieldMap: {}, types: {} };
    var key = field.toLowerCase();
    if (tables[table].fieldMap[key]) {
      duplicateFields.push({ table: table, field: field, row: i + 1 });
    }
    tables[table].fieldMap[key] = true;
    tables[table].fields.push(field);
    tables[table].types[key] = type;

    if (/k_p_i|policie|_id_id|__|[^a-z0-9_]/i.test(field)) {
      malformedNames.push({ table: table, field: field, row: i + 1 });
    }
    var isIdentifier = /(^id$|_id$|_key$|_code$|_sku$|_gstin$|_pan$|_phone$|_email$|_url$|_number$|_reference$)/i.test(field);
    var isAmount = /(amount|price|rate|cost|value|total|balance|debit|credit|quantity|qty|weight|hours|factor|percent|score)$/i.test(field);
    var isBoolean = /^(is_|has_|can_|allow_|active$|enabled$|approved$|closed$|verified$|required$|reconciled$)/i.test(field);
    var validTypes = ['TEXT', 'DECIMAL', 'NUMBER', 'INTEGER', 'BOOLEAN', 'DATE', 'DATETIME', 'JSON_TEXT'];
    if (type && validTypes.indexOf(type) === -1) {
      typeFlags.push({ table: table, field: field, type: type, reason: 'UNRECOGNISED_TYPE_TOKEN' });
    } else if (isIdentifier && (type === 'DECIMAL' || type === 'NUMBER' || type === 'INTEGER' || type === 'BOOLEAN' || type === 'DATE' || type === 'DATETIME')) {
      typeFlags.push({ table: table, field: field, type: type, reason: 'IDENTIFIER_LIKE_FIELD_NOT_TEXT_REVIEW' });
    } else if (isAmount && (type === 'TEXT' || type === 'BOOLEAN' || type === 'DATE' || type === 'DATETIME' || type === 'JSON_TEXT')) {
      typeFlags.push({ table: table, field: field, type: type, reason: 'NUMERIC_MEASURE_LIKE_FIELD_TYPE_REVIEW' });
    } else if (isBoolean && type && type !== 'BOOLEAN' && type !== 'TEXT') {
      typeFlags.push({ table: table, field: field, type: type, reason: 'BOOLEAN_LIKE_FIELD_TYPE_REVIEW' });
    }
  }

  var registryTables = [];
  for (var j = 1; j < registryValues.length; j++) {
    var t = KS_DSA_text_(registryValues[j][rh.table]);
    if (t) registryTables.push(t);
  }
  var registryOnly = registryTables.filter(function (t) { return !tables[t] && t !== 'START_HERE'; });
  var dictionaryOnly = Object.keys(tables).filter(function (t) { return registryTables.indexOf(t) === -1; });

  Object.keys(tables).forEach(function (t) {
    var hasId = tables[t].fields.some(function (f) { return /(^id$|_id$)/i.test(f); });
    if (!hasId && t !== 'START_HERE' && t !== 'Settings') noKeyTables.push(t);
  });

  var bundleDefinitions = [
    {
      name: 'GENERIC_EVENT_OR_LEDGER_BUNDLE',
      fields: ['reference_type', 'reference_id', 'record_date', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit', 'amount', 'owner_user_id']
    },
    {
      name: 'GENERIC_PARTY_CONTACT_BUNDLE',
      fields: ['code', 'name', 'category', 'contact_person', 'phone', 'email', 'address', 'active']
    },
    {
      name: 'GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_BUNDLE',
      fields: ['record_id', 'created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by', 'status', 'notes']
    }
  ];
  var bundleFindings = [];
  bundleDefinitions.forEach(function (bundle) {
    var affected = [];
    Object.keys(tables).forEach(function (t) {
      var count = bundle.fields.filter(function (f) { return !!tables[t].fieldMap[f]; }).length;
      if (count >= Math.max(6, bundle.fields.length - 1)) {
        affected.push({ table: t, matchedBundleFields: count, totalBundleFields: bundle.fields.length });
      }
    });
    if (affected.length) bundleFindings.push({ bundle: bundle.name, affectedTableCount: affected.length, tables: affected });
  });

  var identicalSignatures = {};
  Object.keys(tables).forEach(function (t) {
    var signature = tables[t].fields.map(function (f) { return f.toLowerCase(); }).sort().join('|');
    if (!identicalSignatures[signature]) identicalSignatures[signature] = [];
    identicalSignatures[signature].push(t);
  });
  var repeatedSchemas = Object.keys(identicalSignatures).filter(function (sig) {
    return identicalSignatures[sig].length > 1;
  }).map(function (sig) {
    return { tableCount: identicalSignatures[sig].length, tables: identicalSignatures[sig], fieldCount: sig ? sig.split('|').length : 0 };
  });

  var relationshipFindings = [];
  if (relValues.length > 1) {
    var qh = KS_DSA_headerMap_(relValues[0]);
    var childTableCol = qh['child table'];
    var childFieldCol = qh['child field'];
    var parentTableCol = qh['parent table'];
    var parentFieldCol = qh['parent field'];
    if (childTableCol !== undefined && childFieldCol !== undefined && parentTableCol !== undefined && parentFieldCol !== undefined) {
      for (var k = 1; k < relValues.length; k++) {
        var cr = relValues[k];
        var ct = KS_DSA_text_(cr[childTableCol]);
        var cf = KS_DSA_text_(cr[childFieldCol]);
        var pt = KS_DSA_text_(cr[parentTableCol]);
        var pf = KS_DSA_text_(cr[parentFieldCol]);
        if (!ct && !cf && !pt && !pf) continue;
        if (!tables[ct] || !tables[ct].fieldMap[cf.toLowerCase()]) {
          relationshipFindings.push({ row: k + 1, issue: 'CHILD_TABLE_OR_FIELD_NOT_IN_DICTIONARY', childTable: ct, childField: cf });
        }
        if (!tables[pt] || !tables[pt].fieldMap[pf.toLowerCase()]) {
          relationshipFindings.push({ row: k + 1, issue: 'PARENT_TABLE_OR_FIELD_NOT_IN_DICTIONARY', parentTable: pt, parentField: pf });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  var summary = {
    auditName: 'KAWAD_SWAD_DICTIONARY_SEMANTIC_QUALITY_AUDIT',
    version: '1.0',
    spreadsheetName: ss.getName(),
    spreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    dictionaryDataRowsRead: dictionaryRows,
    dictionaryTablesFound: Object.keys(tables).length,
    registryTablesFound: registryTables.length,
    duplicateFieldDefinitionsWithinTables: duplicateFields.length,
    malformedOrSuspiciousFieldNames: malformedNames.length,
    dataTypeReviewFlags: typeFlags.length,
    tablesWithoutIdLikeField: noKeyTables.length,
    registryTablesMissingDictionary: registryOnly.length,
    dictionaryTablesMissingRegistry: dictionaryOnly.length,
    repeatedGenericBundlesFound: bundleFindings.length,
    identicalFieldSetGroups: repeatedSchemas.length,
    relationshipDictionaryMismatches: relationshipFindings.length,
    transactionRowsRead: false,
    personalDataRead: false,
    authUsersRead: false,
    writesPerformed: false,
    interpretation: 'Heuristic design-quality flags only. Human review is required; this audit does not approve any field or schema change.'
  };
  Logger.log('KS_DSA_SUMMARY ' + JSON.stringify(summary));
  KS_DSA_logParts_('GENERIC_BUNDLE', bundleFindings);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('REPEATED_FIELD_SETS', repeatedSchemas);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('TYPE_REVIEW', typeFlags);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('SUSPICIOUS_FIELD_NAMES', malformedNames);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('DUPLICATE_FIELD_DEFINITIONS', duplicateFields);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('TABLES_WITHOUT_ID_LIKE_FIELD', noKeyTables);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('RELATIONSHIP_DICTIONARY_MISMATCH', relationshipFindings);
  KS_DSA_logParts_('TABLE_REGISTRY_MISMATCH', { registryOnly: registryOnly, dictionaryOnly: dictionaryOnly });
  Logger.log('KS_DSA_END ' + JSON.stringify({ spreadsheetId: ss.getId(), writesPerformed: false }));
}

function KS_DSA_headerMap_(headers) {
  var out = {};
  headers.forEach(function (h, i) {
    var key = KS_DSA_text_(h).toLowerCase();
    if (key) out[key] = i;
  });
  return out;
}

function KS_DSA_text_(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value).trim();
}

function KS_DSA_logParts_(label, data) {
  if (!data || (Array.isArray(data) && data.length === 0)) {
    Logger.log('KS_DSA_' + label + ' NONE');
    return;
  }
  var items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data];
  var part = [];
  var partNo = 1;
  var maxItems = KS_DSA_CONFIG.maxFindingsPerPart;
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    part.push(items[i]);
    if (part.length >= maxItems || i === items.length - 1) {
      Logger.log('KS_DSA_' + label + '_PART ' + partNo + ' ' + JSON.stringify(part));
      part = [];
      partNo++;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD - LIVE SCHEMA RECONCILIATION (READ ONLY)
 * Version: 1.0
 *
 * PURPOSE
 * Compare the physical header row of each registered canonical worksheet
 * against KS_P1_FIELD_DICTIONARY, using KS_P1_TABLE_REGISTRY as the table list.
 * Detect exact matches, missing dictionary fields, additional physical headers,
 * duplicate headers, and the known generic placeholder header pattern.
 *
 * READ-ONLY GUARANTEE
 * - Reads only the table register, field dictionary, worksheet names and row-1 headers.
 * - Does not read business transaction rows, employee/customer/supplier personal data,
 *   authentication data, or cell values below the header row.
 * - Does not create, rename, clear, format, or modify any worksheet or cell.
 * - Does not allocate IDs or write audit results into the workbook.
 * - Writes diagnostic output only to the Apps Script execution log.
 *
 * RUN
 * Select and run: KS_RUN_LIVE_SCHEMA_RECONCILIATION
 */

const KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1 = {
  TABLE_REGISTER_TAB: 'KS_P1_TABLE_REGISTRY',
  FIELD_DICTIONARY_TAB: 'KS_P1_FIELD_DICTIONARY',
  MAX_LOG_CHARS: 8500,
  SPECIAL_NON_TABLES: ['START_HERE'],
  GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_HEADERS: [
    ['record_id', 'created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by', 'status', 'notes']
  ]
};

function KS_RUN_LIVE_SCHEMA_RECONCILIATION() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) throw new Error('No active spreadsheet is available. Open this script from the target spreadsheet.');

  const registerSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.TABLE_REGISTER_TAB);
  const dictionarySheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.FIELD_DICTIONARY_TAB);
  if (!registerSheet) throw new Error('Required register tab not found: ' + KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.TABLE_REGISTER_TAB);
  if (!dictionarySheet) throw new Error('Required field dictionary tab not found: ' + KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.FIELD_DICTIONARY_TAB);

  // These two tabs contain schema metadata, not transaction records.
  const registerValues = registerSheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  const dictionaryValues = dictionarySheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  if (registerValues.length < 2) throw new Error('Table register has no table rows.');
  if (dictionaryValues.length < 2) throw new Error('Field dictionary has no field rows.');

  const registerHeader = KS_schemaHeaderMap_(registerValues[0]);
  const dictionaryHeader = KS_schemaHeaderMap_(dictionaryValues[0]);
  const requiredRegisterColumns = ['table'];
  const requiredDictionaryColumns = ['table', 'field'];
  KS_schemaRequireColumns_(registerHeader, requiredRegisterColumns, KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.TABLE_REGISTER_TAB);
  KS_schemaRequireColumns_(dictionaryHeader, requiredDictionaryColumns, KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.FIELD_DICTIONARY_TAB);

  const tables = [];
  const seenTables = new Set();
  const duplicateTableRegisterRows = [];
  for (let r = 1; r < registerValues.length; r++) {
    const tableName = String(registerValues[r][registerHeader.table] || '').trim();
    if (!tableName) continue;
    const key = KS_schemaNorm_(tableName);
    if (seenTables.has(key)) {
      duplicateTableRegisterRows.push({ row: r + 1, table: tableName });
      continue;
    }
    seenTables.add(key);
    tables.push({
      table: tableName,
      priority: KS_schemaValue_(registerValues[r], registerHeader, 'priority'),
      group: KS_schemaValue_(registerValues[r], registerHeader, 'group'),
      purpose: KS_schemaValue_(registerValues[r], registerHeader, 'purpose / record grain')
    });
  }

  const fieldsByTable = new Map();
  let dictionaryFieldRows = 0;
  const duplicateDictionaryFields = [];
  const seenFieldKeys = new Set();
  for (let r = 1; r < dictionaryValues.length; r++) {
    const tableName = String(dictionaryValues[r][dictionaryHeader.table] || '').trim();
    const fieldName = String(dictionaryValues[r][dictionaryHeader.field] || '').trim();
    if (!tableName || !fieldName) continue;
    dictionaryFieldRows++;
    const tableKey = KS_schemaNorm_(tableName);
    const fieldKey = KS_schemaNorm_(fieldName);
    const combined = tableKey + '::' + fieldKey;
    if (seenFieldKeys.has(combined)) duplicateDictionaryFields.push({ row: r + 1, table: tableName, field: fieldName });
    seenFieldKeys.add(combined);
    if (!fieldsByTable.has(tableKey)) fieldsByTable.set(tableKey, []);
    fieldsByTable.get(tableKey).push(fieldName);
  }

  const results = [];
  let specialSkipped = 0;
  let missingPhysicalTabs = 0;
  let genericPlaceholders = 0;
  let exactMatches = 0;
  let missingFieldTables = 0;
  let extraHeaderTables = 0;
  let duplicateHeaderTables = 0;
  let noDictionaryTables = 0;
  let expectedFieldCount = 0;
  let matchedFieldCount = 0;
  let missingFieldCount = 0;
  let extraHeaderCount = 0;
  let blankPhysicalHeaderCells = 0;

  for (const tableInfo of tables) {
    const tableName = tableInfo.table;
    const tableKey = KS_schemaNorm_(tableName);
    const expectedFields = fieldsByTable.get(tableKey) || [];
    expectedFieldCount += expectedFields.length;

    if (KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.SPECIAL_NON_TABLES.map(KS_schemaNorm_).indexOf(tableKey) >= 0) {
      specialSkipped++;
      results.push({
        table: tableName,
        priority: tableInfo.priority,
        status: 'SPECIAL_CONTROL_NOT_A_NORMALISED_TABLE',
        expectedFieldCount: expectedFields.length,
        matchedFieldCount: 0,
        missingFields: [],
        extraPhysicalHeaders: [],
        duplicateHeaders: [],
        note: 'START_HERE is an instruction page, not a database table; header comparison is intentionally skipped.'
      });
      continue;
    }

    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
    if (!sh) {
      missingPhysicalTabs++;
      missingFieldCount += expectedFields.length;
      results.push({
        table: tableName,
        priority: tableInfo.priority,
        status: 'MISSING_PHYSICAL_TAB',
        expectedFieldCount: expectedFields.length,
        matchedFieldCount: 0,
        missingFields: expectedFields,
        extraPhysicalHeaders: [],
        duplicateHeaders: [],
        note: 'No worksheet with this exact name exists.'
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (expectedFields.length === 0) noDictionaryTables++;

    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const headerCells = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0] : [];
    const blankHeaderColumns = [];
    headerCells.forEach((value, index) => { if (!String(value || '').trim()) blankHeaderColumns.push(index + 1); });
    blankPhysicalHeaderCells += blankHeaderColumns.length;
    const physicalHeaders = headerCells.map(v => String(v || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const normalizedPhysical = physicalHeaders.map(KS_schemaNorm_);
    const physicalSet = new Set(normalizedPhysical);

    const duplicateHeaders = [];
    const headerSeen = new Set();
    for (const header of physicalHeaders) {
      const key = KS_schemaNorm_(header);
      if (headerSeen.has(key) && duplicateHeaders.indexOf(header) < 0) duplicateHeaders.push(header);
      headerSeen.add(key);
    }

    const expectedSet = new Set(expectedFields.map(KS_schemaNorm_));
    const missingFields = expectedFields.filter(f => !physicalSet.has(KS_schemaNorm_(f)));
    const extraPhysicalHeaders = physicalHeaders.filter(h => !expectedSet.has(KS_schemaNorm_(h)));
    const matched = expectedFields.length - missingFields.length;
    matchedFieldCount += matched;
    missingFieldCount += missingFields.length;
    extraHeaderCount += extraPhysicalHeaders.length;

    const genericSignature = KS_schemaIsGenericPlaceholder_(physicalHeaders);
    let status;
    if (genericSignature) {
      status = 'GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_HEADER';
      genericPlaceholders++;
    } else if (duplicateHeaders.length) {
      status = 'DUPLICATE_PHYSICAL_HEADERS_REVIEW';
      duplicateHeaderTables++;
    } else if (missingFields.length && extraPhysicalHeaders.length) {
      status = 'MISSING_FIELDS_AND_EXTRA_HEADERS_REVIEW';
      missingFieldTables++;
      extraHeaderTables++;
    } else if (missingFields.length) {
      status = 'MISSING_DICTIONARY_FIELDS_REVIEW';
      missingFieldTables++;
    } else if (extraPhysicalHeaders.length) {
      status = 'EXTRA_PHYSICAL_HEADERS_REVIEW';
      extraHeaderTables++;
    } else if (expectedFields.length === 0) {
      status = 'NO_DICTIONARY_DEFINITION';
    } else {
      status = 'EXACT_HEADER_SET_MATCH';
      exactMatches++;
    }

    results.push({
      table: tableName,
      priority: tableInfo.priority,
      status: status,
      physicalHeaderCount: physicalHeaders.length,
      blankHeaderColumns: blankHeaderColumns,
      expectedFieldCount: expectedFields.length,
      matchedFieldCount: matched,
      missingFields: missingFields,
      extraPhysicalHeaders: extraPhysicalHeaders,
      duplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaders,
      note: 'Header-set comparison only. Does not verify stored values, types, formulas, route usage, or accounting behaviour.'
    });
  }

  const summary = {
    auditName: 'KAWAD_SWAD_LIVE_SCHEMA_RECONCILIATION',
    version: '1.0',
    spreadsheetName: ss.getName(),
    spreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    physicalSheetCount: ss.getSheets().length,
    registeredTableCount: tables.length,
    dictionaryFieldRows: dictionaryFieldRows,
    expectedFieldCountAcrossRegisteredTables: expectedFieldCount,
    matchedFieldCount: matchedFieldCount,
    missingFieldCount: missingFieldCount,
    extraPhysicalHeaderCount: extraHeaderCount,
    blankPhysicalHeaderCells: blankPhysicalHeaderCells,
    exactHeaderSetMatches: exactMatches,
    genericPlaceholderTables: genericPlaceholders,
    tablesWithMissingFields: missingFieldTables,
    tablesWithExtraHeaders: extraHeaderTables,
    tablesWithDuplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaderTables,
    missingPhysicalTabs: missingPhysicalTabs,
    tablesWithoutDictionaryDefinition: noDictionaryTables,
    specialPagesSkipped: specialSkipped,
    duplicateTableRegisterRows: duplicateTableRegisterRows.length,
    duplicateDictionaryFieldDefinitions: duplicateDictionaryFields.length,
    transactionRowsRead: false,
    personalDataRead: false,
    writesPerformed: false
  };

  Logger.log('KS_SCHEMA_RECON_START ' + JSON.stringify(summary));
  if (duplicateTableRegisterRows.length) Logger.log('KS_SCHEMA_RECON_DUPLICATE_TABLES ' + JSON.stringify(duplicateTableRegisterRows));
  if (duplicateDictionaryFields.length) Logger.log('KS_SCHEMA_RECON_DUPLICATE_FIELDS ' + JSON.stringify(duplicateDictionaryFields));

  // Chunk by serialized size so unusually wide tables do not create oversized log entries.
  const chunks = [];
  let currentChunk = [];
  let currentLength = 2;
  for (const item of results) {
    const itemText = JSON.stringify(item);
    const addedLength = itemText.length + (currentChunk.length ? 1 : 0);
    if (currentChunk.length && currentLength + addedLength > KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.MAX_LOG_CHARS) {
      chunks.push(currentChunk);
      currentChunk = [];
      currentLength = 2;
    }
    currentChunk.push(item);
    currentLength += itemText.length + (currentChunk.length > 1 ? 1 : 0);
  }
  if (currentChunk.length) chunks.push(currentChunk);
  for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
    Logger.log('KS_SCHEMA_RECON_PART ' + (i + 1) + '/' + chunks.length + ' ' + JSON.stringify(chunks[i]));
  }
  Logger.log('KS_SCHEMA_RECON_END ' + JSON.stringify({ spreadsheetId: ss.getId(), registeredTableCount: tables.length, writesPerformed: false }));
}

function KS_schemaHeaderMap_(headers) {
  const map = {};
  headers.forEach((value, index) => {
    const key = KS_schemaNorm_(value);
    if (key && map[key] === undefined) map[key] = index;
  });
  return map;
}

function KS_schemaRequireColumns_(map, required, tabName) {
  const missing = required.filter(name => map[name] === undefined);
  if (missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required columns in ' + tabName + ': ' + missing.join(', '));
}

function KS_schemaValue_(row, headerMap, name) {
  const index = headerMap[KS_schemaNorm_(name)];
  return index === undefined ? '' : String(row[index] || '').trim();
}

function KS_schemaNorm_(value) {
  return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
    .replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
}

function KS_schemaIsGenericPlaceholder_(headers) {
  const actual = headers.map(KS_schemaNorm_).sort();
  return KS_SCHEMA_RECON_V1.GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_HEADERS.some(signature => {
    const expected = signature.map(KS_schemaNorm_).sort();
    return actual.length === expected.length && actual.every((value, index) => value === expected[index]);
  });
}

/*
KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 MASTER DATA HEADER AUDIT
Version: 1.0.0
Mode: READ-ONLY business data; creates one uniquely named audit report tab.

IMPORTANT:
- Run this function directly from the Apps Script editor.
- This file intentionally has NO onOpen() function, to avoid conflicts with existing scripts.
- It does not create/edit business records, reserve IDs, change IDs, edit Users, or access AuthUsers.
- It does not change business headers, formulas, validations, or existing tabs.
- It creates one new report tab named KS_P3_MD_HEADER_AUDIT_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.
- It verifies exact ordered headers for the six approved sheets from the supplied live-header report.

function KS_P3_MD_HEADER_AUDIT_V1_0() {
  const CFG = {
    spreadsheetId: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
    expectedName: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
    expected: {
      IdAllocations: ['allocation_id','tab_name','allocated_id','nonce','created_at'],
      Products: ['product_id','sku','product_name','category','variant','pack_weight_g','selling_unit','retail_pack_only','active','notes'],
      RawMaterials: ['raw_material_id','material_name','unit','opening_stock','current_stock','minimum_stock','active','notes','rate_per_unit','rate_status','category','created_at','created_by'],
      Customers: ['customer_id','customer_type','shop_name','shopkeeper_name','mobile','alternate_mobile','address','locality_area','city','map_location','active','created_at','notes','gstin'],
      Suppliers: ['supplier_id','supplier_name','contact_person','mobile','email','address','city','gstin','payment_terms_days','opening_balance','active','notes','created_at','created_by'],
      Users: ['user_id','full_name','role','mobile','email','active','created_at','notes','username','employment_type','designation','department','reporting_manager_id','joining_date','employment_status','salary_frequency','salary_structure_id','address','emergency_contact','bank_details','document_references','updated_at','created_by','effective_from','effective_to']
    }
  };

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss || ss.getId() !== CFG.spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error('SAFETY STOP: Active spreadsheet ID does not match the approved Kawad Swad workbook. Nothing was written.');
  }
  if (ss.getName() !== CFG.expectedName) {
    throw new Error('SAFETY STOP: Active spreadsheet name does not match the approved workbook. Nothing was written.');
  }

  const checkedAt = new Date();
  const rows = [];
  Object.keys(CFG.expected).forEach(sheetName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (!sh) {
      rows.push([sheetName, 'MISSING_TAB', '', CFG.expected[sheetName].length, 0, 'Tab not found', 'STOP']);
      return;
    }
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const actual = lastCol > 0
      ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v).trim())
      : [];
    const expected = CFG.expected[sheetName];
    const blankCols = [];
    const duplicateHeaders = [];
    const seen = {};
    actual.forEach((h, i) => {
      if (!h) blankCols.push(i + 1);
      else if (seen[h]) duplicateHeaders.push(h);
      else seen[h] = true;
    });
    const missing = expected.filter(h => actual.indexOf(h) === -1);
    const extra = actual.filter(h => h && expected.indexOf(h) === -1);
    const orderMatches = actual.length === expected.length && actual.every((h, i) => h === expected[i]);
    const issues = [];
    if (blankCols.length) issues.push('Blank header columns: ' + blankCols.join(','));
    if (duplicateHeaders.length) issues.push('Duplicate headers: ' + Array.from(new Set(duplicateHeaders)).join(', '));
    if (missing.length) issues.push('Missing: ' + missing.join(', '));
    if (extra.length) issues.push('Extra: ' + extra.join(', '));
    if (!orderMatches && !missing.length && !extra.length) issues.push('Header order differs from approved reference');
    const status = issues.length ? 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' : 'EXACT_MATCH';
    // Metadata only. No employee rows or other business data are read.
    const dataRowCountMetadata = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
    rows.push([
      sheetName, status, actual.length, expected.length, dataRowCountMetadata,
      issues.length ? issues.join(' | ') : 'Exact ordered header match',
      sheetName === 'Users' ? 'HEADER_ONLY; employee values not read' : 'HEADER_ONLY; business values not read'
    ]);
  });

  const stamp = Utilities.formatDate(checkedAt, ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
  const reportName = 'KS_P3_MD_HEADER_AUDIT_' + stamp;
  const report = ss.insertSheet(reportName);
  const reportRows = [
    ['Kawad Swad Phase 3 Master Data Header Audit', ''],
    ['Version', '1.0.0'],
    ['Checked at', checkedAt],
    ['Workbook', ss.getName()],
    ['Workbook ID verified', 'YES'],
    ['Scope', 'Six approved master-data sheets; header-only inspection'],
    ['Business data read', 'NO'],
    ['Business data changed', 'NO'],
    ['ID allocation performed', 'NO'],
    ['Users employee values read', 'NO'],
    ['AuthUsers accessed', 'NO'],
    [],
    ['Sheet', 'Status', 'Actual header count', 'Expected header count', 'Data row count (metadata only)', 'Finding', 'Read scope'],
    ...rows
  ];
  report.getRange(1, 1, reportRows.length, 7).setValues(reportRows.map(r => {
    const a = r.slice(); while (a.length < 7) a.push(''); return a;
  }));
  report.setFrozenRows(13);
  report.autoResizeColumns(1, 7);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  const allExact = rows.every(r => r[1] === 'EXACT_MATCH');
  const summary = {
    status: allExact ? 'HEADER_PREFLIGHT_PASSED' : 'HEADER_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
    reportTab: reportName,
    sheetsChecked: rows.length,
    exactMatches: rows.filter(r => r[1] === 'EXACT_MATCH').length,
    reviewRequired: rows.filter(r => r[1] !== 'EXACT_MATCH').length,
    businessDataRead: false,
    businessDataChanged: false,
    usersEmployeeValuesRead: false,
    authUsersAccessed: false,
    idAllocationPerformed: false
  };
  console.log('KS_P3_MD_HEADER_AUDIT_RESULT ' + JSON.stringify(summary));
  return summary;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 MASTER DATA BATCH 1A-1D
 * Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * PURPOSE
 * Performs a controlled readiness audit of:
 * 1A ID allocation + Settings
 * 1B Products + RawMaterials
 * 1C Customers + Suppliers
 * 1D Users + AuthUsers
 *
 * SAFE SCOPE:
 * - Reads only row-1 headers and first-column non-empty row counts for the
 *   eight named tabs. It does not read cell contents from AuthUsers.
 * - Reads ID policy and Phase 2 master-data rule registers.
 * - Writes only KS_P3_BATCH1_MASTER_AUDIT and appends KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG.
 * - Does not create business records, modify business headers, validations,
 *   formulas, IDs, credentials, stock, prices, or configuration values.
 *
 * WHY THIS IS A GATE, NOT A DATA MIGRATION:
 * Phase 1 ID policy requires a shared server-side allocator used by API/UI
 * writers. A spreadsheet-only allocator cannot be authoritative for backend
 * writes. Backend implementation is required before production ID allocation.
 */

const KS_B1_CFG = Object.freeze({
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  NAME_PREFIX: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  AUDIT_TAB: 'KS_P3_BATCH1_MASTER_AUDIT',
  LOG_TAB: 'KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG',
  ID_POLICY_TAB: 'KS_P1_ID_POLICY',
  MASTER_RULES_TAB: 'KS_P2_MASTER_DATA_RULES',
  TABLES: [
    {name:'Settings', batch:'1A', required:['setting_key','setting_value','description'], unique:['setting_key'], mode:'PRESERVE_TEXT_VALUES'},
    {name:'IdAllocations', batch:'1A', required:['allocation_id','tab_name','allocated_id','nonce','created_at'], unique:['allocation_id','allocated_id','nonce'], mode:'BACKEND_SHARED_ALLOCATOR_REQUIRED'},
    {name:'Products', batch:'1B', required:['product_id','sku','product_name'], unique:['product_id','sku'], mode:'PRESERVE_MASTER'},
    {name:'RawMaterials', batch:'1B', required:['raw_material_id','material_name','unit'], unique:['raw_material_id'], mode:'PRESERVE_STOCK_AND_RATE'},
    {name:'Customers', batch:'1C', required:['customer_id','customer_type'], unique:['customer_id'], mode:'NO_MOBILE_UNIQUENESS_ASSUMPTION'},
    {name:'Suppliers', batch:'1C', required:['supplier_id','supplier_name'], unique:['supplier_id'], mode:'PRESERVE_PAYMENT_TERMS'},
    {name:'Users', batch:'1D', required:['user_id','full_name','role'], unique:['user_id'], mode:'RESTRICTED_NO_GENERIC_WRITES'},
    {name:'AuthUsers', batch:'1D', required:['auth_id','user_id','username','password_hash'], unique:['auth_id','username'], mode:'HIGHLY_RESTRICTED_NO_READ_OR_WRITE'}
  ],
  AUDIT_HEADERS: ['batch','tab_name','tab_exists','header_count','missing_required_headers','duplicate_headers','nonempty_data_rows','unique_fields_to_check','policy_mode','result','notes'],
  LOG_HEADERS: ['timestamp','version','event','spreadsheet_id','spreadsheet_name','backup_url','live_tab_count','inventory_rows','business_schema_changed','details']
});

function KS_PHASE3_BATCH1_MASTER_PREFLIGHT() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (!ss || ss.getId() !== KS_B1_CFG.SPREADSHEET_ID ||
        !ss.getName().startsWith(KS_B1_CFG.NAME_PREFIX)) {
      throw new Error('STOP: This is not the approved Kawad Swad workbook.');
    }

    const policy = ksB1ReadRegister_(ss, KS_B1_CFG.ID_POLICY_TAB);
    const rules = ksB1ReadRegister_(ss, KS_B1_CFG.MASTER_RULES_TAB);
    if (policy.length < 2 || rules.length < 2) {
      throw new Error('STOP: ID policy or Phase 2 master rules register is missing.');
    }

    const policyText = policy.slice(1).map(r => String(r[2] || '')).join('\n');
    const requiredPolicyMarkers = [
      'shared server-side allocator',
      'idempotency key',
      'server-side locking',
      'Persist each committed business transaction to Google Sheets'
    ];
    const policyMissing = requiredPolicyMarkers.filter(x =>
      policyText.toLowerCase().indexOf(x.toLowerCase()) < 0);
    if (policyMissing.length) {
      throw new Error('STOP: ID policy verification failed: ' + policyMissing.join('; '));
    }

    const output = [KS_B1_CFG.AUDIT_HEADERS];
    const issues = [];
    KS_B1_CFG.TABLES.forEach(t => {
      const sh = ss.getSheetByName(t.name);
      if (!sh) {
        output.push([t.batch,t.name,'NO',0,t.required.join('; '),'',0,t.unique.join('; '),t.mode,'BLOCKED','Required tab missing']);
        issues.push(t.name + ': missing tab');
        return;
      }

      // AuthUsers: inspect only row-1 headers and dimensions; never read data cells.
      const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
      const headers = lastCol ? sh.getRange(1,1,1,lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(x => String(x).trim()) : [];
      const missing = t.required.filter(h => headers.indexOf(h) < 0);
      const dupes = headers.filter((h,i) => h && headers.indexOf(h) !== i);
      let dataRows = 'NOT_SCANNED';
      if (t.name !== 'AuthUsers') {
        const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
        if (lastRow > 1) {
          const ids = sh.getRange(2,1,lastRow-1,1).getDisplayValues();
          dataRows = ids.filter(r => String(r[0]).trim() !== '').length;
        } else dataRows = 0;
      }

      const result = missing.length || dupes.length ? 'BLOCKED' : 'STRUCTURE_OK_REVIEW_REQUIRED';
      if (result === 'BLOCKED') issues.push(t.name + ': header issue');
      output.push([t.batch,t.name,'YES',headers.length,missing.join('; '),[...new Set(dupes)].join('; '),dataRows,t.unique.join('; '),t.mode,result,
        t.name === 'AuthUsers' ? 'Sensitive rows were not read.' :
        'Header and first-column row count only; values and uniqueness not validated.']);
    });

    const audit = ksB1GetOutput_(ss, KS_B1_CFG.AUDIT_TAB, KS_B1_CFG.AUDIT_HEADERS);
    audit.clearContents();
    audit.getRange(1,1,output.length,output[0].length).setValues(output);
    audit.setFrozenRows(1);

    const log = ss.getSheetByName(KS_B1_CFG.LOG_TAB);
    if (!log) throw new Error('STOP: KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG missing; audit report written, no business schema changed.');
    const logHeaders = log.getRange(1,1,1,10).getDisplayValues()[0];
    if (logHeaders.join('|') !== KS_B1_CFG.LOG_HEADERS.join('|')) {
      throw new Error('STOP: migration log headers do not match the approved 10-column contract.');
    }
    log.appendRow([new Date(),'1.0.0','BATCH1_MASTER_PREFLIGHT',ss.getId(),ss.getName(),'',
      ss.getSheets().length,output.length-1,false,
      'Readiness audit only. No business tabs, records, headers, formulas, validations, IDs or credentials changed.']);

    const result = {
      success: issues.length === 0,
      status: issues.length ? 'BLOCKED_FOR_REVIEW' : 'PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
      workbookId: ss.getId(),
      batches: ['1A','1B','1C','1D'],
      auditedTabs: KS_B1_CFG.TABLES.length,
      authUsersDataRead: false,
      businessSchemaChanged: false,
      issues: issues,
      reportTab: KS_B1_CFG.AUDIT_TAB,
      nextGate: 'Review audit results, then implement the shared server-side allocator and approved backend contracts.'
    };
    console.log('KS_PHASE3_BATCH1_MASTER_PREFLIGHT_RESULT ' + JSON.stringify(result));
    return result;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksB1ReadRegister_(ss, name) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Required register missing: ' + name);
  const r = sh.getLastRow(), c = sh.getLastColumn();
  return r && c ? sh.getRange(1,1,r,c).getValues() : [];
}
function ksB1GetOutput_(ss, name, headers) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
  if (sh.getLastRow() > 0) {
    const existing = sh.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0];
    if (existing.some(Boolean) && existing.join('|') !== headers.join('|')) {
      throw new Error('STOP: output tab has unexpected headers: ' + name);
    }
  }
  return sh;
}

/**
 * Read business table names from the approved registries.
 * Registry column A contains the table/tab name; row 1 is the header.
 */
function ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss) {
  var names = new Set();

  var tableRegistry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.TABLE_REGISTRY);
  if (!tableRegistry) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing registry: ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.TABLE_REGISTRY +
      '. Reset aborted before any changes.'
    );
  }

  var lastRow = tableRegistry.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow > 1) {
    tableRegistry.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1)
      .getDisplayValues()
      .forEach(function(row) {
        var name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
        if (name) names.add(name);
      });
  }

  var runtimeRegistry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RUNTIME_REGISTRY);
  if (!runtimeRegistry) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing registry: ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RUNTIME_REGISTRY +
      '. Reset aborted before any changes.'
    );
  }

  lastRow = runtimeRegistry.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow > 1) {
    runtimeRegistry.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1)
      .getDisplayValues()
      .forEach(function(row) {
        var name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
        if (name) names.add(name);
      });
  }

  // Explicitly remove all technical/blueprint sheets from the deletion set.
  KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.PRESERVE_ALWAYS.forEach(function(name) {
    names.delete(name);
  });
  names.delete(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);

  return names;
}


/**
 * NON-DESTRUCTIVE PREVIEW.
 * Review the target list before running the reset.
 */
function ksP3V13PreviewEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);

  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Preview stopped.');
  }

  var targets = ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss);
  var targetSheets = [];
  var totalNonFormulaCells = 0;
  var populatedTargetSheets = 0;
  var missingRegisteredTabs = [];

  targets.forEach(function(name) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      missingRegisteredTabs.push(name);
      return;
    }

    var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    var nonFormulaCells = 0;

    if (lastRow > 1 && lastCol > 0) {
      var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues();
      var formulas = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getFormulas();

      for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
          if (!formulas[r][c] && values[r][c] !== '' && values[r][c] !== null) {
            nonFormulaCells++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (nonFormulaCells > 0) populatedTargetSheets++;
    totalNonFormulaCells += nonFormulaCells;

    targetSheets.push({
      sheet: name,
      populatedCellsToClear: nonFormulaCells,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastCol
    });
  });

  var result = {
    previewOnly: true,
    workbook: ss.getName(),
    registeredBusinessTablesFound: targetSheets.length,
    populatedBusinessTables: populatedTargetSheets,
    totalNonFormulaCellsToClear: totalNonFormulaCells,
    missingRegisteredTabs: missingRegisteredTabs,
    preservedBlueprintAndControlSheets: KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.PRESERVE_ALWAYS.length,
    targetSheetNames: targetSheets.map(function(item) {
      return item.sheet;
    })
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * DESTRUCTIVE ONE-GO RESET.
 *
 * A native YES/NO dialog replaces the unreliable typed phrase.
 * A Drive backup is created before the first data-clearing operation.
 */
function ksP3V13ExecuteEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(30000)) {
    throw new Error('Another migration is running. No changes made.');
  }

  var backupFile = null;

  try {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);

    if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.EXPECTED_NAME) {
      throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Reset aborted.');
    }

    var targets = ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss);

    if (targets.size === 0) {
      throw new Error('No registered business tables found. Reset aborted.');
    }

    // Native confirmation dialog. Click YES to proceed, NO to stop.
    var ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
    var response = ui.alert(
      'FINAL DATABASE RESET CONFIRMATION',
      'You are about to clear all data rows in the registered business tables.\n\n' +
      'A complete Google Drive backup will be created BEFORE deletion.\n\n' +
      'WILL BE CLEARED:\n' +
      '- Business master records\n' +
      '- Sales, purchases, payments and expenses\n' +
      '- Production and stock records\n' +
      '- Users and authentication records\n' +
      '- Settings and ID allocation records\n\n' +
      'WILL BE PRESERVED:\n' +
      '- Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 3 blueprints\n' +
      '- Table and field dictionaries\n' +
      '- Backend contracts and relationships\n' +
      '- Migration registers and technical audits\n' +
      '- Headers, formulas, formatting and validations\n\n' +
      'Do you want to create the backup and continue?',
      ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
    );

    if (response !== ui.Button.YES) {
      throw new Error('Reset cancelled by user. No changes made.');
    }

    Logger.log('Reset confirmed by user. Creating backup now.');

    // Mandatory backup, before any deletion.
    var sourceFile = DriveApp.getFileById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    var timestamp = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );
    var backupName = ss.getName() + '_PRE_EMPTY_DB_RESET_' + timestamp;

    if (KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID) {
      backupFile = sourceFile.makeCopy(
        backupName,
        DriveApp.getFolderById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID)
      );
    } else {
      backupFile = sourceFile.makeCopy(backupName);
    }

    if (!backupFile || !backupFile.getId()) {
      throw new Error('Backup creation failed. No business data was cleared.');
    }

    Logger.log('Backup created: ' + backupFile.getUrl());

    var clearedResults = [];
    var missingTabs = [];
    var totalClearedCells = 0;

    // Clear only registered business table tabs. Row 1 is always retained.
    targets.forEach(function(name) {
      var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);

      if (!sh) {
        missingTabs.push(name);
        return;
      }

      var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
      var clearedCells = 0;

      if (lastRow > 1 && lastCol > 0) {
        var body = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol);
        var values = body.getValues();
        var formulas = body.getFormulas();

        var output = values.map(function(row, r) {
          return row.map(function(value, c) {
            if (formulas[r][c]) {
              return formulas[r][c];
            }

            if (value !== '' && value !== null) {
              clearedCells++;
            }

            return '';
          });
        });

        if (clearedCells > 0) {
          body.setValues(output);
        }
      }

      totalClearedCells += clearedCells;
      clearedResults.push({
        sheet: name,
        clearedCells: clearedCells
      });
    });

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // Verify that no non-formula constants remain below row 1 in target tabs.
    var verificationFailures = [];

    clearedResults.forEach(function(item) {
      if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;

      var sh = ss.getSheetByName(item.sheet);
      if (!sh) {
        verificationFailures.push(item.sheet + ': SHEET MISSING AFTER RESET');
        return;
      }

      var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

      if (lastRow <= 1 || lastCol < 1) return;

      var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues();
      var formulas = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getFormulas();

      for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
          if (!formulas[r][c] && values[r][c] !== '' && values[r][c] !== null) {
            verificationFailures.push(
              item.sheet + '!R' + (r + 2) + 'C' + (c + 1)
            );
            if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;
          }
        }
        if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;
      }
    });

    // Write a permanent reset log. This log is technical evidence, not business data.
    var resetLog = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);

    if (!resetLog) {
      resetLog = ss.insertSheet(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);
      resetLog.appendRow([
        'timestamp',
        'operation',
        'status',
        'backup_url',
        'backup_file_id',
        'business_tables_processed',
        'cleared_cell_count',
        'missing_registered_tabs',
        'verification_failures',
        'notes'
      ]);
    }

    var finalStatus = verificationFailures.length === 0
      ? 'SUCCESS'
      : 'VERIFICATION_FAILED';

    resetLog.appendRow([
      new Date(),
      'PHASE_3_EMPTY_BUSINESS_DATABASE_RESET',
      finalStatus,
      backupFile.getUrl(),
      backupFile.getId(),
      clearedResults.length,
      totalClearedCells,
      missingTabs.join(' | '),
      verificationFailures.join(' | '),
      'Registered business data rows cleared; technical blueprint/control registers preserved.'
    ]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    if (verificationFailures.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        'Reset verification failed. Backup is available at: ' +
        backupFile.getUrl() +
        '. Remaining data examples: ' +
        verificationFailures.slice(0, 10).join(', ')
      );
    }

    var finalResult = {
      success: true,
      workbook: ss.getName(),
      businessTablesProcessed: clearedResults.length,
      clearedNonFormulaCells: totalClearedCells,
      missingRegisteredTabs: missingTabs,
      backupUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
      backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
      status: finalStatus,
      note: 'Registered business-table data rows cleared. Technical blueprint and control registers preserved.'
    };

    Logger.log(JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2));
    return finalResult;

  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(
      'PHASE 3 RESET STOPPED: ' +
      (error && error.stack ? error.stack : error)
    );
    throw error;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
