/**
 * Read business table names from the approved registries.
 * Registry column A contains the table/tab name; row 1 is the header.
 */
function ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss) {
  var names = new Set();

  var tableRegistry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.TABLE_REGISTRY);
  if (!tableRegistry) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing registry: ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.TABLE_REGISTRY +
      '. Reset aborted before any changes.'
    );
  }

  var lastRow = tableRegistry.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow > 1) {
    tableRegistry.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1)
      .getDisplayValues()
      .forEach(function(row) {
        var name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
        if (name) names.add(name);
      });
  }

  var runtimeRegistry = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RUNTIME_REGISTRY);
  if (!runtimeRegistry) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing registry: ' + KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RUNTIME_REGISTRY +
      '. Reset aborted before any changes.'
    );
  }

  lastRow = runtimeRegistry.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow > 1) {
    runtimeRegistry.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1)
      .getDisplayValues()
      .forEach(function(row) {
        var name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
        if (name) names.add(name);
      });
  }

  // Explicitly remove all technical/blueprint sheets from the deletion set.
  KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.PRESERVE_ALWAYS.forEach(function(name) {
    names.delete(name);
  });
  names.delete(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);

  return names;
}


/**
 * NON-DESTRUCTIVE PREVIEW.
 * Review the target list before running the reset.
 */
function ksP3V13PreviewEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);

  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Preview stopped.');
  }

  var targets = ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss);
  var targetSheets = [];
  var totalNonFormulaCells = 0;
  var populatedTargetSheets = 0;
  var missingRegisteredTabs = [];

  targets.forEach(function(name) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      missingRegisteredTabs.push(name);
      return;
    }

    var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    var nonFormulaCells = 0;

    if (lastRow > 1 && lastCol > 0) {
      var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues();
      var formulas = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getFormulas();

      for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
          if (!formulas[r][c] && values[r][c] !== '' && values[r][c] !== null) {
            nonFormulaCells++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (nonFormulaCells > 0) populatedTargetSheets++;
    totalNonFormulaCells += nonFormulaCells;

    targetSheets.push({
      sheet: name,
      populatedCellsToClear: nonFormulaCells,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastCol
    });
  });

  var result = {
    previewOnly: true,
    workbook: ss.getName(),
    registeredBusinessTablesFound: targetSheets.length,
    populatedBusinessTables: populatedTargetSheets,
    totalNonFormulaCellsToClear: totalNonFormulaCells,
    missingRegisteredTabs: missingRegisteredTabs,
    preservedBlueprintAndControlSheets: KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.PRESERVE_ALWAYS.length,
    targetSheetNames: targetSheets.map(function(item) {
      return item.sheet;
    })
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}



/**
 * Deterministic fingerprint of registered target names and business data.
 * Used to ensure nothing changed between arming and execution.
 */
function ksP3V14Fingerprint_(ss, targets) {
  var parts = [];
  Array.from(targets).sort().forEach(function(name) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      parts.push(name + '|MISSING');
      return;
    }
    var lr = sh.getLastRow();
    var lc = sh.getLastColumn();
    var count = 0;
    var valuesText = [];

    if (lr > 1 && lc > 0) {
      var range = sh.getRange(2, 1, lr - 1, lc);
      var values = range.getValues();
      var formulas = range.getFormulas();
      for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
          if (!formulas[r][c] && values[r][c] !== '' && values[r][c] !== null) {
            count++;
            valuesText.push((r + 2) + ',' + (c + 1) + ':' + String(values[r][c]));
          }
        }
      }
    }
    parts.push(name + '|' + lr + '|' + lc + '|' + count + '|' + valuesText.join('~'));
  });

  var digest = Utilities.computeDigest(
    Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,
    KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID + '\n' + parts.join('\n'),
    Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
  );
  return Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(digest);
}


/**
 * ARMING STEP. Run after reviewing the non-destructive preview.
 * Authorization expires after 10 minutes.
 */
function ksP3V14ArmEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Reset not armed.');
  }

  var targets = ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss);
  var preview = ksP3V13PreviewEmptyDatabaseReset();
  var arm = {
    spreadsheetId: KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID,
    armedAt: Date.now(),
    fingerprint: ksP3V14Fingerprint_(ss, targets),
    registeredBusinessTables: targets.size,
    populatedBusinessTables: preview.populatedBusinessTables,
    totalNonFormulaCellsToClear: preview.totalNonFormulaCellsToClear
  };

  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(
    'KS_P3_V14_RESET_ARM',
    JSON.stringify(arm)
  );

  Logger.log('RESET ARMED FOR 10 MINUTES. Review preview, then run ' +
    'ksP3V14ExecuteArmedEmptyDatabaseReset().');
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(arm, null, 2));
  return arm;
}

/**
 * DESTRUCTIVE ONE-GO RESET.
 *
 * A native YES/NO dialog replaces the unreliable typed phrase.
 * A Drive backup is created before the first data-clearing operation.
 */
function ksP3V14ExecuteArmedEmptyDatabaseReset() {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(30000)) {
    throw new Error('Another migration is running. No changes made.');
  }

  var backupFile = null;

  try {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);

    if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.EXPECTED_NAME) {
      throw new Error('Workbook name mismatch. Reset aborted.');
    }

    var targets = ksP3V13GetBusinessTableNames_(ss);

    if (targets.size === 0) {
      throw new Error('No registered business tables found. Reset aborted.');
    }

    // Apps Script editor execution may not provide SpreadsheetApp.getUi().
    // Require a separate, recent arming action instead.
    var armText = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty('KS_P3_V14_RESET_ARM');

    if (!armText) {
      throw new Error(
        'RESET NOT ARMED. Run ksP3V14ArmEmptyDatabaseReset() first, ' +
        'review its preview, then run ksP3V14ExecuteArmedEmptyDatabaseReset(). ' +
        'No changes made.'
      );
    }

    var arm = JSON.parse(armText);
    var ageMinutes = (Date.now() - Number(arm.armedAt)) / 60000;

    if (arm.spreadsheetId !== KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID ||
        ageMinutes < 0 || ageMinutes > 10) {
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties()
        .deleteProperty('KS_P3_V14_RESET_ARM');
      throw new Error('Reset authorization expired or workbook mismatch. No changes made.');
    }

    var currentFingerprint = ksP3V14Fingerprint_(ss, targets);
    if (arm.fingerprint !== currentFingerprint) {
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties()
        .deleteProperty('KS_P3_V14_RESET_ARM');
      throw new Error(
        'Business data or target list changed after arming. Authorization cleared. ' +
        'Run preview and arm again. No changes made.'
      );
    }

    // Consume authorization before backup and deletion to prevent reuse.
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties()
      .deleteProperty('KS_P3_V14_RESET_ARM');

    Logger.log('Separate reset authorization verified. Creating backup now.');

    // Mandatory backup, before any deletion.
    var sourceFile = DriveApp.getFileById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    var timestamp = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );
    var backupName = ss.getName() + '_PRE_EMPTY_DB_RESET_' + timestamp;

    if (KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID) {
      backupFile = sourceFile.makeCopy(
        backupName,
        DriveApp.getFolderById(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.BACKUP_FOLDER_ID)
      );
    } else {
      backupFile = sourceFile.makeCopy(backupName);
    }

    if (!backupFile || !backupFile.getId()) {
      throw new Error('Backup creation failed. No business data was cleared.');
    }

    Logger.log('Backup created: ' + backupFile.getUrl());

    var clearedResults = [];
    var missingTabs = [];
    var totalClearedCells = 0;

    // Clear only registered business table tabs. Row 1 is always retained.
    targets.forEach(function(name) {
      var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);

      if (!sh) {
        missingTabs.push(name);
        return;
      }

      var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
      var clearedCells = 0;

      if (lastRow > 1 && lastCol > 0) {
        var body = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol);
        var values = body.getValues();
        var formulas = body.getFormulas();

        var output = values.map(function(row, r) {
          return row.map(function(value, c) {
            if (formulas[r][c]) {
              return formulas[r][c];
            }

            if (value !== '' && value !== null) {
              clearedCells++;
            }

            return '';
          });
        });

        if (clearedCells > 0) {
          body.setValues(output);
        }
      }

      totalClearedCells += clearedCells;
      clearedResults.push({
        sheet: name,
        clearedCells: clearedCells
      });
    });

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // Verify that no non-formula constants remain below row 1 in target tabs.
    var verificationFailures = [];

    clearedResults.forEach(function(item) {
      if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;

      var sh = ss.getSheetByName(item.sheet);
      if (!sh) {
        verificationFailures.push(item.sheet + ': SHEET MISSING AFTER RESET');
        return;
      }

      var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

      if (lastRow <= 1 || lastCol < 1) return;

      var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues();
      var formulas = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getFormulas();

      for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
          if (!formulas[r][c] && values[r][c] !== '' && values[r][c] !== null) {
            verificationFailures.push(
              item.sheet + '!R' + (r + 2) + 'C' + (c + 1)
            );
            if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;
          }
        }
        if (verificationFailures.length >= 100) return;
      }
    });

    // Write a permanent reset log. This log is technical evidence, not business data.
    var resetLog = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);

    if (!resetLog) {
      resetLog = ss.insertSheet(KS_P3_EMPTY_V13.RESET_LOG);
      resetLog.appendRow([
        'timestamp',
        'operation',
        'status',
        'backup_url',
        'backup_file_id',
        'business_tables_processed',
        'cleared_cell_count',
        'missing_registered_tabs',
        'verification_failures',
        'notes'
      ]);
    }

    var finalStatus = verificationFailures.length === 0
      ? 'SUCCESS'
      : 'VERIFICATION_FAILED';

    resetLog.appendRow([
      new Date(),
      'PHASE_3_EMPTY_BUSINESS_DATABASE_RESET',
      finalStatus,
      backupFile.getUrl(),
      backupFile.getId(),
      clearedResults.length,
      totalClearedCells,
      missingTabs.join(' | '),
      verificationFailures.join(' | '),
      'Registered business data rows cleared; technical blueprint/control registers preserved.'
    ]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    if (verificationFailures.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        'Reset verification failed. Backup is available at: ' +
        backupFile.getUrl() +
        '. Remaining data examples: ' +
        verificationFailures.slice(0, 10).join(', ')
      );
    }

    var finalResult = {
      success: true,
      workbook: ss.getName(),
      businessTablesProcessed: clearedResults.length,
      clearedNonFormulaCells: totalClearedCells,
      missingRegisteredTabs: missingTabs,
      backupUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
      backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
      status: finalStatus,
      note: 'Registered business-table data rows cleared. Technical blueprint and control registers preserved.'
    };

    Logger.log(JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2));
    return finalResult;

  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(
      'PHASE 3 RESET STOPPED: ' +
      (error && error.stack ? error.stack : error)
    );
    throw error;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 WORKSTREAM 3
 * Canonical-to-physical field mapping
 * Corrected review version: 1.0.1
 *
 * RUN:
 *   ksP3BuildFieldMapping()
 * VERIFY:
 *   ksP3VerifyFieldMapping()
 * LOGGER CHECK:
 *   ksP3CheckMigrationLoggerAlignment()
 *
 * SAFETY:
 * - Exact workbook ID and name-prefix checks.
 * - Reads governance registers only, not business row values.
 * - Writes only KS_P3_FIELD_MAPPING and appends to KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG.
 * - Preserves manual approval_status and review_notes by table + field key.
 * - Does not alter business tabs, headers, records, formulas, IDs or types.
 * - No-exact-match is review-only, never auto-approved as an alias.

const KS_P3_FIELD_CFG = Object.freeze({
  spreadsheetId: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  expectedNamePrefix: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  dictionaryTab: 'DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074',
  priorFieldReviewTab: 'KS_FIELD_MAPPING',
  inventoryTab: 'KS_P3_LIVE_INVENTORY',
  tableMappingTab: 'KS_P3_TABLE_MAPPING',
  outputTab: 'KS_P3_FIELD_MAPPING',
  migrationLogTab: 'KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG',
  expectedDictionaryRows: 3074,
  version: '1.0.1'
});

function ksP3BuildFieldMapping() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    ksP3FieldAssertTarget_(ss);

    const dict = ksP3FieldRead_(ss, KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.dictionaryTab);
    const prior = ksP3FieldRead_(ss, KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.priorFieldReviewTab);
    const inv = ksP3FieldRead_(ss, KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.inventoryTab);
    const tableMap = ksP3FieldRead_(ss, KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.tableMappingTab);

    if (dict.length < 2 || prior.length < 2 || inv.length < 2 || tableMap.length < 2) {
      throw new Error('STOP: one or more required governance registers are empty. No output written.');
    }

    const dh = dict[0].map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
    const ph = prior[0].map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
    const ih = inv[0].map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
    const th = tableMap[0].map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
    const col = (h, n) => h.indexOf(ksP3FieldNorm_(n));
    const need = (h, names, label) => names.forEach(n => {
      if (col(h, n) < 0) throw new Error('STOP: missing ' + label + ' column: ' + n);
    });

    need(dh, ['table','position','field','data type','required rule','uniqueness',
      'relationship note','plain-language meaning','schema source','confidence',
      'execution eligibility'], 'dictionary');
    need(ph, ['canonical table','canonical field','recommended type','mapping status',
      'observed live headers','recommended action','review finding'], 'prior field review');
    need(ih, ['sheet_name','physical_headers','header_sha256','data_rows_approx'], 'live inventory');
    need(th, ['live_tab_name','mapping_class','approval_status'], 'table mapping');

    if (dict.length - 1 !== KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedDictionaryRows) {
      throw new Error('STOP: expected ' + KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedDictionaryRows +
        ' dictionary rows; found ' + (dict.length - 1) + '. No output written.');
    }

    const live = new Map();
    inv.slice(1).forEach(r => {
      const name = String(r[col(ih,'sheet_name')] || '').trim();
      if (!name) return;
      if (live.has(name)) throw new Error('STOP: duplicate live inventory tab: ' + name);
      const raw = String(r[col(ih,'physical_headers')] || '');
      const headers = raw.split('|').map(x => String(x).trim()).filter(Boolean);
      live.set(name, {
        headers,
        headerSet: new Set(headers.map(ksP3FieldNorm_)),
        hash: r[col(ih,'header_sha256')] || '',
        rows: r[col(ih,'data_rows_approx')] || 0
      });
    });

    const priorMap = new Map();
    prior.slice(1).forEach(r => {
      const t = String(r[col(ph,'canonical table')] || '').trim();
      const f = String(r[col(ph,'canonical field')] || '').trim();
      if (t && f) priorMap.set(t + '\u001f' + f, r);
    });

    const tableMeta = new Map();
    tableMap.slice(1).forEach(r => {
      const t = String(r[col(th,'live_tab_name')] || '').trim();
      if (t) tableMeta.set(t, r);
    });

    const headers = [
      'canonical_table','position','canonical_field','dictionary_type','required_rule',
      'uniqueness_rule','relationship_note','plain_language_meaning','schema_source',
      'confidence','execution_eligibility','physical_tab_exists','physical_header_match',
      'mapping_status','prior_mapping_status','prior_recommended_type','prior_review_finding',
      'live_headers_snapshot','live_header_sha256','approx_data_rows','table_mapping_class',
      'table_approval_status','proposed_action','approval_status','review_notes'
    ];

    // Preserve only genuinely manual columns. Derived fields are recalculated.
    const priorManual = ksP3FieldReadManual_(ss, headers);
    const out = [];
    const counts = {};

    dict.slice(1).forEach(r => {
      const table = String(r[col(dh,'table')] || '').trim();
      const field = String(r[col(dh,'field')] || '').trim();
      if (!table || !field) return;

      const liveInfo = live.get(table);
      const priorRow = priorMap.get(table + '\u001f' + field);
      const tableRow = tableMeta.get(table);
      const exact = !!(liveInfo && liveInfo.headerSet.has(ksP3FieldNorm_(field)));
      const priorStatus = priorRow ? priorRow[col(ph,'mapping status')] : '';
      const priorType = priorRow ? priorRow[col(ph,'recommended type')] : '';
      const priorFinding = priorRow ? priorRow[col(ph,'review finding')] : '';

      let status;
      if (!liveInfo) status = 'MISSING_PHYSICAL_TABLE';
      else if (exact) status = 'EXACT_MATCH';
      else if (priorStatus === 'NO_EXACT_HEADER_MATCH') status = 'ALIAS_OR_MISSING_REVIEW';
      else status = 'MISSING_FIELD_REVIEW';

      // This is a proposed-type conflict only, not proof of physical cell type.
      const dictionaryType = r[col(dh,'data type')] || '';
      const typeReview = priorType && dictionaryType &&
        ksP3FieldNorm_(priorType) !== ksP3FieldNorm_(dictionaryType);

      const tableClass = tableRow ? tableRow[col(th,'mapping_class')] : 'TABLE_NOT_IN_MAPPING';
      const tableApproval = tableRow ? tableRow[col(th,'approval_status')] : 'PENDING';

      let action = exact ? 'PRESERVE_EXISTING_HEADER' : 'REVIEW_ALIAS_OR_MISSING_FIELD';
      if (typeReview) action = 'REVIEW_TYPE_DIFFERENCE; DO_NOT_CONVERT';
      if (String(r[col(dh,'execution eligibility')] || '').toUpperCase().indexOf('NOT APPROVED') >= 0) {
        action += '; NOT APPROVED FOR EXECUTION';
      }

      const notes = !liveInfo
        ? 'No physical tab found in Phase 3 inventory.'
        : exact
          ? 'Exact header name exists. Header presence does not confirm cell-value validity or stored data type.'
          : 'No exact physical header match. Could be alias, absent field, or proposed-only field; inspect routes and owner workflow.';

      const key = table + '\u001f' + field;
      const manual = priorManual.get(key) || {};
      const row = [
        table, r[col(dh,'position')], field, dictionaryType, r[col(dh,'required rule')],
        r[col(dh,'uniqueness')], r[col(dh,'relationship note')], r[col(dh,'plain-language meaning')],
        r[col(dh,'schema source')], r[col(dh,'confidence')], r[col(dh,'execution eligibility')],
        liveInfo ? 'YES' : 'NO', exact ? 'YES' : 'NO', status, priorStatus || '', priorType || '',
        priorFinding || '', liveInfo ? liveInfo.headers.join(' | ') : '',
        liveInfo ? liveInfo.hash : '', liveInfo ? liveInfo.rows : '',
        tableClass, tableApproval, action,
        manual.approval_status || 'PENDING OWNER + TECHNICAL APPROVAL',
        manual.review_notes || notes
      ];
      out.push(row);
      counts[status] = (counts[status] || 0) + 1;
    });

    if (out.length !== KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedDictionaryRows) {
      throw new Error('STOP: expected ' + KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedDictionaryRows +
        ' usable field rows; built ' + out.length + '. No output written.');
    }

    const sh = ksP3FieldGetOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.outputTab, headers);
    // Only the owned report tab is refreshed. Manual approval and notes are
    // carried forward above, keyed by canonical_table + canonical_field.
    sh.clearContents();
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sh.getRange(2, 1, out.length, headers.length).setValues(out);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setFontWeight('bold');
    const filter = sh.getFilter();
    if (filter) filter.remove();
    sh.getRange(1, 1, out.length + 1, headers.length).createFilter();

    const details = {
      dictionaryRows: out.length,
      statusCounts: counts,
      preservedManualDecisionRows: priorManual.size,
      physicalValueScan: false,
      businessSchemaChanged: false,
      note: 'Header-level mapping only; no business values or schema changed.'
    };
    ksP3FieldAppendLog_(ss, 'BUILD_FIELD_MAPPING', details);
    const result = {success:true, version:KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.version,
      outputTab:KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.outputTab, ...details};
    Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksP3FieldReadManual_(ss, expectedHeaders) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.outputTab);
  const result = new Map();
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2 || sh.getLastColumn() < 1) return result;
  const actual = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0]
    .map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
  const tableCol = actual.indexOf('canonical_table');
  const fieldCol = actual.indexOf('canonical_field');
  const approvalCol = actual.indexOf('approval_status');
  const notesCol = actual.indexOf('review_notes');
  if ([tableCol, fieldCol, approvalCol, notesCol].some(i => i < 0)) return result;
  const data = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  data.forEach(r => {
    const t = String(r[tableCol] || '').trim();
    const f = String(r[fieldCol] || '').trim();
    if (!t || !f) return;
    result.set(t + '\u001f' + f, {
      approval_status: r[approvalCol],
      review_notes: r[notesCol]
    });
  });
  return result;
}

function ksP3VerifyFieldMapping() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  ksP3FieldAssertTarget_(ss);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.outputTab);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Field mapping report not found.');
  const vals = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (!vals.length) throw new Error('Field mapping report is empty.');
  const h = vals[0].map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
  const j = h.indexOf('mapping_status');
  if (j < 0) throw new Error('mapping_status column missing.');
  const counts = {};
  vals.slice(1).forEach(r => {
    const k = r[j] || 'UNCLASSIFIED';
    counts[k] = (counts[k] || 0) + 1;
  });
  return {
    success: vals.length === KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedDictionaryRows + 1,
    tab: sh.getName(),
    fieldRows: vals.length - 1,
    columns: sh.getLastColumn(),
    statusCounts: counts,
    businessSchemaChanged: false
  };
}

/**
 * This checks the logger header and appends a test/audit event.
 * It does not repair or rewrite historical malformed log rows.
 */
function ksP3CheckMigrationLoggerAlignment() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  ksP3FieldAssertTarget_(ss);
  const result = {
    success: true,
    logger: KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.migrationLogTab,
    existingRowsPreserved: true,
    historicalRowsRewritten: false,
    note: 'Header alignment checked; this function does not repair historical rows.'
  };
  ksP3FieldAppendLog_(ss, 'MIGRATION_LOGGER_ALIGNMENT_CHECK', result);
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

// Backward-compatible name. Despite the old name, this only checks alignment.
function ksP3RepairMigrationLogger() {
  return ksP3CheckMigrationLoggerAlignment();
}

function ksP3FieldAppendLog_(ss, event, details) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.migrationLogTab);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Migration log missing.');
  const expected = ['timestamp','version','event','spreadsheet_id','spreadsheet_name',
    'backup_url','live_tab_count','inventory_rows','business_schema_changed','details'];
  if (sh.getLastColumn() !== expected.length) {
    throw new Error('STOP: migration log must have exactly 10 columns.');
  }
  const actual = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0]
    .map(ksP3FieldNorm_);
  if (actual.join('|') !== expected.join('|')) {
    throw new Error('STOP: migration log headers do not match expected 10-column schema.');
  }
  const inv = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.inventoryTab);
  const invRows = inv ? Math.max(0, inv.getLastRow() - 1) : 0;
  sh.appendRow([new Date(), KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.version, event, ss.getId(), ss.getName(),
    '', ss.getSheets().length, invRows, 'NO', JSON.stringify(details)]);
}

function ksP3FieldAssertTarget_(ss) {
  if (!ss || ss.getId() !== KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.spreadsheetId ||
      !ss.getName().startsWith(KS_P3_FIELD_CFG.expectedNamePrefix)) {
    throw new Error('STOP: wrong spreadsheet. No changes made.');
  }
}

function ksP3FieldRead_(ss, name) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Required governance tab missing: ' + name);
  return sh.getDataRange().getValues();
}

function ksP3FieldNorm_(v) {
  return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().toLowerCase();
}

function ksP3FieldGetOwnedTab_(ss, name, headers) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) return ss.insertSheet(name);
  if (sh.getLastRow() === 0 || sh.getLastColumn() === 0) return sh;
  const actual = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn())
    .getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v || '').trim());
  if (actual.join('\u001f') !== headers.map(String).join('\u001f')) {
    throw new Error('STOP: ' + name + ' exists with unexpected headers. No write performed.');
  }
  return sh;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 INTEGRATED PREFLIGHT
 * Version 1.0
 *
 * REQUIRED: Add the three corrected v1.0.1 source files to the SAME Apps Script
 * project before running this orchestrator:
 *   1) KS_Phase3_Migration_Control_Corrected_v1_0_1.gs
 *   2) KS_Phase3_Table_Mapping_Corrected_v1_0_1.gs
 *   3) KS_Phase3_Field_Mapping_Corrected_v1_0_1.gs
 *
 * RUN ONLY: KS_PHASE3_INTEGRATED_PREFLIGHT
 *
 * This runs governance/preflight reports in dependency order. It does NOT
 * migrate, create, rename, delete, clear, or modify business tabs/records.
 * The first step creates a full Drive backup before writing the control tabs.
 * Each component manages its own document lock. This orchestrator deliberately
 * does not hold a lock while calling them.
 */
function KS_PHASE3_INTEGRATED_PREFLIGHT() {
  const required = [
    'ksP3InstallMigrationControl', 'ksP3VerifyMigrationControl',
    'ksP3BuildTableMapping', 'ksP3VerifyTableMapping',
    'ksP3BuildFieldMapping', 'ksP3VerifyFieldMapping',
    'ksP3CheckMigrationLoggerAlignment'
  ];
  const missing = required.filter(name => typeof this[name] !== 'function');
  if (missing.length) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Add all three corrected Phase 3 source files first. Missing functions: ' + missing.join(', '));
  }

  const report = {
    version: '1.0',
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    workbookId: SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getId(),
    steps: [],
    businessSchemaChanged: false,
    status: 'RUNNING'
  };

  function runStep(label, fn) {
    const result = fn();
    report.steps.push({ step: label, success: result && result.success !== false, result: result || null });
    if (!result || result.success === false) {
      throw new Error('STOP: ' + label + ' did not pass. Inspect execution log before retrying.');
    }
    return result;
  }

  try {
    // Step 1: structural inventory + backup + preserved migration plan.
    runStep('1_CONTROL_AND_LIVE_INVENTORY', ksP3InstallMigrationControl);
    runStep('1A_VERIFY_CONTROL', ksP3VerifyMigrationControl);

    // Step 2: canonical table mapping, based on the fresh inventory.
    runStep('2_TABLE_MAPPING', ksP3BuildTableMapping);
    runStep('2A_VERIFY_TABLE_MAPPING', ksP3VerifyTableMapping);

    // Step 3: 3,074-row field mapping, based on the table map.
    runStep('3_FIELD_MAPPING', ksP3BuildFieldMapping);
    runStep('3A_VERIFY_FIELD_MAPPING', ksP3VerifyFieldMapping);

    // Step 4: append-only logger header alignment check.
    runStep('4_LOGGER_ALIGNMENT_CHECK', ksP3CheckMigrationLoggerAlignment);

    report.status = 'PREFLIGHT_REPORTS_BUILT';
  } catch (err) {
    report.status = 'STOPPED_WITH_ERROR';
    report.error = String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
    report.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    Logger.log('KS_PHASE3_INTEGRATED_PREFLIGHT_RESULT\n' + JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
    throw err;
  }

  report.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  report.nextGate = 'Review table/field mapping reports and obtain explicit business approvals. No business schema migration has been performed.';
  Logger.log('KS_PHASE3_INTEGRATED_PREFLIGHT_RESULT\n' + JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return report;
}

function ksP3AssertTarget_(ss) {
  if (!ss) throw new Error('STOP: Open the LIVE Kawad Swad Google Sheet first.');
  if (ss.getId() !== KS_P3_BOOT.SPREADSHEET_ID) {
    throw new Error('STOP: Spreadsheet ID mismatch. No changes made.');

    throw new Error('STOP: Workbook name mismatch. No changes made.');
  }
}

function ksP3AssertOwnedTabHeader_(ss, name, expectedHeaders) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() === 0) return;
  ksP3AssertExactHeader_(sh, expectedHeaders);
}

function ksP3AssertExactHeader_(sh, expectedHeaders) {
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (sh.getLastRow() === 0 || lastCol === 0) return;
  const existing = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
    .map(v => String(v || '').trim());
  const expected = expectedHeaders.map(String);
  if (existing.join('\u001f') !== expected.join('\u001f')) {
    throw new Error(
      'STOP: Existing tab "' + sh.getName() +
      '" has an unexpected header. No report tab was overwritten.'
    );
  }
}

function ksP3BuildLiveInventory_(ss) {
  const headers = [
    'sheet_name','data_rows_approx','last_row','last_column',
    'nonblank_header_count','blank_header_positions','duplicate_headers',
    'physical_headers','header_sha256','captured_at'
  ];
  const capturedAt = new Date();
  const rows = ss.getSheets().map(sh => {
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const actualLastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const lastCol = Math.min(actualLastCol, KS_P3_BOOT.MAX_HEADER_COLS);
    const rawHeaders = (lastRow > 0 && lastCol > 0)
      ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
          .map(v => String(v || '').trim())
      : [];
    const nonblank = rawHeaders.filter(v => v !== '');
    const blankPositions = [];
    rawHeaders.forEach((v, i) => { if (!v) blankPositions.push(i + 1); });
    const counts = {};
    nonblank.forEach(v => { counts[v] = (counts[v] || 0) + 1; });
    const duplicates = Object.keys(counts).filter(k => counts[k] > 1);
    const headerText = rawHeaders.join('|');
    const digest = Utilities.computeDigest(
      Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,
      headerText,
      Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
    );
    const hash = digest.map(b => {
      const n = b < 0 ? b + 256 : b;
      return ('0' + n.toString(16)).slice(-2);
    }).join('');
    return [
      sh.getName(),
      Math.max(0, lastRow - 1), // approximate, not a count of populated records
      lastRow,
      actualLastCol,
      nonblank.length,
      blankPositions.join(','),
      duplicates.join(' | '),
      rawHeaders.join(' | '),
      hash,
      capturedAt
    ];
  });
  return { headers: headers, rows: rows };
}

function ksP3ReplaceGeneratedTab_(sh, headers, rows) {
  // Caller has verified exact tab name and header contract.
  sh.clearContents();
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
  if (rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, headers.length).setValues(rows);
  }
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.autoResizeColumns(1, headers.length);
}

function ksP3WriteTable_(sh, headers, rows) {
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
  if (rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, headers.length).setValues(rows);
  }
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.autoResizeColumns(1, headers.length);
}

/**
 * Read-only verification after installation.
 */
function ksP3VerifyMigrationControl() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  ksP3AssertTarget_(ss);
  const names = [
    KS_P3_BOOT.INVENTORY_TAB,
    KS_P3_BOOT.PLAN_TAB,
    KS_P3_BOOT.LOG_TAB
  ];
  const result = names.map(name => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    return {
      tab: name,
      exists: !!sh,
      rows: sh ? Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1) : 0,
      columns: sh ? sh.getLastColumn() : 0
    };
  });
  const output = {
    success: result.every(x => x.exists),
    controls: result,
    liveTabCount: ss.getSheets().length,
    note: 'Verification only. No business tabs or data changed.'
  };
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
  return output;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 POST-RESET READ-ONLY AUDIT v1.0
 *
 * PURPOSE
 * Verify the live workbook after the successful empty-business-data reset.
 * This script is READ-ONLY: it does not create, edit, clear, rename, or delete

 *
 * RUN:
 *   ksP3PostResetReadOnlyAudit()
 *
 * It checks:
 * - Correct workbook identity.

 * - Business table names from the two approved registries.
 * - Missing registered tabs, missing/duplicate/blank headers.
 * - Residual non-formula business data below row 1.
 * - Formula and data-validation counts below the header.
 * - Critical post-reset tabs (Users, AuthUsers, Settings, IdAllocations).
 * - Field dictionary and table registry header layouts for the next schema audit.
 *
 * IMPORTANT
 * This is a verification pass, not schema implementation. It does not add
 * missing columns, change field names, initialize IDs, create admin users,
 * or change settings.
 */

function ksP3AuditReadRegistryNames_(ss, sheetName) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Required registry missing: ' + sheetName);

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return [];

  return sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues()
    .map(function(row) { return String(row[0] || '').trim(); })
    .filter(function(value) { return value !== ''; });
}


function ksP3AuditHeaderLayout_(ss, sheetName) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) return { sheet: sheetName, exists: false };

  var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  var headers = lastCol > 0
    ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
    : [];

  var normalized = headers.map(function(value) {
    return String(value || '').trim();
  });

  var blankColumns = [];
  var seen = {};
  var duplicateHeaders = [];

  normalized.forEach(function(header, index) {
    var column = index + 1;
    if (!header) blankColumns.push(column);

    var key = header.toLowerCase();
    if (key) {
      if (seen[key]) duplicateHeaders.push({
        header: header,
        firstColumn: seen[key],
        duplicateColumn: column
      });
      else seen[key] = column;
    }
  });

  return {
    sheet: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: sh.getLastRow(),
    lastColumn: lastCol,
    headers: normalized,
    blankHeaderColumns: blankColumns,
    duplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaders
  };
}


function ksP3AuditBusinessTab_(ss, sheetName) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) return { sheet: sheetName, exists: false };

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  var result = {
    sheet: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastCol,
    headerCount: 0,
    blankHeaderColumns: [],
    duplicateHeaders: [],
    residualNonFormulaCells: 0,
    residualExamples: [],
    formulasBelowHeader: 0,
    validationCellsBelowHeader: 0
  };

  if (lastCol > 0) {
    var headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];
    var seen = {};

    headers.forEach(function(value, index) {
      var header = String(value || '').trim();
      if (header) {
        result.headerCount++;
        var key = header.toLowerCase();
        if (seen[key]) {
          result.duplicateHeaders.push({
            header: header,
            firstColumn: seen[key],
            duplicateColumn: index + 1
          });
        } else {
          seen[key] = index + 1;
        }
      } else {
        result.blankHeaderColumns.push(index + 1);
      }
    });
  }

  if (lastRow > 1 && lastCol > 0) {
    var range = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol);
    var values = range.getValues();
    var formulas = range.getFormulas();
    var validations = range.getDataValidations();

    for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
      for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
        if (formulas[r][c]) result.formulasBelowHeader++;

        if (validations[r][c]) result.validationCellsBelowHeader++;

        if (!formulas[r][c] &&
            values[r][c] !== '' &&
            values[r][c] !== null) {
          result.residualNonFormulaCells++;
          if (result.residualExamples.length < 10) {
            result.residualExamples.push({
              cell: 'R' + (r + 2) + 'C' + (c + 1),
              value: String(values[r][c]).slice(0, 80)
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Main read-only audit.
 */
function ksP3PostResetReadOnlyAudit() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.SPREADSHEET_ID);

  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error(
      'Workbook name mismatch. Expected "' +
      KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.EXPECTED_NAME +
      '", found "' + ss.getName() + '".'
    );
  }

  var missingTechnicalTabs = KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.REQUIRED_TECHNICAL_TABS
    .filter(function(name) { return !ss.getSheetByName(name); });

  var canonicalNames = ksP3AuditReadRegistryNames_(
    ss,
    KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.TABLE_REGISTRY
  );
  var runtimeNames = ksP3AuditReadRegistryNames_(
    ss,
    KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.RUNTIME_REGISTRY
  );

  var allNames = Array.from(new Set(canonicalNames.concat(runtimeNames)));
  var preservedNames = new Set(KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.REQUIRED_TECHNICAL_TABS);
  var targets = allNames.filter(function(name) {
    return !preservedNames.has(name) &&
      name !== KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.RESET_LOG;
  });

  var tableResults = targets.map(function(name) {
    return ksP3AuditBusinessTab_(ss, name);
  });

  var missingBusinessTabs = tableResults
    .filter(function(item) { return !item.exists; })
    .map(function(item) { return item.sheet; });

  var residualDataTabs = tableResults
    .filter(function(item) { return item.residualNonFormulaCells > 0; })
    .map(function(item) {
      return {
        sheet: item.sheet,
        residualNonFormulaCells: item.residualNonFormulaCells,
        examples: item.residualExamples
      };
    });

  var blankHeaderTabs = tableResults
    .filter(function(item) { return item.blankHeaderColumns.length > 0; })
    .map(function(item) {
      return {
        sheet: item.sheet,
        blankHeaderColumns: item.blankHeaderColumns
      };
    });

  var duplicateHeaderTabs = tableResults
    .filter(function(item) { return item.duplicateHeaders.length > 0; })
    .map(function(item) {
      return {
        sheet: item.sheet,
        duplicateHeaders: item.duplicateHeaders
      };
    });

  var criticalTabs = KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.CRITICAL_EMPTY_TABS.map(function(name) {
    var result = ksP3AuditBusinessTab_(ss, name);
    return {
      sheet: name,
      exists: result.exists,
      residualNonFormulaCells: result.residualNonFormulaCells,
      formulasBelowHeader: result.formulasBelowHeader,
      headerCount: result.headerCount
    };
  });

  var resetLogSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.RESET_LOG);
  var latestResetLog = null;

  if (resetLogSheet && resetLogSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var logLastCol = resetLogSheet.getLastColumn();
    latestResetLog = resetLogSheet
      .getRange(resetLogSheet.getLastRow(), 1, 1, logLastCol)
      .getDisplayValues()[0];
  }

  var dictionaryLayout = ksP3AuditHeaderLayout_(
    ss,
    KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.FIELD_DICTIONARY
  );
  var tableRegistryLayout = ksP3AuditHeaderLayout_(
    ss,
    KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.TABLE_REGISTRY
  );

  var totalResidualCells = tableResults.reduce(function(sum, item) {
    return sum + (item.residualNonFormulaCells || 0);
  }, 0);

  var totalFormulas = tableResults.reduce(function(sum, item) {
    return sum + (item.formulasBelowHeader || 0);
  }, 0);

  var totalValidationCells = tableResults.reduce(function(sum, item) {
    return sum + (item.validationCellsBelowHeader || 0);
  }, 0);

  var report = {
    audit: 'KAWAD_SWAD_PHASE_3_POST_RESET_READ_ONLY_AUDIT',
    version: '1.0',
    readOnly: true,
    workbook: ss.getName(),
    spreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    registryCounts: {
      canonicalRegistryRows: canonicalNames.length,
      runtimeRegistryRows: runtimeNames.length,
      uniqueRegisteredBusinessTabs: targets.length
    },
    technicalBlueprint: {
      requiredSheetsChecked: KS_P3_POST_RESET_AUDIT.REQUIRED_TECHNICAL_TABS.length,
      missingTechnicalSheets: missingTechnicalTabs
    },
    businessTables: {
      registeredTabsChecked: tableResults.length,
      missingTabs: missingBusinessTabs,
      totalResidualNonFormulaCells: totalResidualCells,
      residualDataTabs: residualDataTabs,
      tabsWithBlankHeaders: blankHeaderTabs,
      tabsWithDuplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaderTabs,
      formulaCellsBelowHeaders: totalFormulas,
      validationCellsBelowHeaders: totalValidationCells
    },
    criticalPostResetTabs: criticalTabs,
    resetLogLatestRow: latestResetLog,
    schemaSourceLayouts: {
      fieldDictionary: dictionaryLayout,
      tableRegistry: tableRegistryLayout
    },
    nextStep: 'Use the dictionary and registry header layouts to build a field-by-field live schema reconciliation. Do not auto-add or rename columns from fuzzy matches.'
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return report;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - SHEETS-FIRST MASTER DATA FOUNDATION
 * Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * Scope:
 * - Google Sheets is the authoritative record for this interim stage.
 * - Uses LockService + IdAllocations claims for master IDs.
 * - Supports Products, RawMaterials, Customers and Suppliers manual ID reservation.
 * - Audits master-sheet headers and duplicate existing IDs (except AuthUsers).
 * - Does not read AuthUsers data or write to Users/AuthUsers.
 * - Does not create sample records, alter headers, rename/delete tabs, or change existing rows.
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * - Install in the bound Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets project.
 * - Do not use alongside another active allocator that writes to IdAllocations.
 * - Backend must later call the same allocator endpoint or replace it under a coordinated cutover.

const KS_MD1 = Object.freeze({
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  NAME_PREFIX: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  REPORT_TAB: 'KS_P3_BATCH1_SHEETS_FOUNDATION_AUDIT',

    Customers:   { prefix: 'CUS', idHeader: 'customer_id', allowManual: true },
    Suppliers:   { prefix: 'SUP', idHeader: 'supplier_id', allowManual: true },
    Users:       { prefix: 'USR', idHeader: 'user_id', allowManual: false }
  },
  AUDIT_TABS: ['Settings','IdAllocations','Products','RawMaterials','Customers','Suppliers','Users']
});

function onOpen() {
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi()
    .createMenu('Kawad Swad | Phase 3')
    .addItem('Run Master Foundation Audit','KS_P3_SHEETS_MASTER_AUDIT')
    .addItem('Reserve Master ID','KS_P3_RESERVE_MASTER_ID')
    .addToUi();
}

function KS_P3_SHEETS_MASTER_AUDIT() {
  const ss = ksMdAssertWorkbook_();
  const rows = [];
  KS_MD1.AUDIT_TABS.forEach(name => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      rows.push([name,'MISSING',0,'','','NOT_CHECKED','STOP','Required tab missing']);
      return;
    }
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const headers = lastCol ? sh.getRange(1,1,1,lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v).trim()) : [];
    const nonblank = headers.filter(Boolean);
    const dupes = nonblank.filter((v,i,a) => a.indexOf(v) !== i);
    const rowsCount = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow()-1);
    let idCheck = 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
    let note = 'Header/dimension audit only.';
    if (name === 'AuthUsers') {
      idCheck = 'NOT_SCANNED';
      note = 'AuthUsers is intentionally excluded. No credentials or authentication rows read.';
    } else if (name === 'Users') {
      idCheck = 'NOT_SCANNED';
      note = 'User rows not scanned by this utility. User creation remains restricted.';
    } else {
      const idCol = name === 'Products' ? 'product_id' :
        name === 'RawMaterials' ? 'raw_material_id' :
        name === 'Customers' ? 'customer_id' :
        name === 'Suppliers' ? 'supplier_id' : '';
      if (idCol && rowsCount > 0 && headers.includes(idCol)) {
        const vals = sh.getRange(2, headers.indexOf(idCol)+1, rowsCount, 1).getDisplayValues().flat().map(v=>String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const seen = new Set(), d = new Set();
        vals.forEach(v => { if(seen.has(v)) d.add(v); seen.add(v); });
        idCheck = d.size ? 'DUPLICATES_FOUND:'+d.size : 'NO_DUPLICATES_IN_SCANNED_ID_COLUMN';
        note = 'Only ID column inspected; no other business values evaluated.';
      } else if (idCol) {
        idCheck = rowsCount === 0 ? 'NO_DATA_ROWS' : 'ID_HEADER_MISSING';
      }
    }
    rows.push([name,'YES',lastCol,nonblank.length,dupes.join(' | '),idCheck,
      dupes.length ? 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' : 'STRUCTURE_REVIEW',note]);
  });

  const report = ksMdGetOrCreate_(ss, KS_MD1.REPORT_TAB);
  report.clearContents();
  const headers = ['tab_name','tab_exists','physical_column_count','nonblank_header_count',
    'duplicate_headers','id_check','result','notes'];
  report.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]);
  if (rows.length) report.getRange(2,1,rows.length,headers.length).setValues(rows);
  report.setFrozenRows(1);
  report.autoResizeColumns(1,headers.length);
  const result = {
    success:true, status:'SHEETS_MASTER_FOUNDATION_AUDIT_COMPLETE',
    auditedTabs:KS_MD1.AUDIT_TABS.length,
    authUsersDataRead:false, usersDataRead:false,
    businessSchemaChanged:false, reportTab:KS_MD1.REPORT_TAB,
    note:'Audit report written. No business tabs, headers, or records were changed.'
  };
  Logger.log('KS_P3_SHEETS_MASTER_AUDIT_RESULT '+JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}

/**
 * Manual interim reservation. The ID is claimed in IdAllocations only.
 * It does NOT create a Products/RawMaterials/Customers/Suppliers row.
 */
function KS_P3_RESERVE_MASTER_ID() {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const choices = ['Products','RawMaterials','Customers','Suppliers'];
  const response = ui.prompt(
    'Reserve Master ID',
    'Enter one exact sheet name:\n'+choices.join('\n')+
    '\n\nUsers/AuthUsers are excluded from manual reservation.',
    ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL
  );
  if (response.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) return;
  const tab = response.getResponseText().trim();
  if (!choices.includes(tab)) throw new Error('Unsupported or restricted master tab: '+tab);
  const allocated = ksMdAllocate_(tab);
  ui.alert('ID reserved successfully', allocated+'\n\nA claim was appended to IdAllocations. No master record was created.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
  return allocated;
}

function ksMdAllocate_(tabName) {
  const cfg = KS_MD1.TARGETS[tabName];
  if (!cfg || !cfg.allowManual) throw new Error('ID allocation is not enabled for this tab.');
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = ksMdAssertWorkbook_();
    const target = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    const alloc = ss.getSheetByName(KS_MD1.ALLOC_TAB);
    if (!target || !alloc) throw new Error('Target tab or IdAllocations is missing.');
    ksMdAssertHeaders_(alloc, KS_MD1.ALLOC_HEADERS);

    const headers = target.getRange(1,1,1,target.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v=>String(v).trim());
    const idIndex = headers.indexOf(cfg.idHeader);
    if (idIndex < 0) throw new Error('Required ID header missing: '+cfg.idHeader);

    const existing = new Set();
    const last = target.getLastRow();
    if (last > 1) target.getRange(2,idIndex+1,last-1,1).getDisplayValues().flat()
      .map(v=>String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(v=>existing.add(v));

    const allocLast = alloc.getLastRow();
    const claimRows = allocLast > 1 ? alloc.getRange(2,1,allocLast-1,5).getDisplayValues() : [];
    let highest = 0;
    const re = new RegExp('^'+cfg.prefix+'-(\\d{6})$');
    existing.forEach(v=>{const m=v.match(re); if(m) highest=Math.max(highest,Number(m[1]));});
    claimRows.forEach(r=>{
      if (String(r[1]).trim()===tabName) {
        const m=String(r[2]).trim().match(re);
        if(m) highest=Math.max(highest,Number(m[1]));
      }
    });

    const candidate = cfg.prefix+'-'+String(highest+1).padStart(6,'0');
    if (existing.has(candidate) || claimRows.some(r=>String(r[1]).trim()===tabName && String(r[2]).trim()===candidate)) {
      throw new Error('Candidate ID already exists. Run audit and investigate; no claim written.');
    }
    const nonce = Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');
    const allocationId = 'ALC-'+nonce.slice(0,12).toUpperCase();
    const timestamp = new Date();
    alloc.appendRow([allocationId,tabName,candidate,nonce,timestamp]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const verifyLast = alloc.getLastRow();
    const verify = alloc.getRange(verifyLast,1,1,5).getDisplayValues()[0];
    if (verify[0] !== allocationId || verify[2] !== candidate || verify[3] !== nonce) {
      throw new Error('Allocation claim verification failed. Do not use the candidate ID.');
    }
    return candidate;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksMdAssertWorkbook_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss || ss.getId() !== KS_MD1.SPREADSHEET_ID ||
      !ss.getName().startsWith(KS_MD1.NAME_PREFIX)) {
    throw new Error('STOP: This script is not bound to the expected Kawad Swad workbook.');
  }
  return ss;
}
function ksMdAssertHeaders_(sh, expected) {
  const actual = sh.getRange(1,1,1,Math.max(sh.getLastColumn(),expected.length))
    .getDisplayValues()[0].map(v=>String(v).trim());
  if (expected.some((h,i)=>actual[i]!==h)) {
    throw new Error('STOP: IdAllocations headers do not exactly match expected five-column contract. No allocation written.');
  }
}
function ksMdGetOrCreate_(ss,name) {
  let sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if(!sh) sh=ss.insertSheet(name);
  return sh;
}

/**

 * VERIFY:

const KS_P3_MAP_CFG = Object.freeze({
  spreadsheetId: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  expectedNamePrefix: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  inventoryTab: 'KS_P3_LIVE_INVENTORY',

  phase2RulesTab: 'KS_P2_MASTER_DATA_RULES',

  migrationLogTab: 'KS_P3_MIGRATION_LOG',
  version: '1.0.1'

function ksP3BuildTableMapping() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    ksP3MapAssertTarget_(ss);

    const inv = ksP3MapRead_(ss, KS_P3_MAP_CFG.inventoryTab);
    const reg = ksP3MapRead_(ss, KS_P3_MAP_CFG.registryTab);
    const rules = ksP3MapRead_(ss, KS_P3_MAP_CFG.phase2RulesTab);
    const p2 = ksP3MapRead_(ss, KS_P3_MAP_CFG.phase2PreflightTab);

    if (inv.length < 1 || reg.length < 1) {
      throw new Error('STOP: required governance register missing/empty.');
    }

    const invH = inv[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_);
    const regH = reg[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_);
    const ruleH = rules.length ? rules[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_) : [];
    const p2H = p2.length ? p2[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_) : [];
    const idx = (h, n) => h.indexOf(ksP3MapNorm_(n));

    const requiredInv = [
      'sheet_name','data_rows_approx','last_row','last_column',
      'nonblank_header_count','physical_headers'
    ];
    const requiredReg = [
      'table','group','priority','purpose / record grain','owner role',
      'proposed field count','backend contract?','backend file refs',
      'finalization status','safe action'
    ];
    requiredInv.forEach(x => {
      if (idx(invH, x) < 0) throw new Error('STOP: inventory column missing: ' + x);
    });
    requiredReg.forEach(x => {
      if (idx(regH, x) < 0) throw new Error('STOP: registry column missing: ' + x);
    });

    const inventory = new Map();
    const duplicateInventoryNames = [];
    inv.slice(1).filter(r => r[idx(invH, 'sheet_name')]).forEach(r => {
      const name = String(r[idx(invH, 'sheet_name')]).trim();
      if (inventory.has(name)) duplicateInventoryNames.push(name);
      inventory.set(name, r);
    });
    if (duplicateInventoryNames.length) {
      throw new Error('STOP: duplicate sheet names in inventory: ' +
        duplicateInventoryNames.join(', '));
    }

    const canonical = new Map();
    const duplicateCanonicalNames = [];
    reg.slice(1).filter(r => r[idx(regH, 'table')]).forEach(r => {
      const name = String(r[idx(regH, 'table')]).trim();
      if (canonical.has(name)) duplicateCanonicalNames.push(name);
      canonical.set(name, r);
    });
    if (duplicateCanonicalNames.length) {
      throw new Error('STOP: duplicate canonical table names: ' +
        duplicateCanonicalNames.join(', '));
    }

    const phase2Rules = new Map();
    if (rules.length) {
      const tabCol = idx(ruleH, 'existing_tab');
      rules.slice(1).filter(r => tabCol >= 0 && r[tabCol]).forEach(r => {
        phase2Rules.set(String(r[tabCol]).trim(), r);
      });
    }

    const p2Set = new Set();
    if (p2.length) {
      const nameCol = idx(p2H, 'sheet_name');
      p2.slice(1).filter(r => nameCol >= 0 && r[nameCol]).forEach(r => {
        p2Set.add(String(r[nameCol]).trim());
      });
    }

    const headers = [
      'live_tab_name','mapping_class','canonical_group','priority','record_purpose',
      'owner_role','approx_data_rows','last_row','last_column','live_header_count',
      'live_headers','backend_contract','backend_file_references','phase1_finalization_status',
      'phase1_safe_action','phase2_decision','authority_or_role','dependency_review',
      'proposed_action','approval_status','review_notes'
    ];

    // Preserve manual decision columns from the existing mapping register.
    const oldManual = ksP3MapReadExistingManual_(ss, headers);

    const rows = [];
    const names = Array.from(inventory.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

    names.forEach(name => {
      const ir = inventory.get(name);
      const cr = canonical.get(name);
      const rr = phase2Rules.get(name);
      const get = (row, h, key) => {
        const j = idx(h, key);
        return j < 0 || row[j] == null ? '' : row[j];
      };

      let cls, purpose = '', owner = '', group = '', priority = '';
      let contract = '', refs = '', finalStatus = '', safeAction = '';

      if (cr) {
        cls = 'CANONICAL_TABLE';
        group = get(cr, regH, 'group');
        priority = get(cr, regH, 'priority');
        purpose = get(cr, regH, 'purpose / record grain');
        owner = get(cr, regH, 'owner role');
        contract = get(cr, regH, 'backend contract?');
        refs = get(cr, regH, 'backend file refs');
        finalStatus = get(cr, regH, 'finalization status');
        safeAction = get(cr, regH, 'safe action');
      } else {
        cls = 'EXTRA_TAB_REVIEW';
        purpose = 'Not listed in the canonical registry; classify from workflow and code usage.';
        owner = 'To be confirmed';
      }

      const phase2Decision = rr && idx(ruleH, 'phase2_decision') >= 0
        ? (rr[idx(ruleH, 'phase2_decision')] || '') : '';
      let authority = 'UNCONFIRMED: map actual read/write paths before assigning authority';
      if (rr && String(phase2Decision).indexOf('KEEP') === 0) {
        authority = 'Phase 2 decision recorded; verify ownership and route usage';
      }

      const specialAuthority = {
        Sales: 'Sales transaction authority; preserve existing records',
        SaleItems: 'Sales line-item authority; preserve existing records',
        Payments: 'Payment-event authority; preserve existing records',
        JournalHeaders: 'Accounting journal header authority',
        JournalLines: 'Accounting journal line authority',
        Products: 'Existing product master; do not create a parallel master',
        Users: 'ERP user directory; restricted employee data',
        AuthUsers: 'Authentication authority; highly restricted',
        Workers: 'Factory workforce records; distinct from login users',
        IdAllocations: 'Existing ID allocation registry; preserve historical allocations',
        Settings: 'Configuration authority; setting_value remains TEXT'
      };
      if (specialAuthority[name]) authority = specialAuthority[name];

      const notes = cr
        ? 'Canonical name match only. Route usage, record authority and dependencies still require verification.'
        : (p2Set.has(name)
          ? 'Present in Phase 2 preflight but outside canonical registry; classify as runtime/control/support/legacy only after review.'
          : 'Present in Phase 3 inventory but absent from canonical registry and Phase 2 preflight; investigate origin.');

      const generated = [
        name, cls, group, priority, purpose, owner,
        ir[idx(invH, 'data_rows_approx')],
        ir[idx(invH, 'last_row')],
        ir[idx(invH, 'last_column')],
        ir[idx(invH, 'nonblank_header_count')],
        ir[idx(invH, 'physical_headers')],
        contract, refs, finalStatus, safeAction
      ];
      const manualDefaults = [
        phase2Decision,
        authority,
        'PENDING: inspect backend read/write references and parent-child dependencies',
        'PRESERVE; classify before any rename/merge/retirement',
        'PENDING OWNER + TECHNICAL REVIEW',
        notes
      ];
      const prior = oldManual.get(name);
      const manual = prior
        ? prior.map((v, i) => v === '' || v === null ? manualDefaults[i] : v)
        : manualDefaults;
      rows.push(generated.concat(manual));
    });

    // Include canonical registry entries absent from the physical live inventory.
    Array.from(canonical.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).forEach(name => {
      if (inventory.has(name)) return;
      const cr = canonical.get(name);
      const get = (key) => {
        const j = idx(regH, key);
        return j < 0 || cr[j] == null ? '' : cr[j];
      };
      const generated = [
        name, 'CANONICAL_MISSING', get('group'), get('priority'),
        get('purpose / record grain'), get('owner role'),
        '', '', '', '', '', get('backend contract?'), get('backend file refs'),
        get('finalization status'), get('safe action')
      ];
      const defaults = [
        '', 'No physical tab found in current inventory; verify live workbook and registry.',
        'PENDING: investigate missing canonical tab and backend dependencies',
        'DO NOT CREATE until owner and technical approval',
        'PENDING OWNER + TECHNICAL REVIEW',
        'Canonical registry entry has no matching physical tab in inventory.'
      ];
      const prior = oldManual.get(name);
      rows.push(generated.concat(prior
        ? prior.map((v, i) => v === '' || v === null ? defaults[i] : v)
        : defaults));
    });

    const mapping = ksP3MapGetOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P3_MAP_CFG.mappingTab, headers);
    // Safe replacement is limited to the explicitly owned mapping tab.
    // Manual decision columns have already been carried forward by key.
    mapping.clearContents();
    mapping.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    if (rows.length) {
      mapping.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, headers.length).setValues(rows);
    }
    mapping.setFrozenRows(1);
    mapping.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setFontWeight('bold');
    mapping.autoResizeColumns(1, headers.length);
    const oldFilter = mapping.getFilter();
    if (oldFilter) oldFilter.remove();
    mapping.getRange(1, 1, Math.max(1, rows.length + 1), headers.length).createFilter();

    const extraCount = rows.filter(r => r[1] === 'EXTRA_TAB_REVIEW').length;
    const missingCount = rows.filter(r => r[1] === 'CANONICAL_MISSING').length;
    const log = ksP3MapGetLog_(ss);
    log.appendRow([
      new Date(), KS_P3_MAP_CFG.version, 'BUILD_CANONICAL_TABLE_MAPPING',
      'Rebuilt mapping register; preserved manual decision columns; no business schema changed.',
      JSON.stringify({
        mappedRows: rows.length,
        canonicalMatches: rows.filter(r => r[1] === 'CANONICAL_TABLE').length,
        extraTabsForReview: extraCount,
        canonicalMissing: missingCount,
        preservedManualRows: oldManual.size,
        businessSchemaChanged: false
      })
    ]);

    const result = {
      success: true,
      version: KS_P3_MAP_CFG.version,
      mappedRows: rows.length,
      canonicalMatches: rows.filter(r => r[1] === 'CANONICAL_TABLE').length,
      extraTabsForReview: extraCount,
      canonicalMissing: missingCount,
      preservedManualRows: oldManual.size,
      mappingTab: KS_P3_MAP_CFG.mappingTab,
      businessSchemaChanged: false
    };
    Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksP3MapReadExistingManual_(ss, expectedHeaders) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_MAP_CFG.mappingTab);
  const result = new Map();
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2 || sh.getLastColumn() < expectedHeaders.length) return result;

  const actualHeaders = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn())
    .getDisplayValues()[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_);
  const keyCol = actualHeaders.indexOf('live_tab_name');
  if (keyCol < 0) return result;

  const manualNames = [
    'phase2_decision','authority_or_role','dependency_review',
    'proposed_action','approval_status','review_notes'
  ];
  const manualCols = manualNames.map(n => actualHeaders.indexOf(ksP3MapNorm_(n)));
  if (manualCols.some(i => i < 0)) return result;

  const data = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  data.forEach(row => {
    const key = String(row[keyCol] || '').trim();
    if (!key) return;
    result.set(key, manualCols.map(i => row[i]));
  });
  return result;
}

function ksP3VerifyTableMapping() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  ksP3MapAssertTarget_(ss);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_MAP_CFG.mappingTab);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Mapping register not found.');
  const values = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (!values.length) throw new Error('Mapping register is empty.');
  const header = values[0];
  const classCol = header.indexOf('mapping_class');
  const count = cls => classCol < 0 ? 0 :
    values.slice(1).filter(r => r[classCol] === cls).length;
  const result = {
    success: true,
    tab: sh.getName(),
    rows: Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1),
    columns: sh.getLastColumn(),
    canonicalMatches: count('CANONICAL_TABLE'),
    extraTabsForReview: count('EXTRA_TAB_REVIEW'),
    canonicalMissing: count('CANONICAL_MISSING'),
    note: 'Verification only. No business tabs or records changed.'
  };
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

function ksP3MapAssertTarget_(ss) {
  if (!ss || ss.getId() !== KS_P3_MAP_CFG.spreadsheetId ||
      !ss.getName().startsWith(KS_P3_MAP_CFG.expectedNamePrefix)) {
    throw new Error('STOP: wrong spreadsheet. No changes made.');
  }
}

function ksP3MapRead_(ss, name) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Required register missing: ' + name);
  return sh.getDataRange().getValues();
}

function ksP3MapNorm_(v) {
  return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().toLowerCase();
}

function ksP3MapGetOwnedTab_(ss, name, expectedHeaders) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (sh) {
    if (sh.getLastRow() > 0 && sh.getLastColumn() > 0) {
      const existing = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn())
        .getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v || '').trim());
      const expected = expectedHeaders.map(String);
      if (existing.join('\u001f') !== expected.join('\u001f')) {
        throw new Error('STOP: ' + name +
          ' exists with unexpected headers. No write performed.');
      }
    }
  } else {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
  }
  return sh;
}

function ksP3MapGetLog_(ss) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3_MAP_CFG.migrationLogTab);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Migration log missing.');
  if (sh.getLastRow() < 1 || sh.getLastColumn() < 1) {
    throw new Error('Migration log has no header. No mapping write performed.');
  }
  const h = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn())
    .getDisplayValues()[0].map(ksP3MapNorm_);
  if (h.indexOf('timestamp') < 0 || h.indexOf('version') < 0) {
    throw new Error('Migration log header mismatch. No mapping write performed.');
  }
  return sh;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD - READ-ONLY WORKBOOK AUDIT
 * Version: 1.0
 *
 * Reads the spreadsheet bound to this Apps Script project.
 * No spreadsheet or Drive write methods are used.
 *
 * Output is split into small JSON chunks in the Execution log to make it easier
 * to copy. Header candidates are based on the row (within the first five rows)
 * containing the largest number of non-empty cells. The raw first five rows
 * are included so the header decision can be checked by a human.
 */
function KS_RUN_READ_ONLY_WORKBOOK_AUDIT() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) {
    throw new Error(
      'No active bound spreadsheet was found. Open this script from the intended Kawad Swad spreadsheet.'
    );
  }

  var sheets = ss.getSheets();
  var report = {
    auditName: 'KAWAD_SWAD_READ_ONLY_WORKBOOK_AUDIT',
    auditVersion: '1.0',
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    spreadsheetName: ss.getName(),
    spreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    spreadsheetUrl: ss.getUrl(),
    sheetCount: sheets.length,
    headerDetection: 'Candidate row is the densest non-empty row among the first five rows; human review required.',
    writeOperationsPerformed: false,
    sheets: []
  };

  var totalUsedRows = 0;
  var totalUsedColumns = 0;
  var emptySheets = 0;
  var sheetsWithDuplicateHeaders = 0;
  var sheetsWithBlankHeaderCells = 0;
  var possiblePlaceholderSheets = 0;
  var sheetsWithReadErrors = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var sh = sheets[i];
    var item = {
      sheetIndex: i + 1,
      sheetName: sh.getName(),
      lastRowWithContent: sh.getLastRow(),
      lastColumnWithContent: sh.getLastColumn(),
      frozenRows: sh.getFrozenRows(),
      frozenColumns: sh.getFrozenColumns(),
      candidateHeaderRow: null,
      candidateHeaders: [],
      blankHeaderColumnNumbers: [],
      duplicateHeaders: [],
      possibleGenericPlaceholder: false,
      firstFiveRows: [],
      status: 'READ_OK'
    };

    try {
      var lastRow = item.lastRowWithContent;
      var lastCol = item.lastColumnWithContent;
      totalUsedRows += lastRow;
      totalUsedColumns += lastCol;

      if (lastRow === 0 || lastCol === 0) {
        emptySheets++;
        item.status = 'EMPTY_OR_NO_CONTENT_RANGE';
        report.sheets.push(item);
        continue;
      }

      var rowsToRead = Math.min(5, lastRow);
      var topRows = sh.getRange(1, 1, rowsToRead, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
      item.firstFiveRows = topRows;

      // Choose the densest row as a candidate only. This is not an approval.
      var candidateIndex = 0;
      var bestCount = -1;
      for (var r = 0; r < topRows.length; r++) {
        var count = 0;
        for (var c = 0; c < topRows[r].length; c++) {
          if (String(topRows[r][c] == null ? '' : topRows[r][c]).trim() !== '') count++;
        }
        if (count > bestCount) {
          bestCount = count;
          candidateIndex = r;
        }
      }

      item.candidateHeaderRow = candidateIndex + 1;
      var headers = topRows[candidateIndex].map(function (v) {
        return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim();
      });
      item.candidateHeaders = headers;

      var seen = {};
      var duplicateSet = {};
      var blankColumns = [];
      var nonBlankHeaders = [];
      var allGeneric = true;
      var genericCount = 0;

      for (var h = 0; h < headers.length; h++) {
        var original = headers[h];
        var normalized = original.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

        if (!normalized) {
          blankColumns.push(h + 1);
          allGeneric = false;
          continue;
        }

        nonBlankHeaders.push(original);
        if (seen[normalized]) duplicateSet[normalized] = true;
        seen[normalized] = true;

        if (/^(field|column|col|header|unnamed|blank)[ _-]*\d*$/i.test(original)) {
          genericCount++;
        } else {
          allGeneric = false;
        }
      }

      item.blankHeaderColumnNumbers = blankColumns;
      item.duplicateHeaders = Object.keys(duplicateSet);
      item.possibleGenericPlaceholder = nonBlankHeaders.length > 0 && allGeneric && genericCount >= 2;
      item.candidateHeaderNonBlankCount = nonBlankHeaders.length;
      item.candidateHeaderBlankCount = blankColumns.length;
      item.dataRowExtentAfterCandidate = Math.max(0, lastRow - item.candidateHeaderRow);
      item.note = 'dataRowExtentAfterCandidate is a row-range estimate, not a verified non-empty business-record count.';

      if (blankColumns.length) sheetsWithBlankHeaderCells++;
      if (item.duplicateHeaders.length) sheetsWithDuplicateHeaders++;
      if (item.possibleGenericPlaceholder) possiblePlaceholderSheets++;

      report.sheets.push(item);
    } catch (err) {
      sheetsWithReadErrors++;
      item.status = 'READ_ERROR';
      item.error = String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
      report.sheets.push(item);
    }
  }

  report.summary = {
    sheetCount: sheets.length,
    emptyOrNoContentRangeSheets: emptySheets,
    sheetsWithBlankCandidateHeaderCells: sheetsWithBlankHeaderCells,
    sheetsWithDuplicateCandidateHeaders: sheetsWithDuplicateHeaders,
    possibleGenericPlaceholderSheets: possiblePlaceholderSheets,
    sheetsWithReadErrors: sheetsWithReadErrors,
    sumOfLastRowsAcrossSheets: totalUsedRows,
    sumOfLastColumnsAcrossSheets: totalUsedColumns,
    recordCountsVerified: false,
    writeOperationsPerformed: false
  };

  var json = JSON.stringify(report);
  var chunkSize = 4500;
  var totalChunks = Math.ceil(json.length / chunkSize);

  Logger.log('KS_AUDIT_START ' + JSON.stringify({
    auditName: report.auditName,
    auditVersion: report.auditVersion,
    spreadsheetName: report.spreadsheetName,
    spreadsheetId: report.spreadsheetId,
    sheetCount: report.sheetCount,
    writeOperationsPerformed: false
  }));

  Logger.log('KS_AUDIT_SUMMARY ' + JSON.stringify(report.summary));

  for (var p = 0; p < totalChunks; p++) {
    var part = json.substring(p * chunkSize, Math.min((p + 1) * chunkSize, json.length));
    Logger.log('KS_AUDIT_REPORT_PART ' + (p + 1) + '/' + totalChunks + ' ' + part);
  }

  Logger.log('KS_AUDIT_END ' + JSON.stringify({
    spreadsheetId: report.spreadsheetId,
    sheetCount: report.sheetCount,
    totalChunks: totalChunks,
    writeOperationsPerformed: false
  }));

  return report;
}
