function ksGetProtectedOfficialTabSet_() {
  const protectedSet = new Set(KS_PROTECTED_SYSTEM_AND_REPORT_TABS);

  if (typeof KS_CORE_TABLES !== 'undefined') {
    Object.keys(KS_CORE_TABLES).forEach(group => {
      (KS_CORE_TABLES[group] || []).forEach(t => protectedSet.add(t));
    });
  }
  if (typeof KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES !== 'undefined') {
    KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES.forEach(t => protectedSet.add(t));
  }
  KS_TRANSACTION_TABLES_TO_VERIFY_CLEAN.forEach(t => protectedSet.add(t));

  return protectedSet;
}

function ksIsLegacyScratchTab_(tabName, protectedSet) {
  if (protectedSet.has(tabName)) return false;
  if (KS_LEGACY_SCRATCH_EXACT_TABS.includes(tabName)) return true;
  return KS_LEGACY_SCRATCH_PREFIXES.some(prefix => tabName.startsWith(prefix));
}

/**
 * 1. Read-Only Audit of Legacy Build/Migration Scratch Tabs:
 * Categorizes all tabs into:
 *   - Protected Core ERP & Report Tabs (108)
 *   - Legacy Build/Audit Scratch Tabs (~46 -> recommended to clean)
 *   - Blueprint Domain Tables (147 -> official 218-table dictionary tables)
 */
function ksAuditUnwantedTabs() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksAuditUnwantedTabs');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const protectedSet = ksGetProtectedOfficialTabSet_();

  const allSheets = ss.getSheets();
  const legacyScratchTabs = [];
  const blueprintDomainTabs = [];

  allSheets.forEach(sh => {
    const name = sh.getName();
    if (protectedSet.has(name)) return;
    if (ksIsLegacyScratchTab_(name, protectedSet)) {
      legacyScratchTabs.push(name);
    } else {
      blueprintDomainTabs.push(name);
    }
  });

  Logger.log('=== WORKBOOK TAB HYGIENE SUMMARY ===');
  Logger.log('Total tabs: ' + allSheets.length);
  Logger.log('1. Protected Active ERP & Report Tabs: ' + (allSheets.length - legacyScratchTabs.length - blueprintDomainTabs.length));
  Logger.log('2. Official Blueprint Domain Tables (218-table schema): ' + blueprintDomainTabs.length);
  Logger.log('3. Legacy Build/Audit Scratch Tabs to Clean (' + legacyScratchTabs.length + '): ' + JSON.stringify(legacyScratchTabs));

  return {
    checked_by: ctx.user_id,
    total_tabs: allSheets.length,
    legacy_scratch_count: legacyScratchTabs.length,
    legacy_scratch_tabs: legacyScratchTabs,
    blueprint_domain_count: blueprintDomainTabs.length
  };
}

/**
 * 2. One-Click Safe Cleaner for the 46 Legacy Build/Audit Scratch Tabs (POL-018).
 * Never touches any protected core tab, DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074, or Blueprint domain table.
 */
function ksCleanAllLegacyScratchTabs() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksCleanAllLegacyScratchTabs');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const protectedSet = ksGetProtectedOfficialTabSet_();

  const deleted = [];
  ss.getSheets().forEach(sh => {
    const name = sh.getName();
    if (ksIsLegacyScratchTab_(name, protectedSet)) {
      ss.deleteSheet(sh);
      deleted.push(name);
    }
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  if (deleted.length > 0) {
    ksLogAudit_('LEGACY_SCRATCH_TABS_CLEANED', 'WORKBOOK', ss.getId(), {
      actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
      field_changed: 'sheet_tabs',
      old_value: deleted.length + ' scratch tabs',
      new_value: 'DELETED',
      reason: 'Removed legacy build/migration scratch tabs while preserving DBV5_FIELD_DICTIONARY_3074 and all Blueprint tables (POL-018)',
      approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
    });
  }

  Logger.log('Successfully cleaned ' + deleted.length + ' legacy scratch tabs: ' + JSON.stringify(deleted));
  Logger.log('Remaining tabs in workbook: ' + ss.getSheets().length);
  return { success: true, deleted_count: deleted.length, remaining_tabs: ss.getSheets().length };
}

/**
 * 3. Protected Arbitrary Tab Deletion (if you ever want to remove specific extra tabs by name).
 */
function ksDeleteUnwantedTabs(tabNamesToDelete, confirmationPhrase) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksDeleteUnwantedTabs');
  if (confirmationPhrase !== 'DELETE_APPROVED_UNWANTED_TABS') {
    throw new Error('Safety Lock: Pass exact phrase "DELETE_APPROVED_UNWANTED_TABS" to delete tabs.');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(tabNamesToDelete) || tabNamesToDelete.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Provide an array of exact tab names to delete.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const protectedSet = ksGetProtectedOfficialTabSet_();
  const deleted = [];
  const skipped = [];

  tabNamesToDelete.forEach(rawName => {
    const name = String(rawName || '').trim();
    if (!name) return;

    if (protectedSet.has(name)) {
      skipped.push({ tab: name, reason: 'BLOCKED_PROTECTED_OFFICIAL_TAB' });
      return;
    }

    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      skipped.push({ tab: name, reason: 'TAB_NOT_FOUND' });
      return;
    }

    ss.deleteSheet(sh);
    deleted.push(name);
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  if (deleted.length > 0) {
    ksLogAudit_('UNWANTED_TABS_DELETED', 'WORKBOOK', ss.getId(), {
      actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
      field_changed: 'sheet_tabs',
      old_value: deleted.join(', '),
      new_value: 'DELETED (' + deleted.length + ' tabs)',
      reason: 'Cleaned unwanted tabs prior to Phase H cutover (POL-018)',
      approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
    });
  }

  Logger.log('Deleted tabs (' + deleted.length + '): ' + JSON.stringify(deleted));
  return { success: true, deleted: deleted, skipped: skipped };
}

/**
 * 4. Read-only Phase H Pre-Go-Live Audit (POL-017).
 */
function ksVerifyCleanLiveBaseline() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksVerifyCleanLiveBaseline');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  const dirtyTables = [];
  KS_TRANSACTION_TABLES_TO_VERIFY_CLEAN.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      dirtyTables.push({ tab: tabName, issue: 'MISSING_TAB' });
      return;
    }
    const dataRows = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
    if (dataRows > 0) {
      dirtyTables.push({ tab: tabName, issue: 'NON_EMPTY_ROWS=' + dataRows });
    }
  });

  const userSheet = ss.getSheetByName(KS_CONFIG.TABS.USERS);
  const activeUserRows = userSheet ? Math.max(0, userSheet.getLastRow() - 1) : 0;

  const isClean = (dirtyTables.length === 0);
  const report = {
    checked_at: ksNowIso_(),
    checked_by: ctx.user_id,
    clean_transaction_baseline: isClean,
    configured_users_count: activeUserRows,
    dirty_or_missing_tables: dirtyTables
  };

  Logger.log('=== PHASE H CLEAN BASELINE AUDIT ===');
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return report;
}

/**
 * 5. Controlled Test-Data Purger for New Production Copy (POL-017 & POL-018).
 */
function ksPurgeTestRowsForCleanCutover(confirmationPhrase) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksPurgeTestRowsForCleanCutover');
  if (confirmationPhrase !== 'RESET_FOR_CLEAN_PRODUCTION_BASELINE') {
    throw new Error('Safety Lock: Pass exact phrase "RESET_FOR_CLEAN_PRODUCTION_BASELINE" to clear test rows.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  let clearedTabs = 0;

  KS_TRANSACTION_TABLES_TO_VERIFY_CLEAN.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) return;
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    if (lastRow > 1) {
      sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, sh.getLastColumn()).clearContent();
      clearedTabs++;
    }
  });

  ['RPT_TrialBalance', 'RPT_StockStatus', 'RPT_SalesAndReceivables'].forEach(rpt => {
    const rSh = ss.getSheetByName(rpt);
    if (rSh && rSh.getLastRow() > 1) {
      rSh.getRange(2, 1, rSh.getLastRow() - 1, rSh.getLastColumn()).clearContent();
    }
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  ksLogAudit_('TEST_ROWS_PURGED_FOR_CUTOVER', 'WORKBOOK', ss.getId(), {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'transactional_rows',
    old_value: 'TEST_DATA',
    new_value: '0_ROWS_CLEAN_BASELINE',
    reason: 'Purged ' + clearedTabs + ' tables in new production copy per POL-017',
    approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
  });

  Logger.log('Purged test rows across ' + clearedTabs + ' tables.');
  return { success: true, cleared_tables: clearedTabs };
}

/**
 * 7. Formal Phase H Owner Go-Live Sign-Off Recorder (GATE-08).
 */
function ksRecordOwnerGoLiveSignOff(backupFileId, caSignOffRef) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksRecordOwnerGoLiveSignOff');
  if (!backupFileId || !caSignOffRef) {
    throw new Error('Both backupFileId (from BackupRegister) and caSignOffRef are required before Go-Live sign-off (POL-018).');
  }

  const baseline = ksVerifyCleanLiveBaseline();
  if (!baseline.clean_transaction_baseline) {
    throw new Error(
      'GO-LIVE BLOCKED (POL-017): Workbook contains non-empty transaction tables (' +
      baseline.dirty_or_missing_tables.map(t => t.tab).join(', ') +
      '). Deploy to a clean 0-row production copy first.'
    );
  }

  if (baseline.configured_users_count < 1) {
    throw new Error('GO-LIVE BLOCKED: Populate at least 1 active user in the Users master tab before Go-Live.');
  }

  const auditId = ksLogAudit_('OWNER_GO_LIVE_APPROVED', 'WORKBOOK', 'PRODUCTION_RELEASE_V2', {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'release_status',
    old_value: 'PRE_RELEASE',
    new_value: 'LIVE_APPROVED',
    reason: 'BackupID=' + backupFileId + ' | CA_SignOff=' + caSignOffRef,
    approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
  });

  Logger.log('PHASE H GO-LIVE APPROVED! Audit ID: ' + auditId);
  return { success: true, status: 'LIVE_APPROVED', audit_id: auditId };
}

function ks3rReserve_(ss,table,lockAlreadyHeld){

  try{
    const sh=ks3rSheet_(ss,table),idCol=ks3rNeedHeaders_(sh,[cfg.id])[cfg.id];const led=ks3rSheet_(ss,'IdAllocations'),lm=ks3rNeedHeaders_(led,KS3R.ID_HEADERS);
    const business=ks3rNonblank_(sh,idCol);const last=led.getLastRow();const ledgerRows=last<2?[]:led.getRange(2,1,last-1,5).getDisplayValues();
    const claims=ledgerRows.filter(r=>String(r[lm.tab_name-1])===table).map(r=>String(r[lm.allocated_id-1]).trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const combined=business.concat(claims);const dup=ks3rDupes_(combined);if(dup.length)throw new Error('Duplicate ID detected in '+table+': '+dup.join(', '));
    const re=new RegExp('^'+cfg.prefix+'-(\\d+)$');let max=0;combined.forEach(x=>{const m=String(x).match(re);if(m)max=Math.max(max,Number(m[1]));});
    const id=cfg.prefix+'-'+String(max+1).padStart(6,'0');const nonce=Utilities.getUuid();const allocationId='ALC-'+nonce;
    led.appendRow([allocationId,table,id,nonce,new Date()]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    const check=led.getRange(led.getLastRow(),1,1,5).getDisplayValues()[0];if(check[2]!==id||check[1]!==table)throw new Error('Read-after-write verification failed. Do not reuse this ID.');
    return id;
  } finally {if(!lockAlreadyHeld)lock.releaseLock();}
}

function KS3R_COMMIT_APPROVED_INTAKE(){
  const ss=ks3rSs_();if(!ks3rPolicyApproved_(ss))throw new Error('ID policy approval required before committing master records.');
  const intake=ks3rSheet_(ss,KS3R.INTAKE);ks3rNeedHeaders_(intake,KS3R.INTAKE_HEADERS);const im=ks3rHeaders_(intake);const last=intake.getLastRow();if(last<2){SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Intake is empty. No records to commit.');return;}
  const ui=SpreadsheetApp.getUi();if(ui.alert('Commit approved master data','Only rows marked APPROVED will be appended. Existing records will not be edited. RawMaterials IDs must be semantic owner-supplied IDs. Continue?',ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO)!==ui.Button.YES)return;
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(20000))throw new Error('Could not obtain project lock.');let done=0,failed=0;
  try{
    const values=intake.getRange(2,1,last-1,KS3R.INTAKE_HEADERS.length).getValues();
    values.forEach((r,idx)=>{
      const sheetRow=idx+2;const entity=String(r[im.entity-1]||'').trim();const approval=String(r[im.approval_status-1]||'').trim().toUpperCase();const status=String(r[im.commit_status-1]||'').trim();
      if(approval!=='APPROVED'||status==='COMMITTED')return;
      try{
        if(!KS3R.TABLES[entity])throw new Error('Unsupported entity. Allowed: Products, Customers, Suppliers, RawMaterials.');
        const obj=JSON.parse(String(r[im.record_json-1]||'{}'));if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object'||Array.isArray(obj))throw new Error('record_json must be a JSON object.');
        const sh=ks3rSheet_(ss,entity);const expected=KS3R.HEADERS[entity];const hm=ks3rNeedHeaders_(sh,expected);const cfg=KS3R.TABLES[entity];
        cfg.required.forEach(k=>{if(obj[k]===undefined||obj[k]===null||String(obj[k]).trim()==='')throw new Error('Missing required field: '+k);});
        if(entity==='Products'){
          const skus=ks3rNonblank_(sh,hm.sku).map(x=>x.toUpperCase());if(skus.includes(String(obj.sku).trim().toUpperCase()))throw new Error('SKU already exists: '+obj.sku);
        }
        let id;
        if(entity==='RawMaterials'){
          id=String(obj.raw_material_id||'').trim();if(!/^RM-[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$/i.test(id))throw new Error('RawMaterials requires an approved semantic ID such as RM-MOONG-FLOUR. Generic RWM IDs are disabled.');
          const ids=ks3rNonblank_(sh,hm.raw_material_id);if(ids.includes(id))throw new Error('Raw material ID already exists: '+id);
        } else {id=ks3rReserve_(ss,entity,true);}
        const row=Array(expected.length).fill('');expected.forEach((h,i)=>{if(h===cfg.id)row[i]=id;else if(obj[h]!==undefined)row[i]=obj[h];});
        if(entity==='Products' && obj.active===undefined)row[hm.active-1]=true;
        if(entity==='Customers' && obj.active===undefined)row[hm.active-1]=true;
        if(entity==='Suppliers' && obj.active===undefined)row[hm.active-1]=true;
        if(entity==='RawMaterials'){
          if(obj.active===undefined)row[hm.active-1]=true;
          if(obj.created_at===undefined)row[hm.created_at-1]=new Date();
          if(obj.created_by===undefined)row[hm.created_by-1]=Session.getActiveUser().getEmail()||'UNAVAILABLE';
        }
        sh.appendRow(row);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        const createdRow=sh.getLastRow();const verify=String(sh.getRange(createdRow,hm[cfg.id]).getDisplayValue()).trim();if(verify!==id)throw new Error('Business row read-after-write verification failed. Reserved ID will not be reused.');
        intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.created_id).setValue(id);intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.commit_status).setValue('COMMITTED');intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.commit_note).setValue('Appended to '+entity+' row '+createdRow);intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.committed_at).setValue(new Date());done++;
        ks3rLog_(ss,'MASTER_RECORD_CREATED',entity+' '+id+' appended at row '+createdRow);
      }catch(e){intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.commit_status).setValue('ERROR');intake.getRange(sheetRow,im.commit_note).setValue(String(e.message||e));failed++;}
    });
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
  Logger.log('KS3R_INTAKE_COMMIT '+JSON.stringify({committed:done,failed:failed,existingRecordsEdited:false,authUsersAccessed:false}));
  ui.alert('Intake run finished. Committed: '+done+'. Errors: '+failed+'. Review commit_status and commit_note in '+KS3R.INTAKE+'.');
}

function KS3R_MASTER_VALIDATION(){
  const ss=ks3rSs_();const out=[];
  Object.keys(KS3R.HEADERS).forEach(t=>{
    const sh=ks3rSheet_(ss,t),m=ks3rNeedHeaders_(sh,KS3R.HEADERS[t]);const ids=ks3rNonblank_(sh,m[KS3R.TABLES[t].id]);const dup=ks3rDupes_(ids);
    out.push([t,ids.length,ids.filter(x=>!x).length,dup.length,dup.join(', '),dup.length?'FAIL_DUPLICATE_ID':'PASS_ID_UNIQUENESS']);
    if(t==='Products'){const skus=ks3rNonblank_(sh,m.sku);const sd=ks3rDupes_(skus.map(x=>x.toUpperCase()));out.push(['Products.SKU',skus.length,0,sd.length,sd.join(', '),sd.length?'FAIL_DUPLICATE_SKU':'PASS_SKU_UNIQUENESS']);}
  });
  ks3rReport_(ss,KS3R.MASTER_AUDIT,['entity_or_key','nonblank_count','blank_count_in_id_scan','duplicate_count','duplicates','result'],out);
  Logger.log('KS3R_MASTER_VALIDATION '+JSON.stringify({checks:out.length,usersDataRead:false,authUsersDataRead:false}));
}

function KS3R_RELATIONSHIP_AUDIT(){
  const ss=ks3rSs_();const out=[];
  KS3R.WORKFLOWS.forEach(x=>{
    const [child,cf,parent,pf]=x;const cs=ss.getSheetByName(child),ps=ss.getSheetByName(parent);
    if(!cs||!ps){out.push([child,cf,parent,pf,'BLOCKED_TAB_MISSING','','','No enforcement']);return;}
    const cm=ks3rHeaders_(cs),pm=ks3rHeaders_(ps);if(!cm[cf]||!pm[pf]){out.push([child,cf,parent,pf,'BLOCKED_HEADER_MISSING','','','No enforcement']);return;}
    const pvals=ks3rNonblank_(ps,pm[pf]);const dup=ks3rDupes_(pvals);const pset=new Set(pvals);const cvals=ks3rNonblank_(cs,cm[cf]);const orphans=cvals.filter(v=>!pset.has(v));
    const status=dup.length?'BLOCKED_PARENT_DUPLICATES':orphans.length?'BLOCKED_ORPHANS':'OBSERVED_ZERO_ORPHANS';
    out.push([child,cf,parent,pf,status,pvals.length,cvals.length, 'Read-only audit. No FK enforcement. Parent duplicate count='+dup.length+'; orphan count='+orphans.length]);
  });
  ks3rReport_(ss,KS3R.REL_AUDIT,['child_table','child_field','parent_table','parent_field','result','parent_key_count','child_reference_count','notes'],out);
  Logger.log('KS3R_RELATIONSHIP_AUDIT '+JSON.stringify({relationships:out.length,foreignKeyEnforcementActivated:false}));
}

function KS3R_WORKFLOW_READINESS(){
  const ss=ks3rSs_();const out=[];
  const checks=[['Products','product_id'],['Products','sku'],['Customers','customer_id'],['Suppliers','supplier_id'],['RawMaterials','raw_material_id'],['Recipes','product_id'],['ProductionBatches','product_id'],['ProductionBatches','recipe_id'],['Sales','customer_id'],['SaleItems','product_id'],['SaleItems','sale_id'],['Payments','sale_id'],['PurchaseOrders','supplier_id'],['SupplierBills','supplier_id'],['RawMaterialLedger','raw_material_id'],['ProductionStockLedger','product_id']];
  checks.forEach(([t,f])=>{const sh=ss.getSheetByName(t);if(!sh){out.push([t,f,'TAB_MISSING','BLOCKED']);return;}const m=ks3rHeaders_(sh);out.push([t,f,m[f]?'HEADER_PRESENT':'FIELD_MISSING',m[f]?'READY_FOR_DATA_LEVEL_TEST':'BLOCKED_SCHEMA_OR_ALIAS_REVIEW']);});
  out.push(['ERP backend / API','master-reference validation','Not changed by this Apps Script package','REQUIRES_SEPARATE_CODE_INTEGRATION_AND_TESTS']);
  out.push(['Foreign-key enforcement','all 41 proposed relationships','Package 3 reports unresolved physical key mappings','BLOCKED_PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL']);
  ks3rReport_(ss,KS3R.WORKFLOW_AUDIT,['workflow_area','reference_field','observation','readiness'],out);
  Logger.log('KS3R_WORKFLOW_READINESS '+JSON.stringify({checks:out.length,backendCodeChanged:false,foreignKeyEnforcementActivated:false}));
}

/**
 * Kawad Swad ERP - Phase 3 Integrated Master Data
 * HEADER-ONLY PREFLIGHT UTILITY v1.0
 *
 * Purpose:
 *   Read row 1 only from these four live tabs:
 *     IdAllocations, RawMaterials, Customers, Suppliers
 *   Write the extracted header names to:
 *     KS_P3_HEADER_PREFLIGHT
 *
 * Safety:
 *   - Does NOT read rows 2 onward.
 *   - Does NOT read Users or AuthUsers.
 *   - Does NOT change business tabs, headers, or business records.
 *   - Creates/refreshes only the dedicated report tab.
 *   - Does not create IDs or master records.
 */

const KS_P3_HEADER_PREFLIGHT_CONFIG = {
  workbookId: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  workbookNamePrefix: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  sourceTabs: ['IdAllocations', 'RawMaterials', 'Customers', 'Suppliers'],
  reportTab: 'KS_P3_HEADER_PREFLIGHT'
};

function onOpen() {
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi()
    .createMenu('Kawad Swad | Phase 3')
    .addItem('Run Header-Only Preflight', 'KS_P3_RUN_HEADER_ONLY_PREFLIGHT')
    .addToUi();
}

function KS_P3_RUN_HEADER_ONLY_PREFLIGHT() {
  const cfg = KS_P3_HEADER_PREFLIGHT_CONFIG;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (ss.getId() !== cfg.workbookId) {
    throw new Error('STOPPED: This is not the approved Kawad Swad workbook. No changes made.');
  }
  if (!ss.getName().startsWith(cfg.workbookNamePrefix)) {
    throw new Error('STOPPED: Workbook name verification failed. No changes made.');
  }

  const output = [[
    'tab_name', 'column_number', 'header_name', 'header_is_blank',
    'extraction_scope', 'source_row_read'
  ]];

  const tabSummary = [];
  const missingTabs = [];

  cfg.sourceTabs.forEach(function(tabName) {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      missingTabs.push(tabName);
      tabSummary.push({
        tabName: tabName,
        exists: false,
        columnsRead: 0,
        nonblankHeaders: 0
      });
      return;
    }

    // Only inspect the physical width and row 1. No data rows are read.
    const lastColumn = sh.getLastColumn();
    if (lastColumn < 1) {
      tabSummary.push({
        tabName: tabName,
        exists: true,
        columnsRead: 0,
        nonblankHeaders: 0
      });
      return;
    }

    const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastColumn).getDisplayValues()[0];
    let nonblank = 0;

    headers.forEach(function(value, index) {
      const header = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
      if (header !== '') nonblank++;
      output.push([
        tabName,
        index + 1,
        header,
        header === '' ? 'YES' : 'NO',
        'HEADER_ROW_ONLY',
        1
      ]);
    });

    tabSummary.push({
      tabName: tabName,
      exists: true,
      columnsRead: lastColumn,
      nonblankHeaders: nonblank
    });
  });

  if (missingTabs.length) {
    throw new Error(
      'STOPPED: Required source tab(s) missing: ' +
      missingTabs.join(', ') +
      '. No report was written.'
    );
  }

  let report = ss.getSheetByName(cfg.reportTab);
  if (!report) report = ss.insertSheet(cfg.reportTab);

  // The only write/clear operation in this utility is on its own report tab.
  report.clearContents();
  report.getRange(1, 1, output.length, output[0].length).setValues(output);
  report.setFrozenRows(1);
  report.autoResizeColumns(1, output[0].length);

  const result = {
    success: true,
    status: 'HEADER_ONLY_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE',
    workbookName: ss.getName(),
    workbookIdVerified: true,
    sourceTabs: cfg.sourceTabs,
    tabSummary: tabSummary,
    extractedHeaderCells: output.length - 1,
    businessRowsRead: false,
    usersDataRead: false,
    authUsersDataRead: false,
    businessSchemaChanged: false,
    businessRecordsChanged: false,
    reportTab: cfg.reportTab,
    note: 'Only row 1 was read from the four named tabs. Only the dedicated report tab was written.'
  };

  console.log('KS_P3_HEADER_ONLY_PREFLIGHT_RESULT ' + JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}

function ksP1InstallFoundation() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  let backupUrl = '';
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    ksP1AssertTarget_(ss);

    const data = ksP1LoadData_();
    ksP1ValidatePayload_(data);

    // Create a recoverable copy before any Phase 1 registry tab is written.
    const stamp = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Kolkata',
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );
    const backup = DriveApp.getFileById(ss.getId())
      .makeCopy(ss.getName() + '_BACKUP_BEFORE_PHASE1_' + stamp);
    backupUrl = backup.getUrl();

    const summaries = [];
    summaries.push(ksP1WriteOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.TABLES, data.tables));
    summaries.push(ksP1WriteOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.FIELDS, data.fields));
    summaries.push(ksP1WriteOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.CONTRACTS, data.contracts));
    summaries.push(ksP1WriteOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.RELATIONSHIPS, data.relationships));
    summaries.push(ksP1WriteIdPolicy_(ss));

    const logRows = [
      ['event_id', 'event_datetime', 'version', 'event', 'result', 'details', 'backup_url', 'source_export'],
      [
        Utilities.getUuid(),
        new Date(),
        KS_P1.VERSION,
        'PHASE1_FOUNDATION_INSTALLED',
        'SUCCESS',
        'Installed governance registers only. Business tabs and transaction data were not changed.',
        backupUrl,
        data.sourceWorkbook
      ],
      [
        Utilities.getUuid(),
        new Date(),
        KS_P1.VERSION,
        'SOURCE_COUNTS',
        'VERIFIED',
        'Tables=' + data.tables.length +
          '; Fields=' + data.fields.length +
          '; Backend contract fields=' + data.contracts.length +
          '; Relationship proposals=' + data.relationships.length,
        backupUrl,
        data.sourceWorkbook
      ]
    ];
    ksP1WriteRawTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.LOG, logRows);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const msg = [
      'Phase 1 foundation installed.',
      'Tables: ' + data.tables.length,
      'Fields: ' + data.fields.length,
      'Backend contract fields: ' + data.contracts.length,
      'Relationship proposals: ' + data.relationships.length,
      'Backup: ' + backupUrl,
      'Business records changed: NO'
    ].join('\n');

    // Log the completion details so the function also works when run from
    // the Apps Script editor, where spreadsheet UI access is unavailable.
    Logger.log(msg);
    return { success: true, backupUrl: backupUrl, tabs: summaries, message: msg };
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error('Phase 1 installation stopped safely: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function ksP1ShowSummary() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const expected = [
    KS_P1.TABS.TABLES, KS_P1.TABS.FIELDS, KS_P1.TABS.CONTRACTS,
    KS_P1.TABS.RELATIONSHIPS, KS_P1.TABS.ID_POLICY, KS_P1.TABS.LOG
  ];
  const lines = expected.map(function(name) {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    return name + ': ' + (sh ? Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1) + ' records' : 'not installed');
  });
  const summary = lines.join('\n');
  Logger.log(summary);
  return summary;
}

function ksP1AssertTarget_(ss) {
  if (!ss) throw new Error('Open the target Google Sheet before running this function.');
  if (ss.getId() !== KS_P1.EXPECTED_SPREADSHEET_ID) {
    throw new Error(
      'Wrong spreadsheet. Expected ID ' + KS_P1.EXPECTED_SPREADSHEET_ID +
      ' but found ' + ss.getId() + '. No changes were made.'
    );
  }
  if (ss.getName().indexOf(KS_P1.EXPECTED_NAME_PREFIX) !== 0) {
    throw new Error('Unexpected spreadsheet name: ' + ss.getName() + '. No changes were made.');
  }
}

function ksP1LoadData_() {
  const compressed = Utilities.newBlob(
    Utilities.base64Decode(KS_P1_DATA_B64),
    'application/gzip',
    'ks_phase1_metadata.json.gz'
  );
  const jsonText = Utilities.ungzip(compressed).getDataAsString('UTF-8');
  return JSON.parse(jsonText);
}

function ksP1ValidatePayload_(data) {
  const checks = [
    ['tables', 218],
    ['fields', 3074],
    ['contracts', 888],
    ['relationships', 41]
  ];
  checks.forEach(function(item) {
    if (!data[item[0]] || data[item[0]].length !== item[1]) {
      throw new Error('Embedded ' + item[0] + ' count mismatch. Expected ' + item[1] + '.');
    }
  });
  if (!data.sourceWorkbook) throw new Error('Source workbook identity is missing.');
}

function ksP1WriteOwnedTab_(ss, tabName, records) {
  const headers = Object.keys(records[0] || {});
  if (!headers.length) throw new Error('No headers found for ' + tabName);

  const rows = [headers];
  records.forEach(function(record) {
    rows.push(headers.map(function(header) {
      const value = record[header];
      return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value;
    }));
  });
  ksP1WriteRawTab_(ss, tabName, rows);
  return { tab: tabName, records: records.length };
}

function ksP1WriteIdPolicy_(ss) {
  const rows = [
    ['policy_id', 'area', 'rule', 'implementation_status', 'notes'],
    ['ID01', 'Primary identifiers', 'Every new business record receives a stable, unique string ID. Never use row number as an ID.', 'POLICY REGISTERED', 'Existing historical IDs are preserved.'],
    ['ID02', 'Historical records', 'Never overwrite, regenerate, or bulk-backfill an existing or blank historical ID without a separately approved row-level mapping.', 'POLICY REGISTERED', 'No historical IDs changed by Phase 1.'],
    ['ID03', 'ID allocation', 'All API and UI writers must use one shared server-side allocator with locking and collision checks.', 'BACKEND IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED', 'A standalone Apps Script allocator is not authoritative for external API writes.'],
    ['ID04', 'Idempotency', 'Every retriable create/post operation must carry an idempotency key and return the original result on retry.', 'BACKEND IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED', 'Prevents duplicate orders, payments, stock movements and journals.'],
    ['ID05', 'Relationship integrity', 'Validate referenced parent IDs before writes; do not enforce unapproved relationship proposals.', 'MAPPING / WORKFLOW APPROVAL REQUIRED', 'See KS_P1_RELATIONSHIPS.'],
    ['ID06', 'Google Sheets authority', 'Persist each committed business transaction to Google Sheets and confirm the saved record before reporting success.', 'BACKEND IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED', 'MongoDB may be used only as optional cache/processing.'],
    ['ID07', 'Concurrency', 'Use server-side locking or atomic allocation for sequence/ID operations; never rely on client-generated counters.', 'BACKEND IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED', 'Required for simultaneous users and retries.'],
    ['ID08', 'Audit trail', 'Record actor, timestamp, action, entity, entity ID, idempotency key and outcome for important writes.', 'BACKEND IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED', 'Do not store passwords or secrets in audit logs.'],
    ['ID09', 'Corrections', 'Correct posted financial or stock events with linked reversal/adjustment records, not silent edits.', 'POLICY REGISTERED', 'Accounting policy and approval roles remain owner/accountant decisions.'],
    ['ID10', 'Physical headers', 'Keep existing physical tab names and headers stable; use an explicit canonical-to-physical mapping registry for aliases.', 'POLICY REGISTERED', 'No rename, reorder or destructive header migration in Phase 1.']
  ];
  ksP1WriteRawTab_(ss, KS_P1.TABS.ID_POLICY, rows);
  return { tab: KS_P1.TABS.ID_POLICY, records: rows.length - 1 };
}

function ksP1WriteRawTab_(ss, tabName, rows) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(tabName);

  // Only the six KS_P1-owned tabs are written by this script.
  // Existing business/operational tabs are never passed to this function.
  sh.clearContents();
  const width = Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(function(row) { return row.length; }));
  const normalized = rows.map(function(row) {
    const copy = row.slice();
    while (copy.length < width) copy.push('');
    return copy;
  });

  const chunkSize = 500;
  for (let start = 0; start < normalized.length; start += chunkSize) {
    const chunk = normalized.slice(start, start + chunkSize);
    sh.getRange(start + 1, 1, chunk.length, width).setValues(chunk);
  }

  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.getRange(1, 1, sh.getMaxRows(), width).setWrap(false);
  sh.autoResizeColumns(1, Math.min(width, 12));
  return sh;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 2 LIVE DATABASE PREFLIGHT
 * Version: 1.0 | REPORT-ONLY
 *
 * PURPOSE
 * - Reads the currently open, bound Google Sheet.
 * - Verifies the expected source spreadsheet ID and name.
 * - Inventories all tabs, row counts, headers and header hashes.
 * - Writes ONLY the KS_P2_LIVE_PREFLIGHT report tab.
 * - Does NOT modify business tabs, headers, data, formulas, IDs or formatting.
 * - Does NOT read or export business cell values, password hashes, bank details,
 *   employee documents, salaries or other sensitive data.
 *
 * IMPORTANT
 * - This is a live verification step, not the migration/apply script.
 * - Run it in the LIVE Kawad Swad workbook, not the downloaded XLSX.
 * - Review the generated report before any business schema changes are prepared.
 */

const KS_P2_PREFLIGHT = Object.freeze({
  VERSION: '1.0',
  EXPECTED_SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  EXPECTED_NAME_PREFIX: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  REPORT_TAB: 'KS_P2_LIVE_PREFLIGHT'
});

function ksP2RunLivePreflight() {
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (!ss) throw new Error('No active spreadsheet. Open the LIVE Kawad Swad Google Sheet first.');

    const actualId = ss.getId();
    const actualName = ss.getName();

    if (actualId !== KS_P2_PREFLIGHT.EXPECTED_SPREADSHEET_ID) {
      throw new Error(
        'STOP: Spreadsheet ID mismatch. Expected ' +
        KS_P2_PREFLIGHT.EXPECTED_SPREADSHEET_ID +
        ' but found ' + actualId +
        '. Do not run this preflight on a backup or another workbook.'
      );
    }
    if (actualName.indexOf(KS_P2_PREFLIGHT.EXPECTED_NAME_PREFIX) !== 0) {
      throw new Error('STOP: Workbook name does not match the approved Kawad Swad workbook.');
    }

    const rows = [];
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();
    const now = new Date();

    sheets.forEach(function(sh) {
      const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
      const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
      let headers = [];
      if (lastCol > 0 && lastRow > 0) {
        headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
          .map(function(v) { return String(v || '').trim(); });
      }
      const nonBlankHeaders = headers.filter(function(v) { return v !== ''; });
      const headerText = nonBlankHeaders.join('|');
      const digest = Utilities.computeDigest(
        Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,
        headerText,
        Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
      );
      const headerHash = digest.map(function(b) {
        const v = (b < 0 ? b + 256 : b).toString(16);
        return v.length === 1 ? '0' + v : v;
      }).join('');

      rows.push([
        sh.getName(),
        Math.max(0, lastRow - 1),
        lastRow,
        lastCol,
        nonBlankHeaders.length,
        headerText,
        headerHash
      ]);
    });

    const reportName = KS_P2_PREFLIGHT.REPORT_TAB;
    let report = ss.getSheetByName(reportName);
    if (!report) {
      report = ss.insertSheet(reportName);
    } else {
      report.clearContents();
    }

    const header = [
      'sheet_name',
      'data_rows_approx',
      'last_row',
      'last_column',
      'nonblank_header_count',
      'physical_headers',
      'header_sha256'
    ];

    report.getRange(1, 1, 1, header.length).setValues([header]);
    if (rows.length) {
      report.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, header.length).setValues(rows);
    }
    report.setFrozenRows(1);
    report.getRange(1, 1, 1, header.length).setFontWeight('bold');
    report.autoResizeColumns(1, header.length);

    const metaRow = rows.length + 3;
    report.getRange(metaRow, 1, 6, 2).setValues([
      ['preflight_version', KS_P2_PREFLIGHT.VERSION],
      ['generated_at', Utilities.formatDate(now, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")],
      ['spreadsheet_id', actualId],
      ['spreadsheet_name', actualName],
      ['tab_count', sheets.length],
      ['operation', 'REPORT ONLY. No business tab or business data changed.']
    ]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    Logger.log(
      'Phase 2 live preflight completed. Tabs: ' + sheets.length +
      '. Report tab: ' + reportName +
      '. Business records changed: NO.'
    );
    return {
      success: true,
      tabCount: sheets.length,
      reportTab: reportName,
      businessDataChanged: false
    };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 2 GOOGLE SHEETS MASTER DATA
 * Version: 2.0.0
 *
 * INSTALL:
 * 1. Open the LIVE Kawad Swad Google Sheet.
 * 2. Extensions > Apps Script.
 * 3. Add a NEW file named Phase2_MasterData.gs.
 * 4. Paste this entire file and Save.
 * 5. Run ksP2InstallMasterData() once from the Apps Script editor.
 *
 * SAFETY:
 * - Verifies the target spreadsheet ID before any write.
 * - Makes a Drive backup before changing the workbook.
 * - Does not rename, delete, reorder, clear or rewrite existing business tabs,
 *   headers, IDs, formulas or transaction rows.
 * - Does not create the proposed placeholder tabs as active business tables.
 * - Creates only two Phase 2 governance tabs.
 * - Applies warning-only dropdown validation to selected existing columns.
 * - Master record creation is opt-in through ksP2CreateMasterRecord().
 * - AuthUsers/password hashes are deliberately excluded from generic writes.
 *
 * SOURCE BASELINE:
 * Uploaded workbook: Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets (21).xlsx
 * Reviewed master tabs: Products, Customers, Suppliers, RawMaterials,
 * Users, AuthUsers, Settings, IdAllocations and configuration placeholders.
 *
 * GOOGLE SHEETS IS THE AUTHORITATIVE BUSINESS RECORD.
 * MongoDB must remain optional cache/processing only.
 */

const KS_P2 = Object.freeze({
  VERSION: '2.0.0',
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '1dI0_YOmGBxHtqa1mRpOdM_S_2le5-IDYpOapSeCWH7g',
  EXPECTED_NAME_PREFIX: 'Kawad_Swad_Sales_Management_Google_Sheets',
  RULES_TAB: 'KS_P2_MASTER_DATA_RULES',
  LOG_TAB: 'KS_P2_DEPLOYMENT_LOG',
  ALLOCATION_TAB: 'IdAllocations',
  MAX_SCAN_ROWS: 50000
});

/**
 * Approved, existing operational master tabs only.
 * Required headers are checked by name, never by column position.
 */
const KS_P2_TABLES = Object.freeze({
  Products: {
    idHeader: 'product_id',
    prefix: 'PRD',
    required: ['product_id', 'sku', 'product_name'],
    unique: ['product_id', 'sku']
  },
  Customers: {
    idHeader: 'customer_id',
    prefix: 'CUS',
    required: ['customer_id', 'customer_type'],
    unique: ['customer_id']
  },
  Suppliers: {
    idHeader: 'supplier_id',
    prefix: 'SUP',
    required: ['supplier_id', 'supplier_name'],
    unique: ['supplier_id']
  },
  RawMaterials: {
    idHeader: 'raw_material_id',
    prefix: null,
    required: ['raw_material_id', 'material_name', 'unit'],
    unique: ['raw_material_id']
  }
});

/**
 * Installer. Run once. Safe to run again: only its own two KS_P2 tabs are
 * refreshed; operational business tabs are never cleared or rewritten.
 */
function ksP2InstallMasterData() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P2.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  ksP2AssertWorkbook_(ss);

  const backup = DriveApp.getFileById(ss.getId()).makeCopy(
    'Kawad Swad ERP Phase 2 Pre-Deployment Backup ' +
    Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')
  );

  const report = ksP2BuildRules_();
  ksP2WriteOwnedTab_(ss, KS_P2.RULES_TAB, report.headers, report.rows);
  ksP2InstallWarningValidations_(ss);
  ksP2AppendDeploymentLog_(ss, 'PHASE_2_MASTER_DATA_INSTALLED',
    'Created/updated Phase 2 rule register; applied warning-only validations. ' +
    'No operational records, headers or IDs were rewritten. Backup: ' + backup.getUrl());

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  const summary = [
    'Phase 2 master-data foundation installed.',
    'Rules registered: ' + report.rows.length,
    'Operational business records changed: NO',
    'Existing business headers changed: NO',
    'Backup: ' + backup.getUrl()
  ].join('\n');

  Logger.log(summary);
  return {success: true, rules: report.rows.length, backupUrl: backup.getUrl(), message: summary};
}

function ksP2AssertWorkbook_(ss) {
  if (!ss) throw new Error('Target spreadsheet could not be opened.');
  if (ss.getId() !== KS_P2.SPREADSHEET_ID) {
    throw new Error('Safety stop: spreadsheet ID does not match Phase 2 target.');
  }
  if (ss.getName().indexOf(KS_P2.EXPECTED_NAME_PREFIX) !== 0) {
    throw new Error('Safety stop: spreadsheet name does not match Kawad Swad workbook.');
  }
}

/**
 * Only adds warning-mode validations to existing columns found by exact header.
 * Existing values are not changed. Missing tabs/headers are logged and skipped.
 */
function ksP2InstallWarningValidations_(ss) {
  const rules = [
    {tab: 'Products', header: 'active', values: ['Yes', 'No', 'true', 'false']},
    {tab: 'Products', header: 'retail_pack_only', values: ['Yes', 'No', 'true', 'false']},
    {tab: 'Customers', header: 'active', values: ['Yes', 'No', 'true', 'false']},
    {tab: 'Suppliers', header: 'active', values: ['Yes', 'No', 'true', 'false']},
    {tab: 'RawMaterials', header: 'active', values: ['Yes', 'No', 'true', 'false']}
  ];

  rules.forEach(function(rule) {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(rule.tab);
    if (!sh) {
      Logger.log('Validation skipped: missing tab ' + rule.tab);
      return;
    }
    const col = ksP2FindHeaderColumn_(sh, rule.header);
    if (!col) {
      Logger.log('Validation skipped: missing header ' + rule.tab + '.' + rule.header);
      return;
    }
    const maxRows = Math.max(sh.getMaxRows(), 1000);
    if (sh.getMaxRows() < maxRows) sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(), maxRows - sh.getMaxRows());
    const validation = SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation()
      .requireValueInList(rule.values, true)
      .setAllowInvalid(true)
      .setHelpText('Use Yes/No for new entries. Existing values are preserved.')
      .build();
    sh.getRange(2, col, maxRows - 1, 1).setDataValidation(validation);
  });
}

function ksP2FindHeaderColumn_(sh, headerName) {
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (!lastCol) return 0;
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const index = headers.findIndex(function(v) {
    return String(v).trim().toLowerCase() === String(headerName).trim().toLowerCase();
  });
  return index < 0 ? 0 : index + 1;
}

/**
 * Allocate one new ID using the existing IdAllocations ledger.
 * Examples:
 *   ksP2AllocateId('Products')
 *   ksP2AllocateId('Customers')
 *   ksP2AllocateId('Suppliers')
 *   ksP2AllocateId('RawMaterials')
 *
 * Allocation reserves an ID but does not create a business record.
 * Never use this to backfill or replace historical IDs.
 */
function ksP2AllocateId(tableName) {
  const cfg = KS_P2_TABLES[tableName];
  if (!cfg || !cfg.prefix) throw new Error('Automatic ID allocation is not enabled for: ' + tableName + '. Supply an owner-approved ID.');

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P2.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    ksP2AssertWorkbook_(ss);

    const target = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
    const ledger = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P2.ALLOCATION_TAB);
    if (!target || !ledger) throw new Error('Required target or IdAllocations tab is missing.');

    const idCol = ksP2FindHeaderColumn_(target, cfg.idHeader);
    if (!idCol) throw new Error('Required ID header missing: ' + tableName + '.' + cfg.idHeader);

    const ledgerHeaders = ledger.getRange(1, 1, 1, ledger.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
    ['allocation_id', 'tab_name', 'allocated_id', 'nonce', 'created_at'].forEach(function(h) {
      if (ledgerHeaders.indexOf(h) < 0) throw new Error('IdAllocations missing header: ' + h);
    });

    const used = {};
    const targetLast = Math.min(target.getLastRow(), KS_P2.MAX_SCAN_ROWS);
    if (targetLast >= 2) {
      target.getRange(2, idCol, targetLast - 1, 1).getDisplayValues().forEach(function(r) {
        if (r[0]) used[String(r[0]).trim()] = true;
      });
    }

    const ledgerLast = Math.min(ledger.getLastRow(), KS_P2.MAX_SCAN_ROWS);
    const ledgerRows = ledgerLast >= 2
      ? ledger.getRange(2, 1, ledgerLast - 1, ledger.getLastColumn()).getValues()
      : [];
    const tabIndex = ledgerHeaders.indexOf('tab_name');
    const idIndex = ledgerHeaders.indexOf('allocated_id');
    const nonceIndex = ledgerHeaders.indexOf('nonce');
    ledgerRows.forEach(function(r) {
      if (r[tabIndex] === tableName && r[idIndex]) used[String(r[idIndex]).trim()] = true;
    });

    let max = 0;
    let width = 4;
    Object.keys(used).forEach(function(id) {
      const match = id.match(new RegExp('^' + cfg.prefix.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&') + '-(\\d+)$'));
      if (match) {
        max = Math.max(max, Number(match[1]));
        width = Math.max(width, match[1].length);
      }
    });

    let candidate;
    do {
      max += 1;
      candidate = cfg.prefix + '-' + String(max).padStart(width, '0');
    } while (used[candidate]);

    const nonce = Utilities.getUuid();
    const allocationId = 'ALC-' + Utilities.getUuid();
    const row = new Array(ledgerHeaders.length).fill('');
    row[ledgerHeaders.indexOf('allocation_id')] = allocationId;
    row[tabIndex] = tableName;
    row[idIndex] = candidate;
    row[nonceIndex] = nonce;
    row[ledgerHeaders.indexOf('created_at')] = new Date();

    ledger.appendRow(row);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    return {success: true, table: tableName, allocated_id: candidate, nonce: nonce};
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a new record only in the four approved master tabs.
 * Supply an object whose keys exactly match existing header names.
 * ID is allocated automatically if omitted.
 *
 * Example:
 * ksP2CreateMasterRecord('Products', {
 *   sku: 'KS-EXAMPLE-200',
 *   product_name: 'Example Product',
 *   category: 'Papad',
 *   variant: 'Plain',
 *   pack_weight_g: 200,
 *   selling_unit: 'packet',
 *   active: 'Yes'
 * });
 *
 * This function never edits an existing row.
 */
function ksP2CreateMasterRecord(tableName, record) {
  const cfg = KS_P2_TABLES[tableName];
  if (!cfg) throw new Error('Master record creation is not enabled for: ' + tableName);
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record)) {
    throw new Error('Record must be a plain object.');
  }

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P2.SPREADSHEET_ID);
    ksP2AssertWorkbook_(ss);
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
    if (!sh) throw new Error('Master tab not found: ' + tableName);

    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(function(h) {
      return String(h).trim();
    });
    const headerMap = {};
    headers.forEach(function(h, i) { if (h) headerMap[h] = i; });

    cfg.required.forEach(function(h) {
      if (headerMap[h] === undefined) throw new Error('Required header missing: ' + tableName + '.' + h);
    });

    Object.keys(record).forEach(function(k) {
      if (headerMap[k] === undefined) throw new Error('Unknown field, refusing to write: ' + k);
    });

    const clean = {};
    Object.keys(record).forEach(function(k) {
      clean[k] = record[k];
    });

    if (!clean[cfg.idHeader]) {
      // Reserve under the same script lock without recursively acquiring it.
      clean[cfg.idHeader] = ksP2AllocateIdUnderLock_(ss, tableName, cfg);
    }

    cfg.required.forEach(function(h) {
      if (clean[h] === undefined || clean[h] === null || String(clean[h]).trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('Required value missing: ' + h);
      }
    });

    const lastRow = Math.min(sh.getLastRow(), KS_P2.MAX_SCAN_ROWS);
    const rows = lastRow >= 2 ? sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastCol).getValues() : [];
    cfg.unique.forEach(function(uniqueHeader) {
      const idx = headerMap[uniqueHeader];
      const incoming = String(clean[uniqueHeader]).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (rows.some(function(r) { return String(r[idx] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === incoming; })) {
        throw new Error('Duplicate ' + uniqueHeader + ' refused: ' + clean[uniqueHeader]);
      }
    });

    const output = new Array(headers.length).fill('');
    Object.keys(clean).forEach(function(k) { output[headerMap[k]] = clean[k]; });

    sh.appendRow(output);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    return {success: true, table: tableName, id: clean[cfg.idHeader], row: sh.getLastRow()};
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/** Internal allocator used while ksP2CreateMasterRecord already holds the lock. */
function ksP2AllocateIdUnderLock_(ss, tableName, cfg) {
  if (!cfg.prefix) throw new Error('Automatic ID allocation is not enabled for ' + tableName + '. Supply an owner-approved ID.');
  const target = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
  const ledger = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P2.ALLOCATION_TAB);
  if (!target || !ledger) throw new Error('Required target or IdAllocations tab is missing.');

  const idCol = ksP2FindHeaderColumn_(target, cfg.idHeader);
  const ledgerHeaders = ledger.getRange(1, 1, 1, ledger.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const requiredLedger = ['allocation_id', 'tab_name', 'allocated_id', 'nonce', 'created_at'];
  requiredLedger.forEach(function(h) {
    if (ledgerHeaders.indexOf(h) < 0) throw new Error('IdAllocations missing header: ' + h);
  });

  const used = {};
  const targetLast = Math.min(target.getLastRow(), KS_P2.MAX_SCAN_ROWS);
  if (targetLast >= 2) {
    target.getRange(2, idCol, targetLast - 1, 1).getDisplayValues().forEach(function(r) {
      if (r[0]) used[String(r[0]).trim()] = true;
    });
  }

  const ledgerLast = Math.min(ledger.getLastRow(), KS_P2.MAX_SCAN_ROWS);
  const ledgerRows = ledgerLast >= 2
    ? ledger.getRange(2, 1, ledgerLast - 1, ledger.getLastColumn()).getValues()
    : [];
  const ti = ledgerHeaders.indexOf('tab_name');
  const ii = ledgerHeaders.indexOf('allocated_id');
  ledgerRows.forEach(function(r) {
    if (r[ti] === tableName && r[ii]) used[String(r[ii]).trim()] = true;
  });

  let max = 0;
  let width = 4;
  Object.keys(used).forEach(function(id) {
    const m = id.match(new RegExp('^' + cfg.prefix + '-(\\d+)$'));
    if (m) {
      max = Math.max(max, Number(m[1]));
      width = Math.max(width, m[1].length);
    }
  });
  let candidate;
  do {
    max += 1;
    candidate = cfg.prefix + '-' + String(max).padStart(width, '0');
  } while (used[candidate]);

  const row = new Array(ledgerHeaders.length).fill('');
  row[ledgerHeaders.indexOf('allocation_id')] = 'ALC-' + Utilities.getUuid();
  row[ti] = tableName;
  row[ii] = candidate;
  row[ledgerHeaders.indexOf('nonce')] = Utilities.getUuid();
  row[ledgerHeaders.indexOf('created_at')] = new Date();
  ledger.appendRow(row);
  return candidate;
}

function ksP2WriteOwnedTab_(ss, tabName, headers, rows) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(tabName);

  // Only the two Phase 2-owned tabs are cleared/refreshed.
  sh.clearContents();
  if (headers.length) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setFontWeight('bold');
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  }
  if (rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, headers.length).setValues(rows);
  }
  sh.autoResizeColumns(1, headers.length);
}

function ksP2AppendDeploymentLog_(ss, action, details) {
  const headers = ['timestamp', 'version', 'action', 'details', 'spreadsheet_id'];
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P2.LOG_TAB);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(KS_P2.LOG_TAB);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  }
  const existing = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, Math.max(sh.getLastColumn(), headers.length))
    .getDisplayValues()[0];
  headers.forEach(function(h) {
    if (existing.indexOf(h) < 0) throw new Error('Phase 2 deployment log header conflict: ' + h);
  });
  sh.appendRow([new Date(), KS_P2.VERSION, action, details, ss.getId()]);
}

/**
 * Read-only preview of current master tabs. Logs only counts and header names,
 * never cell values, employee details, credentials, phone numbers or GSTINs.
 */
function ksP2PreviewMasterData() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(KS_P2.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  ksP2AssertWorkbook_(ss);
  const result = {};
  Object.keys(KS_P2_TABLES).forEach(function(tabName) {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      result[tabName] = {exists: false};
      return;
    }
    const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
    result[tabName] = {
      exists: true,
      data_rows: Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1),
      headers: headers,
      required_headers_present: KS_P2_TABLES[tabName].required.every(function(h) {
        return headers.indexOf(h) >= 0;
      })
    };
  });
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - PHASE 3 INTEGRATED MASTER DATA
 * Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * Google Sheets remains the authoritative business record.
 *
 * Workstreams:
 *   1A - Controlled ID reservation (PRD, CUS, SUP)
 *   1B - Controlled Products and RawMaterials entry
 *   1C - Controlled Customers and Suppliers entry
 *   1D - Restricted Users profile updates (AuthUsers is never accessed)
 *
 * SAFETY:
 * - Never accesses AuthUsers.
 * - Users handler reads only user_id values and the selected safe profile field.
 * - Never reads/writes Users bank_details, document_references, role, active,
 *   username, salary fields, authentication data, or other restricted fields.
 * - Does not rename/delete/reorder tabs or alter existing headers.
 * - Does not edit existing business records, except a selected safe Users profile cell.
 * - New master records are appended only after validation.
 * - RawMaterials ID is owner-supplied pending resolution of the RWM prefix conflict.
 * - ScriptLock coordinates executions within this Apps Script project only.
 */

const KS_P3 = Object.freeze({

/* --------------------------- WORKBOOK GUARDS --------------------------- */

function ksP3GetWorkbook_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss || ss.getId() !== KS_P3.SPREADSHEET_ID) {
    throw new Error('SAFETY STOP: Workbook ID does not match the approved Kawad Swad workbook.');
  }
  if (ss.getName() !== KS_P3.EXPECTED_NAME) {
    throw new Error('SAFETY STOP: Workbook name does not exactly match the approved workbook.');
  }
  return ss;
}

function ksP3GetSheet_(ss, name) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Required sheet is missing: ' + name + '. No replacement sheet was created.');
  return sh;
}

function ksP3HeaderMap_(sh) {
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastCol < 1) throw new Error(sh.getName() + ' has no header row.');
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0].map(v => String(v).trim());
  const map = {};
  headers.forEach((h, i) => {
    if (!h) throw new Error(sh.getName() + ' has a blank header at column ' + (i + 1) + '.');
    if (map[h] !== undefined) throw new Error(sh.getName() + ' has duplicate header: ' + h);
    map[h] = i + 1;
  });
  return map;
}

function ksP3RequireHeaders_(sh, required) {
  const map = ksP3HeaderMap_(sh);
  const missing = required.filter(h => !map[h]);
  if (missing.length) {
    throw new Error('SAFETY STOP: ' + sh.getName() + ' is missing required live header(s): ' + missing.join(', '));
  }
  return map;
}

function ksP3Prompt_(ui, title, message, required) {
  const res = ui.prompt(title, message, ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL);
  if (res.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) throw new Error('Cancelled by user. No record created.');
  const value = String(res.getResponseText() || '').trim();
  if (required && !value) throw new Error('Required value was blank. No record created.');
  return value;
}

function ksP3PromptYesNo_(ui, title, message, defaultYes) {
  const label = defaultYes ? 'Y' : 'N';
  const value = ksP3Prompt_(ui, title, message + ' Enter Y or N. Default: ' + label, false).toUpperCase();
  if (!value) return defaultYes;
  if (value === 'Y' || value === 'YES') return true;
  if (value === 'N' || value === 'NO') return false;
  throw new Error('Enter Y or N. No record created.');
}

function ksP3Number_(value, field, required) {
  if (value === '' && !required) return '';
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) throw new Error(field + ' must be a valid non-negative number.');
  return n;
}

function ksP3Now_() {
  return new Date();
}

function ksP3Actor_() {
  // Email may be unavailable in some Google Workspace/personal-account contexts.
  return Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || 'UNAVAILABLE';
}

/* --------------------------- AUDIT LOG --------------------------- */

function ksP3AuditLog_(ss, action, entity, entityId, outcome, detail) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3.EVENT_TAB);
  const headers = ['event_id', 'event_at', 'actor', 'action', 'entity', 'entity_id', 'outcome', 'detail'];
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(KS_P3.EVENT_TAB);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  } else {
    const actual = ksP3HeaderMap_(sh);
    headers.forEach(h => { if (!actual[h]) throw new Error('Audit tab has unexpected structure. Missing: ' + h); });
  }
  sh.appendRow([
    'EVT-' + Utilities.getUuid(),
    ksP3Now_(),
    ksP3Actor_(),
    action,
    entity,
    entityId || '',
    outcome,
    detail || ''
  ]);
}

function KS_P3_RUN_MASTER_AUDIT() {
  const ss = ksP3GetWorkbook_();
  const targets = ['IdAllocations', 'Products', 'RawMaterials', 'Customers', 'Suppliers'];
  const rows = [];
  targets.forEach(name => {
    const sh = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, name);
    const map = ksP3HeaderMap_(sh);
    const required = name === 'IdAllocations'
      ? KS_P3.ALLOCATION_HEADERS
      : KS_P3.TABLES[name].required;
    const missing = required.filter(h => !map[h]);
    rows.push({
      tab: name,
      exists: true,
      physicalColumns: sh.getLastColumn(),
      headerCount: Object.keys(map).length,
      missingRequiredHeaders: missing,
      dataRows: Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1),
      result: missing.length ? 'STOP_REQUIRED_HEADER_MISSING' : 'STRUCTURE_OK'
    });
  });

  // Users: header-only check. Do not read employee rows.
  const users = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, 'Users');
  const userMap = ksP3HeaderMap_(users);
  const userRequired = ['user_id', 'full_name', 'mobile', 'email', 'designation', 'department'];
  const userMissing = userRequired.filter(h => !userMap[h]);
  rows.push({
    tab: 'Users',
    exists: true,
    physicalColumns: users.getLastColumn(),
    headerCount: Object.keys(userMap).length,
    missingRequiredHeaders: userMissing,
    dataRows: 'NOT_SCANNED',
    result: userMissing.length ? 'STOP_REQUIRED_HEADER_MISSING' : 'HEADER_ONLY_OK'
  });

  const reportHeaders = ['tab_name', 'exists', 'physical_columns', 'header_count',
                         'missing_required_headers', 'data_rows', 'result', 'checked_at'];
  let report = ss.getSheetByName(KS_P3.AUDIT_TAB);
  if (!report) report = ss.insertSheet(KS_P3.AUDIT_TAB);
  // This is a dedicated report tab. It is not a business table.
  report.clearContents();
  report.getRange(1, 1, 1, reportHeaders.length).setValues([reportHeaders]);
  const values = rows.map(r => [
    r.tab, r.exists, r.physicalColumns, r.headerCount,
    r.missingRequiredHeaders.join(', '), r.dataRows, r.result, ksP3Now_()
  ]);
  report.getRange(2, 1, values.length, reportHeaders.length).setValues(values);
  report.setFrozenRows(1);
  report.autoResizeColumns(1, reportHeaders.length);

  const allOk = rows.every(r => r.result === 'STRUCTURE_OK' || r.result === 'HEADER_ONLY_OK');
  console.log('KS_P3_MASTER_AUDIT_RESULT ' + JSON.stringify({
    success: allOk,
    status: allOk ? 'MASTER_DATA_STRUCTURE_AUDIT_PASSED' : 'MASTER_DATA_STRUCTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
    results: rows,
    usersDataRead: false,
    authUsersDataRead: false,
    businessRecordsChanged: false,
    businessHeadersChanged: false,
    reportTab: KS_P3.AUDIT_TAB
  }));
  return {success: allOk, results: rows, reportTab: KS_P3.AUDIT_TAB};
}

/* --------------------------- ID ALLOCATION --------------------------- */

function ksP3ReadColumnValues_(sh, col) {
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return [];
  return sh.getRange(2, col, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues()
    .map(r => String(r[0] || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function ksP3AllocateIdLocked_(ss, tableName) {
  const cfg = KS_P3.TABLES[tableName];
  if (!cfg || !cfg.prefix) {
    throw new Error('Automatic ID allocation is not approved for ' + tableName + '. Use an owner-approved ID.');
  }

  const target = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, tableName);
  const targetMap = ksP3RequireHeaders_(target, [cfg.idHeader]);
  const ledger = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, KS_P3.ALLOCATION_TAB);
  const ledgerMap = ksP3RequireHeaders_(ledger, KS_P3.ALLOCATION_HEADERS);

  const used = new Set(ksP3ReadColumnValues_(target, targetMap[cfg.idHeader]).map(v => v.toUpperCase()));
  const ledgerTabValues = ksP3ReadColumnValues_(ledger, ledgerMap.tab_name);
  const ledgerIdValues = ksP3ReadColumnValues_(ledger, ledgerMap.allocated_id);
  // Read the ledger's two relevant columns only, aligned by row.
  const ledgerLast = ledger.getLastRow();
  if (ledgerLast >= 2) {
    const tabVals = ledger.getRange(2, ledgerMap.tab_name, ledgerLast - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    const idVals = ledger.getRange(2, ledgerMap.allocated_id, ledgerLast - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < tabVals.length; i++) {
      if (String(tabVals[i][0]).trim() === tableName && String(idVals[i][0]).trim()) {
        used.add(String(idVals[i][0]).trim().toUpperCase());
      }
    }
  }

  let max = 0;
  let width = 4;
  const pattern = new RegExp('^' + cfg.prefix + '-(\\d+)$', 'i');
  used.forEach(id => {
    const m = id.match(pattern);
    if (m) {
      max = Math.max(max, Number(m[1]));
      width = Math.max(width, m[1].length);
    }
  });

  let candidate;
  do {
    max++;
    candidate = cfg.prefix + '-' + String(max).padStart(width, '0');
  } while (used.has(candidate.toUpperCase()));

  const nonce = Utilities.getUuid();
  const allocationId = 'ALC-' + Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 12).toUpperCase();
  const row = new Array(ledger.getLastColumn()).fill('');
  row[ledgerMap.allocation_id - 1] = allocationId;
  row[ledgerMap.tab_name - 1] = tableName;
  row[ledgerMap.allocated_id - 1] = candidate;
  row[ledgerMap.nonce - 1] = nonce;
  row[ledgerMap.created_at - 1] = ksP3Now_();
  ledger.appendRow(row);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  // Verify the exact claim row. Lock protects this script project, not other projects.
  const newRow = ledger.getLastRow();
  const verify = ledger.getRange(newRow, 1, 1, ledger.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
  if (String(verify[ledgerMap.nonce - 1]) !== nonce ||
      String(verify[ledgerMap.allocated_id - 1]) !== candidate ||
      String(verify[ledgerMap.tab_name - 1]) !== tableName) {
    throw new Error('ID reservation verification failed. Do not reuse the candidate; inspect IdAllocations.');
  }
  return candidate;
}

function ksP3ReserveId_(tableName) {
  const ss = ksP3GetWorkbook_();
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const id = ksP3AllocateIdLocked_(ss, tableName);
    ksP3AuditLog_(ss, 'RESERVE_ID', tableName, id, 'SUCCESS', 'ID reserved; no master record created.');
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('ID reserved: ' + id + '\nNo master record was created.');
    console.log('KS_P3_ID_RESERVED ' + JSON.stringify({table: tableName, id: id, success: true}));
    return id;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
function KS_P3_RESERVE_PRODUCT_ID() { return ksP3ReserveId_('Products'); }
function KS_P3_RESERVE_CUSTOMER_ID() { return ksP3ReserveId_('Customers'); }
function KS_P3_RESERVE_SUPPLIER_ID() { return ksP3ReserveId_('Suppliers'); }

/* --------------------------- RECORD WRITING --------------------------- */

function ksP3CheckUnique_(sh, headerMap, header, value) {
  const col = headerMap[header];
  if (!col) throw new Error('Unique-check header missing: ' + header);
  const existing = ksP3ReadColumnValues_(sh, col).map(v => v.toLowerCase());
  if (existing.indexOf(String(value).trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0) {
    throw new Error('Duplicate ' + header + ': ' + value + '. No record created.');
  }
}

function ksP3AppendByHeaders_(sh, headerMap, record) {
  const row = new Array(sh.getLastColumn()).fill('');
  Object.keys(record).forEach(key => {
    if (!headerMap[key]) throw new Error('Cannot write unknown live field: ' + key);
    row[headerMap[key] - 1] = record[key];
  });
  sh.appendRow(row);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return sh.getLastRow();
}

function ksP3CreateWithAllocatedId_(tableName, buildRecord) {
  const ss = ksP3GetWorkbook_();
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const sh = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, tableName);
    const cfg = KS_P3.TABLES[tableName];
    const map = ksP3RequireHeaders_(sh, cfg.required);
    const id = ksP3AllocateIdLocked_(ss, tableName);
    const record = buildRecord(ui, id);
    if (!record) return null;

    cfg.unique.forEach(h => {
      if (record[h] !== undefined && record[h] !== '') ksP3CheckUnique_(sh, map, h, record[h]);
    });
    record[cfg.idHeader] = id;
    const rowNumber = ksP3AppendByHeaders_(sh, map, record);
    ksP3AuditLog_(ss, 'CREATE_MASTER_RECORD', tableName, id, 'SUCCESS',
                  'New record appended at row ' + rowNumber + '. No existing record changed.');
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    ui.alert(tableName + ' created successfully.\nID: ' + id + '\nRow: ' + rowNumber);
    console.log('KS_P3_MASTER_RECORD_CREATED ' + JSON.stringify({
      table: tableName, id: id, row: rowNumber, success: true
    }));
    return id;
  } catch (err) {
    // If an ID was reserved before the user cancelled or validation failed,
    // that ID remains in IdAllocations as a harmless reserved/unused claim.
    console.error('KS_P3_CREATE_FAILED ' + JSON.stringify({
      table: tableName, message: String(err.message || err)
    }));
    throw err;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function KS_P3_ADD_PRODUCT() {
  return ksP3CreateWithAllocatedId_('Products', function(ui, id) {
    const sku = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Product SKU (must be unique):', true);
    const productName = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Product name:', true);
    const category = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Category:', true);
    const variant = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Variant:', true);
    const weight = ksP3Number_(ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Pack weight in grams:', true), 'Pack weight', true);
    const unit = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Selling unit (for example, pack):', true);
    const retailOnly = ksP3PromptYesNo_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Retail pack only?', false);
    const active = ksP3PromptYesNo_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Set product active?', true);
    const notes = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Product', 'Notes (optional):', false);
    return {
      sku: sku, product_name: productName, category: category, variant: variant,
      pack_weight_g: weight, selling_unit: unit,
      retail_pack_only: retailOnly, active: active, notes: notes
    };
  });
}

function KS_P3_ADD_RAW_MATERIAL() {
  const ss = ksP3GetWorkbook_();
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const sh = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, 'RawMaterials');
  const map = ksP3RequireHeaders_(sh, KS_P3.TABLES.RawMaterials.required);
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    const id = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material',
      'Enter an owner-approved Raw Material ID.\nAutomatic RWM allocation is disabled pending prefix-policy approval:', true);
    ksP3CheckUnique_(sh, map, 'raw_material_id', id);
    const name = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Material name:', true);
    const unit = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Unit (kg, g, litre, piece, etc.):', true);
    const category = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Category (optional):', false);
    const rateText = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Rate per unit (leave blank if not approved/known):', false);
    const rate = rateText ? ksP3Number_(rateText, 'Rate per unit', true) : '';
    const rateStatus = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Rate status (optional, exact business wording):', false);
    const minText = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Minimum stock (leave blank if not set):', false);
    const minStock = minText ? ksP3Number_(minText, 'Minimum stock', true) : '';
    const active = ksP3PromptYesNo_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Set material active?', true);
    const notes = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Add Raw Material', 'Notes (optional):', false);

    const record = {
      raw_material_id: id, material_name: name, unit: unit,
      // No opening/current stock initialization here. Stock must enter through
      // the approved opening-stock or stock-ledger workflow.
      opening_stock: '', current_stock: '', minimum_stock: minStock,
      active: active, notes: notes, rate_per_unit: rate,
      rate_status: rateStatus, category: category,
      created_at: ksP3Now_(), created_by: ksP3Actor_()
    };
    const rowNumber = ksP3AppendByHeaders_(sh, map, record);
    ksP3AuditLog_(ss, 'CREATE_MASTER_RECORD', 'RawMaterials', id, 'SUCCESS',
                  'New raw material appended at row ' + rowNumber + '; stock balances left blank.');
    ui.alert('Raw Material created.\nID: ' + id + '\nRow: ' + rowNumber +
             '\nOpening/current stock were left blank.');
    console.log('KS_P3_MASTER_RECORD_CREATED ' + JSON.stringify({
      table: 'RawMaterials', id: id, row: rowNumber, success: true,
      stockInitialized: false
    }));
    return id;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/* --------------------------- USERS SAFE PROFILE --------------------------- */

function KS_P3_UPDATE_USER_PROFILE() {
  const ss = ksP3GetWorkbook_();
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const sh = ksP3GetSheet_(ss, 'Users');
  const map = ksP3RequireHeaders_(sh, ['user_id'].concat(Object.keys(KS_P3.USER_SAFE_FIELDS)));
  const userId = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Safe User Profile Update', 'Enter the exact user_id:', true);

  // Read only user_id column to locate the row. Do not read complete employee rows.
  const lastUserRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const idCells = lastUserRow >= 2
    ? sh.getRange(2, map.user_id, lastUserRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues()
    : [];
  const matches = [];
  idCells.forEach((r, i) => {
    const v = String(r[0] || '').trim();
    if (v.toLowerCase() === userId.toLowerCase()) matches.push(i + 2);
  });
  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(matches.length === 0
      ? 'User ID not found. No changes made.'
      : 'Duplicate user_id found. No changes made; resolve through an approved data repair process.');
  }

  const fieldChoices = Object.keys(KS_P3.USER_SAFE_FIELDS);
  const choiceText = fieldChoices.map((f, i) => (i + 1) + '. ' + KS_P3.USER_SAFE_FIELDS[f] + ' (' + f + ')').join('\n');
  const choice = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Safe User Profile Update',
    'Choose one field by number:\n' + choiceText, true);
  const n = Number(choice);
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n > fieldChoices.length) throw new Error('Invalid field selection. No changes made.');
  const field = fieldChoices[n - 1];
  const newValue = ksP3Prompt_(ui, 'Safe User Profile Update',
    'Enter new value for ' + KS_P3.USER_SAFE_FIELDS[field] + ':', true);

  // Only the selected cell is written. No full-row read or rewrite.
  const row = matches[0];
  const oldValue = sh.getRange(row, map[field]).getDisplayValue();
  sh.getRange(row, map[field]).setValue(newValue);
  if (map.updated_at) sh.getRange(row, map.updated_at).setValue(ksP3Now_());
  ksP3AuditLog_(ss, 'UPDATE_SAFE_USER_PROFILE', 'Users', userId, 'SUCCESS',
                'Updated field ' + field + '. Old/new values intentionally omitted from audit log.');
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  ui.alert('User profile updated.\nUser ID: ' + userId + '\nField: ' + field);
  console.log('KS_P3_USER_PROFILE_UPDATED ' + JSON.stringify({
    userId: userId, field: field, success: true,
    authUsersAccessed: false, sensitiveFieldsRead: false
  }));
}

 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - MANUFACTURING, QUALITY HOLD/RELEASE & PACKAGING ENGINE

/**
 * 1. Creates a Production Order linked to an approved RecipeVersion (POL-010).
 */
function ksCreateProductionOrder(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION], 'ksCreateProductionOrder');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.product_id || !payload.recipe_id || !payload.recipe_version_id) {
    throw new Error('product_id, recipe_id, and approved recipe_version_id are required (POL-010).');
  }
  const plannedQty = Number(payload.planned_quantity_kg);
  if (!(plannedQty > 0)) throw new Error('planned_quantity_kg must be > 0.');

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const poAlloc = ksAllocateId('ProductionOrders', payload.nonce + '_PO');
  const poId = poAlloc.allocated_id;

  const poRecord = {
    record_id: poId,
    production_order_id: poId,
    order_number: payload.order_number || poId,
    production_plan_id: payload.production_plan_id || '',
    product_id: String(payload.product_id).trim(),
    recipe_id: String(payload.recipe_id).trim(),
    recipe_version_id: String(payload.recipe_version_id).trim(),
    planned_quantity_kg: plannedQty,
    scheduled_start: payload.scheduled_start || nowIso,
    scheduled_end: payload.scheduled_end || '',
    actual_start: payload.actual_start || '',
    actual_end: '',
    supervisor_user_id: payload.supervisor_user_id || ctx.user_id,
    status: 'APPROVED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'ProductionOrders', poRecord, 'production_order_id', [
    'production_order_id', 'product_id', 'recipe_version_id', 'planned_quantity_kg'
  ]);

  ksLogAudit_('PRODUCTION_ORDER_CREATED', 'ProductionOrders', poId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'planned_quantity_kg',
    new_value: plannedQty + ' KG',
    reason: 'RecipeVersion=' + poRecord.recipe_version_id
  });

  return { success: true, production_order_id: poId, planned_quantity_kg: plannedQty };
}

/**
 * 2. Records Raw Material Consumption against a Production Batch & Lot,
 * and posts a PRODUCTION_ISSUE outbound movement in InventoryMovements (POL-005, REQ-026, REQ-039).
 */
function ksRecordProductionConsumption(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION, KS_ROLES.STORE], 'ksRecordProductionConsumption');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.production_batch_id || !payload.raw_material_id || !payload.inventory_lot_id) {
    throw new Error('production_batch_id, raw_material_id, and inventory_lot_id are required for traceability.');
  }

  const plannedQty = Number(payload.planned_quantity) || 0;
  const actualQty = Number(payload.actual_quantity);
  if (!(actualQty > 0)) throw new Error('actual_quantity must be > 0.');
  const unit = String(payload.unit || 'KG').trim();

  // Verify lot has sufficient movement-led balance before issuing (POL-005)
  const lotBal = ksGetMovementLedStockBalance(payload.raw_material_id, payload.inventory_lot_id);
  if (lotBal.balance < actualQty) {
    const msg = 'Insufficient stock in lot ' + payload.inventory_lot_id + ': available=' + lotBal.balance + ', requested=' + actualQty;
    ksLogException_('HIGH', 'ksRecordProductionConsumption', 'InventoryMovements', payload.inventory_lot_id, msg, payload);
    throw new Error(msg);
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const consAlloc = ksAllocateId('MaterialConsumption', payload.nonce + '_MCON');
  const movAlloc = ksAllocateId('InventoryMovements', payload.nonce + '_MOV');
  const consId = consAlloc.allocated_id;
  const movId = movAlloc.allocated_id;
  const varianceQty = Math.round((actualQty - plannedQty) * 1000) / 1000;

  const consRecord = {
    record_id: consId,
    consumption_id: consId,
    production_batch_id: String(payload.production_batch_id).trim(),
    material_issue_id: payload.material_issue_id || '',
    raw_material_id: String(payload.raw_material_id).trim(),
    inventory_lot_id: String(payload.inventory_lot_id).trim(),
    planned_quantity: plannedQty,
    actual_quantity: actualQty,
    unit: unit,
    variance_quantity: varianceQty,
    recorded_by: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  const movRecord = {
    record_id: movId,
    movement_id: movId,
    movement_datetime: nowIso,
    item_type: 'RAW_MATERIAL',
    item_id: consRecord.raw_material_id,
    inventory_lot_id: consRecord.inventory_lot_id,
    movement_type: 'PRODUCTION_ISSUE',
    quantity_in: 0,
    quantity_out: actualQty,
    unit: unit,
    from_location_id: payload.warehouse_id || 'WH-MAIN',
    to_location_id: 'PRODUCTION_FLOOR',
    reference_type: 'PRODUCTION_BATCH',
    reference_id: consRecord.production_batch_id,
    unit_cost: Number(payload.unit_cost) || 0,
    total_cost: Math.round(actualQty * (Number(payload.unit_cost) || 0) * 100) / 100,
    performed_by: ctx.user_id,
    approved_by: '',
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Consumption ' + consId
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'MaterialConsumption', consRecord, 'consumption_id', ['consumption_id', 'production_batch_id', 'actual_quantity']);
  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'InventoryMovements', movRecord, 'movement_id', ['movement_id', 'inventory_lot_id', 'movement_type']);

  ksLogAudit_('MATERIAL_CONSUMED', 'MaterialConsumption', consId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'actual_quantity',
    new_value: actualQty + ' ' + unit + ' (var=' + varianceQty + ')',
    related_record_id: movId
  });

  return { success: true, consumption_id: consId, movement_id: movId, variance_quantity: varianceQty };
}

/**

 */
function ksRecordProductionOutputAndLoss(payload) {
