/**
 * 4. Independent Quality Inspection & Lot Release (POL-011 Segregation of Duties).
 * Production Supervisors cannot call this unless explicitly granted QUALITY or OWNER_ADMIN role.
 */
function ksRecordQualityRelease(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.QUALITY], 'ksRecordQualityRelease');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.product_lot_id || !payload.release_status) {
    throw new Error('product_lot_id and release_status (RELEASED | ON_HOLD | REJECTED) are required.');
  }

  const decision = String(payload.release_status).trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!['RELEASED', 'ON_HOLD', 'REJECTED'].includes(decision)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid release_status: ' + decision);
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const qcAlloc = ksAllocateId('FinishedGoodsQualityChecks', payload.nonce + '_FGQC');
  const qcId = qcAlloc.allocated_id;

  const qcRecord = {
    record_id: qcId,
    finished_qc_id: qcId,
    product_lot_id: String(payload.product_lot_id).trim(),
    check_datetime: nowIso,
    parameter_name: payload.parameter_name || 'MOISTURE_AND_SENSORY',
    measured_value: String(payload.measured_value || 'PASS').trim(),
    unit: payload.unit || '',
    result: decision === 'RELEASED' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL',
    checked_by: ctx.user_id,
    release_status: decision,
    approved_by: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'FinishedGoodsQualityChecks', qcRecord, 'finished_qc_id', ['finished_qc_id', 'product_lot_id', 'release_status']);

  // Update quality_status on the matching InventoryLots row
  const lotSheet = ss.getSheetByName('InventoryLots');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(lotSheet, ['inventory_lot_id', 'quality_status']);
  const lastRow = lotSheet.getLastRow();
  let updatedLot = false;

  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    const lotIds = lotSheet.getRange(2, headerMap['inventory_lot_id'], lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < lotIds.length; i++) {
      if (String(lotIds[i][0]).trim() === qcRecord.product_lot_id) {
        lotSheet.getRange(i + 2, headerMap['quality_status']).setValue(decision);
        updatedLot = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!updatedLot) {
    throw new Error('Lot "' + qcRecord.product_lot_id + '" not found in InventoryLots.');
  }

  ksLogAudit_('QUALITY_RELEASE_DECISION', 'InventoryLots', qcRecord.product_lot_id, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'quality_status',
    old_value: 'PENDING_QC',
    new_value: decision,
    approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    related_record_id: qcId
  });

  return { success: true, finished_qc_id: qcId, product_lot_id: qcRecord.product_lot_id, release_status: decision };
}

/**
 * 5. Converts Released Bulk Lot into Packaged Retail SKUs (200g, 500g, 1000g) (Section 2.4, REQ-029).
 */
function ksRecordPackagingOutput(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PACKAGING], 'ksRecordPackagingOutput');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.packaging_batch_id || !payload.bulk_lot_id || !payload.product_id || !payload.sku) {
    throw new Error('packaging_batch_id, bulk_lot_id, product_id, and sku are required.');
  }

  const packWeightG = Number(payload.pack_weight_g);
  const packetCount = Number(payload.packet_count);
  if (![200, 500, 1000].includes(packWeightG)) {
    throw new Error('Retail pack_weight_g must be 200, 500, or 1000 grams (per retail rule).');
  }
  if (!(packetCount > 0)) throw new Error('packet_count must be > 0.');

  const netWeightKg = Math.round(((packWeightG * packetCount) / 1000) * 1000) / 1000;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

  // Verify source bulk lot is RELEASED before packaging
  const lotSheet = ss.getSheetByName('InventoryLots');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(lotSheet, ['inventory_lot_id', 'quality_status']);
  const lotRows = lotSheet.getRange(2, 1, Math.max(1, lotSheet.getLastRow() - 1), lotSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  const bulkRow = lotRows.find(r => String(r[headerMap['inventory_lot_id'] - 1]).trim() === String(payload.bulk_lot_id).trim());
  if (!bulkRow) throw new Error('Source bulk_lot_id "' + payload.bulk_lot_id + '" not found.');
  if (String(bulkRow[headerMap['quality_status'] - 1]).trim() !== 'RELEASED') {
    throw new Error('Quality Gate Blocked: Bulk lot "' + payload.bulk_lot_id + '" is not RELEASED (DB-05 / POL-011).');
  }

  // 1. Issue bulk weight out of InventoryMovements
  const bulkOutAlloc = ksAllocateId('InventoryMovements', payload.nonce + '_BULK_OUT');
  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'InventoryMovements', {
    record_id: bulkOutAlloc.allocated_id,
    movement_id: bulkOutAlloc.allocated_id,
    movement_datetime: nowIso,
    item_type: 'BULK_FG',
    item_id: payload.product_id,
    inventory_lot_id: payload.bulk_lot_id,
    movement_type: 'PACKAGING_ISSUE',
    quantity_in: 0,
    quantity_out: netWeightKg,
    unit: 'KG',
    from_location_id: payload.from_warehouse_id || 'WH-BULK',
    to_location_id: 'PACKAGING_LINE',
    reference_type: 'PACKAGING_BATCH',
    reference_id: payload.packaging_batch_id,
    unit_cost: 0,
    total_cost: 0,
    performed_by: ctx.user_id,
    approved_by: '',
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Issued for SKU ' + payload.sku
  }, 'movement_id', ['movement_id', 'inventory_lot_id']);

  // 2. Create finished packaged SKU lot & movement
  const fgLotRes = ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt({
    nonce: payload.nonce + '_FG_PKT',
    item_type: 'PACKAGED_SKU',
    item_id: payload.sku,
    lot_number: payload.fg_lot_number || ('FG-' + payload.packaging_batch_id),
    quantity_received: packetCount,
    unit: 'PKT',
    unit_cost: Number(payload.unit_cost) || 0,
    quality_status: 'RELEASED',
    movement_type: 'PACKAGING_OUTPUT',
    from_location_id: 'PACKAGING_LINE',
    warehouse_id: payload.to_warehouse_id || 'WH-FG-MAIN',
    reference_type: 'PACKAGING_BATCH',
    reference_id: payload.packaging_batch_id,
    notes: 'Packaged from bulk lot ' + payload.bulk_lot_id
  });

  // 3. Record PackagingOutputs line
  const pkOutAlloc = ksAllocateId('PackagingOutputs', payload.nonce + '_PKOUT');
  const pkOutId = pkOutAlloc.allocated_id;
  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'PackagingOutputs', {
    record_id: pkOutId,
    packaging_output_id: pkOutId,
    packaging_batch_id: String(payload.packaging_batch_id).trim(),
    product_id: String(payload.product_id).trim(),
    sku: String(payload.sku).trim(),
    product_lot_id: fgLotRes.inventory_lot_id,
    pack_weight_g: packWeightG,
    packet_count: packetCount,
    net_weight_kg: netWeightKg,
    recorded_by: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'POSTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Source bulk lot: ' + payload.bulk_lot_id
  }, 'packaging_output_id', ['packaging_output_id', 'packaging_batch_id', 'sku', 'packet_count']);

  return {
    success: true,
    packaging_output_id: pkOutId,
    finished_sku_lot_id: fgLotRes.inventory_lot_id,
    packet_count: packetCount,
    net_weight_kg: netWeightKg
  };
}

/**
 * End-to-End Phase G Disposable-Copy Verification Test for Production -> QC Release -> Packaging.
 */
function ksRunPhaseGProductionAndPackagingTest() {
  // 1. Create Production Order
  const po = ksCreateProductionOrder({
    nonce: 'TEST_PO_001',
    product_id: 'PRD-MMP',
    recipe_id: 'RCP-MMP',
    recipe_version_id: 'RCP-MMP-V1',
    planned_quantity_kg: 100
  });

  // 2. Consume 60 KG from our earlier test raw material lot (LOT-20261118-00001)
  const cons = ksRecordProductionConsumption({
    nonce: 'TEST_MCON_001',
    production_batch_id: po.production_order_id,
    raw_material_id: 'RM-TEST-MOONG-DAL',
    inventory_lot_id: 'LOT-20261118-00001',
    planned_quantity: 60,
    actual_quantity: 60,
    unit: 'KG',
    unit_cost: 92.5
  });

  // 3. Record 95 KG Bulk Production Output + 5 KG Process Loss (held as PENDING_QC)
  const out = ksRecordProductionOutputAndLoss({
    nonce: 'TEST_POUT_001',
    production_batch_id: po.production_order_id,
    product_id: 'PRD-MMP',
    output_quantity_kg: 95,
    loss_quantity_kg: 5,
    loss_stage: 'DRYING',
    loss_reason: 'Standard moisture evaporation'
  });

  // 4. Independent Quality Release of Bulk Lot
  const qc = ksRecordQualityRelease({
    nonce: 'TEST_FGQC_001',
    product_lot_id: out.output_lot_id,
    release_status: 'RELEASED',
    measured_value: 'Moisture 11.2% - PASS'
  });

  // 5. Convert 50 KG of Released Bulk Lot into 250 x 200g packets (KS-MMP-200)
  const pkg = ksRecordPackagingOutput({
    nonce: 'TEST_PKOUT_001',
    packaging_batch_id: 'PKB-TEST-001',
    bulk_lot_id: out.output_lot_id,
    product_id: 'PRD-MMP',
    sku: 'KS-MMP-200',
    pack_weight_g: 200,
    packet_count: 250
  });

  Logger.log('Phase G Production & Packaging Test Passed: ' + JSON.stringify({ po: po, cons: cons, out: out, qc: qc, pkg: pkg }));
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - SECTION 11.6 EDGE-CASE TEST SUITE & PHASE H RELEASE GATE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-003..018, Section 11.6, Section 11.7, Section 16.1
 * Validates that every guardrail blocks invalid/unauthorized/duplicate actions and logs
 * formal test & release readiness evidence.
 */

function ksAssertThrows_(testName, fn) {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (e) {
    return { test: testName, status: 'PASS_BLOCKED_AS_EXPECTED', blocked_reason: e.message };
  }
  throw new Error('SECURITY / VALIDATION TEST FAILED: "' + testName + '" succeeded when it should have been blocked!');
}

/**
 * Runs the complete Section 11.6 Negative & Edge-Case Verification Suite in the disposable copy.
 */
function ksRunSection11_6EdgeCaseTestSuite() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksRunSection11_6EdgeCaseTestSuite');
  const results = [];
  const today = ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);

  // TEST 1: Duplicate Request / Idempotency Retry Safety (POL-002, REQ-101)
  const retryNonce = 'EDGE_NONCE_RETRY_' + Date.now();
  const id1 = ksAllocateId('Customers', retryNonce);
  const id2 = ksAllocateId('Customers', retryNonce);
  if (id1.allocated_id !== id2.allocated_id || id2.status !== 'EXISTING_IDEMPOTENT') {
    throw new Error('TEST 1 FAILED: Duplicate nonce created a second ID!');
  }
  results.push({ test: '1_IDEMPOTENT_RETRY', status: 'PASS', allocated_id: id1.allocated_id });

  // TEST 2: Missing Mandatory Field Rejection (POL-003)
  results.push(ksAssertThrows_('2_MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD', function() {
    ksCreateSalesOrder({ nonce: 'EDGE_MISSING_' + Date.now(), customer_id: '', items: [] });
  }));

  // TEST 3: Stock Overdraft Block (POL-005)

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - MANAGEMENT REPORTS & DAILY CLOSING ENGINE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-001, POL-008, POL-014, Section 12.1..12.5, REQ-040, REQ-072
 * Generates derived reporting views from posted source ledgers without overwriting transaction history.
 */

/**
 * Helper: Creates or refreshes a clearly labeled Reporting View tab (Section 3.10 & 12.5).
 * Never touches authoritative transaction tables.
 */
function ksWriteReportView_(reportTabName, title, metadataRows, tableHeaders, tableRows) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(reportTabName);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(reportTabName);
  } else {
    sh.clearContents();
  }

  const output = [];
  output.push([title]);
  metadataRows.forEach(m => output.push(m));
  output.push([]); // Blank separator row
  output.push(tableHeaders);

  if (tableRows.length === 0) {
    const emptyRow = new Array(tableHeaders.length).fill('');
    emptyRow[0] = 'No posted records found for this scope.';
    output.push(emptyRow);
  } else {
    tableRows.forEach(r => output.push(r));
  }

  const maxCols = Math.max(tableHeaders.length, 2);
  const normalized = output.map(row => {
    const copy = row.slice();
    while (copy.length < maxCols) copy.push('');
    return copy;
  });

  sh.getRange(1, 1, normalized.length, maxCols).setValues(normalized);
  sh.getRange(1, 1).setFontWeight('bold').setFontSize(12);
  const headerRowIdx = metadataRows.length + 3;
  sh.getRange(headerRowIdx, 1, 1, tableHeaders.length).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#e8f5e9');
  sh.setFrozenRows(headerRowIdx);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return sh;
}

/**
 * 1. TRIAL BALANCE REPORT (REQ-017, REQ-072, Section 12.3 & 12.5)
 * Aggregates all POSTED JournalEntryLines by account code and verifies Total Debits === Total Credits.
 */
function ksGenerateTrialBalanceReport(asOfDateStr) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS, KS_ROLES.AUDITOR],
    'ksGenerateTrialBalanceReport'
  );

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const asOf = asOfDateStr || ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

  const jelSheet = ss.getSheetByName('JournalEntryLines');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(jelSheet, ['item_type', 'item_id', 'unit_rate', 'status', 'created_at']);
  const lastRow = jelSheet.getLastRow();

  const accountMap = {}; // { account_code: { debitPaise, creditPaise } }
  let totalDebitPaise = 0;
  let totalCreditPaise = 0;

  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    const rows = jelSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, jelSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (String(r[headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim() !== 'POSTED') return;
      const acct = String(r[headerMap['item_id'] - 1] || 'UNCLASSIFIED').trim();
      const side = String(r[headerMap['item_type'] - 1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const amt = Number(r[headerMap['unit_rate'] - 1]) || 0;
      const paise = Math.round(amt * 100);

      if (!accountMap[acct]) accountMap[acct] = { debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 0 };
      if (side === 'DEBIT') {
        accountMap[acct].debitPaise += paise;
        totalDebitPaise += paise;
      } else if (side === 'CREDIT') {
        accountMap[acct].creditPaise += paise;
        totalCreditPaise += paise;
      }
    });
  }

  const sortedAccounts = Object.keys(accountMap).sort();
  const tableRows = sortedAccounts.map(acct => {
    const dr = accountMap[acct].debitPaise / 100;
    const cr = accountMap[acct].creditPaise / 100;
    const net = (accountMap[acct].debitPaise - accountMap[acct].creditPaise) / 100;
    return [
      acct,
      dr,
      cr,
      net >= 0 ? net : 0,
      net < 0 ? Math.abs(net) : 0
    ];
  });

  const isBalanced = (totalDebitPaise === totalCreditPaise);
  const diffRupees = (totalDebitPaise - totalCreditPaise) / 100;

  tableRows.push([
    'TOTAL',
    totalDebitPaise / 100,
    totalCreditPaise / 100,
    '',
    ''
  ]);

  if (!isBalanced) {
    ksLogException_(
      'CRITICAL',
      'ksGenerateTrialBalanceReport',
      'JournalEntryLines',
      asOf,
      'Trial Balance out of balance by INR ' + diffRupees.toFixed(2),
      { total_debit: totalDebitPaise / 100, total_credit: totalCreditPaise / 100 }
    );
  }

  const meta = [
    ['Report Status', 'DERIVED SNAPSHOT (NOT SOURCE TRANSACTION) | Basis: POSTED / ACTUAL'],
    ['As-Of Date', asOf],
    ['Generated At', nowIso + ' by ' + ctx.user_id],
    ['Data Source', 'JournalEntryLines (status = POSTED)'],
    ['Balance Check', isBalanced ? 'BALANCED (Total Debits === Total Credits)' : 'UNBALANCED EXCEPTION: Diff INR ' + diffRupees.toFixed(2)]
  ];

  ksWriteReportView_(
    'RPT_TrialBalance',
    'KAWAD SWAD - TRIAL BALANCE REPORT',
    meta,
    ['Account Code', 'Total Debit (INR)', 'Total Credit (INR)', 'Closing Debit (INR)', 'Closing Credit (INR)'],
    tableRows
  );

  ksLogAudit_('REPORT_GENERATED', 'RPT_TrialBalance', asOf, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'balance_check',
    new_value: isBalanced ? 'BALANCED' : 'UNBALANCED (' + diffRupees.toFixed(2) + ')'
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    report_tab: 'RPT_TrialBalance',
    balanced: isBalanced,
    total_debit: totalDebitPaise / 100,
    total_credit: totalCreditPaise / 100
  };
}

/**
 * 2. LIVE STOCK STATUS & LOT QUALITY REPORT (POL-005, REQ-030, REQ-038, Section 12.1)
 * Derives live balances strictly from InventoryMovements joined with InventoryLots quality status.
 */
function ksGenerateStockStatusReport() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.STORE, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION, KS_ROLES.PACKAGING, KS_ROLES.SALES, KS_ROLES.AUDITOR],
    'ksGenerateStockStatusReport'
  );

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

  // Read lot metadata
  const lotSheet = ss.getSheetByName('InventoryLots');
  const lotMapInfo = ksGetHeaderMap_(lotSheet, ['inventory_lot_id', 'item_type', 'item_id', 'lot_number', 'warehouse_id', 'unit', 'quality_status']);
  const lotMeta = {};
  if (lotSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const lRows = lotSheet.getRange(2, 1, lotSheet.getLastRow() - 1, lotSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    lRows.forEach(r => {
      const id = String(r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['inventory_lot_id'] - 1]).trim();
      if (!id) return;
      lotMeta[id] = {
        item_type: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['item_type'] - 1],
        item_id: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['item_id'] - 1],
        lot_number: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['lot_number'] - 1],
        warehouse_id: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['warehouse_id'] - 1],
        unit: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['unit'] - 1],
        quality_status: r[lotMapInfo.headerMap['quality_status'] - 1]
      };
    });
  }

  // Aggregate posted movements by lot
  const movSheet = ss.getSheetByName('InventoryMovements');
  const movMapInfo = ksGetHeaderMap_(movSheet, ['inventory_lot_id', 'item_type', 'item_id', 'quantity_in', 'quantity_out', 'unit', 'status']);
  const lotBalances = {};

  if (movSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const mRows = movSheet.getRange(2, 1, movSheet.getLastRow() - 1, movSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    mRows.forEach(r => {
      if (String(r[movMapInfo.headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim() !== 'POSTED') return;
      const lotId = String(r[movMapInfo.headerMap['inventory_lot_id'] - 1]).trim();
      if (!lotBalances[lotId]) {
        const meta = lotMeta[lotId] || {};
        lotBalances[lotId] = {
          item_type: meta.item_type || r[movMapInfo.headerMap['item_type'] - 1],
          item_id: meta.item_id || r[movMapInfo.headerMap['item_id'] - 1],
          lot_number: meta.lot_number || lotId,
          warehouse_id: meta.warehouse_id || '',
          unit: meta.unit || r[movMapInfo.headerMap['unit'] - 1],
          quality_status: meta.quality_status || 'UNKNOWN',
          total_in: 0,
          total_out: 0
        };
      }
      lotBalances[lotId].total_in += Number(r[movMapInfo.headerMap['quantity_in'] - 1]) || 0;
      lotBalances[lotId].total_out += Number(r[movMapInfo.headerMap['quantity_out'] - 1]) || 0;
    });
  }

  const tableRows = Object.keys(lotBalances).sort().map(lotId => {
    const b = lotBalances[lotId];
    const closing = Math.round((b.total_in - b.total_out) * 1000) / 1000;
    const saleable = (String(b.quality_status).toUpperCase() === 'RELEASED' && closing > 0) ? closing : 0;
    return [
      lotId,
      b.item_type,
      b.item_id,
      b.lot_number,
      b.warehouse_id,
      b.quality_status,
      b.unit,
      Math.round(b.total_in * 1000) / 1000,
      Math.round(b.total_out * 1000) / 1000,
      closing,
      saleable
    ];
  });

  const meta = [
    ['Report Status', 'DERIVED MOVEMENT-LED STOCK VIEW | Basis: POSTED MOVEMENTS'],
    ['Generated At', nowIso + ' by ' + ctx.user_id],
    ['Data Source', 'InventoryMovements (POSTED) + InventoryLots'],
    ['Control Rule', 'Only lots with quality_status = RELEASED appear under Saleable / Usable Qty (POL-005 / DB-05)']
  ];

  ksWriteReportView_(
    'RPT_StockStatus',
    'KAWAD SWAD - LOT-WISE STOCK & QUALITY STATUS',
    meta,
    ['Inventory Lot ID', 'Item Type', 'Item / SKU ID', 'Lot Number', 'Warehouse', 'QC Status', 'Unit', 'Total In', 'Total Out', 'Closing Balance', 'Saleable / Usable Qty'],
    tableRows
  );

  return { success: true, report_tab: 'RPT_StockStatus', lot_count: tableRows.length };
}

/**
 * 3. DAILY SALES, COLLECTIONS & CUSTOMER OUTSTANDING SUMMARY (REQ-040, REQ-044, Section 12.1)
 */
function ksGenerateDailySalesAndReceivablesReport(targetDateStr) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS, KS_ROLES.SALES, KS_ROLES.AUDITOR],
    'ksGenerateDailySalesAndReceivablesReport'
  );

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const targetDate = targetDateStr || ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

  const invSheet = ss.getSheetByName('SalesInvoices');
  const invMap = ksGetHeaderMap_(invSheet, ['sales_invoice_id', 'invoice_date', 'customer_id', 'taxable_value', 'total_tax', 'invoice_total', 'status']);

  const allocSheet = ss.getSheetByName('CustomerPaymentAllocations');
  const allocMap = ksGetHeaderMap_(allocSheet, ['reference_id', 'amount', 'status']);

  // Build map of allocated receipts per invoice
  const paidByInvoice = {};
  if (allocSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const aRows = allocSheet.getRange(2, 1, allocSheet.getLastRow() - 1, allocSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    aRows.forEach(r => {
      if (String(r[allocMap.headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim() !== 'ALLOCATED') return;
      const invId = String(r[allocMap.headerMap['reference_id'] - 1]).trim();
      paidByInvoice[invId] = (paidByInvoice[invId] || 0) + (Number(r[allocMap.headerMap['amount'] - 1]) || 0);
    });
  }

  const tableRows = [];
  let totalInvoiced = 0;
  let totalAllocated = 0;
  let totalOutstanding = 0;

  if (invSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const iRows = invSheet.getRange(2, 1, invSheet.getLastRow() - 1, invSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
    iRows.forEach(r => {
      const status = String(r[invMap.headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim();
      if (status === 'CANCELLED' || status === 'DRAFT') return;
      const invId = String(r[invMap.headerMap['sales_invoice_id'] - 1]).trim();
      const invDateRaw = r[invMap.headerMap['invoice_date'] - 1];
      const invDate = invDateRaw instanceof Date
        ? Utilities.formatDate(invDateRaw, KS_CONFIG.TIMEZONE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
        : String(invDateRaw).slice(0, 10);

      const invTotal = Number(r[invMap.headerMap['invoice_total'] - 1]) || 0;
      const allocated = Math.round((paidByInvoice[invId] || 0) * 100) / 100;
      const balanceDue = Math.round((invTotal - allocated) * 100) / 100;

      totalInvoiced += invTotal;
      totalAllocated += allocated;
      totalOutstanding += balanceDue;

      tableRows.push([
        invDate,
        invId,
        r[invMap.headerMap['customer_id'] - 1],
        status,
        Number(r[invMap.headerMap['taxable_value'] - 1]) || 0,
        Number(r[invMap.headerMap['total_tax'] - 1]) || 0,
        invTotal,
        allocated,
        balanceDue,
        balanceDue <= 0 ? 'PAID' : (allocated > 0 ? 'PARTIALLY_PAID' : 'UNPAID')
      ]);
    });
  }

  tableRows.push([
    'TOTAL', '', '', '', '', '',
    Math.round(totalInvoiced * 100) / 100,
    Math.round(totalAllocated * 100) / 100,
    Math.round(totalOutstanding * 100) / 100,
    ''
  ]);

  const meta = [
    ['Report Status', 'DERIVED INVOICE & ALLOCATION REGISTER | Basis: ISSUED INVOICES'],
    ['Report Date', targetDate],
    ['Generated At', nowIso + ' by ' + ctx.user_id],
    ['Data Source', 'SalesInvoices + CustomerPaymentAllocations']
  ];

  ksWriteReportView_(
    'RPT_SalesAndReceivables',
    'KAWAD SWAD - SALES INVOICES & RECEIVABLES REGISTER',
    meta,
    ['Invoice Date', 'Invoice ID', 'Customer ID', 'Invoice Status', 'Taxable (INR)', 'Tax (INR)', 'Invoice Total (INR)', 'Allocated Paid (INR)', 'Balance Due (INR)', 'Collection Status'],
    tableRows
  );

  return {
    success: true,
    report_tab: 'RPT_SalesAndReceivables',
    total_invoiced: Math.round(totalInvoiced * 100) / 100,
    total_outstanding: Math.round(totalOutstanding * 100) / 100
  };
}

/**
 * Refreshes all 3 core management reports in one click and logs completion.
 */
function ksRefreshAllManagementReports() {
  const tb = ksGenerateTrialBalanceReport();
  const stk = ksGenerateStockStatusReport();
  const sal = ksGenerateDailySalesAndReceivablesReport();
  return { trial_balance: tb, stock_status: stk, sales_receivables: sal };
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - SAFE HEADER-MAPPED WRITER & READ-BACK VERIFIER
 * Enforces POL-003 (No silent data loss), POL-004 (Append-only), Section 3.3 & 11.2
 */

/**
 * Resolves a sheet and returns a map of { header_name: 1-based_column_index }.
 * Throws immediately if blank/duplicate headers exist or required headers are missing.
 */
function ksGetHeaderMap_(sheet, requiredHeaders) {
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('Target worksheet does not exist.');
  const lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();
  if (lastCol === 0) throw new Error('Sheet "' + sheet.getName() + '" has no header row.');

  const rawHeaders = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0];
  const headerMap = {};

  rawHeaders.forEach((h, idx) => {
    const clean = String(h || '').trim();
    if (!clean) {
      throw new Error('Schema Exception: Blank header at column ' + (idx + 1) + ' in "' + sheet.getName() + '".');
    }
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headerMap, clean)) {
      throw new Error('Schema Exception: Duplicate header "' + clean + '" in "' + sheet.getName() + '".');
    }
    headerMap[clean] = idx + 1;
  });

  if (Array.isArray(requiredHeaders)) {
    requiredHeaders.forEach(req => {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headerMap, req)) {
        throw new Error('Schema Exception: Missing required header "' + req + '" in "' + sheet.getName() + '".');
      }
    });
  }

  return { headerMap: headerMap, columnCount: lastCol };
}

/**
 * Appends a single record object mapped strictly by header name, flushes,
 * and reads back the written row to verify primary key & mandatory fields (POL-003).
 */
function ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, tabName, recordObj, primaryKeyField, mandatoryFields) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
  const reqHeaders = KS_CONFIG.REQUIRED_HEADERS[tabName] || mandatoryFields || [];
  const { headerMap, columnCount } = ksGetHeaderMap_(sheet, reqHeaders);

  // Validate mandatory fields before touching the sheet
  (mandatoryFields || []).forEach(field => {
    const val = recordObj[field];
    if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('Validation Error: Mandatory field "' + field + '" missing for "' + tabName + '".');
    }
  });

  // Build row array aligned strictly to sheet headers
  const rowValues = new Array(columnCount).fill('');
  Object.keys(recordObj).forEach(key => {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headerMap, key)) {
      throw new Error('Schema Exception: Unknown field "' + key + '" not in "' + tabName + '" headers.');
    }
    rowValues[headerMap[key] - 1] = recordObj[key];
  });

  const targetRow = sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
  sheet.getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, columnCount).setValues([rowValues]);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  // Read-back verification (Section 11.2)
  const readBack = sheet.getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, columnCount).getValues()[0];
  const expectedPk = String(recordObj[primaryKeyField]);
  const actualPk = String(readBack[headerMap[primaryKeyField] - 1]);

  if (expectedPk !== actualPk) {
    throw new Error(
      'Read-Back Verification Failed in "' + tabName + '" row ' + targetRow +
      ': expected ' + expectedPk + ', got ' + actualPk
    );
  }

  return { row: targetRow, record: recordObj };
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - SALES, INVOICING, DISPATCH & RECEIPTS ENGINE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-003..007, REQ-002, REQ-012, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-040..048
 * Wired strictly to hydrated SalesOrders, SalesOrderItems, SalesInvoices, SalesInvoiceItems,
 * CustomerPayments, CustomerPaymentAllocations, and InventoryMovements headers.
 */

/**
 * Creates a Sales Order + line items with price/tax snapshots and idempotency protection.
 */
function ksCreateSalesOrder(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.SALES, KS_ROLES.FIELD_SALESMAN],
    'ksCreateSalesOrder'
  );

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.customer_id) throw new Error('customer_id is required.');
  if (!Array.isArray(payload.items) || payload.items.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('At least one line item is required.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();

  const soAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalesOrders', payload.nonce + '_SO');
  const soId = soAlloc.allocated_id;

  let subtotal = 0;
  let totalDiscount = 0;
  let totalTax = 0;

  const preparedLines = payload.items.map((item, idx) => {
    const qty = Number(item.quantity);
    const unitPrice = Number(item.unit_price);
    const disc = Number(item.discount_amount) || 0;
    const taxRate = Number(item.tax_rate) || 0; // Unconfirmed GST rates remain 0 unless explicitly configured (POL-016)

    if (!(qty > 0)) throw new Error('Line ' + (idx + 1) + ': quantity must be > 0.');
    if (unitPrice < 0) throw new Error('Line ' + (idx + 1) + ': unit_price cannot be negative.');

    const lineGross = Math.round(qty * unitPrice * 100) / 100;
    const taxable = Math.round((lineGross - disc) * 100) / 100;
    const lineTax = Math.round(taxable * (taxRate / 100) * 100) / 100;
    const lineTotal = Math.round((taxable + lineTax) * 100) / 100;

    subtotal += lineGross;
    totalDiscount += disc;
    totalTax += lineTax;

    const lineAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalesOrderItems', payload.nonce + '_SOI_' + (idx + 1));
    return {
      record_id: lineAlloc.allocated_id,
      sales_order_item_id: lineAlloc.allocated_id,
      sales_order_id: soId,
      product_id: String(item.product_id || '').trim(),
      sku: String(item.sku || '').trim(),
      product_name_snapshot: String(item.product_name_snapshot || '').trim(),
      pack_weight_g: Number(item.pack_weight_g) || '',
      quantity: qty,
      unit_price: unitPrice,
      discount_amount: disc,
      tax_rate: taxRate,
      line_total: lineTotal,
      inventory_lot_id: String(item.inventory_lot_id || '').trim(),
      status: 'OPEN',
      created_at: nowIso,
      created_by: ctx.user_id,
      notes: item.notes || ''
    };
  });

  const shippingAmt = Number(payload.shipping_amount) || 0;
  const grandTotal = Math.round((subtotal - totalDiscount + totalTax + shippingAmt) * 100) / 100;

  const soRecord = {
    record_id: soId,
    sales_order_id: soId,
    order_number: payload.order_number || soId,
    order_datetime: nowIso,
    channel_id: payload.channel_id || 'DIRECT',
    customer_id: String(payload.customer_id).trim(),
    customer_name_snapshot: String(payload.customer_name_snapshot || '').trim(),
    customer_phone_snapshot: String(payload.customer_phone_snapshot || '').trim(),
    billing_address_json: payload.billing_address_json || '',
    shipping_address_json: payload.shipping_address_json || '',
    subtotal: Math.round(subtotal * 100) / 100,
    discount_amount: Math.round(totalDiscount * 100) / 100,
    tax_amount: Math.round(totalTax * 100) / 100,
    shipping_amount: shippingAmt,
    grand_total: grandTotal,
    payment_status: 'UNPAID',
    fulfilment_status: 'PENDING',
    external_order_id: payload.external_order_id || '',
    status: 'CONFIRMED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  try {
    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalesOrders', soRecord, 'sales_order_id', ['sales_order_id', 'customer_id', 'grand_total']);
    preparedLines.forEach(line => {
      ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalesOrderItems', line, 'sales_order_item_id', ['sales_order_item_id', 'sales_order_id', 'quantity']);
    });

    ksLogAudit_('SALES_ORDER_CREATED', 'SalesOrders', soId, {
      actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
      field_changed: 'grand_total',
      new_value: String(grandTotal),
      reason: 'Created order with ' + preparedLines.length + ' items'
    });

    return { success: true, sales_order_id: soId, grand_total: grandTotal, line_count: preparedLines.length };
  } catch (e) {
    ksLogException_('CRITICAL', 'ksCreateSalesOrder', 'SalesOrders', soId, e.message, payload);
    throw e;
  }
}

/**
 * Issues a distinct Sales Invoice from a Sales Order (POL-007: Order != Invoice).
 */
function ksCreateSalesInvoice(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS], 'ksCreateSalesInvoice');
  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.sales_order_id || !payload.customer_id) throw new Error('sales_order_id and customer_id are required.');

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const invAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalesInvoices', payload.nonce + '_INV');
  const invId = invAlloc.allocated_id;

  const taxable = Number(payload.taxable_value) || 0;
  const cgst = Number(payload.cgst_amount) || 0;
  const sgst = Number(payload.sgst_amount) || 0;
  const igst = Number(payload.igst_amount) || 0;
  const totalTax = Math.round((cgst + sgst + igst) * 100) / 100;
  const invTotal = Math.round((taxable + totalTax) * 100) / 100;

  const invRecord = {
    record_id: invId,
    sales_invoice_id: invId,
    invoice_number: payload.invoice_number || invId,
    sales_order_id: String(payload.sales_order_id).trim(),
    invoice_date: payload.invoice_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    customer_id: String(payload.customer_id).trim(),
    billing_gstin: payload.billing_gstin || '',
    place_of_supply: payload.place_of_supply || '',
    taxable_value: taxable,
    cgst_amount: cgst,
    sgst_amount: sgst,
    igst_amount: igst,
    total_tax: totalTax,
    invoice_total: invTotal,
    irn: payload.irn || '',
    e_way_bill_number: payload.e_way_bill_number || '',
    status: 'ISSUED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalesInvoices', invRecord, 'sales_invoice_id', ['sales_invoice_id', 'sales_order_id', 'invoice_total']);

  (payload.items || []).forEach((item, idx) => {
    const itemAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalesInvoiceItems', payload.nonce + '_INVI_' + (idx + 1));
    const lineRec = {
      record_id: itemAlloc.allocated_id,
      sales_invoice_item_id: itemAlloc.allocated_id,
      parent_record_id: invId,
      line_number: idx + 1,
      item_type: item.item_type || 'PACKAGED_SKU',
      item_id: String(item.item_id || '').trim(),
      description: String(item.description || '').trim(),
      quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 0,
      unit: item.unit || 'PKT',
      unit_rate: Number(item.unit_rate) || 0,
      tax_rate: Number(item.tax_rate) || 0,
      line_amount: Number(item.line_amount) || 0,
      status: 'ISSUED',
      created_at: nowIso,
      created_by: ctx.user_id,
      notes: item.notes || ''
    };
    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalesInvoiceItems', lineRec, 'sales_invoice_item_id', ['sales_invoice_item_id', 'parent_record_id']);
  });

  ksLogAudit_('SALES_INVOICE_ISSUED', 'SalesInvoices', invId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'invoice_total',
    new_value: String(invTotal),
    related_record_id: payload.sales_order_id
  });

  return { success: true, sales_invoice_id: invId, invoice_total: invTotal };
}

/**
 * Records a Customer Receipt and explicit Invoice Allocation (POL-006, REQ-020, REQ-065).
 */
function ksRecordCustomerReceiptAndAllocation(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS, KS_ROLES.FIELD_SALESMAN],
    'ksRecordCustomerReceiptAndAllocation'
  );

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.customer_id) throw new Error('customer_id is required.');
  const amountReceived = Number(payload.amount_received);
  if (!(amountReceived > 0)) throw new Error('amount_received must be > 0.');

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const rcptAlloc = ksAllocateId('CustomerPayments', payload.nonce + '_RCPT');
  const rcptId = rcptAlloc.allocated_id;

  const gatewayFee = Number(payload.gateway_fee) || 0;
  const netSettlement = Math.round((amountReceived - gatewayFee) * 100) / 100;

  const rcptRecord = {
    record_id: rcptId,
    customer_payment_id: rcptId,
    customer_id: String(payload.customer_id).trim(),
    sales_order_id: payload.sales_order_id || '',
    sales_invoice_id: payload.sales_invoice_id || '',
    payment_date: payload.payment_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    payment_method_id: payload.payment_method_id || 'CASH',
    amount_received: amountReceived,
    transaction_reference: payload.transaction_reference || '',
    gateway_fee: gatewayFee,
    net_settlement: netSettlement,
    status: payload.status || 'COMPLETED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'CustomerPayments', rcptRecord, 'customer_payment_id', ['customer_payment_id', 'customer_id', 'amount_received']);

  let allocId = '';
  if (payload.sales_invoice_id) {
    const allocAmount = Number(payload.allocated_amount) || amountReceived;
    if (allocAmount > amountReceived) {
      throw new Error('Allocated amount (' + allocAmount + ') cannot exceed received amount (' + amountReceived + ').');
    }
    const aAlloc = ksAllocateId('CustomerPaymentAllocations', payload.nonce + '_RCPTA');
    allocId = aAlloc.allocated_id;

    const allocRecord = {
      record_id: allocId,
      customer_payment_allocation_id: allocId,
      party_type: 'CUSTOMER',
      party_id: String(payload.customer_id).trim(),
      reference_type: 'SALES_INVOICE',
      reference_id: String(payload.sales_invoice_id).trim(),
      transaction_date: rcptRecord.payment_date,
      payment_method: rcptRecord.payment_method_id,
      amount: allocAmount,
      reference_number: rcptId,
      recorded_by: ctx.user_id,
      status: 'ALLOCATED',
      created_at: nowIso,
      created_by: ctx.user_id,
      notes: payload.notes || ''
    };
    ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'CustomerPaymentAllocations', allocRecord, 'customer_payment_allocation_id', ['customer_payment_allocation_id', 'reference_id', 'amount']);
  }

  ksLogAudit_('CUSTOMER_RECEIPT_RECORDED', 'CustomerPayments', rcptId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'amount_received',
    new_value: String(amountReceived),
    related_record_id: payload.sales_invoice_id || payload.sales_order_id || ''
  });

  return { success: true, customer_payment_id: rcptId, allocation_id: allocId, net_settlement: netSettlement };
}

/**
 * Inspects exact headers of any group of tables and logs them cleanly
 * without hitting Apps Script's single-log truncation limit.
 */
function ksInspectTableGroupHeaders(groupName) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const tables = KS_CORE_TABLES[groupName];
  if (!tables) {
    throw new Error('Unknown group "' + groupName + '". Use: ' + Object.keys(KS_CORE_TABLES).join(', '));
  }

  Logger.log('=== SCHEMA INSPECTION: ' + groupName + ' (' + tables.length + ' tables) ===');
  tables.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      Logger.log('[MISSING TAB] ' + tabName);
      return;
    }
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const headers = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0] : [];
    Logger.log('[OK] ' + tabName + ' (rows=' + sh.getLastRow() + ', cols=' + lastCol + '): ' + JSON.stringify(headers));
  });
}

function ksInspectMasterHeaders()     { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('MASTER'); }
function ksInspectInventoryHeaders()  { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('INVENTORY'); }
function ksInspectProductionHeaders() { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('PRODUCTION'); }
function ksInspectSalesHeaders()      { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('SALES'); }
function ksInspectAccountingHeaders() { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('ACCOUNTING'); }
function ksInspectGovernanceHeadersV2() { ksInspectTableGroupHeaders('GOVERNANCE'); }

/**
 * Validates that every core table exists and has unique, non-blank headers (Section 3.3).
 * Logs any missing tab or header defect to ExceptionRegister without modifying data.
 */
function ksRunFullSchemaHealthCheck() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  let checked = 0;
  let passed = 0;
  const issues = [];

  Object.keys(KS_CORE_TABLES).forEach(group => {
    KS_CORE_TABLES[group].forEach(tabName => {
      checked++;
      const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
      if (!sh) {
        issues.push({ tab: tabName, issue: 'MISSING_TAB' });
        return;
      }
      try {
        ksGetHeaderMap_(sh, []);
        passed++;
      } catch (e) {
        issues.push({ tab: tabName, issue: e.message });
      }
    });
  });

  ksLogAudit_('SCHEMA_HEALTH_CHECK', 'WORKBOOK', 'ALL_CORE_TABLES', {
    field_changed: 'schema_status',
    new_value: passed + '/' + checked + ' OK',
    reason: 'Phase C/F Schema Health Verification'
  });

  Logger.log('Schema Health Check Complete: ' + passed + '/' + checked + ' passed.');
  if (issues.length > 0) {
    Logger.log('Issues found: ' + JSON.stringify(issues, null, 2));
  }
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - SIGNED WEB APP BRIDGE (WebAppBridge.gs)
 * Matches backend/app/apps_script_bridge.py & backend/app/action_registry.py (Phase 1.8+)
 */

function doPost(e) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  try {
    if (!e || !e.postData || !e.postData.contents) {
      return ksBridgeJson_({
        status: 'REJECTED',
        error_code: 'EMPTY_PAYLOAD',
        message: 'Missing POST body.'
      });
    }

    const rawBody = e.postData.contents;
    const req = JSON.parse(rawBody);

    // 1. Verify Shared Secret & HMAC-SHA256 Signature
    const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const sharedSecret = String(props.getProperty('SALES_APPS_SCRIPT_SHARED_SECRET') || '').trim();
    if (!sharedSecret || sharedSecret.length < 32) {
      return ksBridgeJson_({
        status: 'REJECTED',
        error_code: 'BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
        message: 'SALES_APPS_SCRIPT_SHARED_SECRET missing or < 32 chars in ScriptProperties.'
      });
    }

    // Apps Script doPost does not expose custom request headers directly unless passed in query/body;
    // support signature in req.signature OR query ?sig= OR verify body integrity if signed via URL/envelope.
    // NOTE: See Step 3 below for passing X-KS-Signature or body signature cleanly.
    const providedSig = String(
      (e.parameter && (e.parameter.sig || e.parameter['X-KS-Signature'])) ||
      req.signature ||
      ''
    ).trim().toLowerCase();

    if (providedSig) {
      const expectedSig = ksHmacSha256Hex_(rawBody, sharedSecret);
      if (!ksSafeEqual_(providedSig, expectedSig)) {
        return ksBridgeJson_({
          status: 'REJECTED',
          error_code: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE',
          message: 'HMAC-SHA256 signature mismatch.'
        });
      }
    }

    const action = String(req.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const targetTab = String(req.target_tab || '').trim();
    const nonce = String(req.nonce || '').trim();
    const correlationId = String(req.correlation_id || '').trim();
    const actorUserId = String(req.actor_user_id || '').trim();
    const actorRole = String(req.actor_role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const payload = req.payload || {};

    if (!action || !targetTab || !nonce || !correlationId) {
      return ksBridgeJson_({
        status: 'REJECTED',
        correlation_id: correlationId,
        nonce: nonce,
        action: action,
        target_tab: targetTab,
        error_code: 'MISSING_ENVELOPE_FIELDS',
        message: 'action, target_tab, nonce, and correlation_id are all required.'
      });
    }

    // 2. Serialize via ScriptLock & Enforce Nonce Idempotency
    lock.waitLock(20000);
    const existing = ksFindByNonce_(nonce);
    if (existing) {
      return ksBridgeJson_({
        status: 'CONFIRMED',
        idempotent_replay: true,
        correlation_id: correlationId,
        nonce: nonce,
        action: action,
        target_tab: targetTab,
        allocated_id: existing.allocated_id,
        record: existing.record || {}
      });
    }

    // 3. Execute Governed Domain Action (or Generic Canonical Table Write)
    const outcome = ksRouteGovernedWrite_(action, targetTab, payload, actorUserId, actorRole, nonce, correlationId);

    // 4. Record Nonce in IdAllocations & Log to AuditLog
    ksRecordIdAllocation_(nonce, targetTab, outcome.allocated_id || nonce);
    if (typeof ksLogAudit_ === 'function') {
      ksLogAudit_(action, targetTab, outcome.allocated_id || nonce, {
        actor_user_id: actorUserId || 'FASTAPI_GATEWAY',
        field_changed: 'governed_write',
        old_value: '',
        new_value: 'CONFIRMED | nonce=' + nonce + ' | corr=' + correlationId,
        reason: 'FastAPI Bridge: ' + action
      });
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // 5. Return ALL Mandatory Echo Fields Required by apps_script_bridge.py
    return ksBridgeJson_({
      status: 'CONFIRMED',
      correlation_id: correlationId,
      nonce: nonce,
      action: action,
      target_tab: targetTab,
      allocated_id: outcome.allocated_id || '',
      record: outcome.record || {}
    });

  } catch (err) {
    return ksBridgeJson_({
      status: 'REJECTED',
      error_code: 'BRIDGE_EXECUTION_ERROR',
      message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)
    });
  } finally {
    if (lock.hasLock()) lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * Routes registered actions from backend/app/action_registry.py to your existing
 * Apps Script engines, falling back to safe Row-1 header-mapped sheet writes for
 * standard CRUD actions so all 15 ERP modules work immediately.
 */
function ksRouteGovernedWrite_(action, targetTab, payload, actorUserId, actorRole, nonce, correlationId) {
  // Specialized Domain Engine Dispatch (if those functions exist in your project)
  if (action === 'RECEIVE_RAW_MATERIAL' && typeof ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt === 'function') {
    return ksCreateInventoryLotAndReceipt(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'CREATE_PRODUCTION_ORDER' && typeof ksCreateProductionOrder === 'function') {
    return ksCreateProductionOrder(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'RECORD_MATERIAL_CONSUMPTION' && typeof ksRecordProductionConsumption === 'function') {
    return ksRecordProductionConsumption(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'RECORD_PRODUCTION_OUTPUT' && typeof ksRecordProductionOutput === 'function') {
    return ksRecordProductionOutput(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'QUALITY_CHECK_DECISION' && typeof ksRecordQualityCheckAndRelease === 'function') {
    return ksRecordQualityCheckAndRelease(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'RECORD_PACKAGING_BATCH' && typeof ksRecordPackagingOutput === 'function') {
    return ksRecordPackagingOutput(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'CREATE_SALES_ORDER' && typeof ksCreateSalesOrder === 'function') {
    return ksCreateSalesOrder(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'CREATE_SALES_INVOICE' && typeof ksCreateSalesInvoice === 'function') {
    return ksCreateSalesInvoice(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'RECORD_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT' && typeof ksRecordCustomerPayment === 'function') {
    return ksRecordCustomerPayment(payload, nonce);
  }
  if (action === 'POST_JOURNAL_VOUCHER' && typeof ksPostBalancedJournalEntry === 'function') {
    return ksPostBalancedJournalEntry(payload, nonce);
  }

  // Safe Header-Mapped Canonical Table Writer for all other action_registry.py actions
  return ksWriteCanonicalRowByHeaders_(targetTab, payload, actorUserId, nonce);
}

/**
 * Appends or updates a row in `targetTab` strictly by matching Row-1 header names
 * so FastAPI's immediate fresh=True readback verification succeeds cleanly.
 */
function ksWriteCanonicalRowByHeaders_(targetTab, payload, actorUserId, nonce) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(targetTab);
  if (!sh) {
    throw new Error('Target sheet not found: ' + targetTab);
  }

  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastCol < 1) {
    throw new Error('Target sheet has no Row-1 headers: ' + targetTab);
  }

  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim());
  const flatData = Object.assign({}, payload.record || {}, payload.updates || {}, payload);
  if (!flatData.created_at) flatData.created_at = new Date().toISOString();
  if (!flatData.created_by && actorUserId) flatData.created_by = actorUserId;
  if (!flatData.nonce) flatData.nonce = nonce;

  // Determine primary ID field (first *_id column or record_id)
  const idColIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h === 'record_id' || h.endsWith('_id'));
  const idField = idColIdx !== -1 ? headers[idColIdx] : null;
  let allocatedId = idField && flatData[idField] ? String(flatData[idField]).trim() : '';

  // Check if updating an existing row by ID
  let targetRow = -1;
  if (idField && allocatedId && sh.getLastRow() > 1) {
    const idValues = sh.getRange(2, idColIdx + 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < idValues.length; i++) {
      if (String(idValues[i][0]).trim() === allocatedId) {
        targetRow = i + 2;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (targetRow !== -1) {
    const existingRow = sh.getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0];
    const updatedRow = headers.map((h, idx) => (h in flatData && flatData[h] !== undefined) ? flatData[h] : existingRow[idx]);
    sh.getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, lastCol).setValues([updatedRow]);
    const savedObj = {};
    headers.forEach((h, idx) => { savedObj[h] = updatedRow[idx]; });
    return { allocated_id: allocatedId, record: savedObj };
  } else {
    const newRow = headers.map(h => (h in flatData && flatData[h] !== undefined) ? flatData[h] : '');
    sh.appendRow(newRow);
    const savedObj = {};
    headers.forEach((h, idx) => { savedObj[h] = newRow[idx]; });
    return { allocated_id: allocatedId, record: savedObj };
  }
}

function ksFindByNonce_(nonce) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName('IdAllocations');
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return null;
  const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0].map(h => String(h).trim());
  const nIdx = headers.indexOf('nonce');
  const idIdx = headers.indexOf('allocated_id');
  const tabIdx = headers.indexOf('tab_name') !== -1 ? headers.indexOf('tab_name') : headers.indexOf('target_table');
  if (nIdx === -1) return null;
  for (let i = data.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
    if (String(data[i][nIdx]).trim() === nonce) {
      return {
        allocated_id: idIdx !== -1 ? String(data[i][idIdx]).trim() : '',
        tab_name: tabIdx !== -1 ? String(data[i][tabIdx]).trim() : ''
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function ksRecordIdAllocation_(nonce, tabName, allocatedId) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName('IdAllocations');
  if (!sh || sh.getLastColumn() < 1) return;
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim());
  const row = headers.map(h => {
    if (h === 'allocation_id') return 'ALLOC-' + Date.now();
    if (h === 'tab_name' || h === 'target_table') return tabName;
    if (h === 'allocated_id') return allocatedId;
    if (h === 'nonce' || h === 'idempotency_key') return nonce;
    if (h === 'created_at') return new Date().toISOString();
    return '';
  });
  sh.appendRow(row);
}

function ksHmacSha256Hex_(message, secret) {
  const bytes = Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(message, secret);
  return bytes.map(b => ('0' + (b & 0xFF).toString(16)).slice(-2)).join('');
}

function ksSafeEqual_(a, b) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return diff === 0;
}

function ksBridgeJson_(obj) {
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(obj)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

/**
 * KAWAD SWAD ERP - WORKFORCE, ATTENDANCE, GIG-WORKER & FIXED-SALARY PAYROLL ENGINE
 * Blueprint Version: 2.0 | Enforces POL-003..004, POL-008, POL-011..013, DB-10, REQ-003, REQ-023, REQ-050..059
 * Supports both:
 *   1. GIG / PIECE-RATE / DAILY WORKERS (verified ProductionWorkerEntries -> payout)
 *   2. FIXED SALARIED EMPLOYEES (monthly/periodic salary + approved overtime - advance recovery -> payout)
 * Confidential salary/bank operations are strictly restricted to OWNER_ADMIN (POL-012).

const KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES = Object.freeze([
  'Employees',
  'LeaveRecords',
  'ShiftSchedules',
  'OvertimeRecords',
  'IncentiveRules',
  'SalaryPayments',
  'EmployeeAdvances',
  'EmployeeGrievances',
  'TrainingRecords',
  'WorkplaceSafetyRecords',
  'ProductionWorkerEntries'
]);

function ksInspectWorkforceHeaders() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  Logger.log('=== SCHEMA INSPECTION: WORKFORCE (' + KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES.length + ' tables) ===');
  KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) {
      Logger.log('[MISSING TAB] ' + tabName);
      return;
    }
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const headers = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0] : [];
    Logger.log('[OK] ' + tabName + ' (rows=' + sh.getLastRow() + ', cols=' + lastCol + '): ' + JSON.stringify(headers));
  });
}

function ksHydrateWorkforceTables() {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksHydrateWorkforceTables');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const dict = ksLoadDictionaryIndex_();
  let hydratedCount = 0;

  KS_WORKFORCE_TABLES.forEach(tabName => {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tabName);
    if (!sh) return;
    const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    const currentHeaders = lastCol > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0].map(h => String(h).trim()) : [];
    const expectedItems = dict.byTable[tabName] || [];
    const missing = expectedItems
      .map(item => item.field)
      .filter(h => !currentHeaders.includes(h));

    if (missing.length > 0) {
      sh.getRange(1, lastCol + 1, 1, missing.length).setValues([missing]);
      sh.setFrozenRows(1);
      hydratedCount++;

      ksLogAudit_('SCHEMA_HYDRATE', tabName, tabName, {
        actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
        field_changed: 'headers',
        old_value: currentHeaders.length + ' cols',
        new_value: (currentHeaders.length + missing.length) + ' cols',
        reason: 'Hydrated ' + missing.length + ' workforce fields from ' + KS_DICTIONARY_TAB
      });
    }
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  Logger.log('Hydrated ' + hydratedCount + ' workforce tables.');
  return hydratedCount;
}

/**
 * 1. Registers an Employee or Gig Worker in Employees (REQ-050, POL-012).
 * employment_type must be: FIXED_SALARIED | GIG_WORKER | DAILY_WAGE | CONTRACT
 */
function ksRegisterWorkerOrEmployee(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.HR], 'ksRegisterWorkerOrEmployee');

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.full_name || !payload.employment_type || !payload.designation) {
    throw new Error('full_name, employment_type, and designation are required (REQ-050).');
  }

  const empType = String(payload.employment_type).trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!['FIXED_SALARIED', 'GIG_WORKER', 'DAILY_WAGE', 'CONTRACT'].includes(empType)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid employment_type "' + empType + '". Use FIXED_SALARIED, GIG_WORKER, DAILY_WAGE, or CONTRACT.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const alloc = ksAllocateId('Employees', payload.nonce + '_EMP');
  const empId = alloc.allocated_id;

  const empRecord = {
    record_id: empId,
    employee_id: empId,
    employee_code: payload.employee_code || empId,
    full_name: String(payload.full_name).trim(),
    mobile: String(payload.mobile || '').trim(),
    email: String(payload.email || '').trim(),
    designation: String(payload.designation).trim(),
    department: String(payload.department || 'PRODUCTION').trim(),
    employment_type: empType,
    joining_date: payload.joining_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    exit_date: '',
    employment_status: 'ACTIVE',
    reporting_manager_id: payload.reporting_manager_id || '',
    address: payload.address || '',
    emergency_contact: payload.emergency_contact || '',
    bank_details_reference: payload.bank_details_reference || '', // Store Drive/vault ref, never raw passwords/secrets (POL-012)
    active: true,
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'Employees', empRecord, 'employee_id', ['employee_id', 'full_name', 'employment_type']);

  ksLogAudit_('EMPLOYEE_REGISTERED', 'Employees', empId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'employment_type',
    new_value: empType + ' (' + empRecord.designation + ')'
  });

  return { success: true, employee_id: empId, employment_type: empType };
}

/**
 * 2. Records Gig / Piece-Rate / Daily Worker Activity (REQ-023, POL-013).
 * Starts as SUBMITTED unless verified_by supervisor is supplied.
 */
function ksRecordWorkerProductionEntry(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_(
    [KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PA, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION, KS_ROLES.HR],
    'ksRecordWorkerProductionEntry'
  );

  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.production_batch_id || !payload.employee_id || !payload.work_date || !payload.task_type) {
    throw new Error('production_batch_id, employee_id, work_date, and task_type are required (REQ-023).');
  }

  const hoursWorked = Number(payload.hours_worked) || 0;
  const unitsCompleted = Number(payload.units_completed) || 0;
  if (hoursWorked <= 0 && unitsCompleted <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Either hours_worked or units_completed must be > 0 (POL-013).');
  }

  const rate = Number(payload.rate) || 0;
  const isPieceRate = (String(payload.pay_basis || '').toUpperCase() === 'PIECE' || (unitsCompleted > 0 && hoursWorked === 0));
  const basisQty = isPieceRate ? unitsCompleted : hoursWorked;
  const amount = Math.round(basisQty * rate * 100) / 100;

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const alloc = ksAllocateId('ProductionWorkerEntries', payload.nonce + '_PWE');
  const entryId = alloc.allocated_id;

  const record = {
    record_id: entryId,
    worker_entry_id: entryId,
    production_batch_id: String(payload.production_batch_id).trim(),
    employee_id: String(payload.employee_id).trim(),
    work_date: payload.work_date,
    task_type: String(payload.task_type).trim(),
    hours_worked: hoursWorked,
    units_completed: unitsCompleted,
    rate: rate,
    amount: amount,
    verified_by: payload.verified_by || '',
    status: payload.verified_by ? 'VERIFIED' : 'SUBMITTED',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'ProductionWorkerEntries', record, 'worker_entry_id', [
    'worker_entry_id', 'production_batch_id', 'employee_id', 'work_date', 'task_type'
  ]);

  ksLogAudit_('WORKER_PRODUCTION_LOGGED', 'ProductionWorkerEntries', entryId, {
    actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
    field_changed: 'task_type',
    new_value: record.task_type + ' (hrs=' + hoursWorked + ', units=' + unitsCompleted + ')',
    related_record_id: record.production_batch_id
  });

  return { success: true, worker_entry_id: entryId, calculated_amount: amount, status: record.status };
}

/**
 * 3. Supervisor Verification of Gig Worker Entry (Segregation of Duties: REQ-023 & POL-011).
 */
function ksVerifyWorkerProductionEntry(workerEntryId) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.PRODUCTION], 'ksVerifyWorkerProductionEntry');
  if (!workerEntryId) throw new Error('workerEntryId is required.');

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName('ProductionWorkerEntries');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(sh, ['worker_entry_id', 'verified_by', 'status', 'updated_at', 'updated_by']);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) throw new Error('No records in ProductionWorkerEntries.');

  const ids = sh.getRange(2, headerMap['worker_entry_id'], lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (String(ids[i][0]).trim() === String(workerEntryId).trim()) {
      const rowNum = i + 2;
      const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
      sh.getRange(rowNum, headerMap['verified_by']).setValue(ctx.user_id);
      sh.getRange(rowNum, headerMap['status']).setValue('VERIFIED');
      sh.getRange(rowNum, headerMap['updated_at']).setValue(nowIso);
      sh.getRange(rowNum, headerMap['updated_by']).setValue(ctx.user_id);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      ksLogAudit_('WORKER_ENTRY_VERIFIED', 'ProductionWorkerEntries', workerEntryId, {
        actor_user_id: ctx.user_id,
        field_changed: 'status',
        old_value: 'SUBMITTED',
        new_value: 'VERIFIED',
        approved_by_user_id: ctx.user_id
      });

      return { success: true, worker_entry_id: workerEntryId, verified_by: ctx.user_id, status: 'VERIFIED' };
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Worker entry "' + workerEntryId + '" not found.');
}

/**
 * 4. Records an Employee Advance / Loan Disbursement (REQ-056, POL-006).
 */
function ksRecordEmployeeAdvance(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN, KS_ROLES.ACCOUNTS], 'ksRecordEmployeeAdvance');
  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.employee_id || !(Number(payload.amount) > 0)) {
    throw new Error('employee_id and positive advance amount are required.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const alloc = ksAllocateId('EmployeeAdvances', payload.nonce + '_EADV');
  const advId = alloc.allocated_id;
  const amt = Math.round(Number(payload.amount) * 100) / 100;

  const advRecord = {
    record_id: advId,
    employee_advance_id: advId,
    employee_id: String(payload.employee_id).trim(),
    period_start: payload.period_start || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    period_end: payload.period_end || '',
    record_date: payload.record_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10),
    quantity_or_days: 1,
    amount: amt,
    approval_status: 'APPROVED',
    approved_by: ctx.user_id,
    payment_status: 'DISBURSED',
    status: 'OPEN_BALANCE',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: payload.notes || ''
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'EmployeeAdvances', advRecord, 'employee_advance_id', ['employee_advance_id', 'employee_id', 'amount']);

  // Post double-entry accounting voucher: Debit Employee Advances (Asset), Credit Cash/Bank
  ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher({
    nonce: payload.nonce + '_JV',
    reference_type: 'EMPLOYEE_ADVANCE',
    reference_id: advId,
    record_date: advRecord.record_date,
    description: 'Employee advance disbursed: ' + advId,
    lines: [
      { dr_cr: 'DEBIT', account_code: '1150-EMPLOYEE-ADVANCES', amount: amt, description: 'Advance ' + advId },
      { dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: payload.payment_account || '1110-PETTY-CASH', amount: amt, description: 'Advance payout ' + advId }
    ]
  });

  return { success: true, employee_advance_id: advId, amount: amt };
}

/**
 * 5. Processes a Gig-Worker Payout from VERIFIED ProductionWorkerEntries (OWNER_ADMIN only per POL-012).
 * Marks settled entries as PAID so they can never be double-paid (REQ-081).
 */
function ksProcessGigWorkerPayout(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksProcessGigWorkerPayout');
  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.employee_id || !payload.period_start || !payload.period_end) {
    throw new Error('employee_id, period_start, and period_end are required.');
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const pweSheet = ss.getSheetByName('ProductionWorkerEntries');
  const { headerMap } = ksGetHeaderMap_(pweSheet, ['worker_entry_id', 'employee_id', 'work_date', 'amount', 'status', 'updated_at', 'updated_by']);
  const lastRow = pweSheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) throw new Error('No entries found in ProductionWorkerEntries.');

  const rows = pweSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, pweSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  const matchedRows = [];
  let totalGrossPaise = 0;

  rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
    const emp = String(r[headerMap['employee_id'] - 1]).trim();
    const st = String(r[headerMap['status'] - 1]).trim().toUpperCase();
    const rawDate = r[headerMap['work_date'] - 1];
    const wDate = rawDate instanceof Date
      ? Utilities.formatDate(rawDate, KS_CONFIG.TIMEZONE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
      : String(rawDate).slice(0, 10);

    // Strictly include ONLY supervisor-VERIFIED entries within the date window (REQ-023 & POL-011)
    if (emp === String(payload.employee_id).trim() && st === 'VERIFIED' && wDate >= payload.period_start && wDate <= payload.period_end) {
      const amt = Number(r[headerMap['amount'] - 1]) || 0;
      totalGrossPaise += Math.round(amt * 100);
      matchedRows.push({ rowNum: idx + 2, entryId: r[headerMap['worker_entry_id'] - 1] });
    }
  });

  if (matchedRows.length === 0 || totalGrossPaise <= 0) {
    throw new Error('No VERIFIED unpaid gig-worker entries found for ' + payload.employee_id + ' in period ' + payload.period_start + '..' + payload.period_end);
  }

  const advanceRecoveryPaise = Math.round((Number(payload.advance_recovery) || 0) * 100);
  if (advanceRecoveryPaise > totalGrossPaise) {
    throw new Error('Advance recovery cannot exceed gross gig earnings.');
  }

  const grossRupees = totalGrossPaise / 100;
  const recoveryRupees = advanceRecoveryPaise / 100;
  const netPayableRupees = (totalGrossPaise - advanceRecoveryPaise) / 100;

  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const payDate = payload.payment_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10);
  const salAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalaryPayments', payload.nonce + '_GIGPAY');
  const payId = salAlloc.allocated_id;

  const payRecord = {
    record_id: payId,
    salary_payment_id: payId,
    party_type: 'GIG_WORKER',
    party_id: String(payload.employee_id).trim(),
    reference_type: 'GIG_PERIOD_' + payload.period_start + '_TO_' + payload.period_end,
    reference_id: matchedRows.map(m => m.entryId).join(','),
    transaction_date: payDate,
    payment_method: payload.payment_method || 'CASH',
    amount: netPayableRupees,
    reference_number: payload.reference_number || payId,
    recorded_by: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'PAID',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Gross=' + grossRupees + ', AdvRecovery=' + recoveryRupees + ', Entries=' + matchedRows.length
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalaryPayments', payRecord, 'salary_payment_id', ['salary_payment_id', 'party_id', 'amount']);

  // Mark included ProductionWorkerEntries as PAID so they cannot be paid twice
  matchedRows.forEach(m => {
    pweSheet.getRange(m.rowNum, headerMap['status']).setValue('PAID');
    pweSheet.getRange(m.rowNum, headerMap['updated_at']).setValue(nowIso);
    pweSheet.getRange(m.rowNum, headerMap['updated_by']).setValue(ctx.user_id);
  });

  // Post balanced double-entry accounting lines
  const jvLines = [
    { dr_cr: 'DEBIT', account_code: '5120-DIRECT-PRODUCTION-LABOUR', amount: grossRupees, description: 'Gig labour payout ' + payId },
    { dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: payload.payment_account || '1110-PETTY-CASH', amount: netPayableRupees, description: 'Net cash/bank paid ' + payId }
  ];
  if (recoveryRupees > 0) {
    jvLines.push({ dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: '1150-EMPLOYEE-ADVANCES', amount: recoveryRupees, description: 'Advance recovery ' + payId });
  }

  const jv = ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher({
    nonce: payload.nonce + '_JV',
    reference_type: 'GIG_WAGE_PAYOUT',
    reference_id: payId,
    record_date: payDate,
    description: 'Gig worker payout ' + payId + ' (' + matchedRows.length + ' verified entries)',
    lines: jvLines
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    salary_payment_id: payId,
    party_type: 'GIG_WORKER',
    entries_settled: matchedRows.length,
    gross_amount: grossRupees,
    advance_recovery: recoveryRupees,
    net_paid: netPayableRupees,
    journal_voucher_id: jv.journal_voucher_id
  };
}

/**
 * 6. Processes a Fixed-Salary Employee Payroll Payout (OWNER_ADMIN only per POL-012).
 */
function ksProcessFixedEmployeeSalary(payload) {
  const ctx = ksRequireRole_([KS_ROLES.OWNER_ADMIN], 'ksProcessFixedEmployeeSalary');
  if (!payload || !payload.nonce) throw new Error('Idempotency nonce is required.');
  if (!payload.employee_id || !payload.salary_month) {
    throw new Error('employee_id and salary_month (e.g., 2026-11) are required.');
  }

  const baseSalary = Number(payload.base_salary) || 0;
  const overtimeAmt = Number(payload.overtime_amount) || 0;
  const incentiveAmt = Number(payload.incentive_amount) || 0;
  const unpaidLeaveDed = Number(payload.unpaid_leave_deduction) || 0;
  const advanceRecovery = Number(payload.advance_recovery) || 0;

  if (baseSalary <= 0) throw new Error('base_salary must be > 0.');

  const grossPaise = Math.round((baseSalary + overtimeAmt + incentiveAmt - unpaidLeaveDed) * 100);
  const recoveryPaise = Math.round(advanceRecovery * 100);
  if (grossPaise <= 0 || recoveryPaise > grossPaise) {
    throw new Error('Invalid net salary calculation: verify deductions and advance recovery.');
  }

  const grossRupees = grossPaise / 100;
  const recoveryRupees = recoveryPaise / 100;
  const netPaidRupees = (grossPaise - recoveryPaise) / 100;

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const nowIso = ksNowIso_();
  const payDate = payload.payment_date || nowIso.slice(0, 10);
  const salAlloc = ksAllocateId('SalaryPayments', payload.nonce + '_FIXPAY');
  const payId = salAlloc.allocated_id;

  const payRecord = {
    record_id: payId,
    salary_payment_id: payId,
    party_type: 'FIXED_EMPLOYEE',
    party_id: String(payload.employee_id).trim(),
    reference_type: 'MONTHLY_SALARY_' + payload.salary_month,
    reference_id: payload.salary_month,
    transaction_date: payDate,
    payment_method: payload.payment_method || 'BANK_TRANSFER',
    amount: netPaidRupees,
    reference_number: payload.reference_number || payId,
    recorded_by: ctx.user_id,
    status: 'PAID',
    created_at: nowIso,
    created_by: ctx.user_id,
    notes: 'Base=' + baseSalary + ', OT=' + overtimeAmt + ', Inc=' + incentiveAmt + ', LeaveDed=' + unpaidLeaveDed + ', AdvRec=' + recoveryRupees
  };

  ksAppendAndVerifyRow_(ss, 'SalaryPayments', payRecord, 'salary_payment_id', ['salary_payment_id', 'party_id', 'amount']);

  const expenseAcct = payload.department_expense_account || '5250-SALARIES-AND-WAGES';
  const jvLines = [
    { dr_cr: 'DEBIT', account_code: expenseAcct, amount: grossRupees, description: 'Monthly salary ' + payload.salary_month + ' (' + payId + ')' },
    { dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: payload.payment_account || '1120-BANK-MAIN', amount: netPaidRupees, description: 'Net salary transfer ' + payId }
  ];
  if (recoveryRupees > 0) {
    jvLines.push({ dr_cr: 'CREDIT', account_code: '1150-EMPLOYEE-ADVANCES', amount: recoveryRupees, description: 'Advance recovery ' + payId });
  }

  const jv = ksPostBalancedJournalVoucher({
    nonce: payload.nonce + '_JV',
    reference_type: 'FIXED_SALARY_PAYOUT',
    reference_id: payId,
    record_date: payDate,
    description: 'Fixed employee salary ' + payload.salary_month + ' (' + payId + ')',
    lines: jvLines
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    salary_payment_id: payId,
    party_type: 'FIXED_EMPLOYEE',
    gross_salary: grossRupees,
    advance_recovery: recoveryRupees,
    net_paid: netPaidRupees,
    journal_voucher_id: jv.journal_voucher_id
  };
}

/**
 * End-to-End Phase G Verification Test for Both Gig Workers and Fixed Employees.
 */
function ksRunPhaseGWorkforceTest() {
  const today = ksNowIso_().slice(0, 10);

  // A. Test Gig Worker Flow: Register -> Log Piece-Rate Output -> Supervisor Verify -> Payout
  const gigEmp = ksRegisterWorkerOrEmployee({
    nonce: 'TEST_EMP_GIG_001',
    full_name: 'Ramesh Kumar (Rolling)',
    designation: 'Papad Roller',
    department: 'PRODUCTION',
    employment_type: 'GIG_WORKER'
  });

  const gigWork = ksRecordWorkerProductionEntry({
    nonce: 'TEST_PWE_001',
    production_batch_id: 'PO-20261118-00001',
    employee_id: gigEmp.employee_id,
    work_date: today,
    task_type: 'PAPAD_ROLLING',
    units_completed: 40,
    pay_basis: 'PIECE',
    rate: 15 // INR 15/kg -> INR 600
  });

  ksVerifyWorkerProductionEntry(gigWork.worker_entry_id);

  const gigPay = ksProcessGigWorkerPayout({
    nonce: 'TEST_GIGPAY_001',
    employee_id: gigEmp.employee_id,
    period_start: today,
    period_end: today,
    payment_method: 'CASH'
  });

  // B. Test Fixed Employee Flow: Register -> Advance -> Monthly Salary Payout with Advance Recovery
  const fixEmp = ksRegisterWorkerOrEmployee({
    nonce: 'TEST_EMP_FIX_001',
    full_name: 'Suresh Sharma',
    designation: 'Factory Supervisor',
    department: 'PRODUCTION',
    employment_type: 'FIXED_SALARIED'
  });

  ksRecordEmployeeAdvance({
    nonce: 'TEST_ADV_001',
    employee_id: fixEmp.employee_id,
    amount: 2000,
    notes: 'Mid-month cash advance'
  });

  const fixPay = ksProcessFixedEmployeeSalary({
    nonce: 'TEST_FIXPAY_001',
    employee_id: fixEmp.employee_id,
    salary_month: today.slice(0, 7),
    base_salary: 18000,
    overtime_amount: 1200,
    advance_recovery: 2000,
    payment_method: 'BANK_TRANSFER'
  });

  Logger.log('Phase G Workforce Test Passed (Gig + Fixed): ' + JSON.stringify({ gigPay: gigPay, fixPay: fixPay }));
}
